Buscamos un/a profesional senior para liderar proyectos complejos en un entorno híbrido, con experiencia en stack completo (NestJS/Node, React) y ecosistemas mixtos con Java. Debe diseñar e implementar soluciones escalables, seguras y de alto rendimiento, manteniendo estándares de calidad y prácticas DevOps.

• Experiencia sólida en backend con NestJS y/o Java (Spring Boot) y desarrollo de APIs REST/GraphQL.

• Frontend avanzado en React con gestión de estado y técnicas de performance (memoization, code-splitting, lazy loading).

• Modelado y optimización de bases de datos PostgreSQL y MongoDB.

• Conocimientos de AWS y prácticas de Infraestructura como Código (Terraform/CloudFormation).

• Experiencia en CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes y observabilidad.

• Fuerte capacidad de diseño, revisión de código, mentoría y resolución de problemas en producción.

• Habilidades de comunicación, trabajo en equipo y orientación a resultados.

Responsabilidades:
• Liderar el desarrollo end-to-end (frontend + backend) con foco en calidad, performance, seguridad y escalabilidad.

• Participar en decisiones de arquitectura, estándares de desarrollo y prácticas DevOps para entrega continua.

• Diseñar APIs REST/GraphQL y contratos (OpenAPI/Swagger), gestionar versionado y backward compatibility.

• Backend en NestJS (módulos, DI, guards/interceptors, pipes, CQRS si aplica) y desarrollo de UI en React con performance y DX optimizados.

• Contribuir en componentes Java (Spring Boot u otros) para microservicios, batch, integraciones y tuning de rendimiento.

• Modelado de datos y persistencia en PostgreSQL y MongoDB, con índices, transacciones y optimización de queries.

• Integración con servicios AWS (autenticación, almacenamiento, colas, observabilidad, secretos, networking).

• Aplicar prácticas de ingeniería senior: revisión de código exigente, documentación, mentoring y gestión de deuda técnica.

• Colaborar con Product, QA, DevOps y SRE para asegurar SLAs, resiliencia y releases controlados.

• Desarrollar y mantener componentes de seguridad (JWT/OAuth2, RBAC/ABAC, OWASP Top 10) y pruebas de endurecimiento.

Deseable:
- Certificaciones en AWS, DevOps o similares.
- Experiencia con OpenAPI/Swagger, CQRS, y patterns de microservicios.
- Conocimiento de seguridad aplicada a APIs y prácticas de testing (unitario, integración y end-to-end).

postings.title: Desarrollador Full-Stack
postings.descriptionText:
Requisito excluyente establecido por nuestros clientes en relación con los perfiles profesionales para el desarrollo de software: es imprescindible que los candidatos posean estudios formales en el ámbito del desarrollo de software, obtenidos en Universidades o Institutos técnico-profesionales acreditados en Chile o en cualquier parte del mundo. No son válidos cursos en bootcamps de programación. En caso de solo tener bootcamps su postulación quedará inadmisible automáticamente.
Para cumplir con este requisito, las carreras cursadas por los candidatos deben tener una duración mínima de dos años. Además, es necesario que los candidatos se encuentren titulados de al menos una carrera que cumpla con estos criterios. Es importante destacar que los bootcamps de programación, independientemente de su duración o intensidad, no serán considerados como válidos para cumplir con este requisito de estudios formales.
Experiencia excluyente:

• Al menos 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software contados desde su titulación.

• Poseer título profesional y/o técnico relacionado al desarrollo de software entregado por una Universidad o Instituto. La carrera debe durar al menos 2 años. No son válidos los bootcamp de programación.

Desarrollador fullstack para trabajar fulltime
Haber utilizado 80% o más delas siguientes tecnologías:

• Redis, Docker, Azure, Openshift.

• Microservicios, Webservice y proyectos de integración como: SOAP y REST.

• React JS y Angular

• .net con framework 4.5, .net 7 o superior.

• Microfrontend

• Javascript, Html, Bootstrap y Jquery

• C#, TypeScript, y Node JS.

• Git

• SQL Server versión 2014 – actual y Oracle 11g.

Sabemos que este stack es amplio, por lo que no exigimos conocimiento avanzado pero sí haberlas aplicado en proyectos reales. Lo importante es que cuentes con experiencia práctica en la mayoría ( 80% o más ) y que tengas la disposición para aprender y complementar las áreas donde aún no tengas experiencia profunda.

Responsabilidades:
Creación, mantención e implementación de productos digitales como plataformas web, aplicaciones móviles y/o sitios web.
El desarrollador fullstack trabajará en el área de desarrollo de software junto con los demás desarrolladores, arquitecto de software y jefe de proyecto. Los proyectos serán mayoritariamente plataformas web para instituciones públicas o privadas donde se desempeñará como desarrollador fullstack.
También debe participar en las reuniones de levantamiento de requerimientos con los clientes, estas reuniones son guiadas por el jefe de proyecto y arquitecto de software, debe asistir por dudas y/o consultas sobre los requerimientos.
El cargo reporta directamente al jefe de proyecto de Usercode, todas las mañanas se realiza una daily para conversar sobre avances y posibles bloqueos del día anterior. Durante el día, todos los desarrolladores trabajan en sus actividades planificadas, pudiendo conectarse a una videollamada con todo o parte del equipo de desarrollo para reuniones de trabajo y/o aclarar dudas.

Deseable:
Experiencia previa en proyectos para instituciones públicas o privadas, manejo de entornos de nube (AWS) y habilidades en levantamiento de requisitos con clientes. Nivel de inglés técnico será valorado. Disponibilidad para viajar ocasionalmente según necesidades de proyecto.

Beneficios:
Somos 100% remotos, con flexibilidad para adaptarse a necesidades presenciales puntuales de clientes. Ofrecemos días extras de vacaciones y una modalidad 3x5 que otorga días libres adicionales, además de un día libre especial por cumpleaños, cambio de domicilio o fallecimiento de mascota. Pago de certificaciones seleccionadas para potenciar tu desarrollo profesional. Promovemos pausas activas para el bienestar del equipo y brindamos aguinaldos. Todo dentro de una cultura que prioriza el crecimiento y la calidad de vida laboral.

evidence: Remoto sin región: no dice si contratan desde Argentina.

postings.title: Programador Back-end Python
postings.descriptionText:
Desarrollo con Python:

• Experiencia construyendo servicios backend con Python (FastAPI, Django REST o Flask en producción).

• Uso sólido de la stdlib (asyncio, logging, typing) y organización limpia de módulos.

• Aplicación de Arquitectura Hexagonal, DDD y CQRS en proyectos reales o de práctica avanzada.

• Diseño y consumo de APIs RESTful (gRPC como plus), manejo de lógica de negocio compleja, validaciones consistentes e idempotencia en endpoints críticos.

• Clean Code + SOLID adaptado a Python; pruebas automatizadas (unitarias e integración) con pytest o unittest, mocks y criterio para aplicar TDD de forma pragmática.

Diseño de Arquitectura y Escalabilidad:

• Contenedores con Docker y despliegue en Kubernetes o plataformas equivalentes.

• Microservicios y comunicación asíncrona/event-driven (RabbitMQ/Kafka/NATS/Pub/Sub como plus).

• Integración con PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy, psycopg, migraciones con Alembic) y MongoDB (driver oficial o motor).

• Uso de Redis como caché para alta concurrencia; diseño de claves, TTL y estrategias básicas de invalidación.

• Observabilidad end-to-end: logs estructurados (logging/structlog), métricas (Prometheus) y trazas con OpenTelemetry.

Colaboración y Flujo de Trabajo:

• Documentación clara de decisiones técnicas, arquitectura y endpoints (ADRs, OpenAPI/Swagger, diagramas C4).

• Fluidez con Git bajo flujos colaborativos (feature branches, pull requests, code reviews).

• Participación activa en Scrum/Kanban, entregas iterativas y proactividad para proponer mejoras técnicas y de producto.

• Mentalidad de Solución: Personas que vean los problemas como oportunidades para diseñar y ejecutar soluciones creativas y efectivas.

• Balance entre Velocidad y Estabilidad: Capacidad para entregar con rapidez sin comprometer la calidad ni la estabilidad del software.

• Pasión por los Retos Técnicos: Interés genuino por enfrentar desafíos complejos y aprovecharlos como espacio de aprendizaje y mejora continua.

• Flexible en la Colaboración: Valoramos a quienes se involucran donde pueden aportar, más allá de lo que indica su rol. Creemos que los equipos funcionan mejor cuando cada persona está dispuesta a sumar donde más se le necesita.

• Cultura de Pruebas: Queremos fomentar una mentalidad donde las pruebas son parte del diseño y no un paso posterior. Valoramos saber cuándo aplicar TDD de forma práctica y cuándo priorizar velocidad sin perder calidad.

Responsabilidades:
• Servicios Python de alto rendimiento y mantenibles: manejo de async/await, tareas en background, timeouts, reintentos y optimización básica de recursos.

• APIs robustas y evolutivas: contratos claros, versionado, compatibilidad forward/backward, manejo de errores y límites de uso.

• Consistencia y resiliencia en sistemas distribuidos: workflows claros, deduplicación, reintentos con backoff y estrategias de compensación cuando aplique.

• Capa de datos a escala: buen modelado, índices, uso inteligente de caché, migraciones seguras e integridad de datos.

• Operabilidad y entrega continua: observabilidad integrada, SLOs básicos, CI/CD con pruebas y checks de calidad.

postings.title: Chief of Staff
postings.descriptionText:
• 5+ years of work experience, at least 2 of them owning outcomes rather than tasks.

• Strong written English (C1+) and comfortable spoken English on a live call. You can write to an investor, a customer, and a vendor without sending the same email three times.

• You can turn a messy topic into a short document: situation, options, recommendation, next actions.

• You work comfortably in spreadsheets and can sanity-check costs and tradeoffs.

• You decide without full information, and you say so when you got it wrong.

• Discretion, because you will see everything, including what is not going well.

• Available 9am to 5pm US Pacific, Monday to Friday. I can flex the start to 8am if that suits your day better.

• Reliable internet with a backup plan, quality camera and headset, quiet workspace.

• Modern laptop with 24GB+ RAM.

This is probably not for you if

• You need tasks specified before you can start.

• You are looking for a strategy or advisory role.

• You would rather coordinate work than do it.

• You wait for approval on reversible decisions.

• You need your responsibilities to stay inside a defined box.

• You think AI output is finished work.

On AI
We are a slop-free startup.
AI makes output cheap, it has not made reviewing that output any cheaper. Handing us unfiltered, unreviewed, verbose AI output moves your work onto someone else’s desk. That will get you fired.
Use AI constantly, to take on more than one person could. Read everything before it leaves your hands.

Responsabilidades:
• Projects that do not belong to anyone yet, from framing through delivery.

• Hiring: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and keeping the pipeline honest.

• Contractors and artists, including scope, delivery dates, invoices, and follow-through.

• The operating cadence: what is tracked, what is overdue, what stopped moving without anyone noticing.

• Systems and SOPs for work that currently lives in my head.

• Investor outreach support: build the list, help send the emails, get the calls on the calendar.

• Whatever is on fire this month that nobody else can pick up.

Some of this is unglamorous. Calendar, inbox triage, and travel come with being the founder’s right hand. It is a small slice of the job, not the point of it, but if that part is beneath you then this is not your role.

What success looks like:

First 90 days. You have mapped what is in flight and what has stalled. I have stopped chasing status. You have taken at least two initiatives off me end to end.
Ongoing. You bring me decisions with a recommendation attached rather than problems. Fewer things need me personally each month.

Deseable:
• Former founder, or agency owner and operator.

• Early employee at a startup where everyone did everything.

• Someone who has already been a founder’s right hand.

• Managed complicated client projects end to end.

• Built an operations function from nothing.

Your title matters much less to me than what you actually owned. If you have made payroll, chased an unpaid invoice, or sat across from an angry client, say so.

Beneficios:
Paid in USD, monthly. Fully remote. PTO: 12 days accrued at 1 day per month, increasing to 15 at year 1. Direct access to the founder, with no agency layer in between. GSuite, Notion, Slack, Attio, Monday.com, Loom, GitHub, and whatever AI tooling makes you fastest.

postings.title: Is/IT Security Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
How You Work
Skills and certifications matter, but what determines success here is how you approach the work, especially when the path isn't clearly defined. We're looking for someone who:

• Investigates without being pointed. You notice gaps and keep digging until you understand a problem, whether or not anyone assigned it. This shows up daily in threat identification, vulnerability review, and incident response.

• Builds to last. You fix the immediate issue, then document it, automate what repeats, and hand off work so it runs without you. Runbooks and roadmaps are part of doing the job well, not overhead.

• Moves without waiting. In a remote team, you set your own priorities and make progress without constant direction. In your first 90 days, you'll orient yourself, ask good questions, and get to work.

• Translates risk for the room. You explain risk clearly to engineers, business owners, and leadership, adjusting to your audience without creating unnecessary alarm.

• Shares what you know. You cross-train teammates, write documentation others can use, and treat security as a shared responsibility, not a gate you control.

Experience and Technical Skills

• 3+ years of mid-level cybersecurity experience as a security analyst, security engineer, systems engineer, or similar technical security role.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

• An advanced, professional, or expert-level security certification is preferred.

• Hands-on experience administering or managing at least one enterprise security application or platform.

• Experience leading security projects from planning through implementation, handoff, and continuous improvement.

• Strong grasp of information security principles and incident investigation techniques, with a practical understanding of threats and risk.

• Working knowledge of network, application, endpoint, cloud, identity, and systems security architecture.

• Experience designing and implementing security controls across servers, networks, databases, cloud, and applications.

• Strong troubleshooting, automation, project management, and written communication skills.

Security Platforms and Domain Knowledge

• Experience securing multi-tenant SaaS platforms: tenant isolation, role-based access control, secure configuration, data protection, threat detection, vulnerability remediation, and incident response.

• Hands-on experience with tools such as SIEM, EDR/XD…

Responsabilidades:
• Identify threats and vulnerabilities, conduct complex security investigations, and lead incident response, containment, recovery, and follow-up activities.

• Architect, design, and implement security technologies and processes in partnership with engineering, infrastructure, application, and business owners.

• Manage, administer, monitor, and support multiple security applications; troubleshoot issues and automate operational workflows to reduce risk and improve response time.

• Measure and report on enterprise security capabilities using automated and manual tools, with clear metrics for risk, coverage, and remediation progress.

• Develop and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, runbooks, roadmaps, and business cases, and communicate them clearly to technical and business partners.

• Review new and existing systems before and after implementation to confirm security requirements and complete risk, architecture, and impact assessments.

• Develop, maintain, audit, and enhance security controls across endpoints, servers, networks, databases, cloud services, applications, identities, and data.

• Support security awareness, audits, assessments, compliance requests, and remediation activities aligned with EIC's security and governance requirements.

• Deliver security projects, mentor and cross-train team members, maintain technical documentation, and strengthen tenant isolation and secure-by-default controls across the multi-tenant SaaS platform.

Deseable:
Skills that will make your application stand out: While we value how you approach the work as much as what you already know, candidates with hands-on experience in AWS Security, Incident Response, Vulnerability Management, SIEM, and SOC 2 will be especially well positioned for this role. These skills map directly to what you'll be doing from day one: securing our AWS-based multi-tenant platform, leading investigations when something goes wrong, finding and fixing risk before it becomes a problem, monitoring for threats, and supporting our SOC 2 compliance efforts. If you've worked in any of these areas, tell us about it in your application — specific examples of projects, tools, or incidents you've handled will help us understand your experience.

Beneficios:
Professional Growth

• Build and own a security function spanning cloud infrastructure, application security, compliance, and incident response.

• Work directly with Engineering, Product, and business leadership on security architecture, risk decisions, and platform controls.

• Gain deep multi-tenant SaaS, SOC 2, and AWS experience that supports certifications like CISSP, CISM, and AWS Security Specialty.

• Grow into leadership roles as EIC scales.

Work Environment

• Distributed team with flexible working arrangements.

• A collaborative, detail-oriented culture that values follow-through…

postings.title: Outsystems Consultant / PM
postings.descriptionText:
• 5 años o más de experiencia como Business Analyst, Product Owner o Consultor Funcional en proyectos de transformación digital.

• Experiencia comprobable en levantamiento de requerimientos con áreas de negocio y tecnología.

• Dominio de técnicas de entrevistas, facilitación de workshops y mapeo de procesos.

• Experiencia elaborando historias de usuario, criterios de aceptación y gestionando backlogs.

• Conocimientos y experiencia en documentación de modelos operativos, roles, matrices RACI y flujos de gobierno.

• Experiencia en gestión y seguimiento de proyectos tecnológicos: planificación, actas, riesgos, compromisos y reportes.

• Excelente comunicación oral y escrita en español, con capacidad de síntesis y presentación de información para audiencias ejecutivas.

• Capacidad para trabajar con múltiples stakeholders, facilitar acuerdos y gestionar prioridades.

¿Qué habilidades valoramos?
Buscamos una persona con pensamiento estructurado, autonomía y orientación a resultados, que destaque por:

• Escucha activa, comunicación asertiva y capacidad de negociación.

• Neutralidad y criterio para facilitar acuerdos entre áreas con diferentes perspectivas.

• Organización, rigurosidad y atención al detalle.

• Capacidad para convertir conversaciones complejas en decisiones y acciones concretas.

• Pensamiento analítico y visión integral del negocio.

• Proactividad, colaboración y compromiso con los resultados.

• Criterio para gestionar el alcance y distinguir las actividades de diagnóstico y planificación de aquellas correspondientes a la ejecución.

Responsabilidades:
Análisis y diagnóstico del negocio

• Realizar entrevistas y workshops con stakeholders de negocio y tecnología.

• Levant ar y documentar procesos actuales, flujos de demanda y mecanismos de toma de decisiones.

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora y necesidades de transformación digital.

• Elaborar documentación funcional de los canales y soluciones bancarias involucradas.

Gobierno y modelo operativo

• Participar en la definición y evaluación de alternativas de gobierno tecnológico, incluyendo modelos de Centro de Excelencia (CoE).

• Documentar roles, responsabilidades, matrices RACI, flujos operativos y mecanismos de decisión.

• Facilitar sesiones de trabajo para alinear áreas y alcanzar acuerdos.

• Colaborar en la definición de indicadores de gestión y operación.

Estrategia funcional y preparación del piloto

• Trabajar junto al Tech Lead en el levantamiento de capacidades y la evaluación de alternativas para reutilizar, modernizar o construir soluciones.

• Facilitar workshops para definir el alcance funcional de un piloto de Suite de Pagos.

• Elaborar épicas, historias de usuario y criterios de aceptación, idealmente bajo el formato Given-When-Then.

• Organizar y priorizar el backlog inicial.

• Apoyar la identificación de dependencias y la preparación del roadmap de implementación.

Gestión y seguimiento del proyecto

• Elaborar y mantener el plan de trabajo, cronograma y seguimiento de entregables.

• Coordinar reuniones, agendas y sesiones con stakeholders.

• Documentar acuerdos, decisiones y actas de reunión de manera oportuna.

• Gestionar riesgos, observaciones, dependencias y compromisos.

• Preparar reportes semanales de avance para los responsables del proyecto.

• Asegurar la trazabilidad y el cumplimiento de los hitos establecidos.

Deseable:
• Experiencia en el sector bancario, especialmente en canales digitales, medios de pago o banca empresas.

• Conocimiento o participación en proyectos desarrollados con OutSystems u otras plataformas low-code.

• Experiencia en Centros de Excelencia (CoE) o marcos ágiles a escala.

• Certificaciones CBAP, ECBA, PSPO, CSPO o PMI-PBA.

• Manejo de Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro o Google Workspace.

• Experiencia definiendo métricas de producto, flujo o adopción tecnológica.

Beneficios:
✨ Pago en USD.
✨ Vacaciones anuales pagadas.
✨ 4 medios días administrativos + medio día libre por tu cumpleaños y el de tus hijos.
✨ Bonificación y días especiales por matrimonio o nacimiento de hijos.
✨ Aporte mensual para actividad física (FitnessDoer).
✨ Acceso a biblioteca digital y formación continua.
✨ Cultura de trabajo flexible, sin burocracia ni código de vestimenta.

• You write clearly and briefly. This is the core skill of the job. Everything a customer reads will be written by you.

• You are technically literate. You do not need to write code, but you should read an error message, understand what an API or a database is, and describe a bug precisely enough that an engineer can act on it without asking you three questions.

• At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time.

Responsabilidades:
Product. What we build next.

• Own the weekly priority list. Ranked, with the reason behind each item. The founder approves it in 15 minutes on Monday.

• Write tickets clear enough that our engineers never ask a follow-up question.

• Keep our project board actually accurate. Today it is not.

• Test features when they ship and close the loop with whoever asked for it.

Discovery. Where the signal comes from.

• Run 3 to 5 customer calls a week. Record them, write the notes, find the pattern.

• Own Intercom. You are the first response to every customer message, every day. This is where most of the signal lives.

• Collect every request from every channel into one place.

Communication. Telling people what changed.

• Write and send release notes when we ship. Our users should never discover a feature by accident.

• Own downtime and incident communication. When something breaks, you tell people what happened and when it is fixed.

• Write and maintain our help docs.

• Update marketing copy and write blog pages as the product changes.

• Help us find users outside our current channel.

How you ramp. We are three people. You will be useful in week two, not month three.

• Week 1. You listen. Sit in every internal call, read every Intercom thread, ask a huge amount of questions. Being annoying with questions is the job.

• Week 2. You shadow the founder. You answer Intercom with him reviewing, and write your first release notes.

• Week 3 to 4. Intercom is yours. You run your first customer calls.

• Month 2. The weekly priority list is yours.

• Month 3 and on. Help docs, marketing and blog open up.

• You can ship small UI and copy fixes yourself. Not features, just the small stuff.

• You have worked at an early stage startup, employee 1 through 10. You decide without being told.

• You have used Notion, Linear, or Intercom.

Beneficios:
• 100% remote, permanently. We have never had an office.

• A small team where your work is visible immediately. No layers.

• Direct access to the founder and to real customers from day one.

• Real ownership of an area, not a piece of someone else's process.

Send your application through Get on Board. In your cover letter, answer one question:
Tell us about a time you changed what a team was building because of something a customer told you. What did they say, and what did you do with it?

postings.title: Founding Lead
postings.descriptionText:
• 5+ years of experience in mobile games product management, live game operations, production, or studio/portfolio leadership.

• Strong experience with F2P casual mobile games.

• Experience with puzzle, word, card/solitaire, jigsaw, hidden object, match-3, or similar evergreen genres is a strong plus.

• Proven ability to improve mature or live products through iteration, LiveOps, monetization work, and data-driven testing.

• Strong understanding of retention, ARPDAU, LTV, ROAS, ad monetization, IAP, LiveOps, UA readiness, and product economics.

• Experience building or leading small cross-functional teams.

• Ability to hire and manage remote contributors across product, design, engineering, analytics, QA, and art/content.

• Comfortable working with older products, imperfect data, technical limitations, technical debt, and practical trade-offs.

• Ability to coordinate with centralized UA, AdOps, analytics, and publishing teams without losing product ownership.

• Strong communication skills and a clear decision-making style.

• Fluent English required.

• Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.

• LATAM work experience or strong understanding of the LATAM gaming talent market is a plus.

• Existing network in the Argentina/Buenos Aires gaming community is a strong plus.

Responsabilidades:
• Build and lead the initial LATAM-based game revival team.

• Recruit, select, onboard, and manage the first key team members, including game design/LiveOps, engineering, and, as needed, QA/release and art/content contributors.

• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and business results for assigned games.

• Lead diagnostics across candidate titles and recommend which game to revive first.

• Define the revival plan for each selected game.

• Audit existing games across FTUE, retention, monetization, content, ad logic, store promise, technical health, LiveOps, and UA readiness.

• Create a fast release cadence focused on measurable product improvements rather than large, unfocused redesigns.

• Define and run experiments to improve retention, engagement, monetization, LiveOps performance, and UA readiness.

• Build a practical LiveOps process: content calendar, events, offers, daily challenges, seasonal updates, and player communication where relevant.

• Coordinate with customer UA, AdOps, analytics, and infrastructure teams while keeping product decisions owned by the revival team.

• Establish dashboards, KPI reviews, experiment readouts, and scale/stop/continue decisions.

• Make clear ship/stop/scale/sunset recommendations based on data and product judgment.

• Establish the operating rhythm of the new team: weekly KPI reviews, product planning, release planning, and post-test readouts.

Deseable:
A hands-on mobile game operator, not a corporate coordinator. You have enough product judgment to know what matters, enough leadership ability to build a small team, enough data discipline to avoid guessing, and enough pragmatism to revive existing games without trying to rebuild everything from scratch. You understand mature games, LiveOps, monetization, legacy audiences, limited resources, and business accountability.
This role is best suited for someone who wants to run a small studio-like operation and be accountable for making revived games real products again.

Beneficios:
Benefits will be discussed at the interview with stakeholders.

postings.title: Field Validation Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Hay dos requisitos excluyentes. Si no los cumples, este no es tu rol, pero si los cumples, sigue leyendo:

• Licencia de conducir vigente y auto propio disponible durante los 4 meses. Vas a manejar rutas urbanas, de carretera y nocturnas de forma sistemática durante meses. Te reembolsamos el combustible.

• Un teléfono propio de gama alta (iPhone reciente o Android flagship). Lo integramos a la matriz de prueba como caso de uso real: con tu SIM, tu uso diario, tu patrón de carga. Solo instalamos la app de referencia del proyecto — nada más.

• Debes residir actualmente en Chile, Argentina o Perú. El cargo es 100% remoto y no requiere asistencia a oficina; sin embargo, debes tener disponibilidad para salir a realizar pruebas en terreno y ejecutar las rutas definidas para el proyecto, incluyendo rutas urbanas, de carretera, nocturnas y eventualmente durante fines de semana.

• No necesitamos que asistas a una oficina, sino que tengas disponibilidad para salir a terreno y realizar pruebas que permitan validar el funcionamiento de la SDK. Estas deberán ejecutarse según las rutas y condiciones definidas para el proyecto, incluyendo trayectos urbanos, de carretera, nocturnos y, eventualmente, durante fines de semana.

• Contrato por 4 meses, full-time, con conversación de continuidad en el mes 3.

Responsabilidades:
Estamos validando un SDK de telemetría: una librería que detecta viajes, mide eventos de conducción y captura GPS y sensores en background de dispositivos móviles.
Buscamos a la persona que ejecutará las campañas de pruebas en terreno sobre una matriz de distintos dispositivos —iPhone, Samsung, y los fabricantes con gestión agresiva de batería— y así generar la evidencia con la que podamos validar este SDK.
Tendrás la responsabilidad de administrar los tiempos para cumplir objetivos, digerir la data cruda del field testing en una flota variada de dispositivos y analizarla en dashboards y reportes estructurados que el equipo pueda accionar.
¿Que vas a hacer?

• Ejecutar ciclos semanales de casos de prueba guionados.

• Ejecutar maniobras controladas de frenada y aceleración.

• Ser dueño del dashboard de seguimiento en Grafana: lo construyes con nosotros e IA en las primeras semanas y después es tuyo. Lo mira todo el equipo.

• Coordinar los ciclos de prueba con el equipo y mantener el catálogo de casos versionado.

• Reportar hallazgos con calidad de reproducción: pasos, logs, modelo, versión de OS y configuración del fabricante.

Deseable:
• Eres recién egresado/a de informática, ingeniería o una carrera afín.

• Tienes base técnica para leer logs y moverte en ADB o Xcode — no necesitas programar.

• Usas herramientas de IA en tu propio trabajo con soltura: acá son parte del método, no un plus.

• Tienes autonomía para trabajar solo/a en terreno la mayor parte del tiempo, contra un checklist, sin supervisión diaria.

Beneficios:

•Día de cumpleaños libre 🥳
•Seguro complementario de salud en Chile y reembolso por seguro médico en el resto de LATAM🏥

• Habilidades blandas: Habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para trabajar en entornos dinámicos.

• Habilidades técnicas:
• AWS (Amazon Web Services): Experiencia sólida en la implementación y gestión de soluciones en la nube utilizando servicios de AWS.

• Networking: Conocimientos en configuración y gestión de redes dentro de un entorno de infraestructura en la nube (subredes, VPN, VPC, etc.)

• Infraestructura Multi-región y Alta Disponibilidad (HA): Implementación de soluciones de alta disponibilidad y recuperación ante desastres en AWS.

• Terraform: Automatización de la infraestructura como código con Terraform.

• AWS Lambda (Python): Desarrollo y mantenimiento de funciones Lambda utilizando Python para aplicaciones sin servidor.

• Amazon EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, Route 53: Experiencia en el uso de estos servicios de AWS para administrar infraestructura.

• Monitoreo y Gestión de Logs: Uso de herramientas como CloudWatch, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) para monitoreo y análisis de logs.

• Seguridad en la nube: Implementación de buenas prácticas de seguridad en AWS, incluyendo control de acceso, cifrado y auditoría.

Responsabilidades:
• Evolución y Arquitectura de la Infraestructura: Evaluar de forma crítica la infraestructura actual y liderar su evolución. Tu misión será robustecer nuestra arquitectura en la nube (AWS), asegurando que el ciclo de vida de los recursos diarios (creación, modificación, operación y eliminación) se ejecute bajo estándares rigurosos de alta disponibilidad, resiliencia y alineación absoluta con el negocio.

• Consolidación de la Automatización (IaC): Tomar nuestras prácticas actuales de infraestructura como código (ej. CloudFormation) y control de versiones, y llevarlas al siguiente nivel de madurez. Buscamos estandarizar y auditar nuestros flujos de aprovisionamiento para que cualquier cambio sea trazable, predecible y metodológicamente impecable.

• Gobierno y Seguridad Continua: Ir más allá de configurar servicios de seguridad (IAM, KMS). Serás responsable de integrar la seguridad desde el diseño, evaluando proactivamente nuestras políticas para crear cimientos sólidos que preparen a la plataforma para cumplir con los más altos y rigurosos estándares de la industria y la calidad empresarial.

postings.descriptionText:
Must have

• 4+ years professional WordPress development including custom themes, ACF, and multilingual setups (Polylang/WPML)

• Deep hands-on Pantheon experience: dev/test/live workflow, multidev, Git mode vs SFTP mode, Autopilot, terminus CLI, and the platform's quirks (e.g., update-core hidden on test/live)

• WP Engine deployment and backup workflows

• Strong Git discipline: feature branches, clean merges, understanding why a branch 14 commits behind master is a red flag

• Front-end build pipelines: SCSS, gulp, npm — and the judgment to never commit compiled output without its source

• A documented QA habit: you can describe, step by step, what you check after a plugin update and why

• Clear written English; comfortable communicating directly with agency partners and, when needed, their clients

• Demonstrated fluency working alongside AI assistants (Claude, Copilot, or similar) in a real production workflow — and clear judgment about where AI output must be human-verified

Responsabilidades:
Run monthly plugin, theme, and WP core updates across a large Pantheon/WP Engine roster using multidev and Autopilot branches — never directly on live
Take a manual backup before every live push, without exception, and verify restore points exist before touching production
Perform structured post-deployment QA on live (key templates, archive pages, plugin-dependent modules like Ajax Load More, Polylang, ACF-driven layouts) so breakage is caught by us, not the client
Know and track plugin-specific quirks per site (e.g., plugins that need deactivate/reactivate after core updates, incompatible importers that must be disabled before a core bump) and maintain that knowledge in a living runbook
Work exclusively through source: edit SCSS/JS sources and recompile via gulp — never patch minified files directly; keep branches synced with master and named after their feature
Respect content integrity: never pull databases down over environments carrying client content; never restore backups onto a live or test environment without confirming what will be lost
Deliver monthly maintenance reports on time, in the correct format and folders, with accurate hosting/backup details per site — reports must reflect what actually shipped to live
Triage urgent "site down" flags fast, communicate root cause honestly (including when it was our push), and close tickets only when the fix is verified on live
Use AI tooling (Claude, Claude Code, and similar) as a daily co-worker: drafting QA checklists, diffing changelogs for breaking changes before updates, generating regression test lists per site, summarizing incident post-mortems, and accelerating debugging — while personally verifying everything AI produces before it ships

Deseable:

• ManageWP or similar fleet-management tooling

• Security hygiene: Sucuri/Wordfence triage, malware cleanup, understanding why code that silently creates admin users must never reach a client repo

• Accessibility (WCAG) scanning and remediation basics

• PHP 8.x migration experience (typed errors, deprecations)

• Experience writing client-facing maintenance reports.

• Competencias en crear e integrar módulos nativos como extensiones para React Native, mejorando funcionalidades cuando la librería base es insuficiente.

Responsabilidades:

• Desarrollar aplicaciones usando React Native que sean eficientes, escalables y con alto rendimiento en dispositivos Android e iOS.

• Integrar módulos nativos en Android (Java/Kotlin) y iOS (Swift/Objective-C) para complementar funcionalidades específicas que requieren acceso profundo al hardware o al sistema operativo móvil.

• Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de backend para la integración de APIs REST y GraphQL garantizando transporte eficiente y seguro de datos.

• Optimizar la navegación y el manejo de estados para mejorar la experiencia del usuario, evitando cuellos de botella y problemas de rendimiento.

• Realizar debugging avanzado y aplicar técnicas de optimización específicas para entornos móviles.

• Crear y mantener módulos SDK nativos, facilitando su uso dentro del entorno React Native.

• Participar activamente en la mejora continua de procesos y prácticas de desarrollo, incluyendo la integración continua y entrega continua (CI/CD).

• Trabajar de manera coordinada con diseñadores utilizando herramientas como Figma para asegurar la correcta implementación de interfaces visuales y usabilidad.

Deseable:

• Familiaridad con prácticas CI/CD en proyectos móviles, incluyendo automatización de compilaciones, pruebas y despliegues.

• Experiencia en trabajo con herramientas de diseño como Figma para asegurar la fidelidad en el producto final.

• Conocimiento en el uso de librerías avanzadas para animaciones, mapas o multimedia en React Native.

• Participación en proyectos open source o contribuciones a la comunidad React Native o desarrollo móvil en general.

Beneficios:
En Mediastream ofrecemos un entorno laboral dinámico y colaborativo que fomenta la innovación constante y el crecimiento profesional continuo. Promovemos una cultura inclusiva basada en el apoyo mutuo y el desarrollo tanto personal como profesional. Contamos con amplias oportunidades de capacitación en tecnologías de vanguardia y trabajamos en conjunto con un equipo de alto nivel para enfrentar desafíos relevantes dentro de la industria del streaming y distribución audiovisual.

Fundada en 2004, OLIVER es la primera y única empresa del mundo especializada en diseñar, crear y gestionar agencias internas, como así también ecosistemas de marketing a medida para las distintas marcas con las que trabajamos. Actualmente, contamos en nuestro haber con más de 300 clientes, situados en más de 40 países. Nuestro modelo único impulsa la creatividad y la eficiencia, lo que nos permite ofrecer soluciones personalizadas que impactan de forma positiva en el público.

Como parte de The Brandtech Group, estamos a la vanguardia del desarrollo de la tecnología a través de la IA más avanzada para revolucionar la forma en que creamos y realizamos nuestro trabajo. Nuestras soluciones de IA mejoran la eficiencia, despiertan la creatividad e impulsan la toma de decisiones acertadas, lo que permite a nuestros equipos producir resultados innovadores e impactantes.

La oportunidad:

Estamos en busqueda de un(a) Creative Director r esponsable de crear campañas excepcionales, contenido creativo y visual digital, con el objetivo de comunicar las marcas al público objetivo, de una manera diferente e innovadora, generando compromiso, sorpresa e identificación . Con modalidad híbrida, quien ocupe este rol combinará dirección creativa de alto nivel con gestión directa de equipos y relación fluida con clientes.

Lo que vas a hacer:

• Dirigir, liderar e inspirar al equipo creativo, acompañando su desarrollo y desempeño cotidiano.

• Contribuir a la ideación, desarrollo e implementación de conceptos creativos alineados con las necesidades del cliente, el consumidor y el mercado competitivo.

• Establecer una relación directa con el cliente, participar activamente en las reuniones de briefing y aportar ideas y soluciones concretas desde el inicio del proceso.

• Elaborar y presentar propuestas creativas con claridad, coherencia y solidez, representando al equipo frente al cliente.

• Dirigir el arte y el diseño de todas las iniciativas de la marca, con especial foco en el ámbito digital.

• Liderar proyectos de alta complejidad: producir campañas viables dentro de los plazos y el presupuesto establecidos.

• Guiar al equipo durante las instancias de briefing para orientar el trabajo hacia los mejores resultados.

• Crear piezas y contenidos alineados con los deadlines y lineamientos de cada marca.

Lo que traés:

• Trayectoria sólida en dirección creativa, con experiencia probada liderando equipos creativos;

• Gran capacidad para el desarrollo de conceptos e ideas con visión estratégica de la creatividad.

• Habilidad para presentar y defender ideas de forma clara y elocuente, tanto internamente como para stakeholders.

• Experiencia en gestión de personas: feedback, mentoring y desarrollo de equipos creativos.

• Conocimiento profundo del entorno digital: redes sociales, display, performance, eventos y diferentes modelos de negocio.

• Comprensión del mercado, el comportamiento del consumidor, el desempeño de la competencia y las tendencias del sector.

• Conocimientos avanzados de fotografía y tipografía aplicados al trabajo creativo.

• Sólido conocimiento y aplicación de metodologías ágiles, incluyendo Scrum.

• Experiencia en proyectos de e-commerce.

• Conocimiento de las principales plataformas de Marketing Digital, especialmente Facebook Ads y Google Ads.

• Comprensión de las entregas creativas digitales y de las especificaciones técnicas de archivos digitales.

• Excelente comunicación escrita y habilidad para relacionarse con clientes de manera profesional y asertiva.

• Alta capacidad de organización, planificación y gestión del tiempo en entornos de alta demanda.

• Perfil analítico: capacidad para leer datos de rendimiento, elaborar informes y tomar decisiones basadas en información.

• Conocimiento general del segmento CPG (productos de consumo masivo): mercado, comportamiento del consumidor, tendencias y competencia.

• Habilidad para trabajar de forma colaborativa en equipos multidisciplinarios.

• Conocimiento de diferentes modelos de comunicación y técnicas publicitarias.

Nice to Have:

• Conocimientos de diseño gráfico y manejo del paquete Adobe.

• Experiencia en gestión de campañas de anuncios pagos en Facebook, Instagram, Google y sus partners de búsqueda.

• Conocimientos o interés en inteligencia artificial aplicada a flujos de trabajo creativos o de producción.

• Inglés profesional oral y escrito.

• Interés activo por las nuevas tecnologías, redes sociales y tendencias culturales locales y globales.

• Ser ambiciosos para alcanzar el éxito.

• Ser imaginativos para superar los límites de lo posible.

• Ser inspiradores para realizar un trabajo innovador.

• Estar siempre aprendiendo y escuchando para comprender.

• Estar enfocado en los resultados para superar las expectativas.

• Ser activamente pro inclusivos y antirracistas en nuestra comunidad, clientes y creaciones

Nosso processo de recrutamento não utiliza inteligência artificial para seleção. Utilizamos a IA para apoiar a eficiência e a consistência, e não para substituir o julgamento humano. A avaliação e a seleção de candidatos são realizadas sem o uso de IA para triagem ou tomada de decisão. Estamos comprometidos com uma experiência justa, cuidadosa e equitativa para cada candidato.

OLIVER, que forma parte del Grupo Brandtech, es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a crear entornos de trabajo inclusivos en los que se motive a todos los empleados a alcanzar su máximo potencial, valorando y respetando las diferencias individuales. Todos los candidatos serán tenidos en cuenta sin distinción de raza, etnia, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, edad, neurodivergencia, estado de discapacidad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la legislación local.

OLIVER ha establecido ambiciosos objetivos medioambientales en torno a la sostenibilidad, con objetivos de reducción de emisiones basados en la ciencia. Colectivamente, trabajamos para cumplir nuestra misión, integrando la sostenibilidad en todos los departamentos y en todas las fases del ciclo de vida de los proyectos.

Fundada en 2004, OLIVER es la primera y única empresa del mundo especializada en diseñar, crear y gestionar agencias internas, como así también ecosistemas de marketing a medida para las distintas marcas con las que trabajamos. Actualmente, contamos en nuestro haber con más de 300 clientes, situados en más de 40 países. Nuestro modelo único impulsa la creatividad y la eficiencia, lo que nos permite ofrecer soluciones personalizadas que impactan de forma positiva en el público.

Como parte de The Brandtech Group, estamos a la vanguardia del desarrollo de la tecnología a través de la IA más avanzada para revolucionar la forma en que creamos y realizamos nuestro trabajo. Nuestras soluciones de IA mejoran la eficiencia, despiertan la creatividad e impulsan la toma de decisiones acertadas, lo que permite a nuestros equipos producir resultados innovadores e impactantes.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Looking to do the best work of your career?

Do it with Dove , one of the most respected global brands on social. We’re building a team across 15 markets to own Dove’s social presence end to end: insight and ideation, platform-native creative, publishing, live ops, and community. From the first idea to the final reply, you’ll shape how Dove shows up every day and create work that influences culture.

You’ll move at newsroom speed with rigorous craft—launching ideas that travel, partnering with standout creators, and turning comments into conversations that become cultural moments. The brief is straightforward: make Dove the most culturally relevant brand on social. You’ll have the scale, purpose, and creative freedom to make it real.

If you’re motivated by ideas that matter, sharpened by data, and committed to making the internet more positive, this is the place to do it. Bring your craft and your courage. Together we’ll build culture—not just content—and do the best work of our careers.

You'll be close to Dove's social channels every day, supporting the planning, publishing, and community engagement that keeps the brand's social presence consistent, culturally relevant, and growing. Based in London with a hybrid working arrangement (minimum 3 days per week on-site), you'll work alongside the Senior Social Media Manager, content creators, strategists, and the Dove brand team to ensure content lands on time, on brand, and on platform. Your understanding of how social channels work, what audiences respond to, and how to keep a content operation moving smoothly will be central to the studio's output.

We support flexible working and are open to different arrangements. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the process.

You'll be one of the people who makes Dove's social presence happen, day in, day out. From content ideation, trend tracking and scheduling to community engagement, copy writing, and performance tracking, you'll manage the daily rhythm of Dove's social channels and ensure the brand shows up consistently and compellingly across platforms.

This is a role for someone who is organised, culturally-fluent, and genuinely enthusiastic about social media as a discipline. You understand what makes content work on TikTok versus Instagram versus YouTube, you can write copy that fits the tone of each platform, and you notice when something is trending before it peaks. We're looking for someone who is as comfortable managing a content calendar and pulling a performance report as they are drafting a reactive post or briefing a content creator on an emerging format.

Success means channels that run smoothly, content that consistently meets brand and platform standards, a community that feels listened to and engaged, and performance data that shows steady growth in reach, engagement, and brand affinity.

Content Planning and Publishing

• Create and manage Dove's social content calendars across TikTok and Instagramand emerging platforms, ensuring a consistent cadence of planned, campaign, and reactive content

• Schedule and publish content across platforms, ensuring every post meets brand guidelines, platform specifications, and accessibility standards (captions, alt text, format requirements)

• Write and adapt social copy for each platform, ensuring Dove's tone of voice is consistent, compelling, and native to the channel

• Coordinate with the creative team and content creators to ensure assets are delivered on time, correctly formatted, and ready to publish

• Support the Senior Social Media Manager in planning always-on content, campaign activations, and seasonal or product-launch moments

Community Management and Engagement

• Monitor Dove's social channels daily, responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely, on-brand, and thoughtful manner

• Engage proactively with Dove's audience, fostering a sense of community and connection that reflects the brand's values of inclusivity and real beauty

• Track trending topics, hashtags, cultural moments, and platform features, flagging relevant opportunities to the wider team and, where appropriate, drafting reactive content

• Identify opportunities to surprise and delight Dove's audience through creative engagement, timely responses, and community-building moments

Performance Tracking and Reporting

• Track and report on social content performance across platforms, compiling regular reports on key metrics including reach, engagement, saves, shares, and audience growth

• Use native platform analytics and social management tools to monitor content effectiveness, identify trends, and flag insights that can inform future content decisions

• Support the Senior Social Media Manager and Data Analyst in building a continuous learning loop between content output and performance data

postings.title: Client Account Manager II
postings.descriptionText:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

Great brands help make Pinners’ inspirations a reality, and we’re looking for a Client Account Manager II to help lead the way.

In this role, you will support one of Pinterest’s most strategic businesses in LATAM, partnering closely on the Mercado Libre business across Hispanic markets . You will help advertisers get the most out of Pinterest by driving strong campaign execution, performance optimization, measurement rigor, and clear client communication. You’ll collaborate closely with sales and cross-functional teams while helping bring structure, insights, and momentum to a complex regional account.

What you’ll do:

• Build and nurture strong relationships with partners by proactively communicating on campaign performance, optimizations, updates, and growth opportunities

• Partner closely with the Client Partner to support a complex regional business across multiple Hispanic LATAM markets

• Ensure partner objectives and requirements are met by coordinating effectively with internal teams including Measurement, Product Marketing, Creative Strategy, Performance Solutions, and others

• Gain a deep understanding of partner business goals and turn data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations

• Own the “how” conversation with advertisers by advising on targeting, bidding, creative, measurement, pacing, and optimization approaches

• Become an expert in Pinterest campaign best practices and performance solutions, and act as a trusted resource on performance-related opportunities

• Ensure campaign setup and execution are strong, monitor results closely, troubleshoot issues, and take action to course-correct when needed

• Interpret and communicate campaign results clearly so that partners understand impact, opportunity, and next steps

• Support QBRs, performance recaps, and other business reviews with strong analysis and clear recommendations

• Actively participate in client meetings, helping explain complex solutions in a simple, credible, and commercially relevant way

• Handle resistance, objections, and product questions thoughtfully and professionally

• Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities that can contribute to account growth and team revenue goals

• Maintain strong fluency in Pinterest ad products, performance solutions, and evolving roadmap updates

• Partner efficiently with cross-functional teams to resolve issues, answer technical questions, and support business growth

• Pitch new performance products and best practices at scale where relevant

What we’re looking for:

• Experience in digital advertising, account management, or media with responsibility for campaign performance and client communication

• Strong track record of turning data into compelling recommendations and business actions

• Experience managing complex workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines with strong attention to detail

• Strong understanding of campaign optimization, performance measurement, attribution, and analytical problem-solving

• Experience with technical and performance-oriented media solutions, including areas such as tagging, measurement, analytics, shopping, search, display, paid social, or lower-funnel advertising

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in person, on the phone, and in writing

• Ability to work cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams

• Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow-through

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and shifting priorities

• Experience managing sophisticated client or agency relationships is strongly preferred

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as math, economics, marketing, business, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• Candidates must be based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. This role will require occasional travel to a Pinterest office for in-person collaboration 1–2 times every 6 months.

postings.title: Sr. Client Partner
postings.descriptionText:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

Great brands help make Pinner’s inspirations a reality, and we’re looking for an experienced Client Partner to help lead the way. You’ll help spread awareness and comprehension of Pinterest Business tools in Argentina, Chile and Columbia. You’ll develop strong brand relationships and work closely to help them get the most out of Pinterest's solutions and meet their business goals.

What you’ll do:

• Retain, grow and diversify the value delivered to our partners, ultimately growing Pinterest revenue as a result across Argentina, Chile and Columbia.

• Coordinate negotiations with partners to create joint business plans, learning agendas and have deep understanding of partners' business and media objectives. Responsible for stakeholder management, decision maker relationships. Arrange regular meetings with partners to discuss their requirements, learn about their objectives and remove roadblocks for partners.

• Orchestrate internal support for the client and agency to solve strategic challenges, from measurement to creative and technical integration to deliver consistent goals and objectives of the partners on a day to day.

• Produce and deliver weekly business updates outlining the current business status, key opportunities, and the accuracy of the sales pipeline.

• Specifically own the “why” Pinterest conversation with advertisers to influence the way they think about the platform’s role in their overarching media mix.

• Present tailored digital media strategies to partners that address their specific marketing needs and align with their business goals. Have a deep understanding of partners’ business goals and turn data into compelling stories through actionable insights to help them succeed. Leverage knowledge of the broader digital and advertising landscape, competitive platforms, and industry landscape to provide insights.

• Apply knowledge of customer goals and joint strategy to increase ad investment. Secure and grow revenue for Pinterest through proactive planning, pitching, deal negotiations, and upselling. Unlock new lines of revenue by navigating across multiple lines of business, marketing objectives, regions. Influences and secures budget allocation from Search, Social, Brand, Video, Agency and other relevant teams.

• Providing partners with guidance and expertise on product and service best practices and features. Be highly knowledgeable about all relevant Pinterest ad product features and capable of clearly explaining their benefits to a customer. Maintains up-to-date education and fluency on evolving product roadmap and iterations. Efficiently interfaces with appropriate cross-functional teams to answer product-related questions or challenges when needed.

What we’re looking for:

• Expertise in digital advertising and media sales including campaign optimization, analytical problem solving, and product/platform knowledge.

• Experience in marketing/advertising/digital, with specific technical acumen in Search/Shopping/Display/Social advertising technologies.

• Established industry relationships and experience working with marketing leaders within client organizations across Latin America.

• Proven track record of exceeding revenue goals.

• Ability to translate partner value across various levels, such as executive, operational, creative, media, and analytics teams.

• Strong team player and ability to succeed in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment while maintaining high levels of operational rigor, digital acumen, and business excellence.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

• Candidates must be based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. This role will require occasional travel to a Pinterest office for in-person collaboration 1–2 times every 6 months.

postings.title: AI Growth Automation Engineer - Bogotá (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for someone who gets a kick out of turning "someone should really automate this" into a working tool by next week. You'll sit at the intersection of Lifecycle, Sales, and AI — building the agents, workflows, and internal products that let Clara prospect, sell, and onboard faster and smarter than a headcount-only approach ever could. This isn't a "use AI to write better emails" role. It's a build role. You'll ship things: SDR co-pilots, outbound agents, lifecycle automations, onboarding flows — and you'll own whether they actually move pipeline and activation, not just whether they're clever.

You will:

• Build AI-powered prospecting & SDR tooling: design and ship agents/workflows that find, qualify, and engage prospects, and that get meetings on AEs' calendars — using tools like Amplemarket, Clay, HubSpot, and LLM APIs, glued together with n8n or custom code.

• Own lifecycle automation end to end: build and iterate on onboarding, activation, and retention flows across email, WhatsApp, and push, using Customer.io and our internal data stack, with AI doing the heavy lifting on personalization, timing, and content generation.

• Design the SDR-to-AE handoff as a system, not a manual process: instrument lead scoring, routing, and handoff logic so reps spend time on conversations, not admin.

• Prototype fast, validate faster: you're expected to go from idea to working internal tool in days, test it against real pipeline/activation metrics, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does.

• Partner cross-functionally: work directly with Sales, SDR leadership, Lifecycle, and Data/Eng to identify where automation unlocks the most value, and to make sure what you build actually gets adopted.

• Turn data into iteration: use Metabase, HubSpot, and Customer.io data to measure what your builds are actually doing to CAC payback, meetings booked, activation rate, and pipeline generated — and report on it in plain, honest terms.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

• +2 years of hands-on experience building automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products — not just using AI tools, but shipping things that use APIs, LLMs, or agent frameworks to do real work.

• Experience with workflow/automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or equivalent) and comfort integrating APIs across systems (CRM, marketing automation, sales tooling).

• Working familiarity with CRM/lifecycle platforms such as HubSpot, Customer.io, or Salesforce.

• Enough technical fluency to read/write basic scripts (Python, JavaScript) or work closely with engineers to get something shipped — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you can't be blocked waiting for one.

• Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to explain what you built and why it matters to non-technical stakeholders and executives.

• A bias toward building and testing over planning — you'd rather ship a rough version this week than a perfect spec next month.

Nice to haves

• Background in Lifecycle Marketing, RevOps, Sales Engineering, Product, or Software Engineering (any of these paths is fine — we care about what you've built, not your job title history).

• Direct experience with sales engagement/AI prospecting tools (Amplemarket, Clay, Apollo, or similar).

• Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and basic prompt engineering.

• Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech, ideally with an SDR/AE motion.

• Startup or small-team experience where you owned something end to end, from idea to production.

• Portuguese proficiency (not required, but useful across our MX/BR/CO/AR footprint).

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Design Engineer, Web (AI-Native) - Hybrid
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do
You will design and build our website. This is a hands-on role for a website designer who builds with AI: you take a page from concept to production, using AI tools and code as part of your daily workflow, and you ship pages that convert across LatAm.

Success means building a website operation that continuously ships and continuously improves. You’ll integrate the existing site into an AI-native CI/CD workflow that makes it faster and safer to launch, test, learn, and iterate. Your work will be measured by the quality and consistency of the experience, conversion impact, speed to ship, and how effectively the systems you build make future work faster.

Your responsibilities

• Design and build Clara's website on our own stack: page templates, components, and a design system that lets the team launch pages in hours, not weeks.

• Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Figma AI, or similar) to go from brief to live page, and know when to take over and finish by hand.

• Build and operate agentic workflows for website delivery. Break larger website initiatives into parallel workstreams and use specialized AI agents for tasks such as implementation, QA, accessibility, performance, content validation, analytics, and localization.

• Prototype interactions at high fidelity. Use Figma, code, AI tools, and browser prototypes to demonstrate how the experience should actually behave before it reaches production.

• Use AI to accelerate concept exploration. Generate multiple layout, interaction, and component directions quickly, then curate, refine, and bring the strongest concepts to production quality. Create repeatable processes where AI can help generate

• Scout, pilot, and adopt new AI design and development tools. Explore AI-assisted component generation, design-system workflows, prototyping, and documentation so the whole team can ship faster without lowering quality.

• Maintain quality across the entire product-marketing surface. Ensure that web experiences, product demos, landing pages, interactive tools, and campaign experiences feel like parts of the same system.

• Build automated QA into the delivery pipeline. Use agents and tooling to continuously check visual consistency, responsive behavior, accessibility, performance, broken links, tracking, localization, and regressions before release.

Must haves

• 3+ years designing and shipping websites or landing pages with measurable business impact.

• A strong portfolio of live sites or pages with conversion results. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

• Strong product and content judgment: you can work with real product messaging, identify weak or generic claims, and help turn product capabilities into clear web experiences.

• Production-level front-end skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and a modern framework (React, Next.js, Astro, or similar). You can ship to production, not just prototype.

• Experience using AI beyond individual prompting: you are comfortable designing multi-step or multi-agent workflows, giving agents scoped responsibilities, reviewing their output, and coordinating parallel work.

• Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, coding agents, MCP-based workflows, or environments such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, or similar.

• Working understanding of CI/CD, Git-based workflows, preview deployments, staging environments, QA, and production releases.

• Active, daily use of AI coding and design tools. They are part of your real workflow, not an occasional experiment. Comfortable participating directly in the software delivery process rather than treating design handoff as the end of the job.

• You write effective prompts: you give models context, constraints, and references to get useful output in the first or second try.

• Expert in Figma, thinking in components and systems, not one-offs.

• Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library, including tokens, responsive behavior, states, and documentation.

• Experience with experimentation: A/B tests, iteration frameworks, and learning from results.

• Comfortable communicating with both creative and analytical teams, and able to manage multiple markets and languages in parallel.

Nice to haves

• Experience migrating a site from a no-code platform to a custom stack.

• Headless CMS experience (Sanity, Contentful, Strapi, or similar).

• Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or AI-assisted content and design pipelines.

• Motion and interaction design (Lottie, GSAP, Framer Motion).

• Familiarity with GA4, Mixpanel, or attribution tools, and with feature flags or experimentation platforms.

• Experience working with GitHub Actions.

• Experience with multi-market or multi-language portfolios.

• Experience working with B2B SaaS or fintech.

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

postings.title: GTM/ Sales - Country Lead - Argentina (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Country Lead Argentina to spearhead our commercial operations and rapidly scale Clara's presence in the region. In this highly strategic role, you will own and deploy the go-to-market strategy for the Clara Global product across the region, while also orchestrating the rollout of our broader product suite. You will bridge local execution with strategic alignment from our Mexico headquarters, defining what winning looks like for Clara in a net-new territory.

•
Design and execute the regional go-to-market strategy for Clara Global and other core products, ensuring tight collaboration and alignment with our central operations in Mexico.

•
Prioritize and relentlessly execute the generation of new business for the Clara Global product, identifying and closing net-new companies globally that require a modern, multi-currency reimbursements solution.

•
Operate as a strategic advisor to our installed base as your second key priority, working directly with active clients to drive adoption of our new reimbursements solution and increase Total Payment Volume (TPV).

•
Lead consultative, high-impact product demos with CFOs, Finance Directors, and HR leaders, positioning Clara as the definitive alternative to fragmented global expense processes.

•
Generate a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound strategies using Amplemarket , LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and creative multi-channel approaches.

•
Maintain pristine pipeline hygiene and accurate forecasting in HubSpot , applying structured qualification frameworks across a high-volume funnel.

•
Act as the internal vanguard for market expansion—relaying cross-border regulatory context, pricing feedback, and market intelligence to Product and Leadership via Slack .

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves:

•
Minimum 8 years of enterprise sales or business development experience at a technology or fintech company, with a consistent track record of top performance on strategic accounts.

•
Demonstrated experience selling payments, financial infrastructure, or fintech products to large enterprise customers.

•
Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and lead commercial negotiations, including bespoke deal structures.

•
Exceptional cross-functional leadership and ability to influence across all levels, with high comfort toggling between big-picture strategy and detailed execution.

•
Proven role-specific execution in building territories and pipelines from the ground up, with high adaptability to fast-changing environments.

•
Experience or interest in AI tools (such as N8N ) to automate workflows, accelerate prospecting, and evolve sales operations.

•
Hands-on proficiency with CRM tools like HubSpot and outbound prospecting platforms like Amplemarket .

•
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Nice to haves:

•
Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it.

•
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or BI tools like Metabase to evaluate pipeline coverage and territory data.

•
A good sense of humor.

How we work in this territory

Argentina is an emerging territory for Clara — there's no office to go into, so this role works remotely from Argentina day to day. You'll ramp up in person with the team, and come together in person for team moments, events and customer visits through the year.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.
