postings.title: Paid Media Specialist - Argentina (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

This is a highly hands-on Paid Media role. You will work directly inside the advertising platforms every day—building and launching campaigns, uploading creatives and copy, checking tracking, monitoring performance, and making optimizations.
This is not a strategy-only, coordination, or people-management position. We’re looking for someone who enjoys executing the work themselves and taking direct ownership of campaigns from setup through ongoing optimization.
You’ll manage campaigns across multiple platforms and markets while using AI as a core part of your workflow. You’ll be operating within one of Latin America’s fastest-growing companies, as ranked by the Financial Times, on a team that is actively building AI-native workflows into everything we do.
Your work will directly impact how Clara grows across Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia—and you’ll help define what AI-augmented Paid Media execution looks like at scale

Your responsibilities will include:

• Launch, monitor and quality assurance of campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other platforms.

• Set up tracking and attribution according to internal guidelines — including AI-assisted tagging validation and anomaly detection.

• Use AI tools daily to accelerate campaign work: generating ad copy variants, summarizing performance data, building audience hypotheses, and drafting creative briefs.

• Conduct keyword and audience research using both native platform tools and AI-powered research assistants (e.g. Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, custom GPTs).

• Support in A/B tests and make regular optimizations — using AI to generate hypotheses, interpret results, and suggest next steps.

• Build and maintain recurring performance reports, leveraging AI to surface insights and write narrative summaries.

• Use automation tools (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier) to reduce repetitive manual work and create scalable workflows around campaign management.

• Work closely with the Growth Team and support teams — using AI to speed up collaboration, from briefing creative to aligning on copy.

Who you are:

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves:

• 2+ year of experience managing campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads (other platforms are a plus, but not required).

• Knows how to navigate ad platforms, create audiences, choose formats, and optimize campaigns.

• Confident working with data and tracking the main Paid Media KPIs (spreadsheets, Looker Studio, Power BI, platform native reporting tools or similar).

• Active, daily user of AI tools — you use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or similar tools as part of your real workflow, not just occasionally.

• Can write effective prompts: you know how to give AI models context, constraints and examples to get useful outputs on the first or second try.

• Has experience using AI to produce or improve ad copy, creative briefs, keyword lists, or performance summaries.

• Organized, precise and able to handle multiple campaigns in parallel.

• Comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical teams.

• Genuinely interested in Paid Media and willing to go deep.

Nice to haves:

• Experience with automation tools like n8n, Make or Zapier to build workflows around paid media tasks.

• Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or AI-assisted reporting pipelines.

• Experience with less common platforms (Spotify Ads, programmatic, Uber Ads etc.).

• Interest or experience in AI workflows, internal tooling, or prompt engineering.

• Experience collaborating with creative teams — including using AI to brief or iterate on creative assets.

• Experience working with B2B SaaS or Fintech.

• Experience with MMMs and/or advanced attribution models.

• Basic understanding of landing page CRO, Google Analytics, or CRM tools like HubSpot.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Product Lead, Collections to own the strategy, execution, and business outcomes for our Collections squad at Clara. In this role, you will lead a squad sitting at the intersection of credit risk, finance operations, and customer experience—ensuring we recover what's owed efficiently, compliantly, and without compromising customer trust. •

Design and iterate on collections workflows, ranging from automated early-stage nudges and digital payment use cases to late-stage escalation paths and external partner handoffs.

•
Manage delinquent portfolio tools, early delinquency signals, and regulatory compliance requirements across our core Latin American markets (Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil).

•
Prototype and validate product ideas using AI tools before committing engineering bandwidth, occasionally contributing code changes (copy, configuration, feature flags, or analytics instrumentation) through standard GitHub PRs.

•
Collaborate closely with engineering to support max uptime, system reliability, and rapid recovery processes.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

•
Working proficiency in English.

•
5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years owning a credit, collections, or risk-adjacent product within a fintech, bank, or lending company.

•
Proven track record of directly moving core business metrics and taking full ownership of product outcomes from discovery to execution.

•
Hands-on technical fluency with web architecture concepts (APIs, services, databases, message queuing) and comfortable using Github workflows (branches, commits, PRs, diffs).

•
Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows, validate ideas early, and optimize day-to-day work.

•
Strong data literacy with hands-on experience writing SQL , conducting cohort analysis, and running experiment design.

•
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
Adaptability to fast-changing environments, operating with high agency and a bias toward action.

Nice to haves

•
Basic proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese or a desire to learn it.

•
Cross-border experience across Latin American markets (MX, CO, BR), including knowledge of market-specific payment gateways, external collections agency integrations, or local debt recovery regulations.

•
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL , or Python to build custom dashboards and run deep-dive data pulls.

•
A good sense of humor.

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

postings.title: Senior Auth Engineer — Users & Auth - Remote First
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

Auth Engineer — Users & Auth

We're looking for an Auth Engineer to own, architect, and build the systems that define how users exist and move within Clara's platform — authentication, authorization, identity, and access control. This is one of those roles where the work is invisible when it's done right and critical when it's not. The scope is deep and end-to-end: architecting the identity layer, designing auth flows, managing the user lifecycle, integrating Auth0 with Clara's platform, and making sure the frontend and backend sides of identity speak the same language. You'll be the person the rest of engineering turns to when there's an auth question no one else can answer. Security isn't a checklist here — it's a first-class concern baked into how we build.

We move fast and trust our engineers to own outcomes end-to-end. That means autonomy to make decisions, proactivity to surface problems before they become blockers, and the attitude to push initiatives across the finish line without waiting to be told what to do.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing and building the identity and access layer that Clara's apps rely on across products — making it work end-to-end and hold up as the platform grows, in close partnership with the team's tech lead

• Owning auth end-to-end: architecture, implementation, and Auth0 integration across frontend and backend

• Designing and hardening auth flows and the full user lifecycle

• Being a strong reference on identity and access for the rest of engineering — a go-to for the hard auth problems that block other teams

• Setting and holding the security and quality bar on identity-critical paths through code reviews and design reviews

• Partnering with the team's tech lead and with product on the feasibility of auth-heavy initiatives, and spotting where AI tooling can close work that would otherwise take months

Who you are

• 4+ years of software engineering experience with solid execution in production environments

• 2+ years of hands-on experience implementing authentication and authorization on a modern identity platform — experience with Auth0 specifically is preferred, comparable platforms is also welcome; IAM depth is a strong plus

• Full-stack engineering with your strength on the backend. We work primarily in Java and Spring on the backend and React on the frontend — depth in those is a plus, but we care more about strong fundamentals and how fast you ramp than about years in any one stack

• Deep understanding of security best practices for web applications and secure software design in distributed architectures

• High autonomy, proactivity, and ownership mindset. You don't wait for direction — you spot what needs to happen and drive it

• A genuine pull toward AI. You don't need to be an expert, but you're actively experimenting with AI tools in your day-to-day work, keep up with where the space is going, and are eager to apply it to how we build. At Clara, AI is part of how we work, not a side topic

• English proficiency, comfortable communicating and collaborating on technical topics across geographies

We've kept this list short on purpose — these are the things that actually matter. If you check most of these and the rest you'd close with curiosity and the right tools, we want to hear from you.

Where we work

This is a remote-first role: you'll work from home day to day. You'll ramp up in person with the team, and come together in person for team moments, events and customer visits through the year.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Creative Automation Motion Designer
postings.descriptionText:
DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

This role is part of our Global Studios team. We create emotive yet conversion-focused ideas, products and campaigns at scale and speed. Our specialty is hyper-personalised, digital communications that change perceptions, shape new behaviours, and shift market share for our clients.

This role is dedicated exclusively to Creative Automation—using technology to produce creative assets at scale. You will be designing and animating templates in Adobe After Effects that integrate with Lightspeed, our proprietary automation engine, to render the assets at scale.

You need to be naturally curious, technically-minded, and eager to experiment. We’re looking for candidates who never shy away from a challenge, are excited to find new and novel solutions to creative problems and who, most importantly, enjoy the more technical side of motion design and animation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Build reusable creative automation templates in Adobe After Effects.

• Help solve creative challenges with novel and clever technical solutions.

• Become an expert within our in-house automation engine Lightspeed—our proprietary Adobe After Effects extension for building and designing creative automation templates.

• Take pride in your work and have excellent project file ‘housekeeping’ skills — name your layers!

• Be an ambassador of the entire creative automation team.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• Excellent written and verbal English

• Comfortable writing and using expressions in Adobe After Effects.

• A portfolio demonstrating creative projects with a clear technical aspect.

• A deep understanding of Adobe After Effects.

• Knowledge of the basic principles of JavaScript.

• A keen interest in and knowledge of third party scripts, plugins and extensions for Adobe software.

• Proactive and self-motivated with strong initiative.

• Eager to learn and develop new and existing skills.

• Meticulous attention to detail.

• Independent and confident, but works well with others.

• Process-driven and a great communicator.

WE OFFER

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. You’re more than welcome and we will encourage you to work from one of our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) as often as you’d like.

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered "Plant Total" membership at Sportclub

• A flexible vacation policy

• Refreshments provided in the office all week

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .

postings.title: Group Director, Paid Social Strategy (Client Partnership) - Remote
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients' problems, no matter where you are in the world.

The Role

Group Director, Client Partner

The tl;dr: You’ll be the beating heart of one of DEPT® 's Paid Social strategy and activation teams to one of the world’s most iconic brands in the social media space. At DEPT®, we don't just fill roles, we create careers. If you're ready to redefine what Paid Social strategy and activation looks like for brand awareness media leadership, we'd love to meet you.

We’re hiring a Group Director, Client Partner to be at the heart of the operation for one of our flagship global partnerships to drive brand awareness and user influence in the social media space. This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of changing user’s brand perceptions, has an affinity with pushing the barriers around topics such as brand lift studies and user influence. This person is someone who thrives on partnering closer with both Paid Social strategists and activation teams to drive end-to-end media excellence and redefine how user awareness is achieved and measured.

As a Group Director, you oversee a team of extremely passionate, qualified and experienced Paid Social awareness specialists. You are the connecting tissue between the sheer brainpower of the specialists and the strategic lead(s) on the client, ensuring alignment with the client’s vision. You drive incremental influence and user awareness leveraging Meta Ads, and have a deep understanding of Paid Social strategy, test methodologies, and thrive on out-of-the box thinking to disrupt best practices.

To achieve your goals in this role, you will maintain senior-level agency relationships with the client’s counterparts and consult on the best path forward to achieve tactical goals developed in relation to the client vision with the other cross-channel leads. Furthermore, you have experience building top-of-class teams and processes to adapt to client needs fast.

You are experienced in consulting for varied clients in the digital marketing space, inclusive but not limited to public affairs, retail, technology, and user privacy. You are capable of influencing user perception leveraging targeting and creatives within DEPT®’s Paid Social offering.

Success in this role after 12 months looks like:

• You’ve built strong relationships with key client stakeholders and your DEPT team, and are seen as the go-to expert for all things Paid Social strategy and activation.

•

• Your team is firing on all cylinders , delivering consistently excellent performance across Meta Ads with clarity, accountability, and collaboration.

• You’ve successfully launched an expanded team and broken down silos across the entire planning and activation process, ensuring we are at the forefront of all applicable conversations.

• You have successfully positioned yourself and team as partners as not order takers, identifying and building processes and documentation to better help unify the clients businesses, eliminating individual business silos and more continuity across campaigns.

• You’re helping the client push the edge of what’s possible whether through a new targeting model, a measurement approach, or new platform feature.

• You’re laying the groundwork for the next chapter, whether that’s deeper measurement, test and learn roadmaps, and bold POVs on how the client can drive the strongest brand lift possible.

•

• You’ve successfully helped support the team in navigating up to twelve different sub-units within the clients business at once and can work autonomously on larger initiatives.

Key responsibilities & Essential duties (Other duties may be assigned)

• Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of awareness focused Paid Social programs across Meta Ads; partnering with specialist leads to ensure executional excellence and innovation.

• Co-create and drive the global Paid Social roadmap for the client in close collaboration with DEPT® strategists, project managers, and media planners based in the United States and United Kingdom.

• Act as a senior lead across all client and internal touchpoints, ensuring seamless integration of processes and updates across teams in the United States and United Kingdom for a variety of different audiences inclusive of consumer and some B2B.

• Oversee the teams that translate brand and product strategy into activation plans that drive measurable outcomes, especially in awareness and consideration.

• Lead the integration of brand lift study data and results into broader marketing and performance strategies, tying these types of data points to business impact.

• Work closely with client stakeholders across Paid Social strategy, media planning, activation, and marketing stakeholders media to align on budgets, KPIs, and evolving changes in planned versus delivered outcomes.

• Be the strategic voice within the cross-functional team , advocating for its role in shaping category leadership.

• Own and nurture senior-level client relationships ; become a trusted partner that is not just focused on short term commercial success but a long lasting partnership.

• Provide resourcing recommendations and continuously monitor the effectiveness and bandwidth of the team (in collaboration with Project Manager).

postings.title: People Administrator
postings.descriptionText:
Hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

As a People Administrator, you will create a smooth employee journey experience. You will be responsible for fulfilling processes to make them as easy and pleasant as possible for all stakeholders. You will be the first point of contact for cross-site administrative tasks and actively support the teams.

Do you work in a precise, structured manner and always have a clear overview of contracts and schedules? Are you good at handling confidential information and performing payroll-related tasks? Can you learn quickly and stay well-informed about what DEPT® has to offer? If you embody all these qualities and are willing to answer every question with a big smile, you might just be our perfect candidate.

Note: Visa or relocation costs are not supported. This position is a full-time position. It is located in Croatia and requires Croatian citizenship. Croatian-speaking applicants who reside in Croatia with a valid work permit are also eligible.

Our DEPT® culture is very important to us. That is why we are eager to find not only the most talented expert in the game, but also a perfect DEPT®-fit.

We are looking for someone who is eager to learn and teach, is honest and direct. Our ideal candidate communicates clearly and brings out the best in situations and people around them.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handled routine administrative tasks for onboarding and offboarding, including tracking next steps, issuing standard employment contracts, and scheduling introductory meetings.

• Prepare and edit routine paperwork, including contract amendments, employment certificates, and standard employee documentation.

• Collated, verified, and submitted monthly payroll data to ensure accuracy and timely processing.

• Pulled standard system reports from internal HR tools to support teams

• Performed regular updates to employee and freelancer databases, maintaining accurate records and upholding data compliance standards.

• Acted as the primary point of contact for daily administrative queries from new hires, employees, and freelancers.

WHAT YOU'll BRING

• Are enthusiastic, ambitious, have a positive mindset, and a proactive attitude and approach.

• Are accustomed to conscientious, independent and forward-looking way of working and acting accordingly.

• Are punctual and can work well independently.

• Are eager to learn new skills and master new technologies.

• Communicate clearly, completely, and on time.

• Have a strong professional command of English in both writing and talking.

• Big Plus: Already have some experience with personnel/payroll administration.

WHAT YOU'll GET

• Transparent career development and pay;

• A flexible, hybrid working policy;

• A rewarding, supportive and healthy company culture.

• Supplemental and additional health insurance;

• Pension scheme: third pillar pension fund;

• Referral bonus program;

• Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, and a multisport programme;

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.

• Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a talented and strategic Principal, Art Direction to join a fast-paced, high performing and most visible, dynamic clients. This is a hands-on role for someone who brings conceptual thinking, sharp visual design capabilities, and video-first experience to the table. Someone who can translate strategy into smart, engaging creative that hooks niche audiences.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 5+ years of experience in visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital campaigns, social-first content, and video-driven work.

• Prior social agency experience or relevant experience with a track record of navigating high-volume, high-visibility accounts.

• On-set and content production experience (domestic or international), including working with video directors, editors, and producers.

• Strong client presentation and communication skills - you can confidently present ideas, take feedback in strides, and advocate for great creative.

• Excellent design sensibility and a strategic eye for layout, typography motion, branding. Additionally, deep knowledge of social best practices for optimal performance.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset - you bring energy to brainstorms, jump in where needed and support your teammates with generosity and respect.

• A creative portfolio that shows your eye for design, your range in digital, video, and ability to turn strategy into scroll stopping creative.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage

• 401K plan, plus matching

• PTO

• Paid Company Holidays

• Parental Leave

postings.descriptionText:

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. THE ROLE

DEPT® is looking for a Business Analyst who owns a workstream independently. A Senior Business Analyst at DEPT leads the translation of complex business needs into actionable product and technology solutions. They'll work across clients, strategists, product managers, designers, engineers, and QA teams, to create alignment from discovery through delivery and ensure that solutions address the intended business and user outcomes, all with minimal oversight. Our business analysts move between clients, industries, and delivery models, balancing client expectations against delivery constraints while working inside multidisciplinary agency teams.

GenAI fluency is core to this role, and you'll be expected to use AI tools daily, including drafting requirements and user stories, summarizing discovery sessions, generating first-pass documentation, all while applying the judgment built through years or rigor to critically review and correct the output, rather than trusting it blindly. Additionally, a good candidate for this role should have a willingness to push the field forward, eager to create new ways of using these tools to build clarity for their teams.

• Run Discovery: Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops, turning what you hear into clear, testable requirements and user stories.

• Document Process & Gaps: Map current and future-state processes — flowcharts, personas, use cases, data mappings — and close gaps before they hit delivery.

• Work the Team's Cadence: Follow Agile/Scrum or Kanban practices, adapting to the team's rhythm.

• Methodology: Working knowledge of Agile and the Software Development Lifecycle.

• Tools: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Lucidchart, Miro, FigJam, and/or Adobe Workfront.

• Ownership & Adaptability: Flag risks early, document decisions, and stay effective when priorities or teams shift under you.

• Coaching: Give junior analysts real, actionable feedback.

postings.title: Senior, Data Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

Ready to move with intent? As a Senior Data Engineer, you take ownership of complex data workflows that power digital transformation. You will design and implement scalable data solutions that bridge the gap between raw information and actionable marketing insights.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Develop and deploy production-grade data pipelines using modern orchestration tools like Airflow or dbt.

• Optimize data models for performance and cost-efficiency within cloud environments.

• Perform code reviews and mentor Core Engineers to ensure high standards of "getting sh*t done".

• Collaborate with Data Scientists and Analysts to ensure data readiness for advanced modeling.

• Implement data security and privacy best practices in line with global standards.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• Proven experience in designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines in a professional environment.

• Deep proficiency in SQL and Python for data processing.

• Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Knowledge of data modeling techniques (e.g., Star Schema, Data Vault).

• Ability to act fast and adapt to the evolving needs of global brands.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is at its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s lived experience, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, and genetic information. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work . Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world, and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

postings.descriptionText:

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

The role

As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.

You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.

This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.

What you'll do

• Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.

• Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.

• Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.

• Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.

• Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.

• Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.

• Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.

• Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.

• Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.

• Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What you bring

• Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.

• Strong proficiency in Python .

• Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.

• Solid working knowledge of database platforms , both SQL and NoSQL.

• Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.

• Experience with at least one major cloud provider . Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.

• Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.

• A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.

• Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.

• The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.

• A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points

• Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.

• Exposure to agent development frameworks.

• Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

postings.title: Senior UX Designer (Focus on Research)
postings.descriptionText:
Senior UX Designer (Focus on Research)

Zagreb, Split, Hybrid

JOB PURPOSE

As a User Researcher , you help product teams make confident, customer-centered decisions by uncovering real user needs, motivations, behaviors and opportunities. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on research to explore problem spaces, test hypotheses and turn insights into action.

In this role, you’ll work at the core of one of our key client teams, shaping how research contributes to the development of digital products and services. From exploring the adoption of AI technologies to enabling journey-driven product thinking – you’ll bring clarity to complexity and structure to uncertainty.

You’ll design and conduct studies, synthesize results, and make insights accessible and actionable for product managers, designers and other stakeholders. But you’ll also help evolve the research practice itself by refining methods, improving tooling and championing user needs across the team. And you’ll do it all in a dynamic environment with some of the most talented (and fun) people the industry has to offer.

WHAT YOU´LL DO

• Plan and conduct user research – from exploratory discovery work to usability tests and concept validations

• Frame research questions and help teams explore problem spaces before jumping into solutions

• Analyse results, document insights, and share them in ways that support product and design decisions

• Work closely with designers, product managers and developers in a cross-functional team environment

• Support the development of research standards and ways of working that scale across teams and topics

• Bring inspiration and structure to the research process, through methods, tools and best practices

• Advocate for a journey-driven, evidence-based approach to product development

• Stay curious: continuously evolve your methods and contribute to the research culture across the team

WHAT YOU BRING

• Over 5 years of experience in user research, ideally at an agency and in agile, product-focused environments

• Strong skills in running and analysing studies – from usability tests to interviews and concept validations

• A talent for making research results easy to understand and act on for designers, product managers and stakeholders

• You stay up to date with emerging tools, methods and technologies and enjoy bringing fresh perspectives into the team

postings.title: Clinical Data Manager
postings.descriptionText:
We’re expanding across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile , and Peru , and we’re looking for an experienced Clinical Data Manager to help build the foundation of our growing LATAM Data Management team, ensuring the delivery of high-quality clinical data that drives successful clinical trials and accelerates innovative therapies to patients.

Position Summary:
The Senior Clinical Data Manager/Principal Clinical Data Manager is responsible and manages all aspects of the clinical trial data management process from study start up to post database lock for assigned projects. Standard Operating Procedures / Work Instructions (SOPs/WIs); regulatory directives; study specific plans and guidelines will be followed. This position will also oversee and/or perform database development and testing.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

• Primary Data Management (DM) contact (Lead DM role) for assigned clinical project(s) / program(s), ensuring that there is back-up, continuity, responsiveness, and that tasks are performed in a timely manner. May support another Lead DM as a back-up and/or team member. May include DM oversight of sponsor programs.

• Oversee project data entry process including development of data entry guidelines, training, data entry quality and resourcing

• May perform quality control of data entry

• Provide input, assesses and manage timelines. Ensure that clinical data management deadlines are met with quality. Assess resource needs for assigned projects, as needed.

• Develop CRF specifications from the clinical study protocol and coordinate the review/feedback from all stakeholders

• May assist in building clinical databases

• Conduct database build UAT and maintain quality controlled database build documentation. Oversee overall quality of the clinical database.

• May specify requirements for all edit check types e.g. electronic, manual data review, edit checks, etc. Oversee development of the edit check specifications and manual data review specifications

• Responsible for creating, revising, appropriate versioning and maintaining data management documentation. Oversee completeness of data management documentation for the Trial Master File.

• Train clinical research personnel on the study specific CRF, EDC, and other project related items as needed.

• Review and query clinical trial data according to the Data Management Plan

• Perform line listing data review based on the guidance provided by the sponsor and/or Lead DM

• Run patient and study level status and metric reporting

• Perform medical coding of medical terms relative to each other in order to ensure medical logic and consistency

• Coordinate SAE/AE reconciliation

• Liaises with third-party vendors such as external data and EDC vendors in a project-manager capacity in support of timelines and data-related deliverables

• May assist with SAS programming and quality control of SAS programs used in the Data Management department

• Identify and troubleshoot operational problems, issues, obstacles, and barriers for studies based on metrics data, audit reports, and input from project team members and other stakeholders

• May assist in reviewing and providing feedback on protocols, Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), if required by the project

• Participate in the development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and corresponding process documentation related to data management and database management activities

• May attend strategy meetings, bid defense prep meetings, bid defenses, capability presentations, potential client engagement meetings

• May review Request for Proposals (RFP), proposals, provide project estimates

• Provide leadership for cross-functional and organization-wide initiatives, where applicable

• Trains and ensures that all data management project team members have been sufficiently trained

• Communicate with study sponsors, vendors and project teams as needed regarding data, database or other relevant project issues

• May present software demonstrations/trainings, department/company training sessions, present at project meetings

• May require some travel

• Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:
Minimum Required:

• Bachelors and/or a combination of related experience

Other Required:

• 8+ years’ experience for a Sr. Clinical Data Manager and 10+ years for a Principal Clinical Data Manager

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook

• Able to handle a variety of clinical research tasks

• Excellent organizational and communication skills

• Professional use of the English language; both written and oral

• Experience in utilizing various clinical database management systems

• Broad knowledge of drug, device and/or biologic development and effective data management practices

• Strong representational skills, ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills

• Ability to undertake occasional travel

Preferred:

• Experience in a clinical, scientific or healthcare discipline

• Dictionary medical coding (MedDRA and WHODrug)

• Understanding of CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, etc.…)

• Oncology and/or Orphan Drug therapeutic experience

We’re expanding across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru , and we’re looking for a Senior Proposals Manager to help build the foundation of our proposals team supporting clinical teams across LATAM and North America regions.

The Sr Proposals Manager will develop client focused budgets and proposals for the conduct of Phase I-IV clinical trials, including simple bid grid mapping with manager support. Work in collaboration with global operational review teams to develop high quality budgets and proposals in response to client Request for Proposal (RFP) requests across a range of therapeutic areas. Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

• Prepare budgets, proposal text and re-bids to support RFP responses for global opportunities.

• Complete budget and proposal deliverables with promptness and accuracy. Provide overall coordination for the entire RFP preparation process, including collaboration with key operational review leads, ensuring accurate incorporation of key strategy and adherence to all key deliverable timelines.

• Review RFP documents from clients and help identify key service requirements and assumptions needed for budget and proposal development.

• Coordinate and lead core RFP development meetings, with attendance from broader company representatives, including sales, operational review and finance teams.

• Develop full project budgets using our costing tool template. Strong grasp of Excel based formula applied to assist the team in capturing appropriate details, unique budgetary needs and mapping to basic client grids, as needed.

• Prepare proposal text using departmental text templates. Accurately reflect client needs and project team’s strategic message and assumptions.

• Communicate and coordinate with all partners and third-party vendors during the RFP development process.

• Ensure accuracy and quality control of budget and proposal text edits, working to a high standard of quality output.

• Support work order and request for information (RFI) requests, where needed.

postings.descriptionText:
We’re expanding our data engineering capabilities across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru , and we’re hiring a Senior Clinical Data Engineer to help build the foundation of this new regional function. In this role, you’ll lead the development and optimization of clinical data systems, drive data standardization, build validation frameworks, and design high‑performance databases and pipelines across global trials.

The Senior Clinical Data Engineer leads the strategic development and optimization of clinical data systems to support regulatory compliance, advanced analytics, and operational excellence across global trials.

This role drives enterprise-level data standardization initiatives, and architects scalable validation frameworks to proactively address systemic data issues. With deep expertise in SAS Programming in a Life Sciences setting, you'll be responsible for building and maintaining modular codebases, sets coding standards, and mentoring junior engineers. The role also oversees regulatory alignment with GCP and FDA 21 CFR Part 11, establishing robust documentation and audit trail protocols.

Through dynamic dashboards and analytics tools, you'll deliver actionable insights into trial performance and data quality. As a strategic liaison across Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory Affairs, you'll help translate clinical requirements into scalable technical solutions and leads the design of secure, high-performance databases and ETL pipelines integrating data from diverse clinical systems.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Data Standardization & Mapping: Spearhead the development of enterprise-level data mapping strategies that transform raw clinical data into standardized formats for high-impact analytics. Lead the adoption and governance of data standards across programs to ensure regulatory alignment and consistency.

Data Quality Assurance: Design and implement robust, scalable validation frameworks that proactively detect and resolve systemic data issues. Serve as a strategic partner to Clinical Data Managers and cross-functional teams, driving continuous improvement in data integrity across global trials

Programming & Scripting: Architect and maintain advanced, modular codebases using SAS to support complex data engineering workflows. Python, R, and SQL experience is highly preferred as we continue to leverage Ai tools across the industry. Establishing coding standards and mentoring junior engineers in automation, reproducibility, and performance optimization. Example use cases includes edit checks, reconciliations, exception listings, programmed protocol deviations, resource projections based on site data entry volume

Regulatory Compliance & Documentation: Lead compliance initiatives to ensure all data systems and workflows meet GCP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and evolving global regulatory requirements. Define documentation protocols and oversee audit trail governance to support inspection readiness and transparency.

Reporting & Visualization: Develop and operationalize dynamic dashboards and analytics tools that provide real-time insights into data quality, trial progress, and operational KPIs. Translate complex datasets into actionable intelligence for clinical and regulatory stakeholders.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Support: Act as a strategic liaison between Clinical Data Engineering and Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory Affairs. Translate clinical and scientific requirements into scalable technical solutions that support study execution and data delivery.

Database Design & Optimization: Lead the design and optimization of secure, high-performance relational databases and data lakes. Ensure infrastructure scalability, query efficiency, and data governance for large-scale clinical datasets.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (life sciences, statistics, data management, clinical operations) or relevant/equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

• Minimum 6 years experience in clinical monitoring, clinical trial management or equivalent

• Advanced programming and automation skills; database design; dashboard development; CDISC governance

• Professional working proficiency in English

Other Required:

• Highly effective oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with project team members

• Excellent organizational and time management skills

• Ability to work in a team or independently as required

• Demonstrated ability to learn how to extract pertinent information from protocols, electronic study data systems and clinical systems

• Proficiency in statistical analysis and data monitoring tools.

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Demonstrated experience with integrated risk planning & management

• Ability to mentor junior team members

Preferred:

• CRO experience as a Clinical Data Engineer or Programmer

• Automation and Ai Agent Deployment in Regulated Environments

Skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data quality and integrity.

• Ability to work with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.

• Effective communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

• Knowledge of data governance, privacy, and security best practices in clinical research.

Competencies:

• Collaboration: Works effectively with clinical, statistical, and technical teams to align data strategies with study goals.

• Accountability: Takes ownership of data engineering deliverables and ensures timely, high-quality outputs.

• Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities and timelines.

We’re expanding our capabilities across Latin America , and we’re hiring a Senior Clinical Research Associate to support critical studies across Argentina!

As a Senior CRA you'll posses a wide-ranging and broad experience handling our most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management. Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected.

Responsibilities:

• Independently oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports

• Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions

• Establishes, updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports

• Manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager

• If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee

• Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues

• Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Performs Monitoring Oversight Visits to assess other CRA team members. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote)

• Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution

• Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations

• Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision's Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues

• Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision's high quality and professional image

• Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned

• Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies

• Identifies and processes Serious Adverse Events according to the procedures defined by the study team. Also demonstrates a full understanding of the SAE reporting process

• Identifies site risks and escalates those to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager with suggested contingencies. Owns the timely and appropriate resolution of the risk with oversight from project team

• Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face-to-face meetings. postings.descriptionText:
We’re expanding our data management capabilities across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru , and we’re hiring a Senior Principal Technical Data Specialist to help build the foundation of this new regional technical data management organization!

The Senior Principal Technical Data Specialist is the senior individual-contributor authority for Technical Data Management. The role shapes functional strategy and technical governance across strategic programs; defines enterprise expectations for requirements, specifications, architecture, testing, integration, migration, archival, and quality; and ensures programmed outputs align with approved requirements before production use.

The role directs resolution of the most complex or high-risk challenges, influences sponsor and internal technology decisions, develops technical capability across the function, and sponsors innovation and process transformation.

Main Duties & Responsibilities:

• Protocol & Requirements Translation: Define enterprise expectations for requirements quality and traceability, advise on novel study designs, and resolve critical requirements issues across strategic programs.

• CRF, Edit Check & Technical Specifications: Provide governance for the full suite of technical specifications, shape and harmonize CRF-aligned templates and design principles across platforms, portfolios, and therapeutic areas, create data transfer agreements, and arbitrate high-impact technical design decisions.

• Database Design & Build Oversight: Establish technical architecture and governance expectations for database delivery, advising leadership on strategic design trade-offs, platform capabilities, interoperability, AI enablement, and systemic technical risk.

• Testing, Defect Management & Validation: Define technical testing standards and quality thresholds, provide assurance for critical validation issues, sponsor advanced automation, and establish expectations for technical execution and evidence while supporting overall coordination by the Lead Data Manager.

• Production Readiness, Migration, Change Control & Archival: Provide governance for major migrations, platform transitions, post-production change, and technical database archival within selected EDC systems; direct response to critical deployment or archival risk and define sustainable practices.

• Data Integration & Workbench Enablement: Shape integration and data-cleaning workbench strategy, long-term technical architecture, operating models, data lineage, control points, and interoperability across clinical data platforms.

• Quality, Compliance & Documentation / Cross-Functional & Sponsor Collaboration / Program Complexity, Planning & Risk Management / Mentoring, Standards & Continuous Improvement: Represent Technical Data Management in strategic governance and sponsor forums; define technical quality and inspection-readiness expectations; lead strategy for business-critical programs; build organizational capability; sponsor innovation and transformation; and ensure sustainable value.

Education and Experience:

Minimum Education & Experience:

•

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent training and experience; and typically 12+ years of relevant experience, including enterprise- or portfolio-level technical leadership and delivery of major improvements or transformations.

Preferred Education & Experience (optional):

•

• Advanced degree or recognized technical leadership credentials, together with demonstrated competencies in enterprise strategy, governance, architecture, compliance, and transformation.

• Or equivalent combination of education, professional training and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job.

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies:

• Recognized expert knowledge of technical clinical data strategy, governance, compliance, inspection readiness, and evolving industry practices.

• Broad and deep expertise across clinical data platforms, architecture, EDC, integrations, workbenches, data flows, standards, testing, migration, and archival.

• Ability to define enterprise requirements, specification, testing, quality, traceability, and technical governance expectations.

• Ability to shape technology strategy, technical architecture, library development, interoperability, AI enablement, and evaluation of emerging capabilities.

• Exceptional judgment and enterprise thinking when directing resolution of unprecedented or business-critical technical challenges.

• Ability to lead technical strategy for the most complex programs and inform capacity, capability, resourcing, and investment planning.

• Trusted strategic communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, sponsors, vendors, and major internal and external governance forums.

• Ability to define sustainable change-control, migration, platform-transition, archival, preventive-control, and inspection-readiness practices.

• Ability to build organizational technical capability, develop successors and technical leaders, sponsor innovation, and establish adoption measures.

• Exemplary technical leadership, ethical judgment, client focus, accountability, inclusive collaboration, professionalism, and sustained organizational impact.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our team who has end-to-end ownership to build a quality product. Through automation and functional testing, they validate a variety of products to offer our customers a seamless banking experience. As a Senior QA Engineer, you will work directly with our product teams and will participate in application specification reviews and architectural design sessions by providing input from a quality standpoint. You will also identify testing strategies for various features and functionalities. Within your first year, you will develop an understanding of how to deliver high performing software at pace of development. You will work in an environment that promotes ownership at all levels including configuring and monitoring apps in production.

This is a fully remote, long-term contract position open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.

Java, Selenium Webdriver, Playwright, Claude Code, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, REST Assured, OkHttp, SumoLogic, Docker, Kubernetes, Gatling, Linux etc

• Execute functional/performance tests by spinning up disposable environments on demand to deploy microservices with different versions and configurations, and customize database content

• Customize, configure, patch services, and deploy infrastructure and code changes all the way through to production

• Analyze log files and troubleshoot production issues by automating and reproducing them in a non-production environment

• Collaborate with QA platform to create solutions for feature validations and test automation for your product

What We Look For:

• Ability to develop test automation in Java using Selenium/Playwright to utilize Integrated Development environments (IDE) such as IntelliJ or Eclipse, with and without Coding assistants

• Experience in deploying services in various environments such as Kubernetes, using deployment tools like ArgoCD and Jenkins

• Capability to improve efficiency of existing test infrastructure using Docker, Playwright and headless browser executions

• Familiarity with log aggregators such as SumoLogic or Kibana, and app monitoring tools such as Honeycomb or Grafana

• Passion for automating tests and delivering high quality features in a fast paced environment

• Comfortable working in Agile methodology

Environmental & Working Conditions

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

postings.descriptionText:
Reporting to the Team Lead, Deal Desk, the Deal Support Coordinator role focuses on transactional deal support and administrative tasks that help our sales team close business efficiently. If you enjoy data accuracy, policy and process, working with systems, and supporting a fast-moving sales environment, this is a great entry point into Sales Operations.

Responsibilities:

• Review and verify incoming deals for accuracy; confirm transactions adhere to revenue recognition policies and operational guidelines to close opportunities efficiently and correctly.

• Ensure approvals for non-standard deals have been properly documented, raised to the right approval levels, and resolved within set timeframes.

• Handle contract amendments (e.g., billing address changes, term extensions, product swaps) by preparing required documentation and routing approvals as needed.

• Maintain data integrity in Salesforce CPQ by identifying and correcting quote or contract discrepancies.

• Enter and update deal data points accurately in Salesforce and related systems that drive org-wide KPIs.

• Monitor our internal Slack deal support hotline channel and route requests appropriately.

• Become a subject matter expert for our customer-facing teams by answering transactional questions and supporting their deals input (e.g., quote status, required approvals).

• Consistently meet defined SLAs and service standards to support timely and accurate bookings and resolutions.

• Provide general administrative support to the Deal Desk team.

Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.

• 1+ year experience in data entry, sales support, customer service, or operations.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, Google Workspace, Microsoft Suite and Adobe tools a plus.

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and consistency in work.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communicator in English at a professional level (written and verbal)

• Proactive, collaborative, and eager to learn sales operations processes.

Additional Requirements:

• Hours: 8 hours a day Monday - Friday between 8:00am - 8:00pm (Eastern Standard Time - US) - We are flexible on start time as long as you can do 8 hours a day between these times. Please note that interviews will take place between these times as well.

• Candidates must have access to and be willing to use their personal computer or laptop for this role. The device must be a Mac (Apple) product.

Additional Role Details:

• This contract position is paid a monthly rate (USD).

• This person must be located in one of the following countries: Argentina; Brazil; Chile; Colombia; Costa Rica.

• Please note that given the nature of the position, this role will not be eligible to participate in company-sponsored benefits.

• The contract is estimated to last 12 months with the potential for extension, though an extension is not guaranteed.

Why You'll Love This Role:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to directly shape our data ecosystem by building robust pipelines and applying modern software engineering principles like version control and automated testing. • Act as the primary technical partner to Product, Finance, Marketing, and Engineering, translating what they need into a roadmap the team can execute.

• Negotiate scope directly with stakeholders.

• Drive a cadence of proactive analysis so the team surfaces questions the business hasn't asked, rather than waiting for tickets.

• Define the team's data testing strategy and govern how business logic is validated across the analytics layer.

• Own the operational health of the analytics layer (monitoring, alerting, incident response, and release readiness for what the team ships).
