Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

• Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path

• Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders

• Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)

• Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses

• Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff

• Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement

• Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant

• Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue

• Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call

• Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

• 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management

• Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks

• Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks

• Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically

• Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

• Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it

• Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers

• Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on

• Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment

• Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation

• Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider

• Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout

• Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, compute…

postings.title: Account Development Rep II
postings.descriptionText:
UserGems is the AI Command Center for outbound and ABM. Think of us as the ‘brain’ behind your go-to-market. We capture account & contact data and buying signals to help companies know who to target, when, and why. Then, take the next actions via humans or AI agents to run personalized outbound and ABM at scale.

UserGems has generated billions in pipeline and revenue for hundreds of start-ups and public companies. Companies like Hubspot, Workday, Crowdstrike, Mimecast, UserTesting, SAP, Outreach see more than 15X ROI in closed-won revenue from UserGems.

Overview

UserGems' Account Development Reps are the front line of our outbound engine.
You'll pick up the phone, work LinkedIn, and turn cold prospects into booked demos for our sales team. You'll report to the Account Development Manager who rolls up to the CMO.
This is entry-level with a real growth path.

As an ADR

• You'll own top-of-funnel outbound: hit the phones with confidence, run cold discovery like a consultant, social sell creatively, and test new channels before anyone tells you to

• You'll work hand in glove with demand gen on target accounts every month, and you own the hand-off to the AE team so nothing gets dropped

• You'll work every channel, call, LinkedIn, email, whatever else works, to book meetings

• You'll follow up on demo requests like someone owes you money

• You'll test, tweak, and get creative until your outreach breaks through the noise. The job isn't hitting a daily dial count. It's using everything you've got, phone, LinkedIn, email, the product itself, and your strategic creativity to make quota happen.

• You'll occasionally travel: this role is fully remote day to day, but annual conferences and company events are part of the job.

• You'll become a product expert fast, because you'll actually prospect with UserGems. Not many ADR roles can say they use their own product to do their job

How you'll ramp

Week 1

• You'll get hands-on with our product, sales process, and tools

• You'll listen to real Gong calls to hear how prospects object and how we handle it

• You'll meet the whole team, one on one

Day 30

• You're almost ramped. Product, pains we solve, value propositions, persona, and discovery have a good foundation.

• You can influence a prospect in a consultative way via cold call

• You're booking meetings on your own

Day 60

• You're running a full list of target accounts efficiently

• You've got personalization at scale down, and somehow you still sound like a human (a funny one) doing it

• You’re experimenting and expanding your impact beyond cold calling channel

• Competitors & common objections: all becoming second nature

Day 90

• You're a real part of the revenue team, not someone still finding their footing

• You're partnering with marketing on campaigns that move pipeline and starting to experiment with your own book of business while still following the roadmap our campaigns lay out

• You’re getting more in-depth with learning the ins and outs of our own tool

What makes you a fit

• 6+ months in a quota-carrying, customer-facing role, consistently exceeding goals and key metrics

• You're not afraid of the phone. You've either done the early-stage prospecting grind or can make a clear case for why you'd excel at it.

Bonus: you’ve cold called into sales, marketing, or revops and:

• You share new ideas, take feedback without flinching, and bring a good attitude on the hard days

• Self-starter energy: entrepreneurial, motivated, and relentless about getting to the outcome - no hand-holding required

• You geek out on AI — using it to work smarter or think more creatively

• You want a fully remote work environment, but you're up for travel to annual conferences and company events

Compensation

Target compensation for the role is $80,000 OTE annually ($60,000 annual base + $20,000 annual variable) with real opportunity for promotion within the first year.

Final compensation package will be determined based on commensurate experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability to perform in the role.

Why you should join:

• You’ll be part of a fast-growing startup as it scales from 70 to hundreds of employees

• Customers love us! (see our Customers & Hall of Gems pages)

• Employees love working here (see Repvue & Glassdoor reviews) and stay a long time. Median tenure for Director+ is 5 years and median tenure for all employees is 3+ years.

• We just had our best quarter ever (by >2X) and signed our first 7 digit contract.

• We will be cash-flow positive by the end of the year and can create our own destiny.

• We're a remote-first company with employees across the Americas and Europe

• We have company & department-wide in-person off-sites around the world so that everyone stays connected

• We believe strongly in being customer-focused and data-driven in everything we do

• We value individual differences in the workforce and strive to make everyone feel welcomed and accepted, regardless of their skin color, gender or sexual orientation

• Health benefits & competitive salary

Como BDR Estratégico, serás responsable de generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio con cuentas enterprise tier 1, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con nuestros Enterprise Sales Executives para abrir puertas, navegar en organizaciones complejas y generar un pipeline de alta calidad para nuestro segmento Enterprise Estratégico.

TU IMPACTO

• Identificar y contactar proactivamente a clientes estratégicos potenciales mediante prospección outbound (llamadas en frío, correos electrónicos, LinkedIn y canales creativos).

• Investigar cuentas grandes y complejas, mapear múltiples partes interesadas (stakeholders) y personalizar el contacto para involucrar a los principales tomadores de decisiones.

• Educar a los clientes potenciales sobre la misión y la propuesta de valor de Wellhub, generando interés y asegurando reuniones para el equipo de ventas.

• Superar objeciones, gestionar expectativas y construir relaciones de confianza a diferentes niveles, incluyendo ejecutivos y líderes senior.

• Colaborar con los Strategic AEs para alinear el mensaje, compartir información y estrategizar en cuentas con múltiples stakeholders.

• Alcanzar o superar las metas mensuales, trimestrales y anuales de generación de pipeline.

• Ser embajador/a de Wellhub en eventos de la industria y oportunidades de networking.

• Desarrollar experiencia en la gestión de ciclos de venta largos y consultivos, con capacidad para conectar el valor de Wellhub con desafíos organizacionales complejos.

• Ser nativo/a de Argentina o tener un gran conocimiento de las cuentas Enterprise en Argentina es un plus.

• Ponerse manos a la obra y apoyar al equipo donde sea necesario: ¡ganamos juntos!

• Vivir la misión: inspirar y empoderar a otros cuidando genuinamente de tu propio bienestar y el de tus compañeros. Poner el bienestar en el centro del trabajo y crear un entorno de apoyo donde todos se sientan cómodos cuidándose, tomándose vacaciones y encontrando un equilibrio entre la vida personal y laboral.

A QUIÉN BUSCAMOS

• Un/a verdadero/a jugador/a de equipo a quien le encanta colaborar para alcanzar metas ambiciosas.

• Tenaz, resiliente y orientado/a a objetivos, con sólida experiencia previa en prospección outbound, desarrollo de negocios o ventas para cuentas estratégicas grandes/complejas.

• Organizado/a y automotivado/a: puedes manejar múltiples prioridades en una organización de rápido crecimiento.

• Receptivo/a al aprendizaje, curioso/a y siempre buscando aprender y mejorar.

• Sólidas habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita en español (nativo).

• El inglés avanzado es un plus (principalmente lectura y escucha): interactuarás con equipos y recursos globales.

• Piensas de manera estratégica y creativa para resolver desafíos complejos.

• Experiencia en la interacción con ejecutivos de nivel C y altos directivos en cuentas Enterprise/Estratégicas es altamente valorada.
Habilidad demostrada para navegar en entornos con múltiples partes interesadas e influir en la toma de decisiones en grandes organizaciones.

Este puesto requiere la asistencia a la oficina al menos 1 vez por semana.

Sabemos que cada persona encara las postulaciones de manera diferente. Incentivamos a todos los candidatos motivados a postularse, incluso si no cumplen con el 100% de los requisitos. Queremos conocerte y evaluar juntos si podés ser una excelente incorporación para nuestro equipo. Tené en cuenta que, para este rol en particular, la experiencia previa en prospectado outbound es un requisito excluyente.

postings.title: Channel Partners Senior Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Channel Partner Senior Manager to our Indirect Sales team, based in Argentina, with regional scope covering Argentina and Chile.

This is a key individual contributor role within Wellhub’s SSLatam indirect sales strategy. You will be responsible for building and scaling a reseller and alliance ecosystem across two high-potential markets, combining hunting for new channel partners with the development and management of existing ones. You will operate with high autonomy, executing go-to-market strategies through brokers, HR consultancies, benefits companies, banks, and fintechs to drive B2B revenue through indirect channels. This role requires a commercially sharp, resourceful professional who understands the indirect channel business, can open doors with senior stakeholders, and knows how to create value both for partners and for Wellhub.

YOUR IMPACT

• Build and grow the channel partner ecosystem across Argentina and Chile, identifying, onboarding, and developing strategic alliances with benefits brokers, HR consultancies, voucher/benefits companies, banks, and fintechs.

• Drive indirect revenue through a mix of hunting new reseller partners and farming existing alliances, ensuring consistent pipeline generation and deal conversion through the channel.

• Own end-to-end partner relationships — from commercial negotiation and contract structuring to joint go-to-market execution, co-marketing initiatives, and ongoing performance management.

• Design and execute joint go-to-market strategies with partners, coordinating internally with Marketing, Sales Team, and Operations to ensure aligned initiatives that maximize channel revenue.

• Prospect and engage senior decision-makers (commercial directors, HR leaders, C-suite) at potential partner organizations, building a qualified pipeline of new alliance opportunities.

• Monitor and report channel performance with accuracy, maintaining forecast discipline and proactively managing risks in the indirect pipeline.

• Ensure commercial sustainability by managing partner margins, MAP clauses, and deal structures that protect Wellhub’s margin while remaining competitive in the market.

• Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves.

WHO YOU ARE

• An experienced channel and alliances professional with 5–7 years of experience in indirect sales, reseller partnerships, or B2B alliance management, ideally in multi-stakeholder commercial environments.

• A hunter-farmer hybrid — you’re equally comfortable opening new partner relationships from scratch and deepening existing ones to unlock long-term revenue.

• A commercially-driven operator with solid understanding of partner economics, margin management, deal structuring, and reseller go-to-market models.

• An autonomous and resourceful professional capable of navigating ambiguity, managing complex negotiations, and driving results without a direct team to lean on.

• A skilled communicator and influencer with the ability to engage and persuade senior stakeholders both externally (partners) and internally (cross-functional teams).

• Familiar with the Argentina and Chilean business landscape, including local dynamics in HR, benefits, and corporate services markets.

• Experienced in or exposed to SaaS, wellness, or HR technology environments — a strong plus but not a hard requirement.

• Fluent in Spanish and English (advanced/fluent), with professional proficiency required to operate in our global environment.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Indirect Sales / Channel Partnerships and B2B Alliance Management are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office equipment reimbursement and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

Xometry is looking for a Customer Marketing Manager responsible for champion-led growth (CLG) and engagement of our existing buyer accounts. You will build the mechanisms that turn buyers into advocates at scale — referrals, reviews, incentives, and buyer stories — and design the strategies that grow adoption within the installed base. This is a role for someone who wants full ownership of the existing-customer lifecycle — driving deeper engagement, expansion, and loyalty — and who can turn that advocacy into stories the rest of the business can use.

How You’ll Contribute:

Champion-Led Growth Strategy

• Own and execute the CLG strategy across the existing buyer base, driving advocacy, referrals, and account expansion at scale

• Build advocacy mechanisms — referral programs, review/reference programs, incentive structures, and integration/plug-in opportunities — that convert satisfied buyers into active champions

• Identify and prioritize which accounts and buyer segments are best positioned for expansion, referral, or advocacy motions

Customer Engagement & Retention

• Design the account engagement journey for existing accounts, including triggers, segmentation, and offers that drive re-engagement and deepen adoption

• Partner with various Marketing teams to translate strategy into executed campaigns — this role owns the playbook and the outcomes

• Continuously test and refine triggers and segments based on account behavior and performance data

Advocacy & Customer Storytelling

• Turn the advocacy engine into a pipeline of buyer stories — case studies, testimonials, and proof points that Sales, Marketing, and cross functional teams can use

• Partner with Commercial Marketing & Enablement to ensure buyer stories feed directly into sales enablement assets

• Build repeatable processes for sourcing, capturing, and publishing buyer stories at scale

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• 5+ years of B2B lifecycle, customer/account based marketing, or growth marketing experience, ideally within a marketplace or platform business

• Demonstrated experience designing and running lifecycle programs (triggers, segmentation, nurture) that measurably grow existing accounts

• Track record of building advocacy or referral programs from the ground up

postings.title: Senior Data Scientist
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. This person will drive data science initiatives, provide technical guidance when needed, and leverage data to solve complex business challenges. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of data science methodologies, strong statistical expertise, and proven experience delivering impactful data solutions in a dynamic environment. This is a 1-year contract with the potential for extension.

Responsibilities:

• Use data analysis, visualization, and modeling tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Python, Pandas) to drive data-driven business strategies, with a focus on cost prediction for a two-sided marketplace.

• Design and execute data science projects, including hypothesis development, statistical analysis, and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing) to answer key business questions and validate assumptions.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data science solutions and ensure alignment with Xometry’s objectives.

• Analyze existing algorithms for accuracy and performance, provide recommendations for optimization, and update production code as necessary.

• Query and extract data from databases (e.g., Snowflake, MongoDB) to support analysis and model development.

• Implement robust data science methodologies, emphasizing best practices in code reproducibility, version control, and model deployment.

• Continuously iterate and improve solutions within a fast-paced, agile environment, addressing challenges with innovative, data-driven approaches.

• Foster a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and continuous learning, encouraging knowledge sharing and skill development within the team.

Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree is required; an advanced degree (M.S. or PhD) in applied math, computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field is highly preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in data science

• Strong expertise in SQL and Python (numpy, scipy, pandas, and scikit-learn preferred) and experience with API integrations using Python.

• Proficient in applied statistics, including knowledge of probability distributions, confidence intervals, statistical tests (e.g., t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-Square), and power analysis.

• Experience with pricing algorithms and technology-driven product development.

• Knowledge of scientific software principles, including version control, code reproducibility, and deployment practices.

• Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and manage shifting priorities effectively.

• Must be able to work core hours aligned with US Eastern Time (GMT-5).

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with global teams and articulate complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team and support one of our core Product Areas. In this role, you’ll work closely with a Product Design Lead, Product Managers, Engineers, and Researchers to design intuitive, scalable product experiences that help manufacturers and buyers succeed on the Xometry platform.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on strong execution, collaboration, and the delivery of high-quality design work within new and established product direction.

What You’ll Do

• Design user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI for features and enhancements within your Product Area

• Translate product requirements and user needs into clear, usable design solutions

• Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research throughout discovery, design, and delivery

• Participate in design reviews and incorporate feedback from the Design Lead and partners

• Ensure designs align with Xometry’s design system, accessibility standards, and usability best practices

• Support engineering handoff by providing clear specifications and design documentation

• Iterate quickly based on feedback, technical constraints, and changing priorities

What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years of product design experience working on digital products

• A strong portfolio demonstrating thoughtful UX, interaction design, and visual design

• Experience collaborating with Product Managers and Engineers in agile product teams

• Solid skills in Figma and modern design systems and workflows

• Ability to clearly explain design decisions and incorporate feedback

• Comfort working within defined product direction and constraints

What Will Set You Up for Success

• Attention to detail and pride in high-quality execution

• Strong collaboration and communication skills
Willingness to ask questions when the context is unclear

• Ability to manage multiple design tasks and deadlines with guidance from a Design Lead

• Openness to learning, feedback, and continuous improvement

Nice to Have

• Experience with complex workflows, marketplaces, or B2B products

• Familiarity with design systems and component-based design

• Exposure to user research or data-informed design

postings.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, CNC & Sheet
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking an experienced and charismatic engineer for a critical customer-facing Senior Solutions Engineer role. This role supports Sales by providing perspective, feedback, and sharing knowledge learned from the front lines of the aerospace and defense engineering and manufacturing community. This role is a unique blend of customer engagement, technical expertise, and project management. Solutions Engineering will report into the Pre-Sales Engineering community, which is dually led by Sales and Operations.

This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and growing company at the forefront of digital manufacturing. If you are a successful, experienced, team-focused engineer with digital fluency and a sincere enthusiasm about the aerospace industry, this could be the right role for you.

How You'll Contribute:

Customer Engagement and Sales:

• Partner with Account Executives to drive account growth and retention

• Discover, illuminate, digest, organize and execute major projects

• Join Account Executives in onsite visits with customers when appropriate

• Proactively identify and address potential manufacturing challenges (including DFM)

• Stay informed about upcoming customer projects and initiatives to ensure alignment with Xometry's capabilities

• Gather customer insights and feedback to inform sales strategies

Pre-Sales Engineering:

• Assist Pre-Sales Engineering with knowledge gathering, digestion, and ultimately compiling correct and competitive quotes

• Combine customer knowledge, Xometry partner knowledge, and Xometry system knowledge to rapidly address customer needs and shepherd projects to delivery

• Provide project management and oversight on complex opportunities

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• 10+ years of relevant experience in aerospace and defense engineering and manufacturing roles

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering is required

• Experience using Xometry’s services from a customer perspective. Partner perspective is a bonus

• Deep familiarity with the methods, materials, culture and products of organizations such as Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Blue Origin, Anduril, General Dynamics, Moog, SpaceX

• Strong understanding of manufacturing principles, including drawings and GDT

• Particularly strong experience in CNC machining. Composites, Plastics, Harnesses and Sheet Metal Fab are bonuses

• Familiarity with ISO9001, AS9100d, ITAR, NIST and other common and critical compliance and certification requirements

• Excellent English communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills. This must extend into remote/digital environments

• Ability to travel to customer and/or partner sites as needed. 25%-35% travel is typical

• Mountain or Pacific home time zone preferred

• Experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce

• Proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office Suite

Please submit your resume in English

postings.title: Social & Community Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is looking for a Social & Community Manager to own how the brand shows up, sounds, and responds across organic social and community spaces every single day. You will be the face of Xometry online — the daily voice, the person engaging in the communities where our buyers and suppliers already are, and the one making sure nothing falls through the cracks when someone reaches out. This role is part storyteller, part community builder, part first responder. You keep the content calendar on track and partner with our agency on production, but the voice, the engagement, and the day-to-day judgment calls are yours. You'll stand up the tools and triage process that let us listen and respond in real time, and you'll pull in subject matter experts when a conversation needs real technical credibility behind it.

How You’ll Contribute:

• Serve as the face of Xometry and operational lead for organic social & community — owning daily voice, community engagement, and servicing triage

• Represent Xometry in buyer and supplier communities (forums, Reddit, YouTube)

• Stand up a social listening/servicing tool

• Own the social content calendar and partner with the agency on content creation

• Establish a servicing triage process for community and social inquiries

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• 7+ years experience managing organic social and/or online community programs, ideally in a B2B or technical industry

• Strong writing skills and a distinct, adaptable voice — comfortable engaging authentically in forums, Reddit, and other community spaces

• Experience with or working knowledge of social listening/servicing tools

• Ability to triage and prioritize inbound engagement, knowing when to respond directly and when to loop in subject matter experts

• Comfort partnering with an agency on content production while retaining ownership of voice and strategy

• A proactive, community-first mindset — you notice what's happening in the conversation and show up in it

#LI-Remote
Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

postings.title: Website Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We are seeking a highly organized and client-savvy Website Project Manager to serve as the engine behind our website build delivery for mid-market manufacturing clients. This is a unique opportunity for a solution-oriented project management practitioner to bridge the gap between technical B2B buyers and the internal teams who bring their websites to life.

You will thrive at the intersection of client relationship management and operational delivery, specializing in translating ambiguous, non-marketing language from manufacturing clients into clear, actionable direction for designers, developers, and content editors. As both the client's primary point of contact and the internal team's source of truth, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of standard and mid-complexity website build projects, from kickoff through launch, ensuring they are delivered on schedule, within scope, and within budget — without requiring daily oversight from leadership.

How You'll Contribute:

• Project Delivery & Leadership:

• Own project delivery end-to-end, leading post-sale website build projects from kickoff to launch with minimal daily oversight

• Manage resourcing to keep project velocity on pace with milestones by coordinating with department heads to secure design and development resources

• Coordinate quality assurance and risk mitigation by working with QA to confirm deliverables meet internal and client standards, and identify and resolve risks before they affect the timeline

• Client Relationship Management:

• Serve as the primary client contact for assigned manufacturing clients: run client meetings, deliver weekly status updates, and turn client input into clear direction for internal teams

Architect responsible for designing and hardening enterprise-scale Databricks data platforms within client engagements — building the guardrails, automation, and standards that let a growing number of business teams safely build on the platform without it collapsing into unmanaged "click-ops."

• Partner with client business and engineering teams to understand upstream use-case needs and translate them into platform capabilities and guardrails, rather than working from requirements handed down secondhand

Required Technical Qualifications

Platform Architecture Focus:

• End-to-end modern data platform architecture design (lakehouse, ingestion, processing, access layers)

• Hands-on Databricks experience: workspace/persona architecture, Unity Catalog, lakehouse patterns, job orchestration, and native governance tooling (governed data platform patterns, lineage, access controls and maintaining business, technical and compliance metadata), tune and optimize Spark configurations, clusters and Delta Lake storage

• Experience architecting scalable cloud-native systems (AWS)

• Advanced distributed processing and streaming architectures

• Platform security, networking, and automation

• Cost estimation and performance optimization

Migration & Modernization Architecture Focus:

• Leading multi-database migration and modernization initiatives, including onto Databricks

• Deep expertise in OLTP/OLAP system design and schema evolution

• Advanced performance tuning, HA/DR, and security patterns

• Cloud-native database architecture across managed services

• Migration strategy, cutover planning, and risk mitigation

Across Both:

• Architecture documentation and standards enforcement

• IaC and automation strategy (Terraform)

• FinOps-aligned design, including ability to audit and optimize cloud infrastructure expense

• Ability to lead and facilitate technical discussions between key business, technology and knowledge stakeholders

• Ability to develop Databrick roadmaps and implementation roadmaps

• Experience in leading, developing and mentoring delivery teams

Experience Requirements

• 6+ years in data engineering, database engineering, or architecture roles

• 3+ years designing cloud-based data solutions

• 3+ years in the AWS data landscape

• 3+ years hands-on Databricks experience required

• High business acumen — comfortable working directly with client business stakeholders to understand their data and priorities, and translating that into governed, well-documented platform capabilities

• Advanced English (minimum C1)

Benefits

• Pay in USD

• 100% remote work, either from home or in a shared workspace

• Generous holidays and unlimited flexible PTO

• Paid for exams and certifications

• Peer bonus awards

• State of the art laptop and tools

• Equipment & Office Stipend

• Individual professional development plan

• Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

This role may require up to 25% travel, depending on business needs.

NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time.

postings.title: Senior Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Senior CXE Engineer, you are a hands-on builder on enterprise contact center transformations. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in the AWS console: building contact flows and AI agents, writing Lambda functions and CDK stacks, developing React-based agent and admin tooling, and debugging production issues on systems that serve tens of thousands of agents and millions of customer interactions. You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development

• Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues

• Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops

• Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis

• Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets

• Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues

• Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions

Amazon Connect Platform Engineering

• Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing

• Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)

• Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management

• Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)

• Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting

• Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers

Full-Stack & Portal Engineering

• Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)

• Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration

• Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements

Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality

• Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances

• Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring

• Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage

• Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

• Work directly with customer engineering teams: pair on integrations, run technical working sessions, demo completed workstreams, and lead knowledge transfer so customers can operate what you build

• Contribute…

Senior Manager, Client Success (Lender)

About The Role

Built Technologies is transforming how capital moves through construction and real estate finance — one of the largest, most complex sectors in the economy. Our platform connects lenders, including many of the top U.S. banks, with the owners, developers, and general contractors they finance. When a draw is approved, a builder can pay subcontractors. When a compliance document clears, a project moves forward. The work we do here is not abstract — it has a direct and material impact on how capital flows and how real estate gets built.

Built's Client Success team drives the retention, adoption, and value realization that make our customer relationships durable and growing — and the Senior Manager of Client Success leads that function at a broader scope. In this role, you will oversee strategic CSMs and managers, drive the strategic direction of the entire client success function, and partner with executive leadership on how the organization scales with Built's growth. At this level, you manage managers or a large team, operate with high autonomy, and connect your function's work directly to Built's net revenue retention, expansion revenue, and market reputation. You build high-performing organizations, develop leaders, and represent client success as a strategic driver of Built's business.

Our Guiding Principles

• Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don't hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.

• Help Customers Win. We learn our customers' businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.

• Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.

• Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don't wait to be asked.

• Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You'll Do

• Lead Client Success team and Managers of Client Success — establish organizational structure, strategic priorities, and performance accountability across a broader span of people and client relationships.

• Develop and implement organization-wide client success strategy, playbooks, and operating methodologies that drive consistent retention and expansion outcomes across all client segments.

• Hire, develop, and mentor CS managers and senior leaders — build a culture of accountability, client obsession, and continuous improvement that attracts and retains top CS talent.

• Set performance expectations and metrics for the client success function — monitor NRR, retention, adoption, and expansion results, and implement improvements that drive consistent commercial outcomes.

• Partner with Sales, Implementation, Product, and Finance to align client success strategy with company objectives and ensure Built delivers a seamless, high-value client experience across the full lifecycle.

• Lead strategic client relationships at the executive level for Built's most important accounts — serve as the senior CS voice in executive client conversations and maintain high-level presence in the portfolio.

• Drive innovation in client success approaches, tooling, and engagement models — continuously improve how the team identifies, develops, and captures expansion opportunities at scale.

• Develop annual forecasts and business plans for customer retention and expansion targets; represent the function's performance and strategy clearly to executive leadership.

• Champion AI and automation adoption across the function — build the systems and expectations that let the team manage more clients more effectively without proportional growth in headcount.

What You'll Bring

• 8–12+ years of experience in client success, customer success, or strategic account management, with 3–5+ years leading multi-level teams or managing a client success function in a high-growth SaaS or fintech environment.

• A proven organizational builder — you've developed CS managers and senior ICs, built strong team cultures, and created conditions where client success professionals do the best work of their careers.

• Deep expertise in client success strategy — scalable engagement models, health scoring, expansion playbooks, and the commercial levers that drive strong NRR in a SaaS business.

• A demonstrated ability to partner with executive leadership on strategy — translating company growth objectives into CS operating plans and connecting team performance to revenue outcomes.

Want to help us help others? We’re hiring!

GoFundMe is the world’s most powerful community for good, dedicated to helping people help each other. By uniting individuals and nonprofits in one place, GoFundMe makes it easy and safe for people to ask for help and support causes—for themselves and each other. Together, our community has raised more than $40 billion since 2010.

Join us! GoFundMe is looking for a dedicated Artificial Intelligence (AI) Specialist to join our Early Careers Program and Data & AI Team to help elevate our analytics at GoFundMe. The Data & AI Team at GoFundMe is building the future of intelligent, helpful systems that power generosity at scale. We’re combining cutting-edge research in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI with deep product understanding to design systems that reason, plan, act, and improve lives.

You will join us in prototyping and evaluating next-generation autonomous agents and multi-agent systems . You’ll work alongside scientists and engineers on high-impact projects—from campaign creation and optimization to donor engagement and AI-native storytelling tools.

You’re an ideal candidate if you love all things data and want to accelerate your career in data and analytics at a fast-growing organization. You have demonstrated experience working with data, are highly collaborative, and are passionate about evangelizing and showing what is possible with data.

This opportunity is open to Masters or PhD students entering their final year of study. This program runs from March 2027 - August 2027 and is based in Buenos Aires, with young professionals expected onsite three days per week.

The Job

• Prototype LLM-based agents with advanced reasoning, planning, and long-term task decomposition capabilities

• Explore multi-agent orchestration using frameworks like LangGraph , CrewAI , and Google ADK

• Implement agent memory architectures like Pinecone , ChromaDB , or Weaviate , enabling persistent context across conversations and workflows

• Integrate external APIs , internal tools, and structured data into agentic planning and execution flows

• Help build scalable evaluation pipelines , including human-in-the-loop and automated testing frameworks

• Contribute to our safety, governance, and observability tooling—embedding transparency and accountability into agent behavior

You

• Pursuing an M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, NLP, Machine Learning , or a related discipline

• Hands-on experience with LLMs and/or agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc.)

• Understanding of prompt engineering , tool use , and agent architecture patterns

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, research-meets-production environment with ambiguity and exploration

• Passion for organization and documentation

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to build strong relationships and trust with all partners at GoFundMe both technical and non-technical

Nice to have…

•

• Experience with A2A protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP)

• Exposure to cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP), Docker/Kubernetes , and microservice design

• Familiarity with reinforcement learning , agent observability , or ethical AI frameworks

• Contributions to open-source agentic tools or LLM-based researc

Why you’ll love it here

• Make an Impact : Be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive difference in millions of lives every year.

• Innovative Environment : Work with a diverse, passionate, and talented team in a fast-paced, forward-thinking atmosphere.

• Collaborative Team : Join a fun and collaborative team that works hard and celebrates success together.

postings.descriptionText:
Want to help us help others? We're hiring!

GoFundMe is the world’s most powerful community for good, dedicated to helping people help each other. By uniting individuals and nonprofits in one place, GoFundMe makes it easy and safe for people to ask for help and support causes—for themselves and each other. Together, our community has raised more than $40 billion since 2010.

Join us! The GoFundMe team is searching for our next Senior Software Engineer, Privacy & Data Governance to join a growing team building and operating the technical infrastructure that ensures GoFundMe honors its data privacy and information management commitments at scale.

You will work across engineering, privacy, and compliance, partnering with Legal & Privacy to translate regulatory requirements into durable, production-grade services. That means building the systems that execute data subject requests, enforce data classification across our data ecosystem, and propagate consent signals from capture through every downstream system.

If you enjoy building reliable, auditable systems under real regulatory pressure and getting the edge cases right, this role is for you.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates considered for this role will be located in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The Job

• Own Data Subject Request pipeline reliability end-to-end: When our DSR orchestrator reports a deletion failure or a pre-flight check flags an inconsistency, you investigate and resolve it [on a shared rotation / as part of normal triage, to confirm]. You'll build DSR handling pipelines that are auditable, resumable, and idempotent, and that can retry safely from an inconsistent state and hold up against third-party API timeouts, partial writes, and stalled event consumers.

• Own access, deletion, and objection processes at the data layer: Maintain and extend the scripts and workflows that carry out individual-level privacy requests across our data warehouse, handling edge cases like legal holds, financial data exemptions, and users who appear across multiple systems under different identifiers.

• Build the systems that classify and protect personal data: Classify and tag personal and sensitive data, and enforce sensitivity tiers across our data catalog. Apply the right redaction method for the situation (e.g., hard delete, nullify, pseudonymize), using approved tokenization and encryption services where policy requires them.

• Drive consent signal propagation: Make sure consent state travels correctly from capture (analytics, retargeting, model training opt-outs, email subscription statuses) through tag managers, event pipelines, and downstream systems such as ad platforms, CDPs, and the data warehouse. Identify and close gaps where a signal is captured but doesn't reach a downstream system, or isn't honored end-to-end across web, mobile, email, and server-to-server channels. Help design and build a centralized consent source of truth.

• Partner on consent management platform (CMP) operations: Work with Pro PMs and Engineering on release management, QA, and production troubleshooting for our CMP across Consumer and Pro instances.

• Build privacy in early: Turn privacy requirements into concrete engineering decisions that support Privacy by Design. Bring them into product development and security engineering reviews, and know when to escalate together with Legal & Privacy.

• Produce technical compliance evidence: Generate the coverage reports, logs, and documentation that support internal privacy-compliance reviews and external audits.

• Use AI to increase engineering impact: Integrate AI-assisted tools and coding agents into your day-to-day workflow to deliver more than traditional development practices alone would allow. Use them to accelerate prototyping, implementation, test generation, debugging, data investigation, documentation, and repetitive engineering work, while holding to our standards for accuracy, maintainability, security, and code review.

You

We care most about strong engineering fundamentals, the ability to learn a new domain quickly, and the judgment to partner with Legal, Privacy, and engineering teams and drive technical work to completion.

• Senior engineering experience with hands-on privacy exposure: 5+ years building and operating production backend or distributed systems, including meaningful, repeated work on privacy or compliance systems, such as DSR or deletion flows, consent handling, data classification, or retention.

• Strong programming: Fluency in a general-purpose language (Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, or similar) for ETL, redaction scripts, pre-flight checks, and coverage reporting, including integrating with external vendor REST APIs (authentication, error handling, rate limiting).

• Reliable, long-running workflows: Experience designing or maintaining multi-step pipelines with independent failure modes, including checkpointing, resumability, and idempotent retries. Incident debugging and ownership: Experience driving a real incident to resolution independently, including one where a pipeline left data partially processed and you reconstructed ground truth from logs, database state, or audit trails. Operating services: Comfort deploying and running services in a containerized environment (Kubernetes basics: deploy, read logs, diagnose a failing pod), with observability and sound handling of secrets and credentials.

• Working knowledge of data stores: Comfort reading and writing SQL and working with data warehouses and databases well enough to build and validate deletion, redaction, and reporting logic.

• Requirements into engineering work: Ability to take a privacy requirement, identify the concrete engineering work it creates, and push back when something is infeasible or counterproductive.

We’re hiring a Principal Kotlin/Spring Boot contractor to help own the execution backbone of a no-code workflow platform. This is not a simple CRUD service. The Orchestrator runtime is a multi-module system that receives workflow execution requests, persists durable state with Temporal, coordinates graph execution, integrates HTTP, agent, LLM, and human-review nodes, and safely executes increasingly AI-generated workflow graphs. You’ll join the squad responsible for the runtime layer that everything else depends on.

Responsibilities :
• Design and harden the Kotlin/Spring Boot runtime that executes workflow graphs reliably in production.
• Implement and improve Temporal.io workflows, activities, signals, queries, retries, and recovery paths.
• Strengthen contract-first APIs and shared contracts.
• Own failure-mode thinking across distributed execution retries, idempotency, partial failure, replay safety, pause/resume, and graceful degradation.
• Work across node types, including HTTP, agentic tool-calling, LLM, and human-in-the-loop review nodes.
• Improve integration coverage using Test containers and layered Docker Compose profiles.
• Collaborate closely with Composer and AI/KB teams on execution semantics and runtime behavior.
• Write clear operational documentation and runbooks for a reliability-critical service.

Qualifications:
• Strong production Kotlin backend experience.
• Strong Spring Boot experience in distributed systems or platform services.
• Hands-on Temporal experience in production.
• Strong understanding of workflow durability, retries, idempotency, and recovery design.
• Experience with multi-module Gradle codebases and contract-first API design.
• Experience with JPA/Hibernate and PostgreSQL.
• Experience with Docker Compose/Test containers integration testing.
• Comfort debugging multi-service systems with mixed Kotlin and Python components.
• Experience with observability tools like micrometer
• Experience with contract first development
• Advanced English is required for this position.

Strong Pluses:
• Experience with DAG/workflow/orchestration engines.
• Experience with AI/LLM/agent runtimes or other non-deterministic execution systems.
• Familiarity with FastAPI-based workers and cross-language integration.
• Experience with auth/token provider abstractions, OAuth2/JWT, or cached token acquisition.
• Experience writing operational docs, runbooks, and reliability guidance.

Job description: Principal Full-Stack Engineer (Must: React & Python)

The Product is focused on building the canonical enterprise representation of platform capabilities and enabling AI-powered knowledge discovery across the organization. The platform is evolving from a generated catalog into a live, AI-enriched capability map that supports chatbot experiences, roadmap insights, gap analysis, and graph-oriented knowledge outputs.
The product currently includes React-driven capability and domain experiences, asynchronous API-fed content refresh patterns, capability normalization and tree-building logic, filtering across nested hierarchies, implementation scoring, maturity visualization, and chatbot integration backed by the Enterprise Knowledge Base API.
We are looking for engineers who are comfortable working across frontend product engineering, Python-based data processing, hierarchical data modeling, and AI integration. The ideal candidate can translate complex business capability structures into intuitive, trustworthy, and visualization-friendly user experiences while applying strong engineering discipline to AI-assisted solutions.

Responsibilities:
• Build and extend React experiences for capability map exploration, search, filtering, scoring, and discovery.
• Maintain Python scripts that ingest, normalize, and transform capability taxonomy data from APIs.
• Improve data-shaping and tree-building logic that powers hierarchical UI experiences and map navigation.
• Integrate evolving Knowledge Base and AI services into catalog workflows and discovery experiences.
• Validate AI-assisted code, UI generation, and data transformations with rigorous engineering standards.
• Work within a micro-frontends module architecture in a monorepo environment and integrate with Orchestrator APIs.
• Contribute to experimentation, testing, build reliability, deployment automation, and engineering best practices.

Qualifications:
• Strong React 19 engineering experience with modern component patterns and asynchronous UI flows.
• Passionate about Web Vitals, Real User monitoring, experimentation.
• Experience building complex interactive UIs such as graph editors, workflow builders, diagramming tools, low-code tools, or canvas-heavy applications, hierarchical data structures, taxonomies.
• Strong frontend state management skills, including React Context + reducer patterns and interaction history such as undo/redo.
• Strong Python experience in data processing, scripting, automation, and API integration.
• Experience building data-heavy applications with advanced search, filtering, and discovery capabilities.
• Experience integrating REST APIs, STOMP/Websocket and backend-driven content sources.
• Practical testing experience with Vitest, Playwright, or equivalent testing frameworks.
• Experimented with Generative UI and MCPs
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across business and technical stakeholder groups.
• Comfort working in evolving environments where AI capabilities and requirements continue to expand.
• Advanced English is required for this position.

Location: Argentina / Mexico (CDMX or Guadalajara) / Peru

● Hands-on experience with data architecture: schemas, identity resolution, datasets, destinations.

Rol: Technical Delivery Lead / Staff Architect

Reporta a: VP LATAM

Departamento: Delivery

Alcance: Delivery, transversal a todos los proyectos y equipos técnicos de LATAM

Ubicación: Córdoba o CABA (Argentina)

Modalidad: Híbrida (presencialidad mínima requerida 6 veces al mes)

Propósito del Rol

Garantizar la excelencia técnica del portfolio de LATAM, actuando como el socio técnico estratégico (Technical Partner) del Delivery Manager. Este rol lidera la viabilidad de las soluciones, la adopción de prácticas de desarrollo asistido por IA y la excelencia operativa. Es el puente donde la estrategia técnica (Architect) se materializa en resultados de negocio (Delivery), asegurando escalabilidad, innovación y calidad en cada proyecto.

Estrategia y Responsabilidades Críticas

1) Sinergia y Technical Partnering

Colaboración estrecha con los Delivery Managers y Project Managers en la definición de Account Plans, aportando la visión técnica a largo plazo, validando la factibilidad de las propuestas comerciales (Upselling/Cross-selling) y gestionando técnicamente los escalamientos de alta criticidad para asegurar la continuidad del negocio, integrando en esta labor un alto dominio de soluciones enterprise, data e AI como eje fundamental del offering de Santex.

2) Rollout y Evolución de Procesos Agénticos

Liderar el despliegue y la evolución continua de los workflows agénticos, integrando aprendizajes obtenidos para optimizar el SDLC de forma permanente. Es un requisito excluyente que este rol actúe como referente interno de agentización e impulse el uso intensivo de AI-assisted development. Responsable de ayudar a Delivery a implementar y medir la eficiencia operativa derivada del uso intensivo de la IA, asegurando mejoras de productividad sin detrimento de la calidad técnica.

3) Monitoreo de buenas prácticas de desarrollo

Asegurar que los equipos de Delivery apliquen de forma consistente las buenas prácticas de desarrollo definidas por la organización: calidad del código, pruebas, documentación, seguridad y uso adecuado de las herramientas. Detectar desvíos tempranamente y accionarlos, comenzando por anticiparse a las no conformidades críticas.

4) Intervención técnica en proyectos

Actuar como punto de escalada técnica ante problemas complejos en proyectos: bloqueantes de arquitectura, decisiones críticas de diseño, conflictos tecnológicos o situaciones de riesgo técnico. Intervenir con criterio y rapidez para desbloquear equipos y proteger la calidad de la entrega.

5) Generación proactiva de soluciones en Pre-sales

Actuar como generador proactivo de propuestas de solución técnica. Basándose en un profundo entendimiento de las necesidades, desafíos y oportunidades del cliente, diseña estrategias tecnológicas que impulsen su negocio, superando el rol de soporte reactivo y posicionándose como consultor técnico estratégico que aporta valor incremental. Asegurando que dichas propuestas estén fundamentadas en el alto dominio de soluciones enterprise, data e AI, posicionándolas como el core del offering de valor de Santex.

6) Setup de equipos e inicio de proyectos críticos

Asistir activamente a los Delivery Managers en la conformación y configuración de los equipos de ingeniería para afrontar nuevos proyectos. Esto incluye apoyar a Delivery en los procesos de screening técnico.

Acompañar el despliegue de las bases y el framework de trabajo durante las etapas iniciales para garantizar un arranque sólido y exitoso del proyecto.

Apoyar a los managers en la identificación de las oportunidades de desarrollo de los líderes técnicos de cada equipo.

7) Input para la matriz de desarrollo de personas

Aportar criterio técnico a la matriz de desarrollo individual del área de Delivery: identificar brechas de habilidades, proponer niveles de seniority esperados por rol y tecnología, y definir los hitos técnicos que los colaboradores deben alcanzar en su plan de carrera.

Funciones Esenciales

• Gestión Agéntica: Iterar workflows basándose en métricas, liderar el AI Tech Board y medir la eficiencia operativa (productivity gains vs. quality).

• Intervención Técnica: Resolver bloqueos de arquitectura, performance o deuda técnica, actuando como punto de escalada técnica.

• Pre-sales Proactivo: Realizar Discovery técnico, diseñar soluciones, y estimar recursos para asegurar la viabilidad comercial y técnica de las propuestas.

• Monitoreo de Buenas Prácticas: Auditar calidad mediante revisiones, métricas (GitHub, etc.) y planes de mejora.

• Screening y Setup: Apoyar a Delivery en el screening técnico y configurar las bases sólidas para el arranque de proyectos críticos.

KPIs de Éxito

• Eficiencia Operativa: % de incremento en productividad mediante IA sin detrimento de la calidad técnica (defect rate).

• Excelencia Técnica: Reducción de incidentes post-entrega y deuda técnica en proyectos clave.

• Liderazgo de Talento: Progreso técnico de los equipos supervisados (brechas de habilidades cerradas).

• Impacto Comercial: Tasa de conversión y valor incremental en propuestas de pre-sales.

Qualifications

• Formación académica en ingeniería de software o afines.

• Experiencia como Arquitecto de Software, Staff Engineer, Technical Manager o Engineer Manager.

• Dominio experto (power user) en herramientas de AI-coding de vanguardia, con un marco de desarrollo claro y replicable.

• Dominio de español e inglés.

• Conocimiento profundo en soluciones basadas en IA, más allá del desarrollo asistido por IA, para colaborar con el área de IA de Santex en la creación de soluciones para clientes, reforzando el posicionamiento de la empresa como referente en IA en LATAM.

• Plus: Experiencia en consultoría de servicios tecnológicos.

Liderazgo y Habilidades Humanas

Comunicación efectiva: Comunica de manera clara y efectiva ideas técnicas complejas tanto a colegas técnicos como a stakeholders no técnicos. Escucha activa para identificar necesidades y preocupaciones.

postings.title: High-Speed Analog Layout Design Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Celero Communications is a fast-growing semiconductor startup developing high-performance coherent DSP technology for next-generation AI infrastructure. We recently announced a $275M Series C following the validation of the industry’s first 2nm coherent DSP silicon. Bloomberg also reported that Alphabet’s CapitalG has backed Celero at a $3B valuation. As we continue to grow, we’re hiring exceptional talent across the United States, Canada, and Argentina for a variety of exciting opportunities.

We are seeking a High-Speed Analog Layout Design Engineer to drive the layout design of complex analog and mixed-signal IP blocks that are at the heart of our advanced optical communication systems. As a key member of the Analog & Mixed-Signal (AMS) design team, you will lead layout development of critical blocks such as ADCs, DACs, PLLs, and other high-performance analog/mixed-signal circuits. You will interface closely with circuit designers, CAD/PDK teams, and other layout engineers to ensure first-pass silicon success. This is a hands-on technical role ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys mentoring others while contributing directly to cutting-edge chip development.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead and own the physical layout design of complex analog/mixed-signal macros (e.g., ADCs, DACs, PLLs), from floor planning through final verification
• Collaborate closely with schematic designers to create optimal layout solutions considering performance, matching, symmetry, and reliability
• Mentor and guide junior layout engineers/contractors across multiple time zones, enforcing best practices in layout design and verification
• Perform and debug full hierarchy LVS, DRC, PERC, ERC, and other signoff checks using industry-standard tools (Pegasus, Calibre, etc.)
• Contribute to chip-level planning including top-level floor planning, block integration, power grid implementation, and signal routing
• Participate in layout design reviews and provide technical leadership for layout quality, verification completeness, and schedule adherence
• Support automation initiatives through scripting and tool customization (SKILL, TCL, Python is a plus)

Required Qualifications
• Minimum 1+ years of hands-on analog/mixed-signal layout design experience and in advanced CMOS/FinFET technologies
• Proven track record of top-level integration IP layout macros and preparing IPs for handoff to Physical Design
• Proven leadership in owning major IP layout macros or full-chip-level layout at FinFET nodes (TSMC preferred)
• At least 1+ years of experience with TSMC FinFET process nodes (N3, N5, N7, or N16)
• Deep understanding of device physics, layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, LDE, etc.), and their impact on circuit performance
• Strong expertise in layout best practices for device matching, noise isolation, ESD protection, symmetry, and parasitic minimization
• Proficiency in floor planning, hierarchical block integration, routing strategy, and power/ground grid design
• Expertise with Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre, Pegasus, and other layout and verification tools
• Familiarity with layout verification flows, including LVS, DRC, PERC, Density, DFM, ERC, and Antenna rules
• Experience working in collaborative environments with international and remote teams
• Strong documentation and communication skills with the ability to clearly present layout trade-offs and status to cross-functional teams
• Experience using revision control systems for layout design management

Preferred Qualifications
• Exposure to optical or high-speed analog interfaces is a strong plus
• Working knowledge of SKILL, TCL, or Python for layout automation or design flow optimization
• Proven ability to collaborate with international teams (U.S., Canada, Argentina)
• Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail and follow-through
• Ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Proactive, eager-to-learn mindset with excellent problem-solving skills

What We Offer
• The chance to play a foundational role at a high-growth semiconductor start-up
• Exposure to a wide variety of cross functional teams
• A collaborative, international team culture where ideas and initiative are valued
• The opportunity to grow alongside Celero as we scale and shape the future of our industry
• A foundational role at a fast-growing semiconductor start-up shaping the future of AI and data center connectivity
