postings.title: Full Stack and Backend NodeJS TypeScript/JavaScript Engineer (Senior) - Latin America, Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional software development experience (backend-focused)

• Strong professional experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript

• Experience building low-latency API services in AWS

• Experience building scalable RESTful APIs

• Experience with SDK integrations to other services

• Experience with PostgreSQL/AuroraDB, including Row-Level Security (RLS)

• Experience building secure multi-tenant environments

• Comfortable writing raw SQL and managing schema migrations (e.g., node-postgres, node-pg-migrate)

• Professional experience with React

• Strong testing practices, including integration tests against real databases and failure-mode/fault-injection testing

• Experience working with AI coding assistants as part of daily development

• CI/CD application creation and maintenance skills

• Solid understanding of full stack development, with the ability to contribute to frontend work when needed

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with append-only, event-sourced, or bitemporal data models

• Experience with Fastify and schema-first validation (e.g., Zod)

• Experience running containerized services on AWS Fargate/ECS

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Full Stack and Backend NodeJS TypeScript/JavaScript Engineer (Senior) - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional software development experience (backend-focused)

• Strong professional experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript

• Experience building low-latency API services in AWS

• Experience building scalable RESTful APIs

• Experience with SDK integrations to other services

• Experience with PostgreSQL/AuroraDB, including Row-Level Security (RLS)

• Experience building secure multi-tenant environments

• Comfortable writing raw SQL and managing schema migrations (e.g., node-postgres, node-pg-migrate)

• Professional experience with React

• Strong testing practices, including integration tests against real databases and failure-mode/fault-injection testing

• Experience working with AI coding assistants as part of daily development

• CI/CD application creation and maintenance skills

• Solid understanding of full stack development, with the ability to contribute to frontend work when needed

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with append-only, event-sourced, or bitemporal data models

• Experience with Fastify and schema-first validation (e.g., Zod)

• Experience running containerized services on AWS Fargate/ECS

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Full Stack and Backend NodeJS TypeScript/JavaScript Engineer (Senior) - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional software development experience (backend-focused)

• Strong professional experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript

• Experience building low-latency API services in AWS

• Experience building scalable RESTful APIs

• Experience with SDK integrations to other services

• Experience with PostgreSQL/AuroraDB, including Row-Level Security (RLS)

• Experience building secure multi-tenant environments

• Comfortable writing raw SQL and managing schema migrations (e.g., node-postgres, node-pg-migrate)

• Professional experience with React

• Strong testing practices, including integration tests against real databases and failure-mode/fault-injection testing

• Experience working with AI coding assistants as part of daily development

• CI/CD application creation and maintenance skills

• Solid understanding of full stack development, with the ability to contribute to frontend work when needed

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with append-only, event-sourced, or bitemporal data models

• Experience with Fastify and schema-first validation (e.g., Zod)

• Experience running containerized services on AWS Fargate/ECS

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Laravel Developer + React - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight Consulting is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight Consulting. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• 4+ years of experience with Laravel, specifically with Laravel 8 and above.

• Experience with: Eloquent ORM, Laravel Authentication, Laravel Query Builder.

• Experience with testing tools, such as Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Laravel Dusk, Playwright.

• Experience with Inertia.js and RESTful API in Laravel.

• Experience with frontend development (React, Vue.js, Laravel Livewire, etc).

• Bonus points if you have experience with Tailwind CSS.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon, both regarding estimates and the general process.

• Ability to identify with Bluelight's clients' goals and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Forensic attention to detail.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: React Engineer - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• 3+ years of professional software development experience. 5+ years preferred but not required.

• 3+ years of professional experience working with React.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• A four-year college degree is required.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon, both regarding estimates and the general process.

• Ability to identify with Bluelight's clients' goals and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

• An understanding of best practices and a commitment to following them.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Forensic attention to detail.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• 3+ years of professional software development experience. 5+ years preferred but not required.

• 3+ years of professional experience working with React.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• A four-year college degree is required.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon, both regarding estimates and the general process.

• Ability to identify with Bluelight's clients' goals and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

• An understanding of best practices and a commitment to following them.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Forensic attention to detail.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities
• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

• Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.

• Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements
• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have
• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities
• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

• Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.

• Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements
• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have
• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities
• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

• Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.

• Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements
• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have
• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities
• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

• Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.

• Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements
• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have
• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities
• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

• Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.

• Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements
• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have
• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Python/Flask+React Fullstack Engineer - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Technical Qualifications
• Backend: 5+ years of experience with Python (Flask, FastAPI, Django) and building complex, service-oriented server logic.

• Frontend: Modern JavaScript/TypeScript development utilizing ReactJS for scalable interactive web applications.

• Data Access: Heavy experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), data storage systems, and advanced data-access models.

Core Responsibilities:
• Full-Stack Ownership: Architect, test, and ship end-to-end full-stack software solutions to fulfill complex financial reporting and data visualization needs.

• Optimization: Refactor existing software continuously using Agile methodologies to improve overall maintainability and speed.

• Collaboration: Partner with product managers and data engineering teams to safely extract, parse, and serve multi-billion-dollar private asset analytics.

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Python/Flask+React Fullstack Engineer - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Technical Qualifications
• Backend: 5+ years of experience with Python (Flask, FastAPI, Django) and building complex, service-oriented server logic.

• Frontend: Modern JavaScript/TypeScript development utilizing ReactJS for scalable interactive web applications.

• Data Access: Heavy experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), data storage systems, and advanced data-access models.

Core Responsibilities:
• Full-Stack Ownership: Architect, test, and ship end-to-end full-stack software solutions to fulfill complex financial reporting and data visualization needs.

• Optimization: Refactor existing software continuously using Agile methodologies to improve overall maintainability and speed.

• Collaboration: Partner with product managers and data engineering teams to safely extract, parse, and serve multi-billion-dollar private asset analytics.

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python/Flask+React) - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Technical Qualifications
• Backend: 5+ years of experience with Python (Flask, FastAPI, Django) and building complex, service-oriented server logic.

• Frontend: Modern JavaScript/TypeScript development utilizing ReactJS for scalable interactive web applications.

• Data Access: Heavy experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), data storage systems, and advanced data-access models.

Core Responsibilities:
• Full-Stack Ownership: Architect, test, and ship end-to-end full-stack software solutions to fulfill complex financial reporting and data visualization needs.

• Optimization: Refactor existing software continuously using Agile methodologies to improve overall maintainability and speed.

• Collaboration: Partner with product managers and data engineering teams to safely extract, parse, and serve multi-billion-dollar private asset analytics.

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python/Flask+React) - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Technical Qualifications
• Backend: 5+ years of experience with Python (Flask, FastAPI, Django) and building complex, service-oriented server logic.

• Frontend: Modern JavaScript/TypeScript development utilizing ReactJS for scalable interactive web applications.

• Data Access: Heavy experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), data storage systems, and advanced data-access models.

Core Responsibilities:
• Full-Stack Ownership: Architect, test, and ship end-to-end full-stack software solutions to fulfill complex financial reporting and data visualization needs.

• Optimization: Refactor existing software continuously using Agile methodologies to improve overall maintainability and speed.

• Collaboration: Partner with product managers and data engineering teams to safely extract, parse, and serve multi-billion-dollar private asset analytics.

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python/Flask+React) - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Technical Qualifications
• Backend: 5+ years of experience with Python (Flask, FastAPI, Django) and building complex, service-oriented server logic.

• Frontend: Modern JavaScript/TypeScript development utilizing ReactJS for scalable interactive web applications.

• Data Access: Heavy experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), data storage systems, and advanced data-access models.

Core Responsibilities:
• Full-Stack Ownership: Architect, test, and ship end-to-end full-stack software solutions to fulfill complex financial reporting and data visualization needs.

• Optimization: Refactor existing software continuously using Agile methodologies to improve overall maintainability and speed.

• Collaboration: Partner with product managers and data engineering teams to safely extract, parse, and serve multi-billion-dollar private asset analytics.

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Associate Sales Operations Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 
 
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
 
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.


The Sales Operations Manager is key to enabling our sales teams (Client Partners and Client Solution Managers) to drive revenue at scale, efficiently and strategically. The role owns revenue planning and pricing, operational effectiveness of our tooling and sales processes, and productive cross-functional partnership across internal teams and our partners. You will support our Business Units representing Twitch, Roblox and Admazing. You'll act as a right hand to the Partner Director on planning, reporting and analysis for the assigned Business Unit, and as the leader of the Client Solutions team, partnering with sales leaders on strategies that improve stakeholder experience, optimize performance and reduce operational costs.
We're looking for a highly organized, self-starting professional who is passionate about process design and optimization, anticipates issues, and takes initiative to solve them.

Main Responsibilities
• Quarterly and annual planning; revenue planning and pricing.

• Weekly sales reporting and analysis: opportunities, pipeline health, weekly status.

• Reporting and analysis for upper management on delivery, attainment, pacing, growth, coverage, efficiency and opportunities.

• Lead a team of CSMs

• Implement processes and procedures to scale.

• Knowledge management: maintain and grow process documentation.

• Process automation and continuous improvement, including leveraging AI tools to streamline reporting, analysis and workflows; provide input on sales ops policies and procedures based on sales feedback and real practice.

• Liaison with partners' sales operations teams.

• Liaison with finance teams; support at closing time; revenue control with the partner's Sales Finance team.

• Foster and maintain strong working relationships with critical business partners (Revenue Recognition, Legal, Finance, etc.).

• Work closely with cross-functional teams on strategic projects.

Skills and Experience Required:
• Experience working in a fast-paced technology company, preferably within the digital advertising landscape. Knowledge of mobile advertising, digital media, and/or relevant industry KPIs is a strong plus.

• Strong ability to influence, communicate effectively, and drive change across multiple stakeholders and levels of management.

• Highly adaptable and able to prioritize, multitask, and quickly shift focus to respond to changing business needs and drive growth.

• Self-starter with the ability to work independently, take ownership, and efficiently manage multiple priorities.

• Detail-oriented, highly organized, creative, and resourceful, with a strong problem-solving mindset.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a collaborative and positive attitude.

• AI & Automation: Daily, hands-on experience using AI tools such as Gemini, Claude, N8N, or similar platforms to automate workflows, improve processes, and drive efficiency. This is a core and non-negotiable requirement of the role.

• Data & Tools: Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets, particularly for reporting, data analysis, and performance tracking. Experience using Salesforce is required.

• Languages: Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, are required.

Why Join Us?
 
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.  
 
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together. 
 
#ALEPH

postings.title: Junior HRBP Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 
 
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
 
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.


We are looking for an Associate Analyst, HRBP to join the Human Resources  team in LATAM. This is a junior position that plays a key operational role supporting our Regional HRBP, ensuring our people processes run smoothly across 18+ countries and 18+ business units.
You will work closely with the Regional HRBP, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, People Service Delivery, and business leaders across the region, contributing to a seamless employee experience and helping turn people priorities into action. You will support key HR processes, provide insights and follow-up, and help ensure that our people practices are consistently and effectively delivered across the region in line with global guidelines.
This role is designed for someone who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and is energized by problem-solving, not paralyzed by it.

Key responsibilities:
1. Hiring & Selection

•
Support the Regional HRBP on submitting the hiring requests to TA through Workday

•
Share regular updates with the Regional HRBP on hiring status and flag any potential hiring risks or challenges

2. Onboarding & Offboarding

•
Coordinate and facilitate welcome meetings/induction for new hires

•
Ensure hiring managers take an active role in a standardised onboarding/induction template, and contribute to the onboarding process where necessary

•
Conduct the scheduled check-in meetings with new employees and their managers; document key findings and flag risks to the Regional HRBP

•
Track onboarding and offboarding processes: documentation, system updates, coordination with legal providers, and final payment follow-up

•
Conduct the exit interview for voluntary resignations and analyse exit surveys to flag risks or challenges to the Regional HRBP

•
Ensure all people movement events are processed accurately and on time in Workday

3. HR Employee Support

•
Act as a point of contact for complex HR queries related to employee relations, policies and procedures, performance and compensation from employees and managers across LATAM

•
Collaborate with PSD on complex employee queries related to other HR topics such as time off requests and balances, Workday challenges, etc.

•
Liaise with PSD on open Jira tickets and ensure timely resolution and follow-up

•
Actively contribute to the FAQ/knowledge base for recurring questions to reduce query volume over time, in partnership with the broader HR team

4. Engagement Plan Execution Support

•
Support the execution of the LATAM Engagement Plan (Career Path Program, Recognition Program, AI & Automation initiatives)

•
Coordinate logistics for engagement activities: communications, scheduling, materials, and tracking

•
Assist in collecting and organizing data for engagement surveys and post-program follow-ups

5. HR Systems & Data Integrity

•
Own the accuracy of Workday organizational structures: positions, attributes, reporting lines, and job profiles

•
Perform regular audits to ensure all people movements (new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations) are correctly reflected in the system

•
Cross-check open positions in Workday against workforce planning data and flag discrepancies to the Regional HRBP

•
Coordinate with different HR teams globally to resolve data inconsistencies

•
Prepare HR reports on demand: headcount, open positions, engagement metrics, and data sanity checks

•
Support the Regional HRBP with data preparation for leadership presentations and business reviews

•
Maintain data hygiene across HR tracking tools (spreadsheets, Workday exports, dashboards)

What You Need For This Role
Background

• Degree in Human Resources, Labour Relations, Organizational Psychology, or related field

Experience

• 1 to 3 years of HR experience in dynamic, fast-moving environments

• Experience with HRIS platforms (Workday experience is a strong plus, not a requirement)

• Exposure to multi-country HR operations is valued but not mandatory

Skills

• Advanced English — written and spoken; most team communication is in English

• G Suite (Google Sheets, Docs, Slides) — advanced level required

• AI tools literacy (familiarity with Claude or similar tools is a plus)

• Analytical mindset — comfortable working with data, spotting inconsistencies, and building clean reports

Bonus track — what sets great candidates apart

• High tolerance for ambiguity — you don't need everything to be defined to take action

• Dynamism — you shift context quickly and don't lose quality when the pace picks up

• Comfort with uncertainty — you see change as the norm, not the exception

• Proactive communication — you flag issues before they become problems

• Discretion — you handle sensitive information with maturity and judgment

Why Join Us?
 
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

postings.title: Programmatic Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 
 
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
 
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.


Aleph is seeking a strategic, high-energy Programmatic Specialist to represent Spotify across the LATAM region. You don't need to be a hands-on trafficker or optimizer, but you do need to speak the language of DSPs, SSPs, and Ad Exchanges fluently enough to sell with real credibility, handle objections, and guide agencies through the offering.

What you'll do
• Own revenue targets and pipeline growth for Spotify's programmatic solutions (self-serve, PMPs, always-on activations) across LATAM markets.

• Proactively prospect and identify new opportunities, and unblock stalled ones within agencies and brands — finding the right internal contact, the right angle, and the right moment to move a deal forward.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with agency programmatic desks, buying, strategy, and digital teams across multiple markets — know how agencies are structured internally and how to navigate them.

• Evangelize Spotify's programmatic offering to agencies and clients, driving upsell and always-on activations, and supporting partners with any questions along the way.

• Translate campaign performance data into insights and business narratives that resonate with clients at a strategic level.

• Train and mentor sales team members on programmatic positioning and talking points.

• Stay current on programmatic trends, self-serve platform dynamics, and industry best practices to keep pitches sharp and relevant.

• Represent Spotify/Aleph at industry events, building market presence across the region.

• Work with third-party vendors and partners to strengthen the offering, and coordinate with internal specialist/operations teams to ensure smooth execution once a deal is won.

What you need for this role
• 5+ years of experience in advertising sales, business development, or account management within programmatic/digital advertising.

• Solid working knowledge of programmatic fundamentals: DSPs, SSPs, Ad Exchanges, and self-serve platforms — enough to sell and defend the offering with authority, even if you're not the one operating it day to day.

• Proven track record building agency/client relationships and driving revenue growth across LATAM markets (regional exposure strongly preferred).

• Strong understanding of agency internal structures and dynamics — you know who to talk to and how to get in the door.

• Comfort with data at a consumption level: able to read dashboards and performance reports and turn them into a compelling client story (Salesforce, Sheets/Slides, Excel).

• A genuinely commercial mindset — you love prospecting, relationship-building, and closing; programmatic is your specialty, not just a technical checkbox.

• Exceptional storytelling, negotiation, and presentation skills; comfortable holding a room at C-suite level.

• Full professional proficiency in Spanish and English.

What will make us really love you
• Commercial Drive — You love the chase: prospecting, unblocking, closing.

• Enough Data Fluency to Sell — You can read a dashboard and turn it into a story, even if you're not the one building it.

• Adaptability — Comfortable moving between a strategic C-suite pitch and a technical programmatic conversation in the same day.

• AI-Curious by Default — When a new tool shows up, you test it and fold it into how you sell — briefs, pipeline signals, prospecting — rather than just tolerating it.

• Passion for music, audio culture, or the creator economy — You get why audio matters to brands and to people, and that shows up in how you pitch.

Why Join Us?
 
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.  
 
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together. 
 
#ALEPH
