postings.descriptionText:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 
 
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
 
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.


We're looking for a high-energy, AI-native Client Partner to own our Twitch and Roblox portfolios in Argentina, connecting top advertisers and agencies with two of the most engaged audiences in gaming and live entertainment.

What you'll do
• Own and grow strategic relationships with international advertisers and agencies in Argentina across both the Twitch and Roblox portfolios.

• Act as a trusted advisor to C-level and marketing stakeholders, helping them navigate live-streaming and in-game advertising landscapes.

• Drive revenue through new client acquisition, renewals, and upsell opportunities — leveraging AI and automation tools to multiply pipeline capacity.

• Translate technical metrics (VTR, CPV, viewability, engagement, in-game impressions) into compelling, narrative-driven business growth stories.

• Educate brands and agencies on the power of Twitch and Roblox as premium media channels; represent Aleph at key industry events.

• Partner with internal teams on strategic planning, media buying, reporting, and campaign optimization for both platforms.

• Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and support forecasting/revenue recognition to ensure predictability across both books of business.

Who you are
• Growth Mindset: Eager to fast-track your professional journey and make an impact from day one across two distinct, fast-moving platforms.

• "Full AI" Oriented: AI is woven into how you think and work — you use tools like Gemini or Claude to automate research, briefs, follow-ups, and scale your daily sales output.

• Gaming & Streaming Enthusiast: Genuine passion for both the gaming industry and live-streaming culture.

• High Energy & Hyper-Adaptable: Comfortable managing the complexity of multi-platform executions and pivoting smoothly as priorities shift.

What you need for this role
• Languages: Full professional proficiency in Spanish and English.

• Education: BA/BS in Business, Marketing, or related field.

• Experience: 5+ years in sales and account management within digital advertising platforms, media agencies, or AdTech/Ad Networks — gaming or streaming experience is a strong plus.

• AI fluency: Proven track record adopting AI/productivity tools to automate routine tasks and scale sales operations.

• Deep understanding of digital ad metrics and campaign optimization on premium platforms.

• Excellent consultative communication skills, able to influence multiple levels of stakeholders.

• Highly organized, comfortable juggling two platform pipelines in a fast-paced environment.
Note to candidates: our final interview includes a conversation on how you use AI to scale your sales output.

Why Join Us?
 
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.  
 
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together. 
 
#ALEPH

This role suits someone with a broad technical fluency who thrives on coordination, troubleshooting, and hands-on building. You don't need to be a professional developer, but you do need to be comfortable using tech tools to design, prototype, and ship real solutions. 
The position will be based at the Buenos Aires office with a hybrid work model.

What You’ll Do
Platform & Systems Management

•
Tech project management: Manage technology-related projects end to end — defining requirements, building timelines, tracking progress, and identifying improvements that serve broader project goals.

•
LMS management (WordPress & LearnDash): Own the day-to-day health of our WordPress-based LMS and LearnDash plugin — user administration, course administration, email flows, bulk imports, new features, configuration, and troubleshooting.

•
CRM & Marketing Automation (Salesforce & Salesforce Marketing Cloud): Act as first point of contact for Salesforce and SFMC — build and test journeys, landing pages, and lead magnets; investigate and resolve issues the Operations team can't solve; escalate and follow up when needed.

•
System integration: Serve as the architect making sure LMS, CRM, Marketing Cloud, and Power BI talk to each other correctly — designing and implementing the technical architecture for data flows between platforms, including low-code integrations.

•
Data integrity & reporting: Review data integrity across LearnDash, Salesforce, and Power BI; execute queries and build reports/extracts for non-technical stakeholders; handle large-scale data reviews (including million-row datasets) when needed.

•
Website support: Provide general technical support for the website and coordinate with relevant resources to resolve issues.

•
Compliance & security: Help bring the LMS environment up to the organization's IT and security standards, acting as liaison between the Education team, developers/cloud providers, and Security/Legal/IT.

Marketing Operations & Growth

•
Campaign execution: Build, test, and launch email and lifecycle campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud — segmentation, audience building, A/B tests, send scheduling, and deliverability hygiene.

•
Landing pages & lead capture: Build and ship landing pages and forms based on designs provided by the internal design team; ensure correct lead routing into Salesforce, field mapping, deduplication, and follow-up automation.

•
Tracking & attribution: Own the measurement layer — GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion pixels, UTM taxonomy and enforcement — so that every campaign, source, and channel is measurable end to end.

•
Lifecycle & retention automation: Design automated flows across the student lifecycle (onboarding, course progress nudges, re-engagement, certification, upsell) connecting LMS events to CRM and Marketing Cloud triggers.

•
Martech stack & compliance: Own the marketing technology stack and its integrations; keep consent management, cookie compliance, and data handling aligned with privacy requirements and company policy.

•
AI for marketing: Apply the same builder mindset to marketing — AI-assisted copy and creative variants, campaign localization at scale, automated performance summaries, and audience insight tooling.

Technical Bridge & Coordination

•
Stakeholder liaison: Serve as a primary point of contact between internal stakeholders…

What You Need For This Role
•
You have a solid, broad understanding of technology and digital platforms, and you're comfortable getting hands-on rather than just directing others.

• You have 5+ years of experience managing Education and Marketing tech projects.

•
You are genuinely curious about AI and see it as a tool to build with, not just a topic to discuss — you've built something with AI before (a workflow, an automation, an integration, a tool).

•
You bring project management skills with a track record of leading initiatives from scope to delivery.

•
You're a strong communicator who moves comfortably between technical and non-technical audiences.

•
You're a proactive problem-solver, able to identify needs and find the right solutions, people, and tools without waiting to be asked.

•
You understand marketing funnels and growth metrics (CPL, CAC, conversion rate, LTV) and can translate them into technical requirements.

•
Hands-on experience with marketing automation and campaign tooling (Salesforce Marketing Cloud strongly preferred) is highly valued.

•
Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking setups is a strong plus.

•

Experience with WordPress and/or LMS platforms (ideally LearnDash) is a strong plus.

Why Binance

postings.descriptionText:
🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup! 🚀
At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.

• Translate business questions from growth and marketing teams into well-defined analytical problems and experimental designs.

postings.title: Financial Services Growth Manager  - NA
postings.descriptionText:
Remote, North America, Full Time, Individual Contributor

Who We Are
At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.
We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.

About The Role
We are looking for a Financial Services Growth Manager to join our growing North America team. You will own a portfolio of strategic partners — acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), banks, and fraud & risk providers — and turn those relationships into revenue: qualified merchant pipeline into Yuno, joint go-to-market with the partner, and direct commercial opportunities where the partner itself becomes a Yuno customer.
This is a commercial role, not a relationship-maintenance one. You will be measured on pipeline sourced, deals unlocked, and revenue converted.
 

Your contribution will be
Partner portfolio ownership
Own end-to-end relationships with a defined portfolio of North American partners and act as their primary commercial point of contact.
Build and maintain joint account plans with each strategic partner: shared merchant target lists, named opportunities, agreed cadence.
Track portfolio health on commercial terms — live volume, sourced pipeline, revenue share earned, opportunities in flight — and act where a partnership is not producing.
Lead generation and co-selling
Source qualified leads through the partner network against a quarterly target, working the partner's own merchant base and commercial teams.
Run joint pipeline sessions with partner sales teams to surface merchants where Yuno unlocks a deal the partner cannot close alone.
Build referral and co-sell rails with partners, including shared incentive structures and clear routing of leads in both directions.
Design and execute joint go-to-market campaigns — co-marketing, joint events, account-based pushes on named targets.
Work with Yuno's sales teams so partner-sourced leads convert, and stay accountable through to close.
Upselling Yuno to partners
Identify and develop commercial opportunities where the partner is the buyer: acquiring banks, wallets, and fintechs adopting Yuno's technology, including orchestration, smart routing, value-added services - such as tokenization, account updater, authentication and third party integrations.
Own and advance commercial cycle on these opportunities, from identification to demo stage, with the ability to convert end-to-end, with specialized support on complex deals.
Negotiate agreements, revenue-share models, and commercial terms alongside legal and finance.
Expand existing partnerships beyond their original scope — new markets, new products, new business lines.
Market and cross-functional
Feed commercial and market requirements back into Product so the roadmap reflects what wins deals in North America.
Provide intelligence on competitive dynamics, partner capabilities, and North American payment trends.
Represent Yuno at industry events and convert that presence into pipeline.
Run QBRs and joint planning sessions focused on pipeline and revenue commitments.
 

Skills You Need
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of proven experience in partnerships, business development, or commercial roles within the payments, fintech, or financial services industry.
Evidence of carrying and hitting a commercial number in a partnership or BD context: pipeline sourced, deals closed, or revenue share delivered. Bring the figures.
Experience selling to payment providers or banks, not only through them.
Demonstrated track record of independently managing strategic partner relationships with acquirers, payment processors, APMs, banks, or fraud solution providers - including commercial negotiations with senior and C-level stakeholders.
Deep experience in the North American payments market is required, including familiarity with local acquiring landscapes, card networks, and local payment methods.
Strong understanding of the payments value chain, including acquiring, issuing, scheme networks, and alternative payment methods.
Ability to operate with high autonomy in ambiguity: identify opportunities, structure the approach, and convert into signed deals with minimal supervision.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level counterparts.
Ability to manage multiple strategic relationships simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Data-driven mindset with ability to define, track, and report on partnership KPIs.
Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Legal, and Commercial teams.
Professional proficiency in English is required.

What We Offer at Yuno
Competitive Compensation
Remote Work – You can work from everywhere!
Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.
Work Equipment
Stock Options
Health Plan wherever you are.
Flexible Days Off

This is not a passive coordination role. You set the standard for how Yuno detects, responds to, communicates about, and learns from incidents. You will spend as much time fixing the process as you do running the response.
On-call responsibility is core to this role. Yuno's engineering teams run a “You Build It, You Run It” model — pods own their own on-call. The Incident Commander function exists to coordinate cross-domain and Sev-1 events where multiple pods are involved.
Your Contribution Will Be
Incident command — act as incident commander on major and critical incidents, owning coordination, decision-making cadence, and escalation from detection through resolution; treat merchant transaction impact, PSP and acquirer dependency failures, settlement and reconciliation knock-on effects, and PCI-DSS scope as first-class concerns in every response.
Reliability metrics — drive down time to detect, time to engage, and time to recover; own MTTR as a headline metric and the operational discipline behind Yuno's 99.99% uptime target.
On-call program — run rotations, escalation policies, paging hygiene, and alert quality; reduce noise so on-call engineers trust their pages.
Incident communications — own internal stakeholder alignment during an event and drive clear, accurate merchant-facing updates — including the status page — in coordination with Support and account teams.
Postmortems — run blameless postmortems, hold the room to a no-blame standard, and make sure action items are concrete, owned, and tracked to closure.
Reliability roadmap — translate recurring incident patterns into reliability work, partnering with engineering teams to turn postmortem findings into roadmap items, not orphaned tickets.
Operating model — define and maintain incident severity levels, response runbooks, and the operating model for declaring and managing incidents.
Reporting — report on incident trends, reliability posture, and SLA and SLO performance to engineering leadership.
Skills You Need
Minimum Qualifications
Proven experience running major incident response in a production environment that real customers depend on, ideally as an incident commander or in a dedicated incident management function.
Strong working knowledge of modern distributed systems and cloud-native operations — comfortable holding your own on a bridge call with senior engineers during an outage, following the technical thread, and keeping the response moving without needing every detail spoon-fed.
Experience defining or maturing an incident management practice from the ground up: severity frameworks, operating models, runbooks, and on-call programs built to last, not just inherited.
Fluency with observability and incident tooling — metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and paging platforms. Hands-on experience with Datadog is strongly preferred; familiarity with a paging platform (PagerDuty, OpsGenie, or similar) and a status page tool is expected.
A track record of running postmortems that change behavior, and of closing the loop between incidents and engineering work.
Excellent written and verbal communication — able to write a clear merchant-facing status update and a precise internal escalation under pressure.
Calm, decisive judgment during high-pressure events — you hold structure when others are reacting.
Comfort being on-call as a regular part of the role, including for critical incidents outside business hours.
English — advanced proficiency required.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with PCI-DSS and the operational obligations that come with handling payment flows at scale.
Spanish — business-level proficiency preferred; Yuno's engineering organization spans LatAm, and on-call bridges and postmortem discussions often run in Spanish.
Nice to Have
Prior experience in payments, fintech, or another high-availability, regulated domain.
Exposure to SRE practices, error budgets, and SLO-driven prioritization.
Experience managing incidents across multi-timezone, remote-first engineering organizations.
What Success Looks Like
First 90 days — you have mapped how incidents currently get declared, run, and reviewed, identified the biggest gaps, and started closing them. Severity definitions and the incident operating model are clear and adopted.
Six months — major incidents run to a consistent standard. Postmortem action items are tracked and closed. On-call noise is down and trust in paging is up. Leadership has a reliable view of reliability trends.
One year — the incident practice is self-sustaining. Runbooks are owned by engineering pods, not just by you. MTTR and repeat-incident rates are trending measurably down, and reliability work sourced from incident data is landing on engineering roadmaps and shipping.

postings.title: Technical Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Remote, Latam, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +3 years of experience
Who We Are
At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.
We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.
 

About The Role
We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!
We are looking for a Technical Account Manager to own and elevate Yuno's technical customer relationships across Latin America. This is a leadership position for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to inspire a team, build trust with customers, and drive outcomes that matter. You will be the senior technical voice for our most strategic accounts in the region — and the person who sets the standard for how great technical partnership looks at Yuno.
Day to day, you will lead a team of TAMs while staying close to the most complex customer challenges yourself. LATAM is one of the fastest-growing payment ecosystems in the world, with unique local nuances and high-stakes integrations. That environment rewards people who bring both precision and resilience — someone who can stay steady under pressure, push through hard problems, and come out the other side with better solutions and stronger customer relationships than before.
This role also sits at the heart of Yuno's cross-functional engine. You will work closely with Product, Development, Sales, and Partnerships teams, making sure customer insights translate into real improvements and that internal teams have the context they need to move fast. You will set best practices, define how the TAM function scales, and ensure every integration your team owns reflects the quality and reliability Yuno's customers expect.
If you are technically sharp, and genuinely excited about building something meaningful in one of the most dynamic payment markets in the world — this role is for you.
 

Your contribution will be
Serve as the senior technical point of contact for strategic accounts, owning escalations and driving resolution on complex integration challenges
Lead high-level discussions with customer leadership around technical strategy, product trade-offs, incident management, and risk mitigation
Define and implement best practices for technical onboarding, integration delivery, and ongoing account health monitoring
Build deep knowledge of each customer's business model, technical stack, and operational needs to proactively unlock value
Partner with developers and senior engineers to provide strategic technical guidance and support solution design
Collaborate with Product and Development teams to customize platform capabilities and feed customer insights into the roadmap
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Partnerships, and Finance to support account retention and regional growth
Monitor integration progress and ramp-up milestones across the team, ensuring consistent and high-quality delivery
Champion the LATAM customer base internally, bringing regional intelligence into Yuno's strategic conversations
 

Skills You Need
Minimum Qualifications
Fluency in English and Portuguese is a plus ; Spanish is a plus
5+ years of experience in technical account management or integration engineering, preferably in fintech or payments
Proven track record of leading or mentoring technical teams
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, and API management tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or Swagger
Proficiency in web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, and modern frameworks
Hands-on experience in at least one server-side language: Golang, Python, Node.js, or equivalent
Familiarity with server and database technologies including Apache, Nginx, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, team priorities, and concurrent projects
Clear and compelling communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all seniority levels
Experience with ticketing systems is a plus
 

What We Offer at Yuno
Competitive Compensation
Remote Work – You can work from everywhere!
Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.
Work Equipment
Stock Options
Health Plan wherever you are.
Flexible Days Off

Across both sides of our business, we help companies automate workflows, scale revenue, and unlock world-class global talent.

As part of this evolution, we are building a high-scale outbound engine to reach SMBs and mid-market companies at scale. This requires a new kind of role - one that blends engineering, automation, experiment velocity, and GTM execution.

About the Role
We are hiring a full-time GTM Automation Engineer to architect, automate, and optimize our outbound growth systems. This is a hybrid role combining Clay automation expertise, light engineering, outbound infrastructure, experimentation, and crisp copywriting.

You will build and maintain the machine behind our outbound engine: Clay workflows, enrichment pipelines, domain infrastructure, multi-tool integrations, personalization systems, and data dashboards. You will run high-velocity experiments, write conversion-focused outbound copy, troubleshoot deliverability, and scale sending volume across hundreds of thousands of leads.

You will work closely with our marketing, product, and sales teams - but you will own your domain with a high degree of autonomy. The systems you build will directly drive pipeline, revenue, and go-to-market strategy. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role that sits at the intersection of engineering and growth. The impact you make here will be massive.

Responsibilities
You will own the entire outbound automation machine, including:

1. Clay Workflows & Lead Infrastructure
- Build advanced Clay workflows for scraping, enrichment, verification, scoring, routing, and personalization
- Use APIs, webhooks, and custom code steps to automate data pipelines
- Create ICP logic, trigger systems, and multi-step lead flows

2. Multi-Domain Email Infrastructure, Deliverability, Verification 
- Set up hundreds, up to thousands of domains, warming, DNS, DMARC, DKIM, SPF
- Build scalable campaign systems in Instantly using Apollo data
- Know the ins and outs of email verification: LeadMagic, BounceBan, and more
- Maintain deliverability and sending health across all domains
- Implement verification, cleansing, and bounce prevention

3. Experiments & Optimization
- Ship several outbound experiments per week, measure results
- Test variations of copy, subject lines, offers, personas
- Build dashboards to track open → reply → meeting → revenue
- Identify bottlenecks and improve system performance continuously

4. Copywriting & Messaging
- Write clear outbound emails and short-form sequences
- Use Clay’s AI rewriting + dynamic variables for deep personalization
- Create persona-based messaging frameworks

5. Data & Engineering Tasks
- Write small scripts (Python, JavaScript) when needed
- Integrate tools through API calls and workflows
- Clean, transform, and normalize data
- Maintain accurate metrics and reporting

Outcomes You Will Be Accountable For
Scaling outbound sending volume from 5k → 50k → 250k+ emails/month
Improving reply rates and meeting-booked rates through experimentation
Reducing cost per qualified meeting
Building a predictable outbound funnel that feeds Sales every day
Ensuring strong deliverability across all domains and systems
Automating manual steps so the outbound engine becomes self-sustaining

Requirements
Must-Have
- Expert-level Clay experience (advanced formulas, automations, integrations)
- Strong experience with Apollo and Instantly
- Ability to write clean, concise outbound copy in English
- Experience setting up email domains, DNS, verification, warming
- Ability to write scripts with Python/JS
- Strong data skills (normalization, dedupe, cleansing, schema design)
- Experience running large-scale outbound campaigns
- Strong analytical and experimentation mindset
- Portfolio/GitHub/work samples showing past automation work

Nice-to-Have
- Experience with CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce)
- Experience in B2B SaaS outbound
- Built outbound systems sending 100k–1M+ emails/month
- Experience with dashboards (Looker Studio, Retool, Metabase)
- Familiarity with web scraping tools and unofficial APIs

Who You Are
- You think in systems and flows
- You get excited about automating something that used to take hours
- You are comfortable working in a high-velocity environment
- You enjoy solving messy data problems
- You can write copy and write scripts
- You like shipping experiments, not sitting in meetings
- You want ownership - not micromanagement

Why Work With Us
- Work directly with the CEO (fast decisions, zero bureaucracy)
- Build one of the most advanced outbound engines in the world
- Competitive salary for top talent
- Remote-first team
- High autonomy, high speed
- Massive growth opportunity

postings.title: Implementation & Customer Success Manager — AI Agents
postings.descriptionText:
About Central
Central builds AI agents that perform real operational work for businesses. Our technology currently includes answering phones, booking appointments, and managing customer follow-ups, with plans to expand into more complex back-office workflows and deeper automation. We are seeking an Implementation & Customer Success Manager to ensure our clients derive maximum value from our products.

Responsibilities
• Own customers end to end, managing the journey from signed contract through implementation, launch, adoption, ongoing success, renewal, and expansion.

• Take new customers live by configuring workflows, call forwarding, prompts, and integrations, testing the entire customer experience before launch.

• Configure AI agents, building and improving prompts, workflows, and integrations as the product evolves.

• Implement new workflows, adapting to rapidly changing processes and tools.

• Run integrations with systems such as athenahealth, Brightree, and NexHealth by obtaining API credentials and debugging permissions.

• Engage with customers through onboarding calls, implementation sessions, and troubleshooting to maintain a proactive communication flow.

• Investigate problems independently, checking configurations and logs to isolate issues before escalating to engineering.

• Triage engineering issues by providing comprehensive information for resolution and verifying fixes before concluding cases.

• Protect and grow revenue by identifying churn risks and opportunities for account expansion.

• Transform recurring issues into documented playbooks or automated solutions to enhance efficiency.

Requirements
• 3+ years in implementation, onboarding, technical account management, or customer success at a B2B software company.

• Experience managing a book of customers or implementations directly.

• Proven ability to configure software solutions, including workflow builders, automation tools, and integrations.

• Strong spoken and written English communication skills, capable of handling customer interactions independently.

• Hands-on experience with telephony, EHRs, APIs, or workflow automation tools.

• Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues without immediate escalation.

• Availability to work US business hours consistently.

• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple implementations and customer issues simultaneously.

• Adaptable to a fast-paced environment where product and priorities frequently change.

Nice to Have
• Experience in front-office, practice-management, or healthcare operations.

• Familiarity with systems like athenahealth, Availity, or Brightree.

• Prior experience implementing AI agents or workflows.

• Knowledge of tools such as Linear/Jira, Stripe, and Slack.

• Experience in early-stage startups or fast-paced environments.

• Proven success in identifying and closing expansion revenue opportunities.

Benefits
• Opportunity to work remotely with a dynamic team.

• Engaging work environment with a focus on innovation and AI technologies.

• Professional development opportunities to grow alongside our evolving product.

• Collaborative team culture that values curiosity and initiative.

• Autonomy in managing customer relationships and implementations.

• Potential for career advancement as the company expands.

About the Role
• This position is key to Central’s success in transforming customer operations through AI. You will play a vital role in ensuring customers can effectively utilize our solutions, driving satisfaction and loyalty.

• The Implementation & Customer Success Manager will be the primary point of contact for clients, responsible for not just implementation but fostering long-term relationships that encourage growth and expansion.

• Your contributions will directly impact our clients' success and the evolution of our product offerings.

Central is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply.

postings.title: Outbound Cold Caller
postings.descriptionText:
Wing Assistant is looking for a highly driven Outbound Cold Caller who thrives on prospecting and opening doors with new potential clients. 
This role is for someone with a true hunter mindset - someone who is not afraid of rejection, enjoys the challenge of outbound outreach, and is creative in finding ways to engage prospects.
You will be responsible for generating qualified meetings and sales opportunities through cold calls, LinkedIn outreach, email campaigns, SMS, and other creative prospecting strategies.
 If you enjoy the thrill of turning cold prospects into warm opportunities, this role is for you.

Responsibilities 
•
Conduct high-volume outbound cold calls to prospective clients

•
Identify and qualify potential leads and decision-makers

•
Schedule meetings for the sales team with qualified prospects

•
Execute multi-channel outreach campaigns including:

•
Cold calling

•
LinkedIn prospecting

•
Email marketing

•
SMS outreach

•
Research target accounts and personalize outreach strategies

•
Consistently meet or exceed outreach and meeting quotas

•
Maintain accurate records of outreach activities in the CRM

•
Collaborate with the sales team to improve messaging and conversion

•
Continuously experiment with creative prospecting techniques

Requirements
•
1–3+ years experience in cold calling, SDR, lead generation, or outbound sales

•
Comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls daily

•
Strong communication and persuasion skills

•
Experience using LinkedIn for prospecting

•
Familiarity with email outreach tools and CRM systems

•
Highly resilient and comfortable handling rejection

•
Strong research skills to identify the right prospects

•
Self-motivated and results-driven

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate:

•
Has a hunter mentality

•
Loves outbound sales and prospecting

•
Is creative with outreach strategies

•
Is competitive and motivated by hitting targets

•
Thrives in a fast-paced sales environment

We are hiring Full Time Property Management Assistant

Goal: Hire a full-time VA to support the builder’s real estate acquisition, permitting, inspection, and transaction-related administration.

Follow up with Jersey City regarding permits and inspection scheduling.
Follow up with sellers regarding offers and transaction status.
Handle phone and email communication with relevant organizations and parties.

• USB Headset with Noise Cancellation feature
• Working Webcam
• Main and backup computer: at least 1.8 GHz processor with at least 4GB RAM
• Main Internet Service Speed: at least 25 Mbps wired connection
• Backup Internet Service Speed: at least 10 Mbps
 
Benefits:
• Performance Incentives
• Job Security and Stability

• Inclusive Culture
• Upskilling Opportunities

• Opportunities for Career Growth

postings.title: Sales Development Representative
postings.descriptionText:
Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses, and our growth depends on a steady flow of qualified sales opportunities. We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to be the tip of that spear: the first person prospective customers meet and the engine that keeps our pipeline full.

This is a high-energy, high-ownership seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn the craft fast and grow into bigger things. You'll identify companies that are actively hiring for roles Wing can support, reach out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

It's a great fit for someone who's competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams.

What You'll Do
Generate and Qualify Pipeline

•
Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can service, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles.

•
Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit.

•
Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels.

•
Run focused outbound campaigns around hiring signals, job postings, company growth, and operational pain points.

•
Hold early discovery conversations to understand the prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions.

•
Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting.

•
Book qualified appointments for Account Executives with companies that have a clear need, relevant hiring activity, or a strong use case for Wing.

Partner with the Sales Team

•
Work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline.

•
Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context AEs need to move deals forward.

•
Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved.

•
Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM.

Bring the Market Back In

•
Feed what you're hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.

•

We’re looking for a Workforce Analytics Lead to build and manage the company’s Shadow Layer — the analytics backbone that powers utilization tracking, attendance health, and workforce stability.This role owns the creation of data-driven workforce intelligence tools, including utilization scoring, EOD bot metrics, idle-time alerts, and attendance risk flags, ensuring operational lead

value.text:
Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement the Workforce Utilization Score, integrating data from time logs, active accounts, and productivity indicators.
- Develop and maintain EOD bot analytics, automating daily performance summaries and activity reporting.
- Build real-time dashboards to flag idle, at-risk, or unassigned talent for proactive redeployment.
- Create attendance risk algorithms to predict potential absenteeism, attrition, or engagement drops.
- Partner with Operations, Training, and HR to align data definitions, reporting logic, and corrective triggers.
- Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify trends in attendance, productivity, and client satisfaction correlation.
- Maintain data accuracy and hygiene across workforce systems and shadow databases.
- Generate periodic workforce health reports for leadership visibility, including utilization rate, idle ratio, and SLA adherence.
- Lead the Shadow Layer roadmap, defining automation priorities and integration with existing tools (e.g., Apploye, Wing App, HRIS).

postings.title: Driver / Data Collector in Windeck, Germany
postings.descriptionText:
Company description
 
Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe. We collect data where automation is not possible. We count features, take pictures, make videos, record speech, and scan areas for every detail you need to make more informed decisions. Our field data collection teams are spread across Europe and North America, ready to accept new challenges.
 
 
Project Overview
 
This project aims to collect high-quality visuals of streets, key points of interest, and public spaces across EU countries. Using vehicles equipped with removable 360° cameras and lidars, drivers will capture comprehensive images of the surroundings. The captured data will be stored on onboard computers (SSD Drives)  and later utilized to enhance one of the world’s leading online mapping platforms.
 
Data collectors will follow pre-assigned routes, focusing on public streets, commercial areas, and points of interest. To ensure the highest image quality, certain areas may need to be revisited during favorable weather conditions. 
The duration of the project varies based on the scope of work required in each targeted data collection area. On average, the assignments involve 3 to 6 months of active work.
 
Work schedule: full time engagement within standard business hours (8 AM - 7 PM).
 
The recruitment process for the position of a Driver involves such steps: safety driving test, interview with recruiter, and onboarding process.

Ideal Candidate:
• Holds a valid EU-issued driver’s license.

• Maintains a clean background check (criminal and driving record).

• Has at least 5 years of driving experience.

• Possesses professional driving experience (e.g., taxi, delivery, logistics).

• Proficient in English and the local language.

• Tech-savvy, with experience using GSuite tools (Gmail, Google Spreadsheets, Google Forms).

• Basic knowledge of vehicle mechanics.

• Demonstrates responsibility, reliability, and professionalism.

• Enjoys traveling and exploring new places.

• Familiar with the area of operations.

What We Offer:
• A dynamic and engaging project that goes beyond just driving.

• Competitive salary.

• Comprehensive training covering both practical and theoretical aspects of data collection.

• Ongoing support from experienced managers.

• The opportunity to work in an international team and environment.

If you’re interested, apply now and join us in shaping the future of data collection!

Coderio diseña y entrega soluciones digitales escalables para empresas globales. 🌍 Más información: http://coderio.com
 
Buscamos un/a Arquitecto de soluciones / SRE para trabajar en un entorno bancario, enfocado/a en la configuración, monitoreo y análisis de soluciones para pruebas de performance.
 
 
Requisitos de ubicación: Solo se tendrán en cuenta candidatos que residan en Argentina.
Responsabilidades
Gestionar tickets relacionados con performance a través de ServiceNow.
Configurar soluciones en ambientes de QA para la ejecución de pruebas de performance.
Trabajar con TPS (Transactions Per Second) para definir las condiciones de las pruebas.
Monitorear métricas y comportamiento de las soluciones durante las pruebas.
Analizar métricas de observabilidad para verificar que los valores se encuentren dentro de los parámetros esperados.
Realizar ajustes de CPU y memoria cuando los valores superen los límites establecidos.
Trabajar con información de trazas y tiempos de respuesta de los diferentes microservicios.
Requisitos
Arquitectura: experiencia sólida en microservicios.
Event-Driven: dominio de arquitecturas orientadas a eventos con Kafka y RabbitMQ.
Plataforma: conocimientos de Kubernetes/OpenShift, Networking y Seguridad.
Conocimientos de AWS / EKS.
Experiencia con herramientas de observabilidad como Grafana y Prometheus.
Conocimientos de Loki.
Conocimientos de performance / performance testing.
Experiencia con ServiceNow.
Conocimientos de Jenkins.
Residir en Argentina
Deseables
Experiencia previa en el sector bancario o financiero 
Conocimientos de arquitectura API-first y de patrones de resiliencia como Circuit Breaker y Bulkhead.
Conocimientos de Java, .NET, Node.js o Python.
Experiencia con AppDynamics y Panda.
Beneficios
100% remoto
Compromiso a largo plazo, con autonomía e impacto
Rol estratégico y de alta visibilidad en una cultura de ingeniería moderna
Equipo internacional colaborativo y liderazgo técnico sólido
Plan de carrera y crecimiento dentro de Coderio
 
¿Por qué unirte a Coderio?
En Coderio valoramos el talento sin importar la ubicación. Somos una empresa remote-first,apasionada por la tecnología, el trabajo colaborativo y la compensación justa. Ofrecemos un entorno inclusivo, desafiante y con oportunidades reales de crecimiento. Si te motiva construir soluciones con impacto, te estamos esperando. Postula ahora.

postings.title: Bilingual Virtual Assistant – Medical Practice
postings.descriptionText:
The client is a primary care physician running a solo private practice that she opened about a year ago. The practice is currently part-time with a patient load of under 300, operates on an insurance-based model, and is located near the Texas-Mexico border, serving a patient base that is mostly English-speaking with a meaningful number of Spanish speakers. Dr. Garcia-Davalos currently works with one in-person medical assistant who checks in patients, takes vitals, and verifies insurance, alongside a third-party billing company that handles claims.
Role Overview
The client is going on maternity leave starting in September and will not be in the office at all for at least that month. Since no patients will be coming in during that time, she does not need in-person support — but she still expects calls and messages from existing patients about medication refills, appointment questions, and upcoming visits scheduled later in the year. She is also using this period to begin transitioning the practice from an insurance-based to a cash-based model, so this role is about holding things down reliably while she is out and helping keep patient communication organized as the practice evolves.
Key Responsibilities
•     Answer incoming patient phone calls via the practice's VoIP line (QUO/OpenPhone), including medication refill requests, scheduling questions, and general patient inquiries
•     Relay medication refill requests to the client for her personal review and sign-off — the VA does not send refills directly
•     Monitor and manage the practice email inbox, including incoming faxes (medical records) and new patient inquiries submitted through the website
•     Let prospective new patients know the practice has a temporary waitlist and is not currently scheduling new patient appointments
•     Assist existing patients with questions about upcoming scheduled visits (the practice sees patients approximately one week per month from October through December)
•     Communicate directly with the client as needed via WhatsApp, iMessage, or Zoom
•     Help document and maintain SOPs during the practice's transition to a cash-based model, laying the groundwork for a smoother handoff when an in-person MA is hired again
Skills & Tools
•     Bilingual: fluent in English and Spanish strongly preferred
•     HIPAA certified
•     Comfortable with VoIP/phone systems (e.g., QUO/OpenPhone) and standard email platforms
•     Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience (medical office, patient-facing, or virtual assistant experience)
•     Strong attention to detail and discretion handling sensitive medical information
•     Reliable and self-directed, comfortable working independently with light day-to-day oversight

postings.title: Executive Assistant
postings.descriptionText:
We're looking for an Executive Assistant to work closely with the owner of a successful business.
This is a varied role covering both business and personal tasks. You'll need to be organised, confident and, most importantly, able to get things done without needing to be told exactly what to do at every stage.
The owner is looking for someone who can take an idea or a task, work out the next steps and run with it.
This could be anything from managing emails and keeping track of projects to researching an apartment, organising appointments or chasing someone for an update.
It's a role that will suit someone who enjoys having responsibility and likes figuring things out.
 
What You'll Be Doing
Executive Support
Manage emails and follow-ups
Keep the calendar organised
Arrange meetings and appointments
Take notes and keep track of actions from meetings
Follow up with people when things need to be completed
Research information and bring back useful options
Keep track of important tasks and deadlines
Help keep the owner organised day to day
Project Management
You'll also help manage various projects and make sure things keep moving.
This includes:
Taking notes or instructions and turning them into tasks
Keeping project and task trackers up to date
Breaking projects down into smaller actions
Delegating tasks where needed
Following up with people
Keeping an eye on deadlines
Spotting when something has stalled and doing something about it
Making sure tasks are actually finished
You should be comfortable taking a fairly broad instruction and working out how to turn it into something practical.
Personal Assistance
Around 20–30% of the role will involve personal tasks and projects.
These could include:
Researching apartments or other property
Booking appointments
Organising personal commitments
Comparing different options
Making bookings and arrangements
Researching things the owner is considering
Taking care of one-off personal projects
The work will change from week to week, so being adaptable is important.
What We're Looking For
We're less concerned about finding someone with a perfect EA background and more interested in finding the right person.
You should be:
Very organised
Confident communicating in English
Comfortable working independently
Good at managing several things at once
Comfortable using different online tools and systems
Good at research
A good communicator
Reliable and discreet
Comfortable taking responsibility
Able to pick things up quickly
Previous EA, PA, administration or project management experience would be useful, but it isn't the only thing we're looking at.
Personality Matters
This is probably the most important part of the role.
We want someone who has a bit of personality and isn't afraid to take the lead when needed.
You should be:
Confident
Energetic
Practical
Creative
Organised
Self-motivated
Comfortable making decisions
Willing to push things forward
Good at finding solutions
If you come across a problem, we want you to try to solve it before simply bringing it back to the owner.
Equally, you should be comfortable saying, "I'm not sure, but I'll find out."
You won't always have clear instructions. That's part of the job.
The Right Mindset
This role will work well for someone who naturally thinks:
"What needs to happen next?"
rather than:
"What task have I been given?"
The owner doesn't want to spend their day explaining every step or checking whether something has been done.
The successful person will gradually become someone they can rely on to take things away and deal with them.

Loom video
Application Process

As part of the initial application, you'll be asked to record a 2–3 minute video .

Please briefly cover:

• Your background

• The type of work you've done

• How you like to work

• An example of something you've had to figure out yourself

• Why you think you'd be a good fit for this role

We are recruiting for a growing payment processing business looking for an experienced Payment Operations Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day operations of the business and support its continued growth.
This is an important early-stage hire. We're looking for someone who understands how payment processing works and can take ownership of the operational side of the business — from merchant onboarding and transaction monitoring through to reconciliation, payment issues, reporting, and ongoing merchant support.
The ideal candidate will have previous experience working for a payment processor, merchant services provider, acquiring bank, fintech, payment gateway, or similar business.
This is not a purely administrative role. We're looking for someone who understands the payments ecosystem, can identify problems before they become bigger issues, and is comfortable building and improving processes as the company scales.

Payment Operations

Reconciliation & Settlements

Track outstanding settlement and funding issues

Ensure financial and operational records remain accurate
Chargebacks, Disputes & Refunds

Track chargebacks through to resolution
Coordinate refunds and ensure they are processed accurately

Identify recurring dispute or payment issues and flag opportunities to reduce them
Reporting & Analysis
Maintain regular payment operations reports
Track transaction volumes, approval rates, declines, chargebacks, refunds, and settlement activity
Identify trends and unusual activity within payment data
Prepare operational updates for management
Use Excel/Google Sheets or relevant reporting tools to analyse payment data
Help establish KPIs and operational dashboards as the business grows
Process & Operations Development
As an early hire within a growing payments business, you will be expected to help build the operational infrastructure, not simply follow an existing playbook.
You will:
Create and improve SOPs for recurring payment processes
Document merchant onboarding and operational workflows
Build checklists and controls to reduce errors

Help establish escalation procedures for payment incidents
Continuously look for ways to make the operation more efficient and scalable
What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone with real-world payment processing experience rather than a general administrator who is willing to learn payments from scratch.
The ideal candidate will have:
2–5+ years of experience in payment processing, fintech, merchant services, acquiring, banking, or a closely related environment
Hands-on understanding of the payment lifecycle
Experience working with payment processors, gateways, acquirers, or merchant service providers
Experience with merchant onboarding and account management
Understanding of authorization, settlement, funding, refunds, and chargebacks
Experience with payment reconciliation and investigating transaction discrepancies
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills
Excellent attention to detail
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Excellent written and verbal communication
Ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously
Technical Knowledge
Candidates with experience working with platforms such as Stripe, Adyen, Worldpay, Fiserv, Global Payments, TSYS, PayPal, Checkout.com, Nuvei, or similar payment platforms would be highly desirable.
Specific platform experience is less important than having a genuine understanding of payment operations and being able to learn new systems quickly.
Knowledge of PCI DSS, payment security, fraud prevention, and payments compliance would also be advantageous.
Personality & Working Style
This role will suit someone who enjoys being the person who makes sure things actually get done.

Highly proactive and takes ownership
Naturally organised and process-driven
Comfortable working independently
Analytical and commercially minded
Calm when dealing with payment issues or operational problems
Comfortable communicating with merchants and external providers
Confident escalating problems when necessary

Comfortable working in a growing business where processes are still being developed

postings.title: Ads Quality Rater - Spanish (Argentina)
postings.descriptionText:
Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join!  
 
As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.
 
You will review ads in both English and Spanish

This role is great for people who:  
 
- Surf the internet daily  
- Use major search engines frequently  
- Know what people want based on a few keywords  
- Enjoy researching topics online
- Want a flexible and fun side job

Project Details  
 
Job Title: Ads Quality Rater
Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $4 per hour)
Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Argentina
Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week.
Start Date: ASAP
Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed 
Project Duration: Long-term

Note: 
- Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process.

Recruitment Process
 
- There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not.
 
- Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.
 
IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).

Experience & Requirements   
• Fluency in Spanish

• Strong understanding of English (written and spoken)

• Comfortable knowledge of modern popular culture

• Reliable computer system and internet connection

• Familiar with using online search engines

• Sign a standard Non-Disclosure Agreement and Service Level Agreement

Welo Data

When you join Welo Data, you have the opportunity to bring your career to the next level.

- We offer a great variety of unique and interesting projects in a multicultural and international environment
- We focus on building long-term, supportive relationships with all of our partners
- Our projects offer excellent professional development opportunities that empower your career learning and growth
- You'll receive human support from our Community Team 24 hours per day, 6 days per week

If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, take a moment to apply below!

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.


Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Basque 
- Based in: Spain, Remote
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community 
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
 
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

postings.descriptionText:
Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.


AIの未来をあなたの手で形作りましょう
 
Welo Dataでは、高品質な言語データを通じて人間中心のAIを支えています。Welo Dataの一員として、世界中のクライアントと共に、言語を活用してより包括的な技術を実現していきましょう。
 
私たちは、言語学者、言語愛好家、文化への理解が深い貢献者からなるグローバルなコミュニティを拡大しています。リモートで柔軟に働きながら、アノテーション、評価、プロンプト作成といった意義のある仕事に挑戦してみませんか？
 
必要な条件:
日本語のネイティブまたはそれに近い流暢さ
日本、シンガポール、韓国、フランス、中国、イギリス、カナダ、台湾、ブラジル、フィリピン、タイ、ペルー、インドネシア、ドイツ、メキシコ、ベトナム、マレーシア、ニュージーランドを拠点としています
英語力がある方
デジタルツールに慣れている方
細部に注意を払える好奇心旺盛な方
 
なぜ私たちと働くのか？
🚀 無限の可能性 – 好きな時間と場所で働き、成長の機会を得られます
🤖 無限のAI – よりスマートで包括的なAIに貢献できます
🌎 私たちと一緒に – グローバルでサポート体制の整ったコミュニティに参加
 
📩 今すぐ応募！
簡単な質問に答えて、私たちの人材プールにご登録ください。
📬 ご質問がありますか？件名に「Application: Shape the Future of AI」と記載の上、TalentRequests@welocalize.comまでお問い合わせください。

At Welocalize, we're dedicated to powering human-centered AI with high-quality language data. We're growing a global community of language professionals and enthusiasts, and we're looking for talented individuals to join us! If you're passionate about how language and technology intersect, this is your opportunity to help shape the future of inclusive, human-centered AI.
 
In these remote roles, you'll contribute to high-quality language data that powers cutting-edge AI systems. You'll be part of a vibrant community, taking on task-based projects in areas such as:
- Annotation
- Evaluation
- Prompt Creation
 
When a suitable project becomes available, we'll invite you to a brief qualification process that may include training, assessments, or onboarding, depending on the project's specific needs.
 
Projects You Might Work On:
 
You might find yourself contributing to AI in diverse ways, for example:
 
Supporting AI Language Data for Korean, Chinese or both
 
If you have native or near-native in Korean, Chinese or both fluency, you'll contribute to improving AI systems by engaging with a wide variety of language-focused tasks. This could include annotation, evaluation, or prompt creation, all aimed at enhancing AI's understanding and use of the languages
 
Evaluating Machine Transliterated Lyrics (Korean to Chinese)
 
For those with native-level or near-native proficiency in transliterating Korean to Chinese (Simplified) script, you'll play a crucial role in assessing the quality and accuracy of machine-transliterated song lyrics. This involves reviewing and evaluating lyrics for meaning, fluency, and naturalness, providing quality ratings based on predefined criteria, and identifying and correcting errors in transliteration. Your feedback will directly contribute to improving automated transliteration systems. Familiarity with different music genres and lyrical styles is a plus.

- We're seeking detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable individuals eager to engage with language and technology
- Native or near-native fluency in the Korean and Chinese 
- Proficient in English (both written and spoken).Comfortable using digital tools and working remotely.
- Ability to focus on detail and maintain concentration over large volumes of content.
- Previous experience in translation, localization, or linguistic quality evaluation is a plus but not required.
- Experience using online evaluation tools or platforms is a nice-to-have.
 
Geographic Requirements
We accept candidates from a wide range of countries, including but not limited to: China, South Korea, United States
 
All work is freelance, offers flexible scheduling, and is ongoing based on project needs. For some projects, candidates who get onboarded and complete 10 hours in the first week may receive a reimbursement for 1 hour of their evaluated hourly rate as part of a learning program.

한국어 및 일본어 원어민 수준 또는 이에 준하는 능력 | 韓国語および日本語のネイティブまたはそれに近い流暢さ

postings.title: Dutch Sports Localization Specialist (Football)
postings.descriptionText:
As a trusted global transformation partner, Welocalize accelerates the global business journey by enabling brands and companies to reach, engage, and grow international audiences. Welocalize delivers multilingual content transformation services in translation, localization, and adaptation for over 250 languages with a growing network of over 400,000 in-country linguistic resources. Driving innovation in language services, Welocalize delivers high-quality training data transformation solutions for NLP-enabled machine learning by blending technology and human intelligence to collect, annotate, and evaluate all content types. Our team works across locations in North America, Europe, and Asia serving our global clients in the markets that matter to them. www.welocalize.com
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
OVERVIEW
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB
 
Welocalize is seeking passionate and culturally fluent Sports Subject Matter Experts specialized in football with exceptional writing skills to join our localization team. You’ll review, localize, fact check, translate, and adapt football-related content so it resonates with audiences in your market. 
 
Project Details:
Language Pair: English (US) > Dutch (Netherlands)
Task Type: Quality Control
Assessment: Grammar + SME knowledge

MAIN DUTIES
• Review, localize, fact check, translate, and adapt sports-related content, mainly football, while adhering to writing style guides and guidelines

• Conduct market-specific research on local content, product and terminology trends, and best localization practices for the target audience in your market

• Provide feedback on written content

REQUIRED SKILLS
• BS/BA and/or 2+ years of work experience in the linguistic field, sports journalism, copywriting, or in copy-editing

• Extensive sports knowledge, mainly football

• Experience in translation and localization of multimedia content, preferably also machine translations and evaluations

• Native-level fluency in the target language

• Excellent grammar and writing skills in the native language

• Strong creative writing, proofreading, and editing skills in the native language

• Tech savvy: strong practical knowledge of computers and mobile devices, word processors, and spreadsheets

• Owning licensed version of MS Office apps

• Ability to work independently and remotely

BONUS IF YOU HAVE:
• Published work on platforms like ESPN, The Athletic, FourFourTwo, or similar .

• Experience working with sports media platforms, live score apps, or sports streaming services.

• A flair for adapting voice and style to Gen Z, football fan culture, and pop culture audiences.

After your application is reviewed, shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our team to complete the application process.

postings.title: English to Armenian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Global 
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 


The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English into Armenian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 
Project Details 
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Armenian
What You Will Do 
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Armenian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools
Additional Key Information 
- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.
Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.  
Why Join Us 
This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources. 
If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Job Reference: #LI-JC1

About the Role
We are looking for experienced English into Spanish (Mexico) linguists specializing in Clinical-trial, Pharmacovigilance and Regulatory document translation.
Key Responsibilities
Translate clinical research, regulatory and pharmacovigilance documents from English to Spanish LatAm.
Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive content.
Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM/Phrase), also Track Changes in Microsoft Word following project-specific setup instructions.
Field of Expertise
Clinical Research Documents (protocols and synopses, IB, ICF, Patient Sheets, Patient Diaries)
Regulatory Documents (SmPC, PIL, Labels, CTD Modules)
Pharmacovigilance Documents (PSUR, DSUR, RMP, SAE and AE)
Must-Have Criteria
Applicant must meet at least one of the following criteria:
Education
A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies (or an equivalent degree) or
Recognized graduate qualification in any other field, plus a minimum of two years of full-time professional experience in translation or
A minimum of five years of full-time professional experience in translation
Relevant translation experience
At least two years of practical translation experience, specifically with life sciences (clinical trials and pharmacovigilance) and medical documents
Technical Skills
Familiarity with CAT tools (XTM/Phrase), License will be provided.
Familiarity with Track Changes in Microsoft Word
Native Language
A candidate must be native in ESMX (Mexican Spanish)
Nice-to-Have
Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology or similar
In-house industry experience at a CRO or pharmaceutical company.
Before Applying
Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
