postings.title: English to Uzbek (Cyrillic) Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Global 
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 


The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English into Uzbek (Cyrillic) Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 
Project Details 
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Uzbek (Cyrillic)
What You Will Do 
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Uzbek (Cyrillic) and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools
Additional Key Information 
- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.
Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.  
Why Join Us 
This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training, and access to established linguistic resources. 
If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Welo Global is seeking an experienced freelance English (en-US) to Hebrew (he-IL) Translator and Copy Editor to support an exciting, long-term project with a leading multinational company.
This is an on-going freelance and remote position.
Project Details
Location: Remote
Expected Volume: Approximately 1000-2000+ words per week
Employment Type: Freelance/Independent Contract
Task type: Translation and Copy-Editing
Content types: Marketing, UI, Product, Support, Informational, Light Legal
CAT Tool: Client specific CAT tool (training provided)

Native or near‑native proficiency in Hebrew (he-IL) with excellent command of English (en-US)
2+ years of professional translation experience with a degree in Translation, Linguistics, or a related field
or

Demonstrated experience translating English to Hebrew across a variety of content types, includinginformational, marketing, UI, product, support
Experience using CAT tools

Strong communication skills, responsiveness, reliability, and openness to feedback and revisions
Join a global network of linguists, benefit from ongoing support and training, collaborate on high-visibility international projects, and build a long-term partnership with Welo Global.

We look forward to connecting with you!

postings.descriptionText:
As a trusted global transformation partner, Welocalize accelerates the global business journey by enabling brands and companies to reach, engage, and grow international audiences. Welocalize delivers multilingual content transformation services in translation, localization, and adaptation for over 250 languages with a growing network of over 400,000 in-country linguistic resources. Our team works across locations in North America, Europe, and Asia serving our global clients in the markets that matter to them. www.welocalize.com
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
OVERVIEW
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB
 
Welocalize is seeking passionate and culturally fluent Sports Subject Matter Experts specialized in football with exceptional writing skills to join our localization team. You’ll review, localize, fact check, translate, and adapt football-related content so it resonates with audiences in your market. 
 
Project Details:
 
Language Pair: English (US) > Japanese
Task Type: Quality Control
Assessment: Grammar + SME knowledge
 
MAIN DUTIES
Review, localize, fact check, translate, and adapt sports-related content, mainly football, while adhering to writing style guides and guidelines
Conduct market-specific research on local content, product and terminology trends, and best localization practices for the target audience in your market
Provide feedback on written content
REQUIRED SKILLS
BS/BA and/or 2+ years of work experience in the linguistic field, sports journalism, copywriting, or in copy-editing
Extensive sports knowledge, mainly football
Experience in translation and localization of multimedia content, preferably also machine translations and evaluations
Native-level fluency in Japanese
Excellent grammar and writing skills in English
Strong creative writing, proofreading, and editing skills in Japanese
Tech savvy: strong practical knowledge of computers and mobile devices, word processors, and spreadsheets
Owning licensed version of MS Office apps (MUST)
BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

After your application is reviewed, shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our team to complete the application process.

About Welo Life Sciences 
Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com
About the Role
We are currently looking for freelance professionals to support Non-Linguistic QC activities for our translation projects in the Life Sciences domain.
Non-Linguistic QC is the final quality assurance step before delivery to the client. Typical tasks include checking for inconsistencies, numeric mismatches, formatting and layout issues, and ensuring client-specific requirements have been followed.
Key Responsibilities
Perform Non-Linguistic Quality Control of translations into English for pharmacovigilance, regulatory, and clinical content.
Use CAT tools and run QC checks to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Validate formatting, numbers, dates, units, terminology, and adherence to instructions.
Support processing of non-editable/handwritten sources and perform formatting QC after conversion.
Work according to availability and meet TATs (typically 12–24 hours).
Requirements
QC/QA Experience
Minimum 6 months QC/QA-related experience in the localization industry. *Project management experience involving pre-delivery checks can also be counted.
Technical Skills
Familiarity with CAT tools (XTM/Phrase), License will be provided.
Familiarity with QA checks tools (Xbench, Verifika, or CAT-integrated QA)
Familiarity with Track Changes in Microsoft Word
English Proficiency
Advanced level in English (C1 or above)
Availability
Availability of 4–5 hours per day
Flexibility and willingness to work occasional weekends and bank holidays.
Able to meet urgent TATs (12–24 hours) and manage many small files.
Before Applying
Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
 
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your QC related experience, including years of experience, the document types you’ve QCd, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
 
We look forward to receiving your application!

OVERVIEW
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB
 
We are looking for a Tech Linguistic Tester, you will primarily be proofreading and editing content already localized to your native language, making sure you catch any errors in the content, such as: grammar, typos, syntax, punctuation, capitalization, political incorrectness, inconsistencies, and extra spaces between words or characters. You will sometimes be translating content from English to your native language. You will also be checking UIs for functional issues.

Responsibilities:
• Write and report relevant bugs and errors using best practices through internal database system.

• Ability to undertake and prioritize tasks and issues quickly and efficiently.

• Native language skills and cultural awareness of native country.

• Good oral and written communication.

• Highly organized with attention to detail and a commitment to quality.

• QA various products in by accurately following testing instructions and test cases

• Discover and report defects (bugs) using client specific bug tracking tools

• Evaluate translations in the context of software, mobile apps and documentation.

• Be a subject matter expert for linguistic issues in the target language; be able to research and resolve linguistic questions

• Adhere to project-specific quality standards, trademarks, style guides and client-preferred checklists and glossaries

• Troubleshoot basic problems; be able to communicate effectively and escalate testing issues

• Complete assigned tasks in a timely manner and of high quality.

Experience:

• Native-level or fully bilingual fluency (both spoken and written language) in required language(s)

• Strong English skills, both written and verbal

• Experience with MS applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint);

• Ability to navigate networks and websites with different browsers

• Basic knowledge of PC-hardware (desktop and laptop)

• Basic knowledge of smart phones (iPhone or Android)

• Familiarity with Android and iOS operating systems.

• 3+ years professional translation & localization experience.

• Familiarity with native culture and trends.

• Avid user of social media with familiarity with Facebook Family of Apps.

• Experience with consumer devices that provide utility like messaging, health, fitness, calendar, organization.

Key competencies:

• Strong Company & Industry Awareness

• Strong Problem-Solving skills as to arrive at optimal solution.

• Shows excellent Time Management skills

• A Plan-Do-Check-Act cycle approach to tasks and workloads

• Takes Ownership of deliverables

Other Skills:

• Candidates with Localization/QA/translation experience or with advanced computer skills are preferred

About Welocalize 
Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 


Overview 
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for managing assigned accounts end-to-end, including project planning, execution, monitoring, delivery, and closure in line with Welocalize’s standard processes and tools. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will partner with the Operations Squad Lead to support large enterprise accounts.
This role will serve as the primary project-level contact for clients, building strong customer relationships while collaborating closely with Welocalize account directors and production teams to maximize delivery performance, client satisfaction, quality, and profitability.
The ideal candidate is a motivated and dependable professional with strong relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams. They should bring the adaptability, resilience, and energy needed to succeed in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
 
Main Duties
Lead and supervise global teams, including internal and external stakeholders, with responsibility for both direct and indirect reports.
Prepare, analyze, and implement project plans in alignment with Welocalize standards, including project initiation, workflow management, completion, status updates, invoice approvals, and client information maintenance.
Develop and manage detailed project schedules to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
Prepare project estimates and proposals for client review and approval.
Conduct risk assessments and implement strategic plans to minimize potential issues and ensure successful outcomes.
Oversee QA projects, including resource allocation, defect management, reporting, and overall quality performance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve project and client objectives.
Create and maintain process documentation as required.
Operate independently with moderate support, proactively identifying and escalating issues outside of scope in a timely manner.
Partner with production teams to drive continuous improvement in project delivery, efficiency, and profitability.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including colleagues across departments and vendors.
Develop trusted client relationships at the project level, achieving measurable success in customer satisfaction ratings.
Ensure clear, effective, and timely communication with all project stakeholders, including clients and production teams.
Maintain accuracy and timeliness of all financial systems data.
Prepare and deliver reporting, including weekly project status updates, budget-to-actual analysis, time management, and client/vendor-related issues.
Protect project profitability through effective margin management.
Plan, prepare, and lead quarterly business reviews with clients in face-to-face settings.
 
Requirements
Education Level: Master’s degree, or Bachelor’s degree with relevant industry experience in lieu of a Master’s degree.
Proven track record in Localization Project Management.
Experience working internationally or directly with global product development teams.
Experience within a technology-driven company or environment.
Demonstrated success managing large enterprise clients.
Proven ability to lead and deliver large-scale accounts and complex projects successfully.
Experience creating client-facing documentation, including Statements of Work (SOWs), proposals, process documentation, and post-project reviews.
Proven record of contributing to process improvements, operational initiatives, and new ideas.
Experience supporting new client sales cycles, including presentations, analysis, recommendations, and relationship development.
Strong experience managing financial budgets, reconciliations, and budget reporting.
Hands-on experience with CAT and TMS tools, ideally including Crowdin, Smartling, XTM, or Phrase.

postings.title: Shape the Future of AI — Finnish Talent Hub
postings.descriptionText:
Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.


Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?
 
Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.
 
By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.
 
Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.
 
What You’ll Need
- Native or near-native fluency in Finnish
- Based in: Finland, Spain, France, Estonia
- English proficiency
- Comfortable with digital tools
- Detail-oriented and curious
 
Why Join Us?
🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow
🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI
🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community 
 
About our projects:
Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
Depending on your skills, you might:
📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems
🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance
💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy
Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.
 
How to Apply?
Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.
 
📬 Questions?
If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

About Welo Life Sciences 
Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.  welolifesciences.com
About the Role
We are looking for experienced Spanish (Spain) to English (GB or US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines. 
This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes.
Key Responsibilities
Translate Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-regulatory content from Spanish into English.
Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content.
Requirements
Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant 
translation training.
Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating medical documentation, specificially with experience and knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and/or Clinical-Regulatory content.
Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP).
Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature.
Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules.
Strong Spanish proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory.
Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools.
Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions.
Nice to Have
Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome.
Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability.
Tools & Systems
CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding.

postings.descriptionText:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.


The Opportunity
We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.
We are looking for a hungry, highly autonomous Staff or Senior level Product Engineer to help and scale our internal tools. The Internal Tools team is the operational engine of Luxury Presence. Your customers are our own people: Customer Success, Sales, Onboarding, and fellow engineering teams. If an internal team needs a tool to move faster, automate a bottleneck, or serve our clients better, you will build it or support the architecture to make it happen.
This role requires a true “10x engineer” who leverages AI development workflows (like Claude Code and Orca) to ship high-quality code at an unprecedented pace. You will be touching everything from complex UI dashboards in React to background job processing in NestJS, and deeply integrating it with our core data ecosystem.
What You'll Do
Lead internal product development. Partner with teams across Customer Success, Sales, Onboarding, and Engineering to uncover operational bottlenecks and design intuitive, high-leverage tools that multiply their effectiveness.
Own the internal tool ecosystem. Architect and scale our internal platform (Scout) across the full stack. You'll weave together our React frontends, NestJS backends, and complex data integrations (spanning our CRM, data warehouse, and communication platforms) into a unified, reliable experience.
Accelerate delivery through AI. Integrate AI natively into your daily workflow. You will use agents to write, review, and ship production code, turning complex requirements into working software at an elite pace.
Turn ambiguity into impact. Take ownership of open-ended business challenges. You will act as both product manager and lead engineer for internal tools—scoping the true need, designing the solution, and shipping it end-to-end.
What We're Looking For
Attributes:
You are an AI-native developer. You have deep experience with AI development workflows and tools (Claude Code, Cursor). You understand how to prompt, iterate, and use AI to output 10x the impact of a traditional engineer.
You get joy from helping others. You are deeply empathetic to your internal users. You measure your success by the time you save others and the headaches you eliminate.
You are highly product-oriented. You care deeply about the how and why of software. You view your internal coworkers as your highest-priority customers, always asking if a feature actually solves their core problem before writing a line of code.
You are hungry and autonomous. You don't wait for a perfectly scoped Jira ticket. You are a problem solver who digs into the business need, proposes a technical solution, and ships it.
You think in systems. You can reason about the whole request path from UI to data, understanding how internal tooling impacts the broader platform architecture.
Skills and Experience:
Extensive experience as a Senior or Staff-level full-stack engineer in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
Experience building scalable backend services (NestJS preferred) and designing robust GraphQL APIs (code-first resolvers).
Strong database fundamentals using ORMs (Sequelize) over PostgreSQL, and experience writing integration tests against real databases.
Comfortable operating in a modern DevOps environment, relying on feature flags, rigorous testing, and solid observability.
Tech Stack
Frontend: React SPA (Vite), TypeScript, Tailwind, React Router, Apollo Client. Vitest + RTL for testing, Playwright for e2e.
Backend: Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, GraphQL (code-first resolvers).
Data & Background: PostgreSQL (via Sequelize), Bull/Redis for background jobs. Deep integrations with Salesforce, Snowflake/Flurry, Dialpad, Zoom, Front, and Anthropic. Testing via Jest + Supertest.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes via ArgoCD, Flyway for migrations, LaunchDarkly for flags, Datadog for logs/APM/RUM.

postings.title: BI Engineer (Data Analyst)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT APPLY
 
APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com.
 
LOCATION: APPLY is hybrid/remote-friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Latin America, preferably working in hours that align to PT (Pacific Timezone) or ET (Eastern Timezone). Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees.
 
THE ROLE:

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•
Design, build, and maintain BI dashboards and reports (Looker Studio & Power BI) that turn raw platform data into clear, actionable insights for business and marketing stakeholders.

•
Partner with Data Engineering to migrate and validate dashboard data models through the GCP-to-Azure/Snowflake migration, ensuring metric parity and no regression in reporting accuracy.

•
Perform exploratory data analysis across BigQuery/Snowflake datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities the business isn’t already looking at.

•
Write and optimize SQL across BigQuery and Snowflake, and build/maintain dbt models to support scalable, governed data marts.

•
Collaborate on Dagster-orchestrated data pipelines — understanding lineage and dependencies well enough to troubleshoot issues and contribute to data model design, not just consume the output.

•
Explore and prototype agentic AI and data science solutions (e.g., LLM-powered analysis, automated insight generation, predictive/propensity modeling) to accelerate how the team surfaces and acts on data.

•
Apply data governance principles in day-to-day work: support privacy and retention deletion workflows (OneTrust), and ensure PII is handled correctly across CRM/MarTech data integrations (Customer.io, Twilio Segment).

•
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle — requirements gathering, data modeling, dashboard build, validation, and stakeholder walkthroughs.

•
Identify data quality issues and partner with Data Engineering to resolve root causes rather than patching symptoms downstream.

•
Stay current on BI and analytics tooling and proactively recommend improvements to the platform’s reporting stack.

REQUIREMENTS:
•
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

•
4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a hybrid analytics engineering role.

•
Strong SQL skills across BigQuery and/or Snowflake — comfortable with complex queries, CTEs, and window functions.

•
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Looker Studio and/or Power BI.

•
Working knowledge of dbt for data modeling and transformation.

•
Familiarity with pipeline orchestration tools — Dagster preferred, Airflow or similar also acceptable.

•
Understanding of data governance and privacy compliance concepts, ideally with exposure to OneTrust or a similar consent/privacy management platform.

•
Experience working with CRM/MarTech data sources such as Customer.io, Twilio Segment, or comparable CDP/ESP platforms.

•
Some hands-on data engineering skills (Python, pipeline debugging, schema design) are a strong plus — you don’t need to be a full-time data engineer, but you should be comfortable enough to partner closely with one.

•
Excellent communication skills — able to translate data findings into business insight for non-technical stakeholders.

•
Experience supporting a cloud data migration (GCP, Azure, or AWS) is a plus.

•
A curious, insight-first mindset — comfortable going beyond “build the dashboard that was asked for” to proactively surface what the data is actually saying.

• Google Cloud certification is considered an asset

LIFE AT APPLY
 
People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:
 
Agentic Delivery: Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.
An inclusive and safe environment: We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.
AI & Strategic Upskilling: Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.
Generous vacation policy: Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.
Flexible work arrangements: We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.
 
APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email careers@applydigital.com.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager (Future Opportunities)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT APPLY
 
APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com.
 
LOCATION: APPLY is hybrid/remote-friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Latin America, preferably working in hours that align to PT (Pacific Timezone) or ET (Eastern Timezone). Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees.
 
THE ROLE:

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Build and champion product strategies and vision throughout client engagements, as well as brief and inspire internal team members to deliver on that vision.

• Retrieve and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders, other teams, and various research methods, workshop facilitation methodologies to shape requirements, features and end products.

• Take ownership over creating product plans and roadmaps with the buy-in of executive stakeholders.

• Prepare and review product requirements documents (PRD) - be meticulous in ensuring requirements of all types (client, business, user experience, design, technical, non-functional) are understood, documented, kept up-to-date, conflicts resolved, and finally communicated in a timely fashion to team members and client stakeholders.

• Organize product releases and priorities properly, ensuring compliance with business value expectations.

• Prepare recommendations to track product use and impact end users - define measurement plans for the digital products that we design and build. Build your skills using a repertoire of analytics tools.

• Ensure requirements have been delivered to specifications, defects have been managed through to resolution, and assess readiness for launch.

• Continuously prepare recommendations to expand product base and vision - based on data and research-driven insight.

• Add value to the team - you are not just an order-taker. You understand what it means to drive ROI through business and customer value, you understand the constraints from all directions, and you use your consultative skills to make recommendations to move vision forward.

REQUIREMENTS:
• You are capable of detecting the main projects, initiatives, and epics that must be executed to achieve the expected business results.

• You are an effective communicator and facilitator, and are able to successfully manage expectations.

• You are experienced with backlog management, sprint planning, and roadmapping exercises, and you are able to generate spaces and workshops to define approaches and align solutions.

• You are a creative leader, a team player, and a problem solver.

• You are professional, confident, and able to understand which ideas will and which won’t work.

• You have proven yourself in a consultation role, through Agency, Consultancy, or other Professional Services Firm. You have strong proficiency in stakeholder management.

• Demonstrated experience using Contentful as a headless CMS for building and managing websites is a bonus.

• You’re good at techie speak and non-techie speak. You’ve collaborated in multidisciplinary teams, are able to convey technical concepts to non-technical people as well as turn business, UX, design requirements into technical specifications.

• It’s easy for you to break down complex problems into logical, digestible steps

• Ambiguity doesn’t scare you, and you thrive on turning ambiguity and conflicting information into clarity in a fast-changing environment.

• You have a portfolio of digital products that you have shipped, managed and operated, and are proud to share how it delivered value to end users.

• You have done it before, with a minimum of 7 years of experience in a Product Management or similar position.

• Google Cloud certification is considered an asset

LIFE AT APPLY
 
People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:
 
Agentic Delivery: Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.
An inclusive and safe environment: We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.
AI & Strategic Upskilling: Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.
Generous vacation policy: Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.
Flexible work arrangements: We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.
 
APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email careers@applydigital.com.

postings.descriptionText:
Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise. Our exceptional experience across Applications, Data & AI, DevOps, Security, and the Microsoft Azure platform enables organizations to accelerate innovation, enhance security, and optimize operational agility.

After 90 Days

• The Advisory Partnership — You have established productive working relationships with Operations, Engineering, Customer Success, and senior architects, and are confidently participating in technical discussions with internal teams and customer stakeholders.

• The Contribution — You have completed your initial architecture assessments or Well-Architected Reviews, delivered actionable findings and recommendations, and developed scoped solution approaches with clear assumptions, risks, dependencies, and effort estimates.

After 1 Year

• Your Influence — You have contributed to reusable architecture standards, assessment templates, and governance practices, while helping define and validate automation and AI-enabled workflows that improve the consistency, quality, and scalability of architecture assessments.

Required Skills (The Non-Negotiables)

• Role-Specific Mastery — Strong understanding of Azure infrastructure and platform services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Networking, Azure Storage, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Backup, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure Cost Management. Familiarity with the Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework and experience participating in architecture reviews, design reviews, technical governance, or customer-facing architecture engagements.

• Architecture & Solution Planning — Demonstrated ability to translate technical and business requirements into practical Azure-based solutions, evaluate architectural risks and tradeoffs, and develop solution recommendations, implementation approaches, scope definitions, assumptions, dependencies, and effort estimates for infrastructure and cloud initiatives.

• Cost Optimization & Operational Excellence — Experience evaluating cloud environments and identifying opportunities to improve cost efficiency, operational maturity, reliability, and performance. Ability to develop actionable recommendations that balance cost optimization with customer requirements, resiliency, security, and operational supportability.

• Communication — Strong written communication, presentation, and documentation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and explain architectural recommendations and tradeoffs to customer stakeholders and both technical and non-technical teams.

• Collaboration & Problem Solving — Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across Operations, Engineering, Customer Success, and architecture teams. Sound judgment to identify when initiatives exceed managed services scope and require consulting or senior architecture involvement.

Nice to Have (The Bonus Points)

postings.title: Front End Developer (Remote LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Your Impact
You are joining us as a front-end web developer who will own and evolve the user interfaces for our internal tools. Alongside that primary focus, you will grow into full ownership of our Power BI reporting, building on solid, hands-on Power BI experience to take on report and dashboard delivery. Your day-to-day will involve building and improving user interfaces first and foremost, while growing into ownership of our Power BI reports, dashboards, and report-deployment process — all aimed at making our internal tools more usable and our reporting reliable, consistent, and easy to maintain.

What Success Looks Like
We measure success by results and alignment. Here is how we define a "win" for this role over your first year:
After 90 Days

• The Foundation — You have developed a strong understanding of the existing front-end codebase, and are already building and updating individual Power BI reports yourself as part of your onboarding.
• The Integration — You have built working relationships with Engineering and with the client-facing teams who rely on your reporting output, and are fielding Power BI requests directly.

• The Contribution — You have independently delivered several Power BI report or dashboard updates, and shipped your first UI improvement.

After 1 Year

• Your Impact — You have taken full ownership of Power BI reporting — including report delivery and the report-deployment process — while also shipping measurable improvements to our internal tools' UI.

• Your Growth — You have become the team's go-to owner for Power BI reporting and a strong, independent contributor on the front-end codebase.

• Your Influence — You have defined and documented standard measures, naming conventions, and templates that made reporting consistent across programs and clients, and helped shape a new internal configuration-management interface from the ground up.

The Skill Matrix
Required Skills (The Non-Negotiables)

• Years of Experience — 5+ years (in role)

• Role-Specific Mastery — Strong, hands-on front-end web development skills (React or similar) as your primary craft, complemented by solid, hands-on Power BI experience — enough to take on full ownership of report and dashboard delivery.

• Operational Excellence — Working knowledge of the Power BI data layer (semantic models, DAX, Power Query/M) and SQL, with comfort learning and eventually owning an existing Python-based deployment/automation codebase.
• Communication — Strong written and spoken English, with the fluency to collaborate clearly with technical, non-technical, and client-facing colleagues.

• Collaboration — Experience partnering with engineers and cross-functional or client-facing teams to make sure the right data is surfaced in the right way, and comfort taking over and improving an inherited platform rather than only building from scratch.

• Problem Solving — A strong eye for design and usability, and the judgment to improve the robustness of an existing deployment process by reducing brittle, manual steps.

Nice to Have (The Bonus Points)

• Power BI Projects (PBIP) — Experience with Power BI Projects and TMDL semantic-model definitions.

• Power Platform — Experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate).

• Design Tooling — Experience with design systems, component libraries, or UX tooling (e.g., Figma) to keep interfaces consistent and polished.

• Azure Ecosystem — Familiarity with Azure Resource Graph, Log Analytics/KQL, and Microsoft Sentinel.

How We Show Up
These 'Core Three' represent the heartbeat of Atmosera. They are the behaviors and attributes we align to every day, defining how we interact, solve problems, and celebrate our wins together. This is simply who we are at our best.

• Humble (Low Ego, High Impact) — We share credit easily, admit when we're wrong, and view every mistake as a data point for growth.

• Hungry (Internal Drive) — We have a natural bias for action. We don't wait for permission to solve a problem or find a better way to do things.

• Mindful (Intentional Awareness) — We are conscious of our impact on the team. We listen more than we speak and respond to challenges with empathy and situational awareness.

Our Interview Process
We value your time and aim for transparency. Our typical interview process looks like this:

1. Talent Screen: (30 mins) A conversation about your background and the role mission.

2. The Impact & Attributes Assessment: (60 mins) The "What" (Required Skills and Core Capabilities). This stage will require a live-coding challenge.

3. Collaborator Loop: (45 mins) The "How" (Cultural DNA and The Core Three).

• Podcast Growth & Spokesperson Role

• Lead social efforts across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms

• Actively engage publicly to extend credibility, reach, and trust

Skills/Traits Required:
• Required

• You love social media and creating content across multiple platforms

• You’re comfortable on camera or on mic (or excited to get there)

postings.title: Virtual Assistant
postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for a Customer Experience Virtual Assistant to support the team in daily customer support, operational follow-up, and administrative coordination related to the use of our SaaS platform.
 
This role focuses on providing excellent customer experience, managing customer requests, maintaining organized records, and supporting operational tasks that ensure smooth daily operations.
 
We are looking for a reliable, organized, and service-oriented professional who enjoys helping customers, following up on tasks, and working in a remote, digital environment.
 
Working hours: 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m

Key Responsibilities:
• Customer Support & Customer Experience (60%)

• Respond to basic customer inquiries related to the use of the platform.

• Provide first-level functional support to customers.

• Follow up on customer requests until resolution with the appropriate team.

• Register and update support tickets or requests.

• Ensure customers receive the necessary information to use the platform effectively.

• Identify frequently asked questions or recurring issues to improve customer experience.

• Administrative & Operational Coordination (25%)

• Maintain client information updated.

• Assist in coordinating internal and external meetings.

• Document relevant communications and operational activities.

• Prepare simple operational tracking reports.

• Support task tracking and follow-up for the team.

• Administrative & Commercial Support (15%)

• Assist with invoice follow-up and payment status tracking.

• Help coordinate sales or customer follow-up meetings.

• Route customer feedback or requests to the appropriate teams.

Requirements:
• 2–4 years of experience as a virtual assistant, customer support assistant, or administrative support assistant.

• Experience working remotely in organized and structured environments.

• Experience using customer management tools.

• Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, or similar.

• Basic experience with administrative tracking, reporting, or operational coordination.

• Basic to intermediate English for written communication.

Ideal Profile:
We are looking for someone who is:

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Reliable and responsible

• Service-minded with a strong customer orientation

• Comfortable managing multiple simple tasks simultaneously

• Curious and eager to learn

• Comfortable working in digital environments

Key Skills:
• Organization and time management

• Attention to detail

• Clear and professional communication

• Task follow-up and coordination

• Strong common sense and problem-solving mindset

• Technical Skills

• Familiarity with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar)

• Basic to intermediate Excel or Google Sheets

• Experience with customer support or ticketing tools

• Experience working with SaaS platforms is a plus

What We Offer:
• 100% remote work

• Part-time schedule

• Opportunity to work in a growing SaaS company

• Clear processes and team support

• Collaborative and professional environment

postings.title: Software Engineer: Frontend
postings.descriptionText:
Whippy is leading the way in AI-powered business communication, transforming how companies engage with customers using intelligent AI Agents. From customer support to marketing to sales, businesses rely on Whippy’s Voice AI and Chat AI to eliminate manual workflows—responding to inquiries, nurturing leads, screening job applicants, and automating high-value interactions at scale. By combining AI-driven messaging with omni-channel automation, Whippy replaces outdated tools with a single, powerful platform that helps businesses work smarter, faster, and more efficiently.




⚡ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Frontend Engineer at Whippy, you will:

 - Craft intuitive interfaces that allow our users to interact with powerful communication paradigms.

 - Write Engineering Requirement Documents to take something from idea, through defined tasks, to implementation, roll out, and evaluation of its success.

 - Build unit and end-to-end test suites that help us effectively maintain product performance and reliability, and integrate product analytics to measure the success of the features you launch.

Some frontend engineers have built:

 - Our React Native mobile app from the ground up on their own.

 - A SQL-style data filtering GUI that interfaces with our flexible backend APIs.

 - A spreadsheet-style data grid for real-time marketing analytics.

 - A design system built with Radix UI and Stitches.




🎯ABOUT YOU

 - A strong understanding of frontend architecture to build interactivity-rich systems for fetching, mutating, and rendering data effectively.

 - A desire to be a part of the entire project development process. From research gathering and planning, to implementation and monitoring.

 - Great written and verbal communication skills for expressing ideas, designs, and potential solutions in a mostly-asynchronous manner.




🙌 WHAT WE OFFER?

 - Compensation is $60K-$80K/year based on experience

 - Opportunity to take on significant responsibility and ownership in a highly disruptive product.

 - Working hands-on with serial entrepreneurs who have created $100M+ valued companies.




WHAT TO KNOW?

To provide transparency, here are some important points to note about the position:

 - We are a startup, and our team dynamics differ from those of companies of different sizes and stages. Our team is distributed across the globe, and this distributed nature will continue to grow. This means that there is always something happening, so effective time management in a remote and asynchronous engineering environment is essential.

 - While English is the second language for many engineers on the team, fluency in written English is a requirement. While fluency in spoken English is also a plus, if you are not confident in your written English ability, please do not apply.

 - We do not ask applicants to complete take-home assignments or participate in “leetcode” style interviews. However, we do require a two-week full-time or four-week part-time fully paid “work trial” of “mutual assessment.” More details about this mutual assessment period are outlined below. If you are unable to commit to this, please do not apply.

 - We hire globally regardless of timezone, but we have team meetings on Mondays and Fridays at 2:30 pm GMT. If you are unable to be online during these hours, please do not apply.

 - Pay is determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: interviews and an assessment of several factors that are unique to each candidate, job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, and abilities of the candidate.




WHAT’S THE PROCESS?

 1. Submit your Resume or CV

 2. Video call to talk about your experience and the role.

 3. 2-week full-time paid work trial.

 4. Meet the team and review work.

 5. Full Time Position Offer extended.




HOW DOES THE PAID ASSESSMENT PERIOD WORK?

Before the trial, we’ll discuss some options for a two-week project. We’ll agree on the scope of the project before you start.

You’ll work independently, however, you’ll have access to the team to ask questions and get support on anything you might need to complete the task efficiently.

At the end of the trial, if we both enjoyed working together, we’ll offer you a full-time position.

We’re aware that there are pros and cons to this process, but we believe this is the best possible way for both parties to be excited about working together. If you are asking questions like “I’m applying for multiple jobs what happens if I get one can we speed up the trial?” Then you’re probably not going to be the right fit and you should take another role.

postings.title: Customer Success Manager (Hybrid Buenos Aires, remote LATAM, or remote US)
postings.descriptionText:
Hi, I'm Joe, Head of Customer Success at Whippy. I'm hiring an entrepreneurial CSM to retain and grow a dedicated book of customers. 



WHY I'M HIRING

At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. Whippy has six incredible products today because we've always built alongside our customers - that's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, Ai-agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1000+ businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding/implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

Our best CSMs have taken our staffing customers from an initial $12k deal to $180k ARR because customers like Your Employment Solutions https://www.linkedin.com/company/your-employment-solutions/ are getting over $1M in ROI using Whippy to augment their teams and beat the competition.

 

You'll help us grow more customers by deeply understanding their desired outcomes, helping them achieve those outcomes, and providing an exceptional experience along the way.

 

This is one of those rare jobs with massive growth and learning opportunities: there's no bureaucracy here, and we're still early in building a world-class customer success team. You'll have a crucial role to play, and fresh ideas, feedback, and experimentation are always encouraged because we double down on wins and quickly pivot when ideas don't work out.

You'll work with six other CSMs and report directly to me, and I'll provide the support, coaching, tools, and data to do the best work of your career here, plus the variable comp to get well rewarded when you deliver results.

 

I'm looking for a CSM that wants to grow into a renaissance CSM, someone technical, strategic, and commercial, all in one: Technical as in you enjoy mastering the product and finding the best solutions for our customers. Strategic as in you deeply understand your customers pain points and always have a plan to solve them. Commercial as in you have pricing awareness and understand the retention and expansion risks and opportunities in your book.



 


SOME THINGS YOU'LL DO

 - Own your gross and net revenue retention, and get rewarded for beating targets.

 - Run a proactive cadence on every account: prepared calls, clear agendas, mutual success plans, and follow-through.

 - Become a product and customer expert. Master Whippy’s products and know your customers' business well enough to build the workflows, AI agents, and automations that solve their problems.

 - Tie usage to business outcomes, and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.

 - Turn wins into case studies, references, and testimonials that help sales win the next customer.

 - Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

 - Tell customers the truth, steering them away from work that won't move their business and toward the work that will.

 - Advocate for the customer. Feed what you hear to product, sales, and engineering so we build the right things.

 - Experiment and iterate. If you have an idea to do something better, do it and document what you learn.




OUR CUSTOMER SUCCESS VALUES

This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach & support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:

 - We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.

Operations Associate (LATAM Remote, Buenos Aires Hybrid Preferred)

Full time | US Eastern hours | $2,000 to $3,000 USD per month total comp, paid monthly


Hi, I'm David, CEO and co-founder of Whippy. I'm hiring an Operations Associate to work directly with me and take over the layer of work that is keeping me from doing the things only a CEO can do.




Why I'm hiring

Whippy is a fast growing bootstrapped, profitable, and the category leader in AI communication for staffing, with over 1,000 customers and new industries opening behind it. We are hiring across sales, marketing, operations, and customer success right now, and the person finding and messaging every one of those candidates is me.

We recruit through my LinkedIn on purpose. A founder's message gets replies at many times the rate of a recruiter's. But running searches, writing outreach, following up, and scheduling interviews is close to twenty hours a week, and that is twenty hours I should be spending with enterprise customers and partners. The same is true of the billing follow ups, account changes, and admin that land in my inbox every evening.

Your job is to take all of that off my plate, run it better than I do, and document it so well that someone else can run it after you. Then you move up to the next thing. I am hiring a Head of Operations in parallel, and you will be the first person on their team. If you are good, you will learn more about how a real business works in a year here than in three years anywhere else, because you will be inside the decisions, not reading about them.



Some things you'll do

The first 90 days are mostly recruiting:

• Build candidate lists in Sales Navigator and Juicebox against the ICPs I give you for each open role

• Message candidates from my LinkedIn account using templates written in my voice, and get good enough at it that I stop editing them

• Handle replies, route interested candidates to a screening call or a Loom, and flag anything you cannot answer

• Keep Ashby current, schedule interviews and reference calls, and chase interviewers for feedback

• Send me a weekly funnel: sent, accepted, replied, screened, hired



By day 90 you add the operations layer:

• Monitor Stripe for failed payments and overdue invoices, chase them to resolution, reconcile checks

• Process upgrades, downgrades, and churn across Stripe, HubSpot, and our internal tools off a checklist you help write

• Keep HubSpot records clean so what a customer signed, uses, and pays always match

• Handle Deel onboarding and offboarding steps, travel and dinner bookings, and the vendor list



Once that runs without reminders, you grow into partner administration, process documentation, and whatever the Head of Operations and I need figured out next. I will not pretend that is the day one job. It is earned by making the operational work disappear. But it is real, and the people who do this well become the operations team.



How we work

Bootstrapped and profitable, so revenue is the strategy. Our customers are East Coast, so we start early. No task is above or beneath anyone here, including me, and I still cold call. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work and verify every fact. Speed over polish. Results over activity. You will always know where you stand with me.



What I'm looking for

• Writing above all. You will be writing as me to VPs at American companies. It has to sound like a sharp person, not a template. This is the number one predictor of success in the role

• Organized to a fault. Nothing you own gets asked about twice

• Comfortable with a daily number. Outreach is a volume game run with care, and you like seeing the funnel move

• Curious, coachable, and low ego. You want feedback and you get better quickly

• Already using AI tools to work faster, and eager to automate your own work

• Judgment. Half this job is defined tasks. The other half is noticing what needs doing before anyone assigns it

• Ideally one to three years as an SDR, recruiting coordinator, or operations associate at a SaaS or tech company selling into the US. If your path is unconventional and you can explain why it makes you good at this, apply anyway

• Fluent written and spoken English, and able to work US Eastern hours

Experience with Stripe, HubSpot, or Ashby is a plus, not a requirement. I can teach tools. I cannot teach ownership.



You'll thrive here if...

• You get energy from a clean inbox and a moving funnel

• You would rather own a small thing completely than touch a big thing lightly

• You want to see how a company actually runs from the inside, and you are willing to do the unglamorous work to get that seat

• You are excited by a job that changes every month



This is not for you if

• You think outreach and billing are beneath you. They are week one, and they are how you earn everything after

• You need detailed instructions for every task

• You are looking for a job description that stays the same



About Whippy

Whippy is a communication, automation, and AI agent platform. You reach customers across calls, texts, and email at scale, with every conversation in one shared inbox. Replies get assigned to a teammate, handled by an AI agent, or carried forward by an automation, and the data flows back into your systems in the format you need. It cuts the repetitive work and frees teams for the human work that drives revenue.

We're industry agnostic, with our biggest wins in staffing, healthcare, and other in person businesses going through digital transformation. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, with over 1,000 businesses using Whippy worldwide.

Whippy was founded in 2021 by me and our CTO, Jack Kennedy. Jack is an engineering machine and a marathon runner. I started BloomNation in 2011 after winning $27,205 in a poker tournament, grew it into a platform generating billions in sales for florists, then left to build something bigger with Jack.

postings.title: Human Data Evals Lead (Remote/US/LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Reports to: CEO

Owns: data proposals, sample development, quality, and pilot delivery

Location: Remote / Latam / US



THE ROLE

You will own Anyone AI’s data initiatives and proposals to AI labs, from the data proposal or responding to requests, through pilot delivery. You own how we build proposals and develop the sample packages and benchmarks: frontier-grade packages across reasoning, coding, agents, and tool use, multi-modal and others, produced in collaboration with subject-matter experts, with expert-verified ground truth, multi-model headroom results, and QC that survives buyer-side scrutiny. You are the person who designs the sample that demonstrates our quality, converts pilots into production engagements. On a small team, this is the operational center of the Human Data Division.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Proposals & requests. Study public benchmarks and eval targets, and turn them into proposals and sample packages that demonstrate capability and win the work. Respond to lab data requests and pilots.

 - Sample & benchmark development. Design and build the sample packages, working with subject-matter experts. Every package meets the bar of our current sample set:
   
   - Expert-verified, exact-match-checkable ground truth and gold reasoning trajectories.
   
   - Multi-model evaluation showing real headroom, and proof the task discriminates the model, not just that it's hard.
   
   - Rigorous QC structure: calibration layers, severity-weighted rubrics, deterministic verifiers, evidence maps, etc.

 - Subject-matter experts. Recruit, brief, calibrate, and review a pool of experts across coding, agentic/tool-use, and STEM/reasoning. Raise their output to our standard and keep it there; be the arbiter of what "correct" and "frontier-difficulty" mean.

 - Lab relationships. Be a direct point of contact for lab partners on Slack and calls, with support from the CEO and the wider team. Keep senior lab contacts informed, surface what they actually need, and pull in the CEO and subject-matter experts when the conversation calls for it.

 - Pilot delivery. Own pilots end to end: scoping, SOW, staffing, production, QC, and delivery. Nothing ships before it's lab-ready, and nothing comes back rejected as "not frontier-level" without us already knowing why.


EXPERIENCE

 - Originated data or benchmark proposals for AI labs, translated eval targets into sample tasks that demonstrate capability, and owned the engagement through delivery.

 - Deep evaluation and quality expertise: LLM benchmarking, with real strength in code-model evaluation.

 - Built QC processes and artifact standards that met enterprise or lab requirements, and set a quality bar a team of experts was held to.

 - Thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the rules are still being written, and delivers under pressure.

Qualifications

 - 5+ years in technical delivery, quality, or program management, with recent experience in AI/ML data, model evaluation, or benchmarking.

 - Hands-on experience delivering data or evaluation work to AI labs or enterprise ML teams, scoping through delivery.

 - Working fluency with how frontier models are evaluated: benchmarks, rubrics, pass rates, headroom, and what makes a task discriminate a model.

 - Proven people/vendor leadership, you've recruited, calibrated, and held a team or expert pool to a quality standard.

 - Fluent English. Spanish is a nice to have.

postings.title: Strategic Project Lead (Remote/US/LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Reports to: CEO

Owns: the AI lab / partner account, relationship, scoping, and commercial growth across engagements

Location: Remote / Latam / US


THE ROLE

You own the relationship with one or more lab partners and everything we deliver into them. You are the senior point of contact who keeps the account healthy, scopes the next engagement before the current one finishes, and turns a single pilot into a growing book of production work. You sit between origination and execution: the Human Data Evals Lead sets what we sell and to what standard, your Human Data Managers make projects ship, and you make the account expand. On a small team, you carry the commercial weight of the relationship.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Account ownership. Be the senior, trusted point of contact for lab partners on Slack and calls. Understand what they actually need next, and position our work to win it.

 - Scoping & expansion. Turn requests and pilots into scoped engagements and SOWs; convert pilots into production and grow the account engagement over engagement.

 - Delivery oversight. Own outcomes across the account’s projects, working through the Human Data Managers who run them. Accountable for the account’s quality reputation, not the line-by-line execution.

 - Commercial sense. Manage scope, pricing inputs, and margin at the account level; know when to pull in the CEO on pricing and the subject-matter experts on substance.

 - Strategic read. Track where each lab is heading, surface the next opportunity, and feed origination signal back to the Human Data Evals Lead.


EXPERIENCE

 - Owned a client or partner relationship and grew it — turned an initial engagement into expanding, repeat work.

 - Operated in a customer-facing technical role (delivery lead, TAM, forward-deployed, or account/engagement management) where you scoped work and carried commercial responsibility.

 - Worked with or sold to AI labs, ML teams, or technical enterprise buyers, and held your own in a senior technical conversation.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years in account management, engagement management, technical delivery leadership, or partnerships, with recent exposure to AI/ML data, model evaluation, or benchmarking.

 - Fluent in how frontier data and evaluation work is bought and judged — enough to scope it credibly and defend quality to a sophisticated buyer.

 - Track record of growing accounts and converting pilots to production.

 - Strong commercial instincts and comfort with ambiguity in an early, fast-moving environment.

 - Fluent English. Spanish is a nice to have.

postings.title: Human Data Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Reports to: Human Data Evals Lead

Owns: end-to-end project delivery, staffing, production, quality, and on-time shipping

Location: Remote / Latam / US


THE ROLE

You run our data projects from scoped brief to delivered package. Once an engagement is won, it’s yours: you assemble the right experts, drive production, enforce the quality bar on every artifact, and ship on time. You are the person who makes sure nothing leaves the building below frontier standard, and nothing comes back rejected without us already knowing why. On a small team running multiple concurrent projects, you are the delivery engine of the Human Data Division.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Project execution. Take scoped engagements through staffing, production, QC, and delivery. Own timeline, throughput, and the delivered package across several concurrent projects at once.

 - Expert orchestration. Staff each project from the expert pool, brief and calibrate contributors, manage their output and utilization, and keep production moving without quality drift.

 - Quality control. Run the QC structure on every deliverable — calibration layers, severity-weighted rubrics, deterministic verifiers, evidence maps — so each package survives buyer-side scrutiny before it ships.

 - Throughput & instrumentation. Track output-per-contributor-week, flag bottlenecks early, and protect margin by managing expert hours against scope.

 - Handoff. Keep the Strategic Project Lead and the Human Data Evals Lead informed on status, risk, and what shipped; surface anything that needs escalation before it becomes a delivery miss.


EXPERIENCE

 - Delivered technical or data projects end to end under deadline pressure, owning quality and throughput across multiple concurrent workstreams.

 - Managed distributed contributors or expert pools — briefing, calibrating, and holding output to a standard.

 - Built or run QC processes that caught defects before a client did.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years in program/delivery management, technical project management, or data operations, ideally in AI/ML data, evaluation, or annotation.

 - Comfortable with how frontier models are evaluated — rubrics, pass rates, what makes a task discriminate a model — enough to QC it, even if you don’t author it.

 - Proven ability to run several projects in parallel without dropping quality or timelines.

 - Fluent English. Spanish is a nice to have.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We create high-quality STEM training data for frontier AI models. Our data is used directly in training and evaluation pipelines at leading AI labs to improve model reasoning in technical domains.

We are looking for experts in Physics to design rigorous, deterministic problems that are genuinely challenging for state-of-the-art AI systems. Each problem must have exactly one verifiable correct answer and be submitted together with a complete, verified solution.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design advanced physics problems for frontier AI training and evaluation

 - Create deterministic problems with exactly one correct answer

 - Write complete, verified solutions and clearly document the reasoning process

 - Develop problems that test deep physical reasoning and multi-step analysis, not just memorization

 - Where relevant, use Python or specialized tools to build simulations, models, or computational workflows

 - Ensure all outputs are technically precise, reproducible, and well-written in English




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Master’s, or PhD in Physics or a closely related field

 - Strong research or industry experience involving theoretical, experimental, or computational physics

 - Strong Python skills; comfort with scientific libraries such as numpy, scipy, or similar

 - Solid understanding of modeling, simulation, numerical methods, and multi-step problem solving

 - Ability to design original, difficult problems that reflect real physics workflows

 - Excellent attention to detail and technical writing skills in English




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with simulation tools or domain-specific physics software (e.g., finite element tools, circuit simulators, symbolic systems)

 - Background in areas such as computational physics, statistical mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, or related fields

 - Experience evaluating model reasoning, benchmarking, or designing technical assessments

postings.title: Data & Operations Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Our vision: Mastering machine learning is difficult, time-consuming, and often frustrating. Meanwhile, the AI industry faces its biggest challenge: a global shortage of skilled talent. At Anyone AI, we close this gap by upskilling the best talent from LatAm through an accelerated, hands-on training program designed and led by AI industry experts.



Our mission: We are building the largest hub of AI developers in the region, investing in tens of thousands of developers over the next decade.



We are founding members of Deep Vision AI, one of the first companies in the computer vision / AI space, which was acquired in early 2020 by DFW Capital Partners. Anyone AI is backed by top global investors like GFC -Global Founders Capital- (investors in Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, etc), Canvas Ventures (early investor in Coursera), Latitud Fund (the largest community of angel investors for LatAm), Magma Partners, Lotux VC, among others.
