 - Full clean NZ Class 1 driver's license, non-negotiable - you'll be clocking serious km's

 - On-farm experience (bonus points if you've worked with either beef or dairy cows)

 - A communicator who leaves farmers feeling good about Halter - your interactions matter!

 - Physically fit and up for the manual side of the work

 - Reliable, punctual, and someone who takes ownership, if you say you'll be there, you're there

 - A strong work ethic with a track record to back it up

 - Comfortable working independently on the road and as part of a team when back at base

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a motivated and high-performing Field Specialist to join our team in New Zealand, supporting the maintenance and performance of Halter’s on-farm hardware infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our systems are operating efficiently, resolving technical issues quickly, and helping to refine and improve the reliability of our hardware across our customer network.

Note this role is Tasman/Marlborough based with regular NZ travel.

This is a hands-on position that requires strong technical ability, problem-solving skills, and a proactive approach to field operations. You may find yourself maintaining and upgrading infrastructure one day and deploying new equipment on-farm the next. You’ll be the go-to person for ensuring everything runs smoothly, delivering exceptional service and support to our customers. As a Field Specialist, you’ll work closely with our hardware, product, and customer success teams, ensuring effective collaboration and a strong feedback loop between the field and our Auckland HQ.This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact in transforming New Zealand’s dairy and livestock industry through world-class agri-tech innovation.

 - Hardware Diagnosis: Diagnose any issues with our hardware and feed this information back to the relevant team.

 - Deployment Support: Provide critical on-site support during farm deployments if needed, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring successful installations.

 - On-call: Be part of the global on-call roster to support tower-related incidents and proactively find solutions in a timely manner.

 - Collaboration: Work closely across all of the Halter teams to ensure alignment and successful customer outcomes.

 - Problem-Solving: Address and resolve technical challenges promptly and effectively, ensuring minimal disruption to farm operations.

 - Adaptability: Be prepared to manage a variety of tasks, often simultaneously, to meet the dynamic needs of the role.

 - Data Analysis: Ability to collect, interpret, and analyse data from our hardware, optimise processes, and inform decision-making. You'll ensure that actionable insights are extracted to improve operational efficiency and resolve issues proactively. Development and management of a maintenance system for our NZ market.

 - Travel: travel within the South Island region + some NZ wide travel will be required.

 - Handiness: Practical skills and resourcefulness, with the ability to handle a wide range of tasks even without specific technical training.

 - Time management skills: Ability to manage your own time so that tasks are completed on schedule.

 - Team-Oriented Approach: Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues across different locations.

 - Commitment to Excellence: A dedication to providing the highest quality service, ensuring that Halter’s infrastructure is always operating at its best.

 - Willingness to travel: Spontaneous & planned travel will be included in this role. You might be 3 or 4 days on the road per week. You may also be 3 nights away from home per week.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS (THESE ARE NOT MANDATORY FOR YOU TO APPLY)

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're building a regional finance and operations hub in Buenos Aires, and this role owns the finance engine for Argentina and Uruguay. Reporting to the Director Finance & Operations, South America, you'll be accountable for the close, tax, statutory compliance and controls across both entities, and you'll lead a Financial Accountant and a Billing Admin from day one.

This is a build role in the literal sense. Some processes exist when you arrive; most don't. You'll design them, run them, and make them hold as volume grows fast. You'll work closely with the Director on planning and strategy, and with Halter's global finance team in New Zealand on consolidation, reporting and group requirements.

If you want to be the person who knows exactly why every number in two countries is right, and who built the process that makes it so, this is it.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The monthly close for Argentina and Uruguay: accurate, on time, and reconciled to group reporting.

 - Tax compliance across both countries (ARCA, formerly AFIP, and provincial Ingresos Brutos in Argentina; DGI and BPS in Uruguay), with advisors managed rather than relied on.

 - Statutory reporting and audits, including inflation-adjusted local reporting and the bridge to group IFRS.

 - Controls and source-of-truth discipline: coding, approvals, documentation and audit-readiness across both entities.

 - Treasury operations: cash positions, FX execution within the policy the Director sets, and import and supplier payment compliance.

 - Leading and developing the Financial Accountant and Billing Admin, and deciding what gets automated rather than resourced.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Must-haves

 - 6 to 10 years in accounting, controllership or audit, with hands-on Argentine tax and statutory experience.

 - You've owned a close end-to-end, not just contributed to one.

 - Working knowledge of inflation-adjusted reporting and IFRS, and the ability to reconcile the two.

 - Fluency in Spanish and English. You'll work daily with the team in New Zealand.

 - Experience managing or mentoring others.

 - Accuracy and a builder's instinct. You're comfortable creating process where none exists.

Nice-to-haves

 - Uruguayan tax and compliance exposure.

 - Big 4 background, or experience in a multinational subsidiary reporting to an offshore parent.

 - Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP.

 - A track record of automating finance processes or using AI to create leverage.




HOW WE'LL KNOW YOU'RE WINNING

 - Close runs on time every month and reconciles to group without back-and-forth.

 - Tax filings and statutory audits in both countries are clean and on time, with no surprises.

 - The Director spends their time on strategy, partnering and operations, not reviewing your work.

 - Your team is growing and taking on more each quarter.




CULTURE LINE

This role is Absolute Ownership of the numbers across two countries: if it's wrong, it's yours to find and fix. It rewards someone who works From First Principles to build processes that scale rather than copying familiar ones, and who brings the discipline of Here to Win to a close that doesn't slip.




OUR OFFICE FIRST APPROACH 

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

You'll also bring our first sales hires up to speed and build the reporting that tells us how the launch is going. Once things are up and running, the job shifts to keeping the market on plan and helping it grow.

 - Setting up the market in Salesforce with our Ecosystem team, including territories, currency, quoting and reports.

 - Working with our Global Pricing & Packaging Manager on local pricing and discount rules, taking currency and inflation into account

 - Starting weekly pipeline reviews and forecast calls with the first sales hires, and agreeing what each stage means

 - Training new sales team members on our tools and processes as they join

 - Making sure launch and support are ready before the first customer signs, with our Customer Revenue Operations Manager

 - Letting the team in New Zealand know what's different about this market and where our current approach needs to change

Then, once things are up and running your day could look like…

 - Running pipeline reviews with sales leaders and checking deals and stages are accurate

 - Looking into why conversion drops between stages and fixing the cause

 - Building reports that give leadership a clear view of the market without them having to ask

 - Supporting with the sales teams adoption of new tooling, or a feature that our Ecosystem team have just launched.

 - Writing up what you've built so the next market launch has something to start from

 - Feeding structured commercial intelligence back to HQ: what's working, what's not, what the market needs that our current playbook doesn't address

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT CANALS

Canals builds software for wholesale distributors, helping them operate more efficiently through automation and AI.

Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. Every day, thousands of people rely on Canals to help process orders, manage purchasing, handle accounts payable, and streamline critical business workflows.

We're a profitable, rapidly growing company with a team of roughly 140 people distributed across North and South America. We care deeply about building great products, hiring exceptional people, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.


THE ROLE

Our customer base is growing fast, and we’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer eager to learn and grow with us. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers building scalable, high-performance systems that solve real-world problems in logistics and automation.

This is a great opportunity to gain exposure to modern engineering practices, real customers, and a product that delivers measurable business impact.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Work closely with senior engineers to design, build, and maintain backend systems that power our platform.

 - Contribute to feature development, bug fixes, and performance improvements.

 - Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and maintainability.

 - Collaborate with product and design teams to bring ideas from concept to production.

 - Learn new tools and technologies, and grow into greater ownership over time.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Typically, 0–2 years of professional experience as a software engineer (internships or projects count!).

 - Solid programming fundamentals and familiarity with at least one backend language (Go, Python, Node, etc.).

 - Curiosity and a desire to understand how complex systems fit together.

 - Eagerness to learn from others and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team.

 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

 - Interest in startups, AI, or logistics a plus.


WHY JOIN CANALS

We're building software that solves real problems for an industry that keeps the world running. Our customers rely on our platform every day to operate their businesses.

We've found strong product-market fit and continue to grow quickly, creating opportunities for people who want to have a meaningful impact on the trajectory of a company.

We believe great people build great companies. That's why we invest heavily in hiring, development, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.

You'll work alongside ambitious, thoughtful teammates who care deeply about what they do, challenge each other directly, and have a lot of fun along the way.

We value ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement. Good ideas can come from anywhere, and people are trusted to make things happen.

We're remote-first, flexible, and distributed across North and South America, bringing together talented people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.



Canals.ai is an equal opportunity employer. In addition to EEO being the law, it is a policy that is fully consistent with our principles. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to status as a protected veteran or a qualified individual with a disability, or other protected status such as race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, pregnancy or age.

postings.title: IT Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
WHO ARE WE?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

 

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

 

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.



Where does this role fit in?

 - Build, operate and continually improve the technology platform that lets every UpGuardian work securely, efficiently and with minimal friction.

 - You’ll own the lifecycle of our corporate technology end to end: identity, endpoints, SaaS and the service practices that hold them together. You’ll automate the repetitive parts, instrument the rest, and make security a property of how systems are built rather than a task someone remembers to do.

 - This is an engineering role, not a ticket queue. If you see the same request three times and your first thought is “why is a human still doing this?” - you’ll fit.

 - Security is an outcome of excellent operational engineering here, not the primary function of the role.



What will you do?

Platform, identity and fleet

 - Google Workspace, Okta (or equivalent IdP), and MDM (Kandji, Jamf or similar) across a mostly macOS and ChromeOS fleet

 - You’ll own SaaS administration and lifecycle, asset management, endpoint standards and compliance, and the joiner–mover–leaver process end to end

Zero Trust and secure access

 - Operate and continually improve our Cloudflare Zero Trust environment across ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway, DNS filtering, tunnels and identity and device aware access policies

 - You’ll help move us away from traditional network trust, maintain secure access to internal applications and services, troubleshoot access and connectivity issues, and make sure security controls don’t create unnecessary friction for employees

Automation and internal tooling

 - Automation is the default approach, not a stretch goal. If a task happens more than twice, it’s a candidate for code

 - You’ll work with REST APIs, Python, Apps Script, Terraform, n8n and AI assisted workflows to build internal tooling that removes work rather than making it faster to do by hand

Service operations

 - Incident, problem and change management. Service catalogue, knowledge base, service metrics, capacity planning and operational readiness

 - You’ll define these practices where they don’t exist yet and improve the ones that do

Reliability and continuous improvement

 - Zero touch provisioning, endpoint compliance, fleet health, monitoring, reporting, SaaS governance and self service. Making internal platforms boringly reliable is the goal

Security, embedded

 - Deploy and maintain security controls, harden endpoints, support security incidents, reduce operational risk and keep baselines current

 - Security is part of how you’ll operate the platform rather than a separate function you’ll own

What will you bring?

You won’t have all of this. Tell us which parts you’d be learning, and we’ll tell you honestly whether that works

 - Depth across enterprise SaaS and identity - you’ve administered Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, an IdP such as Okta or Entra, and MDM at organisational scale. You’re comfortable with SSO, SAML, SCIM, DNS and certificates

 - Zero Trust, hands on - you’ve worked with ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway or modern network access controls, ideally Cloudflare Zero Trust or a similar platform such as Zscaler, Netskope, Tailscale or Entra Private Access. You understand identity and device aware access and the principles behind replacing traditional network trust

 - You don’t need to be a Zero Trust specialist, but you should be comfortable taking ownership of an existing Cloudflare implementation, troubleshooting it and making it better

 - You genuinely automate - you write code using Python, Apps Script or similar, work confidently with REST APIs, and can point to internal tooling you’ve shipped that removed recurring work permanently

 - Fleet management maturity - you’ve worked with macOS at scale, zero touch provisioning and endpoint compliance baselines

 - Service operations experience - you’ve run incident and change practices, defined metrics and built documentation people actually use

 - Security and infrastructure fundamentals - you’re comfortable with endpoint hardening, identity security, DNS, certificates, secure network access and making sensible risk trade offs

 - Process improvement instinct - you make the system better, not just the outcome of one request
   
   

What will give you an edge?

 - Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code

 - Cloudflare

 - n8n or similar orchestration

 - AI and LLM-assisted workflows

 - Deep macOS expertise

 - Chrome Enterprise

 - Working in a security-first or audited environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001)
   
   

What's in it for you? 

 - Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

 - WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

 - $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

 - Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

 - 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

 - Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

 - Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate com

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - Buenos Aires, Argentina (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the technical direction of multiple teams, driving the design and evolution of large-scale distributed systems that serve millions of customers. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that engineers who are eager to learn will be successful here — and we will teach you Clojure as our main backend language.

 - You will build and evolve
   
   - Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
   
   - High-throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
   
   - Continuous Integration and Deployment pipelines on AWS
   
   - Data storage solutions using Datomic and DynamoDB
   
   - Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
   
   - Services running as much as possible in Kubernetes
   
   We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We work in small, independent teams that feel like startups within the company and avoid unnecessary coupling and centralization whenever realistic. We understand that execution is key to success and continuously optimize our processes to remove bottlenecks.

 


YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Setting technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies

 - Working with large-scale distributed systems and understanding their broad architecture and trade-offs

 - Driving pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient, secure, and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

 - Mentoring engineers across teams and helping maintain a high technical bar organization-wide

 - Writing, testing, instrumenting, documenting, and maintaining high-quality code

 - Pairing and participating in code reviews to support the growth of others in and around your teams

 - Collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new end-to-end experiences

 - Ensuring comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and robust error handling across team services

 - Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

 - Focusing primarily on backend applications, while being open to contributing to mobile and frontend development according to business needs


WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 - At least 4 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

 - Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

 - A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands or millions of users

 - A strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with the ability to work across multiple languages

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams, even without direct authority

 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations

 - Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and prior experience with CI/CD

 - Strong communication skills to identify and prevent risks, and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - Advanced English skills

 


LOCATION

Buenos Aires, Argentina 
Argentina · Avenida del Libertador General San Martín 1000 – Vicente López

 


OUR BENEFITS

Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development, and life outside of work. They include:

 - Chance of earning equity

 - Health Insurance

 - Life Insurance

 - NuCare

 - International business travel insurance

 - NuLanguage

 - Vacations

 - Parental leaves

 - Work from home allowance

Even if you feel you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply — your unique skills and experiences may be just what we're looking for, and we're excited to learn more about what you can bring to our team.

 


WORK MODEL FOR THIS ROLE

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit  https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/ https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.google.com/a/macros/nubank.com.br/s/AKfycbwvrewE58oGSbRWIVv8CyCWN68GLxpPVsfYYXv-ZHg94QFsTJmi82rF1x0yt-OTs2W0DQ/exec

postings.title: Staff Software Engineer - Insurance
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the role

Our mission is to evolve the platform architecture and workflows that let Insurance scale across more customers, more products, and new markets, and to close the gap between AI capabilities built centrally and their reliable adoption in production.

As a Staff Software Engineer - Insurance, you will be a senior technical leader across two connected fronts: diagnosing and evolving our service architecture as the platform scales, and leading the rollout of AI/agentic tooling across the team's engineering workflow, from spec and code generation to testing and validation.

You will operate at platform scale, building infrastructure and practices other teams depend on, while partnering closely with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and Insurance partners. You'll be part of a lean, entrepreneurial team that delivers outsized business impact while protecting millions of customers, sitting at the intersection of embedded insurance, Nu's most important customer surfaces, and our insurer partners. This team is also one of the earliest adopters of agentic engineering within Nubank, putting you at the center of how that transformation actually happens.


You’ll be responsible for

 - Diagnosing and evolving our platform architecture to remove constraints on scale, supporting a growing user base, expanding product portfolio, and global expansion.

 - Providing AI-first engineering leadership, setting the standards and practices for how the team builds and evolves with AI/agentic tooling.

 - Cutting through ambiguity, surfacing trade-offs and aligning cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Security, Compliance, Insurance partners) around clear outcomes.

 - Ensuring observability for AI systems and platform services in production (tracing, logging, alerting).

 - Mentoring engineers on technical approach across both architecture and AI/agentic best practices, raising the team's execution level over time.

 - Evaluating and incorporating both internal (Nubank) and external AI tools and agents into our workflows, based on what best fits our needs.

 - Partnering with Nubank's central AI/platform teams and other BUs to share learnings and stay aligned on tooling direction.

 - Enabling more Nubankers to safely contribute to AI-powered products over time (engineers and non-engineers)

 - Embedding responsible, auditable practices in everything shipped, across platform and AI systems alike, per applicable regulations and internal risk standards.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Lead Software Engineer , you will serve as a technical authority across entire business domains, shaping company-wide engineering strategy and driving the architectural evolution of large-scale distributed systems that power our core platform for tens of millions of customers. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that top-tier technical leaders who are eager to learn will thrive here — and we will support your mastery of Clojure as our main backend language.



YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR 

 1. Architectural Leadership: Defining long-term technical vision and architecture roadmaps across business area, balancing immediate business goals with long-term system sustainability.

 2. Strategic Alignment: Partnering with Leaders to translate team business strategy into scalable engineering systems and technical bets.

 3. Engineering Excellence: Setting and raising the technical bar for the entire engineering organization through systemic improvements, architectural reviews, and best-practice frameworks.

 4. High-Impact Execution: Hands-on leadership in designing, prototyping, and executing on the most complex, high-risk, or foundational systems in the company.

 5. Mentorship & Talent Growth: Mentoring engineers

 6. Cross-Organizational Resilience: Establishing team practices for observability, failure domain isolation, disaster recovery, and incident resolution for critical systems

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

 1. Extensive Experience: 8+ years of experience engineering complex digital products

 2. Domain-Scale Expertise: Mastery of distributed systems design, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and failure-mode analysis in systems handling high concurrency and millions of active users.

 3. Cross-Team Influence: Demonstrated history of steering large-scale technical initiatives, aligning competing priorities across multiple engineering teams.

 4. Leadership & Sponsorship: Experience mentoring engineers

 5. Business Acumen & Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs, risk profiles, and architectural decisions

 6. Language Proficiency: Advanced English skills (both written and spoken)

 


WORK SETUP

Buenos Aires, Argentina

 - Work from home allowance

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design core product experiences end to end, from early exploration through launch and iteration

Dylan Babbs, Co-founder & CTO

postings.title: Engineering Manager - AI Product(100% Remote EMEA)
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote (Europe Time Zone)
Start date: ASAP
Language: English
Team: AI



ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is a European technology company operating a cloud and infrastructure platform, and we are looking for an AI Engineering Manager to lead the small, high-leverage team behind their AI product.

The Engineering Manager is to lead a team of AI engineers and researchers building the systems that power an AI-enabled products and the model inference offering. You’ll manage the people and the roadmap: hiring and developing a high-caliber team, setting technical direction alongside senior ICs, and driving delivery on projects that range from applied ML features inside the products to the infrastructure that serves models in production at scale.

This is a hybrid people/technical leadership role. You should be comfortable running a team day-to-day (1:1s, planning, performance, hiring) while also being comfortable enough technically to review designs, unblock research and engineering tradeoffs, and represent the team to other engineering and product leaders.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage, coach, and grow a team of AI/ML engineers and researchers, including hiring, career development, and performance management.

 - Own delivery for AI-enabling projects across the product portfolio, translating ambiguous product and research goals into scoped, sequenced engineering plans.

 - Co-own the roadmap and operations of the inference offering, including reliability, latency, cost, and scaling of model serving infrastructure.

 - Partner with research scientists to move promising models and techniques from experimentation into production, balancing research rigor with shipping velocity.

 - Set and maintain engineering standards for the team: code quality, experimentation practices, evaluation methodology, on-call, and incident response for production inference systems.

 - Work closely with Product, Infrastructure, and Data teams to prioritize work and remove cross-team blockers.

 - Report on team progress, risks, and capacity to engineering leadership, and represent the team’s work in planning and roadmap discussions.

 - Stay current on the AI/ML and inference landscape (models, serving frameworks, hardware) and bring relevant developments back to the team’s technical strategy.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of experience in a technical leadership or engineering management role (AI/ML teams preferred), plus a strong prior track record as a hands-on engineer or researcher.

 - Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform or inference infrastructure in production (model serving, GPU workloads, latency and cost optimization)

 - Working knowledge of the AI/ML lifecycle: model training or fine-tuning, evaluation, and production deployment.

 - Experience with, or strong technical fluency in, model inference and serving infrastructure (e.g., GPU scheduling, batching, quantization, latency/throughput tradeoffs, serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton, or similar).

 - Demonstrated ability to manage both researchers and engineers, who often have different working styles, timelines, and definitions of “done.”

 - Strong judgment on scoping and sequencing ambiguous, research-adjacent projects into shippable increments.

 - Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical tradeoffs for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Experience owning production systems, including reliability and incident response, is a plus.


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS FOR YOU

 - Own a product, not a component: Lead the team behind the company's AI product and shape the capabilities the wider business builds on

 - High leverage, small team: With three engineers, your technical and strategic decisions translate directly into what ships

 - Grow as a leader: Manage, mentor, and inspire a talented team while influencing strategic technical decisions

 - Stay hands-on: Balance leadership with coding in a modern, high-scale AI platform environment

 - Work with cutting-edge technology: Deepen your expertise in LLMs, inference infrastructure, GPU compute, and distributed systems at scale

 - Drive platform evolution: Directly impact architecture, reliability, and AI quality across the organization

 - Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Backend teams, expanding your cross-functional expertise

 - Remote-first flexibility: Enjoy a fully remote role while aligning with the European time zone

We recruit on behalf of our clients and prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. We are committed to a fair and inclusive hiring process. We process your personal data solely for recruitment purposes, in accordance with applicable privacy laws, and maintain reasonable safeguards to protect your information. NICE TO HAVE

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Flexible freelance contract with autonomy

 - Direct partnership with founders

postings.title: AI Content Operations Lead
postings.descriptionText:
About WON

WON redesigns how a business works: what its customers experience on the outside, and how its operation runs  on the inside. We do that for retail and consumer brands, travel, hospitality, financial services, and private equity  portfolios. We are not a consultancy that separates the thinking from the doing, and we are not a platform  company with something to sell you. Those two halves are our two disciplines: Experience Intelligence and  Operational Intelligence.

This is not a social media job. We are not hiring someone to post content. We are hiring the person who will  design, operate, and continuously improve the AI-powered media engine behind WON, turning every founder  conversation, workshop, keynote, podcast, interview, and strategy session into a continuous stream of exceptional content across every major platform. The role sits inside Operational Intelligence and points that discipline at our  own operation.

AI gives exceptional people extraordinary leverage. It increases capacity, it does not replace judgment. That is the  bet this role is built on: the systems absorb the repetition, and your taste decides what is actually worth  publishing.

This role reports to the CEO and works directly with the technical team on the internal tooling behind the pipeline.



What You’ll Own

 - The complete content production lifecycle: capture, intake, AI-assisted production, review, publishing, and the searchable library where everything lands

 - Editorial judgment: which moments are worth cutting, which assets ship, and where the quality bar sits • Coordination of editors and creative resources, including review of every asset before it publishes

 - The measurement layer: production velocity, turnaround time, quality, and what the content actually does for audience and pipeline

 - Work with the technical team to design the internal tooling behind the pipeline: ingestion from Zoom, Google Meet, Riverside, Loom, etc, scoring of high-value moments, generation of titles, hooks, captions and platform-specific variations, routing through editing and approval, and scheduling across platforms

 - Build the quality checks that run before publication, so moving fast never means shipping something that doesn’t align with the company's point of view or quality standards.

 - Keep a prioritized list of what to automate next, with the manual cost of each item quantified, and bring it to the technical team as specific proposals rather than general frustration



How Success Is Measured

 - By day 30, every meaningful conversation enters a structured production pipeline

 - By day 60, production is predictable, measurable, and repeatable: volume and turnaround time are known  numbers rather than estimates

 - By day 90, WON consistently publishes more than 500 high-quality pieces of content a month

 - By month 12, a large share of the work you did by hand in your first month runs through AI-assisted workflows you helped design

 - Over time the capability compounds rather than resets: faster, more autonomous, and cheaper to run each  quarter, and durable enough to outlast any one person operating it



What You’ll Bring

 - Experience running a content or media operation end to end, in-house or agency, where you owned the  pipeline and not a single stage of it

 - Systems thinking evidenced by what you have built: a process you designed, documented, and then  measurably improved

 - Real fluency with AI tools in daily work rather than curiosity about them. You can describe a workflow you  rebuilt around AI and what it saved

 - Editorial judgment you can defend: you can articulate why a moment, a hook, or a cut is good, not just that it  feels good

 - Comfort operating with high ambiguity and little supervision, creating structure where none exists

 - Fluent written and spoken English, with the precision to work closely with both creative and technical  colleagues



Bonus points: hands on with OpusClip, Descript, Vizard, Submagic, CapCut or Canva; have used ClickUp,  Slack and Google Workspace as an operating environment, not just a place to keep notes; publishing and  scheduling at volume through Buffer, Metricool or similar; have specified or shipped an internal automation alongside an engineering team.



How We Work

 - We use AI to remove operational friction, not to create more of it. A system that costs more than it saves gets  killed, not defended

 - Experience with every tool is not required. The ability to master a new one quickly is

 - We care far more about how you think than what your resume says. Finalists may be asked to complete a paid project using real WON recordings

 - Compensation is $4,000 to $5,500 USD per month plus performance incentives tied to production volume,  quality, automation milestones, and audience growth

 - This is a founding role. The production capability you build becomes one of the firm’s durable operating assets, and you will have built it

 - If six months from now you are still doing the manual work you did in your first week, we will both know it went wrong. The role is designed to automate itself forward



Most companies use AI to work a little faster. If you are excited by the idea of building the capability that  produces the work, rather than simply producing the work, we would love to meet you.

postings.title: AI Content Operations Lead
postings.descriptionText:
SOBRE WON

WON rediseña cómo funciona un negocio: lo que sus clientes experimentan por fuera y cómo opera por dentro. Trabajamos con empresas de retail y consumo, travel, hospitality, financial services y portafolios de private equity.

Combinamos Experience Intelligence y Operational Intelligence. Este rol forma parte de Operational Intelligence y aplica ese enfoque a nuestra propia operación.

No buscamos a alguien para simplemente publicar contenido en redes. Buscamos a la persona que diseñará, operará y mejorará continuamente el AI-powered media engine de WON: un sistema que convierte conversaciones con founders, workshops, keynotes, podcasts, entrevistas y sesiones de estrategia en contenido de alta calidad para las principales plataformas.




LO QUE HARÁS

 - Serás responsable del ciclo completo de producción: captura, intake, producción asistida por AI, revisión, publicación y organización de la biblioteca de contenido.

 - Definirás el criterio editorial: qué momentos vale la pena convertir en contenido, qué assets se publican y cuál es el estándar de calidad.

 - Coordinarás editores y recursos creativos, revisando cada asset antes de su publicación.

 - Medirás velocidad de producción, turnaround time, calidad y el impacto del contenido en audiencia y pipeline.

 - Trabajarás directamente con el equipo técnico para diseñar el tooling interno del pipeline: ingestión desde Zoom, Google Meet, Riverside, Loom y otras fuentes; identificación de momentos de alto valor; generación de titles, hooks, captions y variaciones por plataforma; edición, aprobación y scheduling.

 - Crearás quality checks previos a publicación para mantener velocidad sin comprometer el punto de vista ni los estándares de WON.

 - Mantendrás una lista priorizada de oportunidades de automatización, cuantificando el trabajo manual que cada una puede eliminar y convirtiéndolo en propuestas concretas para el equipo técnico.




LO QUE BUSCAMOS

 - Experiencia gestionando una operación de content o media end-to-end, in-house o en agencia, siendo responsable del pipeline completo y no únicamente de una etapa.

 - Capacidad demostrada de systems thinking: procesos que hayas diseñado, documentado y mejorado de forma medible.

 - Experiencia real utilizando AI en el trabajo diario y capacidad para explicar workflows que hayas rediseñado con AI y el impacto obtenido.

 - Criterio editorial sólido, con capacidad para explicar por qué un momento, hook o cut funciona.

 - Comodidad trabajando con alta autonomía y ambigüedad, creando estructura donde todavía no existe.

 - Inglés escrito y hablado fluido, necesario para trabajar estrechamente con colegas técnicos y creativos internacionales.



Plus: experiencia práctica con OpusClip, Descript, Vizard, Submagic, CapCut o Canva; ClickUp, Slack y Google Workspace; publishing y scheduling a escala mediante Buffer, Metricool o herramientas similares; o experiencia especificando o desarrollando automatizaciones internas junto con un equipo de ingeniería.




CÓMO MEDIREMOS EL ÉXITO

30 días: toda conversación relevante entra en un production pipeline estructurado.

60 días: la producción es predecible, medible y repetible, con volumen y turnaround time conocidos.

90 días: WON publica consistentemente más de 500 piezas de contenido de alta calidad al mes.

12 meses: una parte significativa del trabajo manual inicial funciona mediante AI-assisted workflows que hayas ayudado a diseñar.

La capacidad debe seguir mejorando con el tiempo: más rápida, autónoma y eficiente, sin depender de una sola persona para operar el sistema.




CÓMO TRABAJAMOS

En WON usamos AI para eliminar fricción operativa, no para crear más. Si un sistema cuesta más de lo que ahorra, lo eliminamos.

No necesitas experiencia con cada herramienta. Buscamos capacidad para aprender rápidamente, buen criterio y la capacidad de construir sistemas que mejoren con el tiempo.

El proceso final puede incluir un paid project utilizando grabaciones reales de WON.

Compensación: USD $4,000–$5,500 mensuales + performance incentives vinculados a volumen de producción, calidad, hitos de automatización y crecimiento de audiencia.



Working arrangement: El rol comienza de forma remota. WON está explorando la posibilidad de construir un hub en Medellín a medida que el equipo crezca.



Este es un founding role. La capacidad de producción que construyas se convertirá en uno de los activos operativos duraderos de WON.

Si te interesa construir la capacidad que produce el trabajo —no solamente producir el trabajo— queremos conocerte.

postings.title: Customer Support Representative (LatAm, Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
HI 👋 I’M AIDAN, FOUNDER OF MAPLE.

At Maple https://maple.inc, we’re building AI agents that work for restaurants. These agents answer calls, take orders, book appointments, and handle real customer interactions over natural voice.



But our bigger mission goes deeper: we’re building automated ontologies that model how businesses actually operate — their services, workflows, constraints, and language — so our agents can adapt to them instantly. We meet businesses where they are, not where software wants them to be.



We have many customers, strong revenue growth, years of runway, and backing from world-class investors. I’ll share more once we meet.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

When a business signs with Maple, two things must happen:

 1. They must get live quickly.

 2. They must feel like we have their back.

This role sits at the intersection of onboarding and support. You will:

 - Guide new customers through setup

 - Handle live support when issues arise

 - Think quickly when edge cases happen

 - Communicate calmly when a restaurant owner has questions

 - Escalate to engineering clearly and precisely and implement solutions

We need someone who:

 - Thinks on their feet

 - Enjoys talking to business owners

 - Can gather context fast

 - Is comfortable with ambiguity

 - Takes ownership instead of waiting




WHAT YOU’LL DO


ONBOARDING

 - Run onboarding calls with new customers

 - Translate business operations into structured AI configurations

 - Identify gaps or unclear workflows and clarify them live

 - Ensure customers go live quickly and confidently


SUPPORT

 - Handle inbound support calls, texts, and emails

 - Troubleshoot real-time voice agent issues

 - Think creatively when things don’t follow the script

 - Gather complete context before escalating to engineering

 - Own issues end-to-end


SYSTEMS + FEEDBACK

 - Document cases clearly in Salesforce

 - Communicate tightly in Slack

 - Identify recurring friction points

 - Suggest improvements to tooling, onboarding flow, or documentation




WHO YOU ARE


OWNERSHIP MENTALITY

You think like an operator. You take initiative, care about outcomes, and feel energized by solving real problems.




RESPONSIVENESS

You operate with urgency and reliability. When something needs attention, you step in quickly and keep it moving.




GROWTH-MINDED

You enjoy learning, improving, and quickly implementing feedback. 




JOB REQUIREMENTS

 - Fluency in English (C1/C2), with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages

 - 2–5+ years in customer support, onboarding, or high-touch SaaS roles

 - Experience handling escalations and complex customer issues with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment

 - Strong conversational ability (moderately extroverted, not robotic)

 - Quick thinker — you don’t default to “let me check on that”

 - Comfortable handling ambiguous or messy situations

 - Ability to stay calm, respectful, and solution-oriented in time-sensitive or high-pressure situations

 - Able to gather context when customers provide incomplete information

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively, manage multiple active cases simultaneously, and maintain accuracy under pressure


BONUS IF YOU:

 - Have worked with SMBs or local businesses

 - Have experience with Intercom, OpenPhone, Salesforce

 - Have supported technical products

 - Thrive in early-stage startup environments







HOW WE WORK

 - We optimize for leverage. That means great internal tooling, fast CI/CD, and code that scales across many customer types

 - We believe in deep ownership. Engineers here talk to users, design features, and ship fast

 - We value clarity over process. You’ll spend most of your day building, not waiting on decisions

 - We move in person. We’re a tight-knit team that moves fast and solves problems together




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary + meaningful equity

 - A real product with real usage and growing revenue

 - Strong In-person culture, fast feedback loops, and zero bureaucracy

 - A small team that feels like a founding team

 - Full health, dental, vision, 401k, life insurance, and unlimited PTO

 - Tools budget, coffee budget, whatever-you-need-to-be-great budget



Want to help reimagine how software works for real-world businesses? Let’s talk.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.



In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.



We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 

 


WHERE YOU'LL CREATE IMPACT

 - Build!

 - Design backend systems and APIs (Python preferred) that run real-time, business-critical accounting logic

 - Ship features end to end - architecture, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and beyond

 - Integrate third-party tools and external systems, proactively managing edge cases and risk

 


WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS

 - Hardcore work ethic and high agency

 - 5+ years in backend engineering (language agnostic)

 - Deep experience with complex business logic products

 - Strong database skills: PostgreSQL, SQL, ORMs, migrations, schema design

 - Experience deploying on AWS (or similar), with solid CI/CD and production-readiness fundamentals

 - Bonus: Python and a modern web framework (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)

 


WHY YOU’LL THRIVE HERE

 - Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

 - You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

 - Your feedback shapes the product directly

 - High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations
   
    


MEET THE ENGINEERING TEAM

 - Ignacio https://www.linkedin.com/in/ignaciobrasca/ shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself. Pure initiative, compounding.

 - Marcin https://www.linkedin.com/in/mkuzdowicz/ took a non-existent tax structure and built it end to end, setting the north star for how the team keeps improving it on top of it; modular and robust, always setting the bar for the rest.

 - Puhiza https://www.linkedin.com/in/puhiza-doci/ grew her team from one to full capacity, while owning our integration framework end to end; scaling it to support migrations, integrations, and bank connections. The queen of I/O on our platform.

 - Danylo https://www.linkedin.com/in/godspell33/ took ownership of our bank connection engine end to end and rebuilt it from scratch over a weekend.
   
    


HOW YOU OPERATE

 - Pragmatic: you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability - we use Postgres until it breaks

 - Hard working: 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three' - Jeff Bezos.

 - Curious: you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems

 - Fast-moving: you deploy daily, iterate quickly, and never wait for permission
   
    


BENEFITS & COMPENSATION

 - Equity: $50,000 - $80,000

 - Base salary: $140,000 - $250,000

 - Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

 - Home internet, co-working space & office setup support

 - Flexible PTO (27 days incl. public holidays)

 - Unlimited AI token usage

 - AI skills development & enablement

 - Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years’ tenure)

 - In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus, and more!)

 

“Join us to fix the boring, think the hard, and build the impossible, so we become the most robust engineering platform for accounting the world has ever seen.”

Ignacio Brasca,  https://www.linkedin.com/in/ignaciobrasca/Head of Engineering at DualEntry

postings.title: Applied Engineer (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT DUALENTRY

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

 

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

 

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

 

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 

 


WHERE YOU'LL CREATE IMPACT

 -  Build!

 -  Embed on named customer projects and own them end to end: discovery, design, build, deploy and verify

 - Build migration and integration pipelines on Temporal that are idempotent, resumable, and auditable

 - Model and load customer accounting data into Postgres correctly, including reconciling against their existing system

 - Build internal tooling so recurring one-offs stop being one-offs

 - Feed patterns back into the core product, and productize or hand off anything that becomes permanent

 - Compress the path from “customer requested” to “shipped"

 


WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS

 - Hardcore work ethic and high agency

 -  5+ years shipping production full stack software, end to end and unsupervised

 - Django and DRF, plus Postgres beyond ORM defaults. You read query plans and you have run migrations against live data with customers on it

 - Next.js and React with TypeScript

 - Durable workflow experience. Celery preferred

 - Direct customer exposure on past experiences. You have sat with a customer, scoped the problem with them, and shipped against it

 - Experience with third party APIs, webhooks, rate limits, reconciling two systems that disagree
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Accounting, ERP, or fintech domain knowledge: double-entry, chart of accounts, close, AP/AR, revenue recognition

 - Prior forward deployed, applied, or special projects experience

 - Judgment about when to ship a script versus build a system

 


WHY YOU’LL THRIVE HERE

 - Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

 - You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

 - Your feedback shapes the product directly

 - High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

 


MEET THE TEAM

 - Ignacio https://www.linkedin.com/in/ignaciobrasca/ shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself

 - Marcin https://www.linkedin.com/in/mkuzdowicz/ took a non-existent tax structure and built it end to end, setting the north star for how the team keeps improving it on top of it; modular and robust, always setting the bar for the rest

 - Puhiza https://www.linkedin.com/in/puhiza-doci/ grew her team from one to full capacity, while owning our integration framework. The queen of I/O on our platform

 - Danylo https://www.linkedin.com/in/godspell33/ took ownership of our bank connection engine end to end and rebuilt it from scratch over a weekend

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Equity: $50,000 - $80,000

 - Base salary: $150,000 - $280,000

 - Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

 - Home internet, co-working space & office setup support

 - Flexible PTO (27 days incl. public holidays)

 - Unlimited AI token usage

 - AI skills development & enablement

 - Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years’ tenure)

 - In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus, and more!)
   
    

“Join us to fix the boring, think the hard, and build the impossible, so we become the most robust engineering platform for accounting the world has ever seen.”

Ignacio Brasca https://www.linkedin.com/in/ignaciobrasca/, Head of Engineering at DualEntry

postings.title: Instructional Designer – Learning & Development - Remote Latam
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote – Latin America
Employment Type: Full-Time



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Instructional Designer to help shape and build engaging, practical, and scalable learning experiences within our learning management system (LMS), Docebo.

This role is an opportunity to help define not only how courses are built, but also what great learning should look like across the organization. You will work closely with subject matter experts and internal stakeholders to transform knowledge, processes, and business needs into clear, engaging, and effective learning experiences.

The ideal candidate combines strong instructional design fundamentals with a modern approach to digital learning, including interactive content, assessments, multimedia, learner engagement, and emerging AI-powered learning tools.




WHAT YOU’LL DO




LEARNING & INSTRUCTIONAL DESIGN

 - Design and develop engaging online courses and learning experiences using instructional design best practices.

 - Translate complex information, processes, and subject matter expertise into clear, learner-friendly content.

 - Apply instructional design methodologies such as ADDIE, backward design, adult learning principles, and/or other relevant frameworks.

 - Define learning objectives, course structures, lesson plans, assessments, activities, and learning paths.

 - Design learning experiences that are practical, relevant, and connected to real-world job responsibilities.

 - Develop different types of learning experiences, including microlearning, self-paced courses, knowledge checks, scenario-based learning, and interactive activities.

 - Ensure content is clear, accessible, engaging, and appropriate for the target audience.




DOCEBO & COURSE DEVELOPMENT

 - Build, configure, and maintain courses within the Docebo LMS.

 - Organize course structures, learning paths, training materials, assessments, and learner activities.

 - Explore and leverage Docebo’s content creation and AI-powered capabilities to improve the speed and quality of course development.

 - Use multimedia, interactive elements, assessments, and other available tools to create engaging learning experiences.

 - Evaluate existing courses and recommend improvements to content, structure, learner experience, and engagement.

 - Maintain consistency in course design, instructional standards, terminology, and branding across the learning library.

Docebo currently supports AI-assisted course creation, interactive lessons, assessments, translation, voiceover, and learner data that can be used to continuously improve courses. (Docebo Help https://help.docebo.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020080300-Creating-and-managing-e-learning-courses?utm_source=chatgpt.com)




LEARNING STRATEGY & VISION

 - Help establish and evolve a vision for digital learning across the organization.

 - Research emerging trends, tools, and best practices in instructional design, e-learning, AI-powered learning, and employee development.

 - Identify opportunities to make learning more personalized, practical, and embedded into the learner’s workflow.

 - Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals and translate them into measurable learning outcomes.

 - Recommend new approaches, technologies, and learning formats that can improve learner engagement and knowledge retention.

 - Help develop a scalable learning framework that can grow with the organization.


COLLABORATION & CONTENT DEVELOPMENT

 - Partner with subject matter experts to gather, organize, validate, and transform knowledge into learning content.

 - Facilitate content discovery sessions and interviews with SMEs.

 - Guide SMEs on how to communicate complex topics effectively to learners.

 - Manage multiple course-development projects and prioritize work based on business needs.

 - Coordinate reviews, revisions, approvals, and course launches.

 - Incorporate learner and stakeholder feedback into ongoing course improvements.




MEASUREMENT & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Monitor course engagement, completion, assessment results, and other relevant learning metrics.

 - Use learner data and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.

 - Evaluate whether learning experiences are achieving their intended outcomes.

 - Continuously iterate on courses based on learner behavior, business needs, and performance data.

 - Help connect learning outcomes to broader business and workforce objectives.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of experience in Instructional Design, Learning & Development, eLearning, Curriculum Development, or a related field.

 - Experience designing and developing online or digital learning experiences.

 - Hands-on experience with an LMS; Docebo experience is highly preferred.

 - Strong understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.

 - Experience developing learning objectives, assessments, activities, and structured learning paths.

 - Strong writing, editing, and content-organization skills.

 - Ability to take complex information and turn it into simple, engaging, and actionable learning content.

 - Experience working with subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

 - Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently in a remote environment.

 - Curiosity about emerging technologies, AI, and their impact on learning and workforce development.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Docebo Creator or other AI-powered authoring tools.

 - Experience with tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar e-learning authoring platforms.

 - Experience creating video-based learning, microlearning, simulations, or scenario-based training.

 - Experience with SCORM or other e-learning standards.

 - Experience using learning analytics to improve course effectiveness.

 - Experience designing AI literacy, technology, or professional skill

Job Title: MSP Technical Support Specialist

Location: Remote

Time Zone: US Time Zones (PST - EST)

 

Role Overview

We are looking for an enthusiastic and eager-to-learn Entry-Level IT Support Specialist to join our fast-paced Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. In this role, you will serve as the first point of contact for inbound technical support requests, working alongside experienced engineers to deliver timely, accurate resolutions. If you are passionate about technology, eager to build your IT career, and ready to learn in a ticket-driven, SLA-focused setting, we want to hear from you.

 

What You'll Do

Receive, triage, and respond to inbound support tickets via phone, email, and ticketing platform within defined SLA windows.

Assist in diagnosing and troubleshooting basic hardware, software, networking, and connectivity issues for end users.

Support remote desktop sessions, basic account management tasks (Active Directory / Azure AD), and simple network troubleshooting under guidance.

Document all interactions, steps taken, and resolutions thoroughly in the PSA/ticketing system (e.g., ConnectWise, Autotask, HaloPSA).

Escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior engineers with clear, detailed handoff notes.

Assist with user onboarding and offboarding tasks, including device setup and access provisioning. Contribute to the internal knowledge base by documenting common fixes and workarounds. Maintain professionalism and clear communication throughout the support lifecycle.

 

Required Qualifications

Experience in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment is mandatory.

A genuine passion for IT and a strong desire to grow within an MSP environment.

Basic working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, and common business applications. Foundational understanding of networking concepts: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset.

Ability to follow processes, take direction, and escalate appropriately.

 

Nice to Have

CompTIA A+ certification or currently working toward it. Any exposure to PSA tools (ConnectWise, Autotask, or equivalent) or RMM platforms. Basic familiarity with Azure Active Directory or Microsoft Intune. Any hands-on experience in a helpdesk, IT internship, or lab environment.

postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

You build production agent systems that run themselves. Not prompts, loops. Not a single assistant, a coordinated swarm.

The role:
We build and ship agent platforms that do real work in production. This role is for an engineer who designs self-running agent loops and multi-agent swarms, not someone who tweaks prompts one turn at a time. You will own systems that find work, do it, verify it, and report back, with humans at the gates rather than in every iteration.
This is a hands-on, ship-first engineering role. You write production code other engineers trust, and you treat agents as software systems that need triggers, budgets, stop conditions, verification, and observability like any other.

What we mean by loop engineering: designing an agent system as a control loop with an explicit trigger, scope, action, budget, stop condition, and report, plus a verifier that can reject bad work, so it runs unattended and knows when to stop or hand back to a human. Not a bigger prompt. A system that prompts the agents for you.
What we mean by swarm agents: a coordinated fleet of specialized agents (planner, builder, reviewer, verifier, scout, coordinator) with file and task ownership, shared state, quality gates, and clean handoffs, run by an orchestrator rather than one do-everything assistant.



What you'll do

 - Design self-running loops. Define the trigger, scope, action, budget, stop condition, and reporting so an agent runs unattended, stays inside cost and iteration limits, and knows when it is done versus when to escalate.

 - Build multi-agent swarms. Orchestrator plus specialized agents with clear file and task ownership, shared state or a shared mailbox, quality gates between stages, and handoffs that do not step on each other.

 - Make verification first-class. Build the part of the system that can say no: the checks, evals, and reviewer agents that catch confident mistakes before they merge. A loop is only as trustworthy as its ability to check its own work.

 - Own agent state and memory. Persistent on-disk state and per-turn context assembly so long-running tasks survive restarts and the system does not forget what the repo already knows.

 - Ship the platform around the agents. APIs, services, queues, and integrations in TypeScript and Node, deployed to AWS, with real tests, tracing, and observability for long multi-iteration runs.

 - Keep humans in the loop where it counts. Plan approval and pull request review, and active management of comprehension debt so the team understands what the swarm ships, not just that it shipped.
   
   

What we're looking for

 - Strong engineering fundamentals. 5+ years writing production software that other engineers depend on. (Adjustable; we care more about what you have shipped than the number.)

 - Hands-on loop engineering. You have designed agent loops with explicit stop conditions, budgets, retries, and self-verification. You can explain the difference between a task on repeat and a real loop, and you know why the verifier matters as much as the maker.

 - Multi-agent or swarm experience. You have built or operated systems where multiple agents coordinate: orchestration, handoffs, shared state, ownership or locking, and quality gates.

 - Fluency with modern agent tooling. Claude Code or Codex style agents, sub-agents, persistent memory and skills files, tool and function calling, MCP, and reason-act-observe loop patterns.

 - Solid TypeScript and Node. Comfort with a service framework (NestJS or similar) and a typed data layer (Prisma or similar).

 - Cloud and delivery. AWS (ECS or Fargate or similar), Docker, and CI/CD. You can take something from repo to production yourself.

 - A verification mindset. You treat "done" as a claim to be proven, and you build the checks that prove it.
   
   

Nice to have

 - Running 10+ parallel agents and managing token and cost budgets at scale

 - Distributed systems, queues, and event-driven design

 - React for agent-facing interfaces

 - Prior work on developer tooling, orchestration frameworks, or internal agent platforms

 - Familiarity with where loop engineering is heading next, including continual learning systems

 - SOC 2 or ISO 27001 awareness for handling client data
   
   

How we work

 - Plan, approve, execute. Agents propose, a human approves the plan, agents build, a senior reviews every pull request before merge.

 - Small loops over big prompts. We design systems that discover work, do it, check it, and report, while we watch instead of type.

 - Ship. Bias to production. Working software in front of users beats a perfect design doc.

 - Direct and concise. Strong opinions, loosely held. Say the hard thing early.



What success looks like in 90 days

 - You have shipped at least one self-running loop into production with a verifier the team trusts.

 - You have extended or hardened a multi-agent workflow with clear ownership and quality gates.

 - You have improved observability or cost control on an existing agent system so we can debug and trust long runs.



Tech environment
TypeScript, NestJS, React, Turborepo monorepo, Prisma, AWS ECS Fargate, Docker, GitHub Actions. Agent layer built on Claude and Claude Code patterns, MCP, sub-agents, and persistent memory.

Paid acquisition drives most of Scale Army's growth. We invest over $80K/month and plan to increase that investment if the results earn it. You'll own how that growth happens: the strategy behind the spend, the offers and funnels it sends traffic to, and how each dollar turns into qualified pipeline.

Running campaigns yourself is part of the job, and you need to be excellent at it. But it's only one part. You'll also decide where budget goes, craft and build lead magnets, offers, and the landing pages paid traffic converts on, work with Sales on lead quality, and be the team's go-to person for what's driving growth and where to invest next.

You'll be measured on business outcomes, not platform metrics: meetings held, SQLs, pipeline quality, and what each one costs.

Growth strategy and numbers. You'll own the full funnel that paid feeds, from spend to conversion, MQLs, meetings held, SQLs, and pipeline. You'll know our marketing CAC by channel and product line, where the funnel leaks, and what more spend will realistically return. Before we commit to $150K/month, you'll forecast what it will deliver. Once you deliver on it, you'll get more budget to spend.



Offers and conversion funnels. You'll decide what paid traffic is sent to: which offers and lead magnets we run, how they're positioned, and which landing pages and funnel paths we test. You'll set the testing roadmap and the hypotheses behind it, you’ll work with our  CRO to build and execute the tests, and you'll be accountable for whether they turn into qualified pipeline.



Budget allocation. Spend increases are gated by efficiency. You'll decide when a channel, campaign, or offer has earned more budget and when it needs to be pulled back, and you'll explain those calls with data.



Paid media execution. You'll build, launch, and optimize campaigns yourself across 2–3 product lines. Meta is our main channel, and you need to be an expert operator there. You'll also turn Google, LinkedIn, X, CTV, and other channels into real contributors.



Creative direction. We have an in-house team of creative strategists, designers, video editors, and copywriters. You own what runs and why: the hypotheses, the testing roadmap, and the feedback loop that shows the team what converts.



Revenue alignment. You'll work closely with Sales, Sales Ops, and Marketing Ops on offline conversions, HubSpot attribution, and lead quality. You'll push back on targeting and ICP assumptions when the data says we're wrong.



An AI-native way of working. At Scale Army, AI is central to how we work, not a side tool. You'll use it to do the work of a much larger team:

HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

 - Marketing CAC

 - Cost per MQL and cost per SQL

 - MQL meetings held and cost per meeting held

 - Conversion rates across offers, landing pages, and funnel steps

 - Pipeline quality

We don't measure you on CTR, CPM, or cheap lead volume.

This role is built to grow. Paid acquisition is central to how Scale Army scales, and as performance becomes predictable, there's real opportunity to take on more ownership of our growth strategy, including building a team.




WHAT YOU BRING

Must-haves

 - Advanced AI fluency that goes well beyond prompting. You've built things with tools like Claude Code, created reusable skills or agents, and set up your own dashboards and automations. Be ready to show us examples.

 - An ownership mindset. You don't wait to be told what to test next, and you don't stop at the edge of the ad platform.
