postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a fast-growing AI-driven technology company specializing in government procurement intelligence. The company operates a platform that collects and organizes government Request for Proposal (RFP) data, helping customers identify opportunities and compete for government contracts.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Data QA & Admin Associate will support the quality and accuracy of a government RFP data pipeline by validating information from government websites, researching public documents, managing public records requests, and identifying issues that may affect data completeness. This role involves ongoing website monitoring, document retrieval, data validation, and collaboration with the engineering team to resolve issues.

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable following structured workflows while independently researching government websites and records. This individual should be proactive in identifying inconsistencies, documenting issues, and maintaining accurate information across the platform.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


WEBSITE & DATA QUALITY ASSURANCE

 - Manually review government issuer websites, including cities, counties, and public authorities, to identify new RFP opportunities and ensure none are missed.

 - Monitor website changes, updated URLs, and new data sources that may require adjustments to the scraping pipeline.

 - Create clear, detailed tickets for the engineering team regarding website changes, missing opportunities, and data discrepancies.

 - Validate that newly published RFP opportunities are accurately reflected in the internal system.

 - Identify recurring issues and patterns that may indicate gaps in data coverage.
   
   


LOCAL GOVERNMENT DOCUMENT RESEARCH

 - Research and retrieve government documents, including budgets, Capital Improvement Plans (CIPs), council and board meeting minutes, agendas, and planning reports.

 - Navigate city, county, school district, and government agency websites to locate relevant documents.

 - Use website search functions, Google, agenda portals, document archives, and related public records to identify the most current versions of documents.

 - Submit public records requests when required documents are not publicly available online.

 - Follow up with government agency staff regarding outstanding requests, documenting responses, extensions, and denials.

 - Upload retrieved documents into the internal system and maintain accurate records of research activities and request statuses.
   
   


DOCUMENTATION & PROCESS ADHERENCE

 - Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), checklists, and best practices for website navigation and data management.

 - Track and report daily tasks to maintain transparency and accountability.

 - Communicate blockers, website issues, and unusual cases to the team through Slack.

 - Identify opportunities to improve research workflows, data retrieval processes, and operational efficiency.
   
   


RFP DOCUMENT RETRIEVAL SUPPORT

 - Assist with retrieving RFP documents from government procurement websites when additional support is needed.

 - Identify and download the correct primary RFP documents from procurement portals.

 - Support website logins, account setup, and CAPTCHA-protected portals when access issues affect the team or scraping pipeline.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 1+ years of experience in quality assurance, administrative support, or related roles involving repetitive tasks and data management.

 - Experience following structured, multi-step procedures while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

 - Experience working with data validation, document research, or administrative workflows involving detailed recordkeeping.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing, incorrect, or inconsistent information.

 - Ability to navigate government websites, including portals requiring account logins, CAPTCHAs, and file downloads.

 - Ability to research and locate government documents across websites, archives, and public records.

 - Ability to follow SOPs, checklists, and structured workflows accurately and consistently.

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage tasks independently while meeting deadlines.

 - Ability to document issues clearly and coordinate with engineering teams and government agency staff.

 - Ability to use Slack to communicate blockers, website issues, and workflow updates.

 - Methodical approach to data quality, document classification, and information accuracy.

 - Proactive attitude toward identifying problems and recommending process improvements.

 - Dependable approach to recurring responsibilities and daily output requirements.

 - Willingness to learn new processes, take on challenges, and support team priorities.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Public records requests are submitted and followed up on promptly, with accurate and current statuses maintained for every open request.

 - Document classification and retrieval errors remain low, with accuracy improving over time.

 - Website changes, updated URLs, and new data sources are proactively identified to improve data coverage.

 - Blockers, unusual cases, and technical issues are clearly communicated to the engineering team.

 - Daily output targets are consistently met, with assigned work completed by agreed deadlines.

postings.title: Accountant - AR & Collections
postings.descriptionText:
Remote role - for candidates based in Argentina. 
About the role

Our client is a fast-growing American disaster recovery business headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. When fires, floods, and storms hit, they respond, and they've done that work coast to coast: from Seattle to Miami, from Massachusetts to Hawaii. They operate four SERVPRO franchises as their home base and a large-loss practice that travels wherever disaster strikes.

The majority of their finance and accounting team is in Bosnia, so Argentine time works great to work with both their Eastern Europe and Nashville based teams. You'd join established teammates, report to the FP&A Analyst, and work in close daily coordination with their other Accounting Analyst, all backed by the Nashville-based Controller and CFO.

Why This Role Is Worth Your Ambition
• You're in-house, not in a BPO. You work for one company, on one business, with one team, and you see the results of your work every month. No client rotations, no billable-hours factory.
• A first-class education in American business. Insurance claims, cash flow, collections strategy, month-end close, real exposure to how a US operating company runs, with mentorship from senior finance leadership in Nashville.
• AI as a core skill, not a buzzword. We use artificial intelligence across our finance workflows. You'll learn to use it two ways: to make yourself dramatically more efficient, and to help build new tools that don't exist yet.
• Cross-training by design. Every accounting analyst there is trained across both AR and AP. This role leans heavily toward AR and collections, but you'll learn the full cycle, because cross-training is how we scale, how we cover each other during vacations, and how you grow into training others. It means your learning curve never flattens.
• A real path upward. We're growing, and we promote from within the team we've built. The person who masters this seat is the person we develop toward finance leadership.

The Work, Honestly
We want to be straight about the day-to-day: a lot of blocking and tackling. High-volume invoice processing, data entry, cash application, chasing documentation, reconciling accounts, and collection calls, done accurately, every day, without drama. This seat keeps cash coming in the door.

We believe that's exactly how finance leaders are built: nobody should manage a close who hasn't run one invoice at a time. If you take pride in unglamorous work done exceptionally well, this is your way in.

Much of our receivables work involves insurance claims, deductibles, and customers navigating the worst week of their year. We collect firmly and through process, and we treat every customer with patience and respect, especially the difficult ones.

What You'll Do
Accounts Receivable & Collections (your primary focus)
• Own the AR aging: monitor balances, prioritize follow-up, and drive aged receivables toward resolution
• Handle collections calls and correspondence with American customers and insurance carriers, professionally and calmly, including escalated accounts
• Work with adjusters and carriers to resolve claim-related payment issues (deductibles, coverage denials, short pays)
• Prepare accounts for formal escalation, including documentation supporting lien filings and third-party referral
• Document all collection activity and keep every follow-up commitment

Invoice Processing & Billing (daily volume)
• Generate, review, and send customer invoices, accurately coded by job, location, and class
• Post customer and insurance payments and handle cash application, including researching unapplied or short payments
• Send customer statements, payment reminders, and follow-up correspondence
• Maintain clean records: job notes in our management system, documentation files, W-9 and certificate-of-insurance tracking

Payroll & Month-End Close
• Process payroll entry accurately and on schedule, coordinating with our payroll provider
• Prepare basic accrual entries and assigned journal entries
• Complete bank and credit card reconciliations and recurring vendor reconciliations on the close calendar
• Maintain fixed asset roll forwards, royalty schedules, and supporting workpapers
• Support the FP&A Analyst, Controller, and CFO on analysis and special projects, increasingly with AI tooling you'll help build

Accounts Payable (cross-trained with our other accounting analyst for coverage)
• Enter, code, and schedule vendor invoices per payment terms, matched to supporting documentation
• Reconcile vendor statements and chase missing invoices so nothing becomes a surprise
• Match credit card transactions to receipts and code expenses; chase down missing receipts
• Maintain vendor master data and support 1099 preparation

What We're Looking For
Required
• 2+ years of accounting, bookkeeping, or AR/AP experience, including invoice processing and reconciliations
• Direct collections experience; this is the heart of the job
• Excellent spoken and written English; you'll be on the phone with American customers and insurance adjusters daily
• Willingness to work a delayed morning / afternoon-shifted schedule with substantial overlap of US Central Time business hours (our team already works this way)
• High accuracy at high volume: you catch your own errors and don't let details slip
• Professionalism under pressure: you can hold a firm line on a past-due balance without ever raising your voice
• Strong follow-through: you close loops, keep commitments, and escalate with facts, not noise
• Proficiency in Excel; curiosity about AI tools and comfort learning new systems fast

Preferred
• Experience collecting from or billing US customers or insurance carriers
• Hands-on experience using AI tools in real workflows
• Experience with ADP, Ramp, QuickBooks Online, or similar
• Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field

postings.title: Product Support Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Why are we hiring this role?
Our customers use the product against bid deadlines, so the work it generates is urgent and interrupting
by nature. A customer hits a bug mid-bid. A table sorts on the wrong column. An upload fails for one
account. A compliance task comes due.
Right now that lands on the engineers building our takeoff pipeline, and it fragments them — the most
expensive possible way to answer a support ticket. We are hiring someone to own it properly, because it
deserves an owner rather than whoever is interrupted.
This is not a queue-closing role, and we will not pretend otherwise. Resolving issues properly and
converting the recurring ones into product changes produces unusually broad knowledge of the system.
That knowledge is the basis for moving into other work here, and we expect that to happen.
What you’ll own
- Support issues, end to end. Reproduce, diagnose, fix, and confirm the fix with the customer
who reported it. You close your own loops.
- Turning vague reports into reproducible cases. “The forecast is broken for this account” has to
become a specific, reproducible scenario before anyone can fix it. Doing that well is most of the
job, and it is the part that separates people who are good at this from people who are not.
- The details that make a product feel finished. Sorting, filters, tooltips, empty states, and error
messages that say something useful.
- Stopping the repeats. Operational and compliance work kept current — dependency upgrades,
security remediation — plus the upstream change that ends a class of issue instead of fixing it a
fifth time.
What we expect day to day
- You talk to customers directly. Not through a middle layer. You will write to the estimator who
filed the bug and tell them it is fixed. Strong English, written and spoken, is non-negotiable for
that.
- You live in Linear with the engineers. Issues, findings, and decisions live in Linear, attached to
the work. Daily standup; you show work-in-progress constantly, not big reveals.
- You go outside the codebase to find answers. In the data, in Sentry, in PostHog, and in the
interface the customer is actually looking at. A large share of support work is one SQL query
away from the answer.
- You work in the open and take feedback straight. We are direct. You ship progress to the team
channel, present at reviews, and get honest feedback — including from the founder. We argue
about the work, decide fast, and move.
- You use AI aggressively. Everyone here uses AI daily for research, writing, analysis, and building.
Same bar for this role.
What We’re Looking For
We only hire superstars — expect to be asked why you’re one.
Required
- 2–4 years building production web applications
- Solid TypeScript and React
- Comfortable with SQL — you reach for a query before you reach for a guess
- Strong debugging: reading a stack trace, bisecting a regression, and reproducing an issue from a
screenshot and an incomplete description
- Strong written and verbal English; clear async communication
- Willingness to investigate outside the codebase, and to fix the cause rather than the symptom
Nice to have
- Prior support or on-call experience — ideally with a specific change you made that eliminated a
whole class of issue
- Our stack is TypeScript throughout — Next.js, React, Hono, Drizzle over PostgreSQL on Neon,
Vercel, with AWS and Terraform underneath. Familiarity helps; no construction background?
Fine — the industry is learnable and the founder is your shortcut.

Location: Latin America only
About the Role
Ryz Labs is partnering with a client looking for a Software Engineer to help improve the reliability, usability, and overall quality of a production web application.
In this role, you'll work across the application to investigate unexpected behavior, identify technical issues, and implement code-level improvements that make the product more reliable for its users.
We're looking for an engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, digging into complex problems, and turning unclear issues into practical, lasting solutions. You'll collaborate with the engineering team to troubleshoot production behavior, improve existing functionality, and prevent recurring issues through thoughtful engineering.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys both building software and making existing applications work better.

• Improve application usability by refining forms, filters, sorting, error handling, and other user-facing functionality.
• Identify recurring technical problems and develop solutions that prevent them from happening again.
• Contribute to code quality, application stability, dependency updates, and security improvements.
• Collaborate with product and engineering teammates to prioritize issues and deliver reliable solutions.
• Communicate technical findings clearly and document investigations and solutions for distributed teams.
What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications
• 2–4 years of experience developing and maintaining production web applications.
• Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React.
• Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
• Experience debugging application issues and troubleshooting unexpected behavior in production or development environments.
• Ability to investigate problems using logs, error reports, user feedback, and incomplete technical information.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to understand existing codebases and make targeted improvements without introducing regressions.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
• Comfortable collaborating asynchronously with a distributed engineering team.
Nice to Have
• Experience with Next.js or other modern web frameworks.
• Familiarity with PostgreSQL and ORMs such as Drizzle.
• Experience with error monitoring and product analytics tools such as Sentry and PostHog.
• Exposure to cloud platforms and deployment environments such as Vercel or AWS.
• Experience with production incident investigation, on-call rotations, or application maintenance.
• Familiarity with Hono, Neon, Terraform, or similar technologies.
• Experience improving application reliability, usability, or performance through code changes.
Who Would Thrive in This Role?
• Engineers who enjoy debugging as much as building new features.
• Developers who look beyond the immediate error to understand the root cause.
• People who are comfortable navigating an existing codebase and figuring out unfamiliar systems.
• Engineers who take ownership of problems and follow them through to resolution.
• Professionals who value clear communication, practical solutions, and continuous product improvement.
Industry experience is not required.

postings.title: Sr Data Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
This is a role for 6 month period - Fixed term  
Ryz Labs is looking for a Sr Data Analyst to join one of our client's team , an e-commerce platform.
As their Senior Data Analyst, you'll own the numbers the business actually decides on. Pricing, customer cohorts, payment systems, logistics, marketing channel performance — the analysis behind those calls comes from this seat. You'll work across the full width of a real operating e-commerce business: how visits become orders, how orders become delivered shipments, which customers come back, and what each of those is worth. Your job is not to produce dashboards. It is to produce decisions, and to be the person in the room who knows whether a number is trustworthy.
You'll report into Data & Analytics and work daily with Marketing, Operations, Finance, Customer Experience, and Engineering. 
Numeric Defensibility — The Condition of the Seat
In a bootstrapped company, decisions get made on the numbers in front of us, quickly, and often without a second analyst to check the work. That makes accuracy the condition of this seat rather than a quality of it.
Key Responsibilities
Analysis That Drives Decisions
• Own in-depth analysis across the business: customer base and cohort behavior, pricing, payment systems, logistics and fulfillment performance, and marketing channel efficiency.
• Find the trends, patterns, and anomalies that matter, and separate them from noise — then say what you'd do about it.
• Partner with business-unit leaders, Finance, Operations, and executives to understand the decision behind the request, not just the data pull.
• Bring the recommendation, not only the output. An analysis that ends at "here's the chart" isn't finished.
Data Models, Metrics & Definitions
• Build and maintain the data models that support recurring reporting and business requirements.
• Own the definition of the metrics you produce, and defend those definitions when different teams want the number to mean different things.
• Own the accuracy of at least one recurring business report end to end — its definition, its source, and whether anyone can trust it.
• Establish and hold data governance practices: naming, documentation, source of truth, and what happens when two dashboards disagree.
Visualization & Communication
• Build interactive dashboards and reports that a non-technical leader can read without you in the room.
• Present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives, and hold up under questioning.
• Write clearly. A short, direct summary of what changed and what it means beats a twelve-tab workbook.
• Deliver inconvenient findings early. A number that undercuts a plan is the most valuable thing this seat produces.
Statistical & Predictive Work
• Apply statistical techniques to test whether what we're seeing is real.
• Build and implement predictive models that support forecasting and planning decisions.
• Use advanced data mining techniques to surface insight nobody thought to ask for.
• Know the limits of your own models, and say them out loud when the output gets used.
Working AI-First
• Work automation-first: use AI tools to draft queries, explore datasets, generate documentation, and accelerate analysis — then apply your own judgment before anything ships.
• Treat any analysis you run more than twice as a candidate for automation.
• Own the quality gate on machine-generated SQL and analysis. Verify the logic and the numbers against source before results leave your hands.
• Leave your reporting surface more automated at the end of each quarter than it was at the start.
Requirements
Basic Qualifications
• Numeric defensibility. Given a dataset and a business question, you can produce the figure, say where it came from, say how it's defined, and say what would make it wrong. We will test this directly with real data.
• An analysis that changed a decision. A specific piece of work where the business did something different because of what you found. What you looked at, what you found, what changed, and what it was worth.
• A caught-error story. A time you or a tool produced a confidently wrong number, how you caught it, and the checking habit you built as a result.
• An automation portfolio. Two or three recurring analyses or reports you personally automated, with what changed in hours saved or errors avoided. Rough honest numbers beat polished vague ones.
• Writing we can read. A short executive summary of an analysis, and one example where you delivered a finding that someone senior did not want to hear.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field — Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or similar.
• 5+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years as a Data Analyst, preferably in e-commerce or a comparable high-volume, transactional business.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for querying, analysis, statistical work, and visualization.
• Experience working with large-scale datasets and conducting real statistical analysis, not just aggregation.
• Working knowledge of data governance: source of truth, documentation, metric definition, and how to keep two reports from disagreeing.
• Strong prioritization and project management — you can carry several requests without dropping the one that matters most.
• Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, lean environment where nobody is coming to scope the work for you.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with a cloud data warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery) and dbt or an equivalent transformation layer.
• E-commerce and marketing analytics depth: channel attribution, ROAS, cohort and retention analysis, LTV, promotional lift.
• Exposure to apparel, distribution, 3PL, or another high-volume, product-based operation.
• Financial statement literacy — you can read a P&L and ask a useful question about it.
• Hands-on with AI and automation tooling (Claude, agentic SQL workflows, Apps Script, or similar) b

Technical Solutions Engineer
 
Our client helps organizations solve complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action and delivering lasting value. The company actively promotes an inclusive working environment and recognizes the value that diversity brings to its people, clients, and communities. It is committed to continually improving its initiatives, policies, and practices to foster authenticity, professional growth, and equity.
 
What You’ll Do
 
The Technical Solutions Engineer is a technical role that bridges client support, custom development, and platform implementation. You will serve as a technical subject-matter expert for enterprise platforms, delivering hands-on support and tailored solutions that drive client success.
This position combines direct client support during launches and implementations with custom development responsibilities, including API integrations, AI tooling, and web-based solutions.
You will manage the complete lifecycle of technical issues and custom requests—from initial diagnosis and root-cause analysis to temporary workarounds and permanent fixes—while collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams.

Key Responsibilities
 
Platform Implementation and Client Support
 
• Serve as a technical subject-matter expert for enterprise platforms, providing implementation guidance and troubleshooting support during client launches and deployments.
• Work alongside clients during training and go-live activities, executing implementation tasks and resolving adoption blockers in real time.
• Develop and deliver technical training, best-practice documentation, and configuration guides tailored to client use cases.
• Track and communicate adoption metrics, including instances launched, users onboarded, and time to value.
 
Custom Development and Configuration
 
• Implement custom configurations, scripts, and lightweight development solutions to meet client-specific requirements, including dashboards, API integrations, data transformations, AI-agent configurations, and web-based applications.
• Write and maintain full-stack code for client customizations and internal automation tools.
• Architect and build web-based solutions tailored to client needs.
• Coordinate with development teams on client-specific integrations, API customizations, and feature requests.
• Develop workarounds for platform limitations and advocate for product enhancements based on recurring client needs.
 
Technical Support and Issue Resolution – L2/L3
 
• Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues across enterprise platforms and client environments.
• Perform detailed root-cause analysis through SQL queries, log reviews, and systematic troubleshooting.
• Implement short-term workarounds and contribute to long-term fixes.
• Manage incidents from end to end, including reproducing issues, assessing impact and priority, coordinating cross-functional resolution, validating fixes, and communicating outcomes to stakeholders.
• Escalate issues appropriately to Engineering and Product teams while maintaining ownership of client communication and resolution tracking.
• Support production incidents and urgent deployments in accordance with secure deployment processes.
 
Documentation, Knowledge Management, and Automation
 
• Create and maintain knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, and best-practice documentation.
• Ensure technical content remains current with product releases.
• Identify patterns in support tickets and recommend product or process improvements supported by data and evidence.

• Contribute to quality-assurance activities, including test automation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing coordination for platform updates.
 
Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Participate in customer-success reviews and post-implementation check-ins to identify adoption opportunities and technical risks.
• Mentor junior support team members and contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives.
 
Required Experience and Technical Skills
 
• At least five years of hands-on experience in technical support, customer-success engineering, or SaaS operations.
• Full-stack development proficiency and the ability to build web-based applications across front-end and back-end technologies.
• Strong expertise in API design and integration, with demonstrated experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and webhooks.
• Advanced knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), including experience implementing MCP-based integrations or tools.
• At least five years of SQL experience, including writing queries, analyzing data, and troubleshooting data-related issues.
• Experience using AI tools and APIs to build AI-powered client solutions.
 
Core Competencies
 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically and independently.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt technical explanations for developers, business users, and executives.
• Customer-first mindset and a strong sense of ownership.
• Commitment to driving client success, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
• Ability to learn new platforms and systems quickly.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent issues while meeting response-time expectations.
• Comfortable working proactively in fast-paced and ambiguous environments.

Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.



Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery—from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.



What you will do

 - Deliver end-to-end data science projects using classical machine learning (e.g., regression, classification, time series forecasting) and deep learning approaches — from data exploration and modeling to deployment and performance tracking.

 - Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify opportunities and translate them into measurable data-driven solutions.

 - Present complex analytical findings in a clear, actionable way to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Contribute to analytical planning and ensure alignment with overall business objectives.

 - Support presales activities by preparing data/ML solution concepts, participating in client meetings, and estimating project scope and potential value.

 - Help shape the Data Science practice by contributing to its strategic development and supporting recruitment initiatives.



What you bring

 - Proven experience as a Data Scientist delivering end-to-end projects — from exploratory data analysis to model deployment, performance evaluation, and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing).

 - Strong expertise in working with tabular and time-series data, including EDA, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and model evaluation.

 - Proficiency in Python and common data-science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).

 - Experience leading or mentoring analytics teams and coordinating with business stakeholders.

 - Excellent communication skills, able to translate between technical and business perspectives effectively.

 - Solid understanding of business processes and data structures.

 - Confidence in client-facing settings: gathering requirements, shaping analytical roadmaps, and delivering measurable business value.

 - Fluency in English for meetings with international clients.



Nice to have

 - Hands-on experience with deep learning, computer vision, or generative AI projects.

 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and MLOps tools.

 -  Experience with data visualization or BI tools for communicating insights.

 - Shape real-world AI-driven projects across key industries, working with clients from startup innovation to enterprise transformation.

postings.title: Production Support Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.



Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery—from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.



We are looking for a Production Support Engineer to join a small, high-trust team responsible for the health and reliability of a revenue-critical sales platform. You'll sit between end users — partners and call centers — and engineering, triaging incidents, managing communication, and keeping stakeholders informed and calm when things go wrong.

You'll own the incident management response process end-to-end — from first alert through post-mortem and corrective action follow-up. This is not a developer role. The technical bar is deliberately calibrated: you need to understand how APIs work, read logs, and interpret what you're seeing — not implement fixes. What matters equally is your ability to translate technical issues into plain language and manage expectations across very different audiences.

Longevity and genuine interest in the role matter here. This team values people who want to grow with it, not move through it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Monitor platform health and triage incoming incidents — distinguishing critical issues (outages, service degradation) from non-critical ones (bugs, defects). 

 - Investigate incidents using logging tools — reading API calls, responses, and log data to understand what happened and where. 

 - Own the incident management response process, post-mortems, and corrective action follow-up. 

 - Notify stakeholders of critical issues proactively — specifying SLA risk and communicating clearly on status via email, phone, or ticket system. 

 - Cross-reference tickets across multiple systems and follow defects through the full lifecycle until closure. 

 - Communicate clearly with partners and call center teams — translating technical findings into plain language and managing expectations throughout resolution. 

 - Manage the incident queue in Jira and prioritize bugs within engineering sprint cycles. 

 - Participate in weekly cross-functional meetings with engineering and account/call center management. 

 - Provide suggestions for continual improvement of applications and processes. 

 - Join on-call rotations after ramp-up — responding to alerts via OpsGenie within defined SLA windows. 




BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years of providing clear status updates on tasks, issues, and resolutions to stakeholders at multiple levels.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Clear understanding of eval vs. deterministic testing — the difference between pass/fail based on exact input/output and evaluating probabilistic AI outputs using human-in-the-loop evaluations, score metrics, benchmark datasets, and semantic evaluation.

 - Strong understanding of web and mobile application development lifecycles including iOS and Android specifics.

postings.descriptionText:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

Our backend team is building a highly-available and distributed data pipeline that powers Telnyx products like Voice, Messaging and Wireless. We leverage the Telnyx private backbone network to build a cloud-agnostic data platform that processes thousands of messages per second.

With our lean team, we're currently running and managing more than 30 dockerized microservices deployed in multiple regions in the U.S. and Europe. We are looking for a senior Java backend engineer with deep knowledge of Java Core.

In this role you will

• Work on 30+ microservices implemented in Java 21 and Scala that process, aggregate and expose all data our telecommunication and messaging engines generate

• Improve performance of our pipeline — we currently process 10k messages/sec and are growing

• Architect our services and pipelines so they work with minimum latency in all our locations around the world (U.S., E.U., Australia, South America)

• Implement fraud detection processes with machine learning (Kafka and Kafka Streams)

• Deploy services to multi-cloud Kubernetes environments to achieve 99.999% uptime

• Push code to production multiple times a day

What we're looking for

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience

• 4+ years of experience with Java and its ecosystem of tooling

• Experience with at least one of these databases: Cassandra, ClickHouse, or OpenSearch

• Experience with AI tooling, or a strong willingness to learn

Nice to have

• Experience with Scala or another functional programming language

• Experience with Linux, Git, and Docker in a CI environment

• Experience with distributed systems and systems that maintain "five nines" (99.999%) of uptime

postings.title: Technical Product Support Engineer (Remote): AMER
postings.descriptionText:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

About the Role

We're looking for a curious, technically-minded problem solver — not someone to just close tickets.

You'll troubleshoot complex customer issues across voice, messaging, APIs, IoT, and AI products, digging into networking problems, debugging integrations, and analysing logs alongside engineering teams. But this role goes further: we're building an AI-first support model, and as you develop product expertise, you'll help shape it — building bots, automating workflows, and turning repetitive tasks into cron jobs. If you've ever spotted a repetitive task and actually built the fix for it, you'll fit right in. A background in software engineering, networking, or a related technical field (however you got there) is ideal — We care about what you can do, not where you learned it.

What You'll Do

• Troubleshoot: complex customer issues across networking, APIs, and communications products

• Investigate: using tools like Postman, cURL, Wireshark, Linux terminal and our internal tooling

• Collaborate: with customers, vendors, and engineering teams to resolve cases

• Automate: contribute to bot-building and workflow automation

• Document: solutions and improve self-service resources

• Learn: VoIP protocols, internal systems, and new technologies as the role evolves

Your Toolkit

• Troubleshooting: Postman, cURL, Wireshark, sngrep, Linux terminal

• Ticketing and Comms: Zendesk, Slack

• Collaboration: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Meet)

• Automation: n8n, Zapier, OpenClaw (internal AI platform), scripting (Python, Bash, etc.)

• Version Control: GitHub

• Analytics: Metabase, Graylog, Jira

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

• Background in Computer Science, IT, networking, or equivalent hands-on experience

• Networking fundamentals: solid understanding of how the internet works, including DNS, routing, IP addressing, and HTTP/HTTPS

• API experience: comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and tools like Postman or cURL

• Linux terminal proficiency: comfortable navigating filesystems, reading logs, and running commands

• Problem-solving mindset: you dig into issues, ask good questions, and don't give up easily

• Communication skills: you'll need to be highly proficient in English, both written and verbal - owning customer communication and technical documentation from day one

Nice-to-Have

• Familiarity with scripting or programming (Python, Bash, JavaScript, or similar)

• Understanding of AI concepts such as RAG, MCPs, embeddings, and prompt engineering

• Experience using n8n, Zapier, Git/GitHub, or similar

You don’t need to tick every box - if you’re keen to learn that's the box that matters most !

This role operates on AMER timezone, 9am–6pm Monday to Friday

About You

As a VoIP Engineer you understand how the Telnyx Telephony Engine works as whole, while also being able to identify each underlying service and its purpose. You use this knowledge plus your experience working with VoIP technologies to design new features and guide software developers on their implementation. You assist other teams by triaging escalated issues and then working with all the involved parties until they are resolved. You are the subject matter expert for all topics that are telephony related, and when you don't know the answer you will know who to ask.

The Opportunity

You work with users around the globe, where you help by solving their communications challenges. You’ll also get to work with other engineers to build delightful features that span various parts of the system, as well as our business, sales, and operations teams to understand and solve our users’ pain points.

We’re looking for people with a strong background in VoIP technologies and interest in building successful products or systems; you’re comfortable in dealing with lots of moving pieces; you have exquisite attention to detail; and you’re comfortable learning new technologies and systems.

• Understand how all Telephony services work and how they are integrated to the platform.

• Operate, maintain, expand and support SIP proxies based on Kamailio or OpenSIPS applications.

• Handle level 3 troubleshooting escalations and triaging.

• Analyze telephony traffic patterns and identify issues and anomalies.

• React to critical alerts in order to rapidly return to a full-service state.

• Troubleshoot and resolve voice and network protocol communication issues.

• Interface with partner organizations for interconnections and expansions.

• Design, build, test, deploy and maintain monitoring, alerting, QA and logging tools for Telephony applications.

• Coordinate system maintenance and deployment events.

Who we're looking for

• A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications or similar.

• Strong understanding of IP telephony (VoIP), TCP/IP Networks and related protocols (SIP, RTP, RTCP, ISUP, TLS, STUN, TURN, WebRTC).

• Experience with Open Source VoIP applications such as Kamailio, OpenSIPS, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, Asterisk and open source tools such as Wireshark, sngrep and Homer.

• Experience with Linux, Open Source tools and shell scripting.

• Experience with containers and automation/orchestration tools such as Docker, Ansible, Jenkins, Kubernetes.

• Familiarity with programming in Python, Elixir or Go are a plus.

postings.title: Country Manager (Nordics)
postings.descriptionText:
David Kennedy Recruitment is working with a leading B2B solution provider who are looking to recruit a Country Manager for the Nordic region for their offices in Malta.

Position: Country Manager
Location: Sliema, Malta
Employment type: Full-time

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a dynamic Country Manager to drive market expansion, build strategic client relationships, and accelerate revenue growth. You will play a key role in identifying new business opportunities, managing the full sales cycle, and positioning our solutions effectively in the market. This is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-paced, international environment.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Identify and develop new business opportunities through research, networking, and strategic outreach, managing prospects through the full sales cycle

• Build and maintain a strong, active sales pipeline through consistent and targeted activity

• Understand customer needs and deliver consultative, solution-driven sales approaches

• Develop deep relationships with clients to ensure long-term partnerships and tailored solutions

• Act as a product expert, confidently presenting current and upcoming offerings

• Collaborate with internal teams to convert leads into successful client engagements

• Create and maintain high-quality sales materials, including presentations and supporting resources

• Develop commercially viable proposals aligned with both business and client objectives

• Track and report on sales pipeline progress and customer journey stages

• Represent the company at trade shows, industry events, and conferences

• Deliver product demonstrations both remotely and in person

• Partner with Product and Marketing teams to drive initiatives that support new business acquisition.

REQUIREMENTS:

• Fluent in Swedish or Danish , along with strong English communication skills, in both written and spoken communication

• Strong network of C-level contacts within the gaming or gambling sector

• Proven experience within Nordic iGaming markets, either in B2B sales/account management or a commercial B2C role

• In-depth knowledge of casino, slots, and live casino products

• Demonstrated experience in developing and executing regional or global sales strategies

• Solid understanding of marketing principles

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, complex, and evolving environment

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

• Self-driven with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

• Highly motivated with the ability to influence and inspire others

• Hands-on, proactive approach with a strong sense of ownership

• Commercially focused with a data-driven mindset

• Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills with the ability to build lasting relationships.

BENEFITS:

• Comprehensive onboarding and training aligned with high industry standards

• Supportive, collaborative, and inclusive company culture

• Excellent career progression opportunities within a fast-growing international organisation

• Access to continuous learning and development through a dedicated learning platform.

postings.title: Líder de re-Commerce & Calidad
postings.descriptionText:
En Bidcom lideramos el mercado de E-commerce en Argentina, consolidándonos como el vendedor #1 en Mercado Libre durante el Hot Sale 2026, tanto en facturación como en unidades vendidas. Lograr este hito requiere de una gestión operativa de excelencia, donde el control de calidad, el recupero técnico y la rentabilidad del canal outlet operan en perfecta sinergia.
Buscamos un/a Líder de re-Commerce & Calidad que lidere la estrategia end-to-end de recupero técnico, control de calidad y comercialización de productos outlet de la compañía. • Gestionar el P&L del negocio Outlet, definiendo la estrategia de pricing, posicionamiento, costo de recupero y margen de contribución para maximizar la rentabilidad.

• Transformar el equipo de Calidad en un centro de Business Intelligence, diseñando tableros de control con datos de devoluciones y garantías para impulsar la mejora continua del catálogo.

• Impulsar la automatización e integración de nuevas tecnologías (como Inteligencia Artificial) en los procesos de inspección, clasificación y escala operativa.

• Construir, escalar y optimizar los canales de monetización de stock recuperado (Nuevo u Outlet), identificando nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento comercial.

• Cooperar activamente con las áreas de Operaciones, Dirección y Comerciales para alertar sobre fallas de fábrica, optimizar packaging y mejorar la experiencia final del usuario.

Requisitos:

• Experiencia de 3 a 5 años en posiciones de liderazgo operativo, servicio técnico, control de calidad, logística inversa o e-commerce/retail tecnológico.

• Marcada visión de negocio y perfil comercial con manejo fluido del P&L, costos y márgenes de contribución.

• Formación: Graduados o estudiantes avanzados en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

• Porque vas a liderar la estrategia de recupero y calidad de una de las operaciones de Mercado Libre más importantes de Argentina.

• Porque tendrás ownership directo sobre el P&L de una unidad de negocio en constante crecimiento.

• Construir y mantener indicadores y tableros de seguimiento del área, utilizando los datos para priorizar y tomar decisiones.

• Construir y mantener el P&L por negocio, servicio y producto y cliente, asegurando la correcta asignación de ingresos y costos directos e indirectos.

• Desarrollar y mantener modelos de costeo y rentabilidad que permitan simular escenarios y evaluar el impacto económico de decisiones sobre la estructura de costos.

• Actuar como business partner de los dominios, desafiando supuestos de costos y contribuyendo a mejorar la calidad de las decisiones sobre asignación de recursos.

• Diseñar y evolucionar tableros de control que muestren la evolución de costos, drivers de asignación y rentabilidad por negocio/servicio/producto/cliente.

• Elaborar reportes ejecutivos e insights accionables sobre el P&L para la dirección y los distintos equipos.

• Impulsar iniciativas de automatización y mejora continua en los procesos de costeo, asignación y reporting.

Es por ello, que estamos buscando un/a IT And Operational Risk SR Analyst para sumarse al equipo. Su proposito será crear procesos y sistemas para la identificación temprana de fallas: mapear procesos críticos, entender la interacción entre servicios/APIs y el flujo de datos (iniciando con un producto clave como Cashout), detectar zonas ciegas entre sistemas sin control activo y cuantificar el impacto potencial para implementar soluciones antes de que los problemas que puedan ocurrir.

¿Querés ser protagonista de esta historia e impulsar la transformación financiera de millones de personas? ¡Súmate!

¿Qué desafíos vas a encontrar en esta posición?

• Mapeo End-to-End e Integración: Relevar y estandarizar flujos de procesos tecnológicos complejos, analizando la comunicación entre APIs, la lógica del pipeline y el comportamiento de los productos.

• Detección Proactiva de Fallas: Identificar zonas grises, huecos de control e ineficiencias en las interacciones entre distintos procesos y productos donde no exista monitoreo.

postings.title: Product Lead - Infrastructure
postings.descriptionText:
Supabase is the open-source Postgres development platform that 10M+ developers and thousands of enterprises depend on every day. Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime and Vector Search all run on one platform: the same compute , the same disks , the same network and control plane, in every region we operate.

Supabase's hardest problems live in that platform. Millions of databases, growth that compounds every quarter, and a customer base running from a developer on a free project to a regulated enterprise routing traffic through PrivateLink . Reliability, capacity, cost and the enterprise features that close deals all come back to the same primitives. We're hiring a Product Lead to own them.

About the role

You own the platform primitives every Supabase product runs on: compute, disks, networking, the API gateway, capacity and regions. You own the enterprise surfaces built on top of them too, including read replicas , custom domains , PrivateLink and Bring Your Own Cloud. You report to the Head of Product and set direction for the whole area alongside the leads for our other product lines. You're the only product person on the platform today, and the team grows under you as the area does.

What you'll be responsible for:

•
You talk to customers across the full spectrum. Developers running a single small project, growing startups whose bill is mostly compute and disk, enterprises walking through a network architecture review, and partners building on top of Supabase.

•
You own the problem statement and requirements behind every platform bet. You define what we're building and why before engineering starts, name the cost, capacity and reliability constraints, and keep that clarity current through execution.

•
You decide what gets built, what gets deferred, and what gets cut. Every quarter you're choosing between enterprise unlocks that open new markets, cost and performance wins for the long tail of projects, and net-new capabilities that change what Supabase can run. The priorities are yours, and so is defending them.

•
You own reliability as a product surface. You set service levels that track what customers experience, hold teams to them, and show customers what it takes to run millions of databases.

•
You define how each launch is measured before it ships. The metric, the threshold and the read afterwards are yours: whether a launch moved enterprise deal velocity, project economics, or platform reliability.

•
You keep engineering, design and leadership aligned. The platform touches every other Supabase product, every region and every customer tier. You write down what's coming, why, and in what order, and you surface dependencies before they become blockers.

You might be a good fit if you:

•
Have 8+ years of product management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder who has built in this space. You're technical enough to read an architecture doc and follow a design discussion.

•
Have shipped cloud infrastructure as a product. You've owned at least one of compute, networking, storage, or multi-region and multi-tenant systems at a cloud, infrastructure or PaaS company, as the owner rather than a neighbouring team. You can judge the tradeoffs: instance sizing and capacity, disk and storage economics, scale-to-zero versus always-on, single-tenant versus shared, and the distance between "works in one region" and "works in twenty." Familiarity with how enterprises buy infrastructure (PrivateLink, BYOC, procurement) is a bonus.

•
Have grown with an infrastructure product. You've owned infrastructure small enough to hold in your head, and stayed with it until capacity, regions and cost became the real constraints.

•
Are biased toward speed. You'd rather ship something imperfect and learn from it.

•
Build with what you own. You stand up a read replica, put a custom domain in front of a project, terminate traffic through PrivateLink, deploy onto BYOC. You develop opinions through first-hand use.

•
Use AI to move faster. You lean on AI for the slow parts of the job (research, drafting, synthesising feedback) so you spend more time on judgment calls.

•
Work async by default. We're fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

What We Offer

•
Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

•
ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

•
Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

•
Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

•
Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

•
Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

•
Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

•
~400 team members

•
60+ countries

•
20+ languages spoken

•
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

•
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers (Eeste), Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.

Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.

Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.

Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.

Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.

Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.

•
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

Who are we looking for

•
A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.

•
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.

•
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.

•
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.

•
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.

•
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.

•
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

•
Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.

•
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.

•
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

postings.title: Legal Counsel - Regulatory Compliance, Product and Privacy
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally-distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 80+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional lawyer as Legal Advisor or Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to work on a variety of compliance and privacy matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as cutting-edge questions of technology, law and product development. In this role we are looking for someone with some experience in compliance, privacy and product development, paired with an ability to learn and tackle new challenges and complex questions. You should be able to demonstrate good commercial judgement and provide high-quality legal and compliance advice. If you have a rigorous work ethic, capability to grasp details, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement, this role is for you.
Location : This role is home-based in EMEA or the Americas, with an option of working from our London office.

The role entails

• Drafting and reviewing corporate policies, spearheading process change and deploying controls to meet compliance regulatory requirements globally

• Helping develop, maintain and scale global privacy programs. This includes conducting PIAs, ROPAs and supporting operational initiatives

• Working with cross functional with teams to evaluate the impact of privacy and data protection laws and regulations, including AI regulations

• Providing legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical’s product teams

• Working with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice

What we are looking for in you

• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active licence to practise law or current progress towards that

• Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills

• Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation

• Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organisation

• Ability to stay organised, proactive and efficient

• Ability to demonstrate good commercial judgement

• Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

• Experience in compliance, data privacy, or product development

• Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices

• Understanding of the open source software community and values

• Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software

• Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Are you experienced in garment manufacturing quality control and interested in helping train the next generation of AI systems? As AI models are increasingly applied to global manufacturing, supply chain monitoring, and production analysis, their ability to reason about quality standards, inspection processes, and factory workflows depends on accurate, real-world training data. That training data begins with practitioners who understand how garments are actually produced and evaluated.
We’re looking for Garment Manufacturing QC Specialists with hands-on experience inspecting garments and finished goods in factory or production environments. You’ll challenge AI models on real-world quality control scenarios involving defect identification, measurement tolerances, stitching quality, material consistency, finishing standards, and production compliance. This project focuses on evaluating how well models understand manufacturing workflows, common failure points, and quality decision-making at scale.
On a typical day, you will review and discuss garment quality inspection scenarios with the model, verify whether model reasoning aligns with real factory QC practices, evaluate defect classification and severity assessment, analyze inspection workflows across production stages, capture recurring model errors, and suggest improvements to training prompts and evaluation criteria.
General experience in garment manufacturing environments is ideal, including familiarity with sewing outputs, production lines, and inspection checkpoints. This project does not require advanced technical education; practical factory-floor experience in quality checking or garment inspection is strongly valued. Clear communication and the ability to explain quality judgments and production realities are essential.
Ready to turn your garment manufacturing QC expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will help improve manufacturing quality worldwide.
We offer a pay range of $6-to-$15 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

postings.descriptionText:
We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm

Hello! We are GoFasti , a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe.

We need an English-speaking Mid Level 1038- Campaign Coordinator , based in Latin America, available to work remotely.

We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills.

Are you the one we are looking for?

Responsibilities:



• 
Execute optimizations across client Google Ads, Meta Ads, and emerging social platforms accounts following industry best practices.




• 
Monitor daily campaign performance and make data-drive adjustments to improve efficiency ROI.




• 
Support day-to-day ad account maintenance and reporting.




• 
Build, monitor, and proactively deliver performance reports with a focus on scaling channel results.




• 
Manage QA processes to ensure accuracy in ad content and on-time delivery.




• 
Translate business objectives into actionable multi-channel strategies, including audience segmentation and retargeting.




• 
Monitor ad platform updates and algorithm changes to proactively adjust strategies.




• 
Work with paid search, DSP, and email teams to execute collaborative cross-channel marketing.




• 
Identify and implement fixes for low catalog match rate and product feed health to maximize efficiency.





Requirements:



• 
1–3 years of experience in digital advertising and campaign management (specifically Meta and Google Ads).




• 
Strong understanding in setting up, monitoring and troubleshooting Meta pixels and conversion events to drive campaigns.




• 
Excellent written and verbal communication; growth mindset with a desire for continuous learning.




• 
Experience with other social platforms such as Pinterest, X (Twitter), or LinkedIn is a Plus.





Compensation:



• 
The salary range offered for this position varies from (USD) $1,500 - $1,700 per month, depending on seniority and skillset.




• 
This is a 40 hours per week.




• 
This position is for an independent contractor, through a payroll platform.




• 
The talent will work remotely allocated at our client.





Here are the steps for this process:

Application review/approval > Screening interview with GoFasti's team > We build and send your profile to our client > Profile review/approval by client > Interview with the client > Hiring and onboarding.

Once you apply for the job, our team will review your resume. If it meets the requirements, we will contact you and move forward in the process.

Note for Candidates Approached Directly:
If you were contacted directly by a member of our team and are interested in this opportunity, please do not apply through this link. Instead, reach out to the person who contacted you to coordinate a meeting.

Thank you!

• SQL avanzado: Dominio de SQL complejo: window functions, optimización de queries, modelado dimensional.

• Collaborate with customer engineering teams.

postings.title: Oficial Metalúrgico
postings.descriptionText:
Acompañamos a un empresa industrial especializada en la fabricación de herrajes y morsetería para líneas eléctricas de baja, media y alta tensión, en la búsqueda de un Oficial Metalúrgico.
Su operación combina distintos procesos metalúrgicos, como soldadura, prensado, mecanizado y control dimensional, trabajando sobre piezas y componentes que forman parte de infraestructura eléctrica.
Vas a formar parte del equipo de Producción, trabajando directamente sobre la fabricación y terminación de piezas metálicas.
El rol requiere experiencia práctica, atención al detalle y compromiso con la calidad, combinando soldadura, operación de maquinaria, lectura de planos y control de medidas , siempre bajo estándares de seguridad industrial.

Responsabilidades principales

• Soldadura y Ensamble: Realizar soldaduras (puntos y cordón continuo) garantizando la máxima resistencia estructural.

• Operación de Máquinas: Operar balancines y prensas, asegurando el seteo correcto y el cumplimiento de los ritmos de producción.

• Interpretación Técnica: Lectura de planos para identificar tolerancias, secuencias de armado y criterios de control.

• Control de Calidad en Proceso: Uso de instrumentos de medición (calibre, micrometro, galgas) para asegurar que ninguna pieza salga de tolerancia.

• Gestión de Mejora: Registro de producción, detección de desvíos (scrap/retrabajo) y mantenimiento del orden bajo metodología 5S.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Formación: Secundario Técnico (Mecánico, Electromecánico o Metalúrgico) preferentemente.

• Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años en plantas industriales/ metalúrgicas.

• Competencias Técnicas preferentemente:

• Interpretación de planos: lectura y comprensión de planos técnicos, manejo de cotas, tolerancias básicas y simbología simple (deseable).

• Manejo de maquinaria metalúrgica: operación segura de balancines y prensas, con conocimiento de riesgos asociados, normas de seguridad y sistemas de resguardo.

• Metrología básica: uso de calibre para el control dimensional y verificación de medidas durante el proceso productivo.

• Soldadura: identificación de criterios de calidad visual, tales como porosidad, falta de fusión, exceso de material, entre otros, asegurando prolijidad y terminación adecuada.

• Buscamos una persona con fuerte compromiso con las normas de Seguridad e Higiene y el uso de EPP.

Por qué sumarte?

• Incorporarte a una empresa industrial sólida, vinculada a un sector estratégico como el energético.

• Trabajar en una operación donde la calidad, la seguridad y la precisión técnica son parte central del proceso.

• Contar con buenas condiciones de contratación y una propuesta salarial competitiva.

postings.title: Responsable de Mejora Continua y Supply Chain

Una posición nueva, con espacio para proponer, construir y medir el impacto de lo implementado.

¿Cuál será tu desafío?
Trabajar sobre los distintos procesos de Supply Chain, combinando análisis y cercanía con la operación para detectar oportunidades de mejora en inventarios, almacenamiento, distribución y eficiencia.
No se trata solo de identificar qué podría hacerse mejor, sino de convertir ese análisis en proyectos concretos, medibles y escalables.

Principales responsabilidades

• Diseñar y liderar proyectos de mejora continua vinculados a Supply Chain.

• Analizar procesos, detectar oportunidades y desarrollar soluciones que mejoren su eficiencia y escalabilidad.

• Diseñar y dar seguimiento a KPIs de nivel de servicio, costos y eficiencia.

• Analizar desvíos, identificar sus causas y transformarlos en acciones de mejora.

• Trabajar sobre inventarios, almacenamiento, reposición y exactitud de stock.

• Participar en mejoras de layout, picking, armado y despacho de pedidos.

• Analizar oportunidades de optimización en distribución y costos de flete.

• Impulsar iniciativas de automatización y simplificación de procesos.

• Trabajar transversalmente con Comercial, Sistemas, Administración y otras áreas.

• Medir el impacto de los proyectos implementados y realizar seguimiento de sus resultados.

¿A quién buscamos?

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia profesional.

• Experiencia en Operaciones, Supply Chain, Logística, Distribución, Procesos o Mejora Continua.

• Experiencia trabajando con procesos, indicadores y proyectos de mejora.

• Excel avanzado.

• Se valorará experiencia con metodologías Lean, 5S o gestión por procesos.

• Se valorará manejo de Power BI.

¿Por qué sumarte?
Porque no llegás a ocupar una posición ya escrita: vas a tener espacio para construirla.
Es un rol nuevo, con autonomía, contacto directo con la operación y alta exposición a la Gerencia de Operaciones. Vas a poder desarrollar proyectos desde cero y ver concretamente qué cambia después de implementarlos.
Además, el alcance permite trabajar sobre una Supply Chain diversa, atravesada por distribución mayorista, e-commerce y retail.
