postings.title: Staff Software Engineer (SRE)
postings.descriptionText:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 !

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Responsibilities

•
Kubernetes Ownership : Manage and scale Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS , ensuring reliability, performance, and security.

•
Infrastructure Automation : Implement and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi) to automate infrastructure provisioning and management.

•
Performance Optimization : Monitor and optimize system performance, scalability, and resource utilization.

•
Blockchain Infrastructure : Configure and maintain crypto nodes across multiple blockchains to support our wallet’s operations.

•
Database Scaling : Optimize and scale database infrastructure to handle terabytes of blockchain data efficiently.

•
System Reliability : Continuously improve system uptime, monitoring, and observability using tools like Datadog and OpenTelemetry .

•
Collaboration : Work closely with backend and product teams to support feature development and system scaling.

Qualifications

•
5+ years in a SRE or Software Engineer role.

•
Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production environments.

•
Proficiency with AWS infrastructure and services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM).

•
Solid experience with Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

•
Monitoring and observability experience using tools like Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

The target base salary for this role will range between $200,000 to $250,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors (such as location) at the point in time of offer.

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

•
Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

•
Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

•
Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits ( only available to full-time employees)

•
Competitive salary and equity

•
Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

•
Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

•
Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

•
401(k) retirement plan

•
Wellness stipend

•
Weekly meal stipend

•
Learning & Development stipend

•
Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

postings.title: Jr Performance Marketer - AI Technology
postings.descriptionText:
Workster is partnering with an international technology company to recruit a Junior Performance Marketer specialising in AI technology. In this role, you will support digital marketing campaigns that build awareness, attract customers and drive measurable growth for AI-powered products and services.
You will work closely with marketing, product, sales and data teams to plan, launch and optimise campaigns across digital channels. The ideal candidate brings a strong interest in performance marketing, an analytical mindset and curiosity about AI and emerging technology.

Your Role

• Support the planning and delivery of performance marketing campaigns for AI-powered products and services

• Help manage campaigns across channels such as paid search, paid social, display, email and other digital platforms

• Assist with campaign setup, audience targeting, budget tracking and quality checks

• Monitor campaign performance and prepare regular reports on key metrics, including traffic, conversions, cost per acquisition and return on advertising spend

• Use marketing data and platform insights to identify opportunities to improve campaign results

• Support the testing and optimisation of advertising copy, creative assets, landing pages and audience segments

• Work with content and creative teams to develop campaign materials that communicate product benefits clearly

• Help maintain campaign calendars, tracking documents and marketing dashboards

• Support the implementation of tracking, tagging and conversion measurement across digital campaigns

• Research audiences, competitors, market trends and relevant AI industry developments

• Collaborate with product and sales teams to align campaigns with customer needs and business objectives

• Contribute to lead generation, customer acquisition and product growth initiatives

• Follow marketing, privacy and advertising guidelines when supporting campaign activity

• Keep up to date with performance marketing tools, digital channels and developments in AI technology

Your Qualifications

• Some experience in digital marketing, performance marketing or a related role, including internships or relevant projects

• Understanding of digital marketing channels such as paid search, paid social, display or email

• Interest in campaign measurement, customer acquisition and data-informed marketing

• Comfortable working with spreadsheets and interpreting performance data

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail

• Organised approach and ability to manage tasks, deadlines and competing priorities

• Ability to work collaboratively with marketing, product, sales and creative teams

• Curiosity about AI, technology products and how digital marketing can support their growth

• Familiarity with tools such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics or marketing dashboards is an advantage

• Knowledge of conversion tracking, A/B testing or marketing automation is an advantage

• Relevant marketing qualifications or training are an advantage

• Opportunity to support the growth of AI-powered products and services

• International and multidisciplinary working environment

postings.title: Security Engineer AI - AppSec, GRC
postings.descriptionText:
Workster is partnering with an international technology company to recruit a Security Engineer specialising in AI, application security (AppSec) and governance, risk and compliance (GRC). In this role, you will help protect AI-powered products, applications and services throughout their development and operation.
You will work closely with engineering, product, data, legal and compliance teams to identify security risks and build practical safeguards into technology and processes. The ideal candidate brings experience in application security and security governance, with an understanding of the risks and controls associated with AI systems.

Your Responsibilities

• Assess the security of AI-powered products, applications, APIs and supporting infrastructure

• Embed security requirements and practices into the software development lifecycle, from design and development through deployment and maintenance

• Conduct or coordinate application security reviews, threat modelling, vulnerability assessments and penetration testing

• Identify, prioritise and support remediation of security vulnerabilities, including risks specific to AI systems and integrations

• Review AI system design and data flows for risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, insecure model access and misuse of outputs

• Develop and maintain secure coding standards, technical security guidance and AppSec policies

• Advise engineering teams on secure architecture, authentication, authorisation, encryption, secrets management and API security

• Support security controls for AI models, datasets, third-party services and model development or deployment workflows

• Establish and maintain security governance, risk and compliance processes for products, services and internal systems

• Contribute to risk assessments, control evaluations, audit evidence and remediation plans

• Help map security practices to relevant frameworks, standards and regulatory requirements

• Collaborate with privacy, legal, compliance and risk teams on data protection and responsible AI considerations

• Support security incident readiness and contribute to the investigation and resolution of application or AI-related security incidents

• Track security metrics, prepare reports and communicate risks, findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Keep up to date with application security practices, AI threats, security standards and relevant regulatory developments

Your Qualifications

• Professional experience in security engineering, application security, information security or a related field

• Experience assessing and securing web applications, APIs, cloud services or software platforms

• Understanding of secure software development, threat modelling, vulnerability management and security testing

• Knowledge of common application security risks and relevant testing approaches

• Experience with governance, risk and compliance activities, such as risk assessments, control reviews or audit support

• Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST or SOC 2

• Understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, encryption and secure configuration principles

• Awareness of AI and machine learning security risks, including data, model and inference-time threats

• Ability to assess technical risks and explain their impact and remediation options clearly

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a practical approach to risk

• Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, product, data, legal and compliance teams

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear security documentation

• Ability to manage competing priorities and contribute effectively in a changing technology environment

• Experience with security testing tools, code scanning, cloud security platforms or GRC systems is an advantage

• Relevant security certifications or training are an advantage

• Fluent English, both written and spoken

The Offer

• Opportunity to strengthen the security of AI-powered products and services

• Collaborative work with engineering, product, data, legal and compliance teams

• Meaningful involvement in application security and security governance initiatives

• Professional development in a rapidly evolving technology and security sector

• International and multidisciplinary working environment

languages.level: fluent

postings.title: Credit Manager / AR Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
Workster is excited to be recruiting for a highly organised and motivated professional to join our client’s finance team as a Credit Manager / AR Accountant. This is a key opportunity to partner with a renowned multinational organisation and manage the full cycle of Accounts Receivable and credit risk processes. The ideal candidate will take ownership of AR processes, act as a trusted advisor for stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement. If you thrive in dynamic environments, have a focus on accuracy, and seek growth within a supportive culture, this could be your next career step.

Key Responsibilities in Credit Control and Accounts Receivable

• Manage end-to-end Accounts Receivable (AR) activities, including invoice generation, payment allocation, and account reconciliation.

• Monitor customer accounts to identify overdue balances, initiate collection activities, and resolve outstanding debts in a timely manner.

• Assess creditworthiness of new and existing clients, recommend credit limits, and perform ongoing risk analysis.

• Prepare and deliver regular AR and credit management reports to senior finance stakeholders.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, customer service, and finance teams to address queries and ensure a seamless client experience.

• Support the month-end and year-end close process for Accounts Receivable, ensuring compliance and accuracy of all records.

• Implement and enhance policies, controls, and procedures to minimise credit risk and optimise cash flow.

• Respond promptly and professionally to both internal and external finance-related enquiries.

Required Skills and Qualifications for Credit Management and AR Accounting Roles

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (essential).

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience in an Accounts Receivable, Credit Control, or related finance/accounting position.

• Proficient in financial software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics) and advanced knowledge of MS Excel.

• Excellent analytical skills with a strong attention to detail and a solution-oriented mindset.

• Clear and effective communicator with the ability to build relationships across teams and levels.

• Strong organisational skills; able to prioritise work in a fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines.

• Fluency in English required; additional European languages are an advantage.

• Demonstrated commitment to integrity, confidentiality, and continuous professional improvement.

Benefits and Advantages of an AR Accountant / Credit Manager Job

• Attractive base salary and performance-related bonuses.

• Comprehensive benefits package including private health insurance and on-going training.

• Opportunity to join a respected international company with excellent career progression routes.

• Inclusive, diverse, and supportive team culture dedicated to your success.

• Modern office facilities and the possibility for hybrid/remote work, depending on business needs.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at Workster
Workster celebrates diversity and is firmly committed to equal opportunities for all. We encourage applications from individuals of every gender identity, culture, background, and experience. Our recruitment process is inclusive and solely based on skills, qualification, and professional potential for the Credit Manager / AR Accountant role.

How to Apply for a Credit Manager / AR Accountant Career Opportunity
If you are passionate about credit control, AR processes, and want to develop your finance career in a vibrant international environment, please submit your CV in English. We look forward to advancing your application and welcoming you to our client’s finance team!

postings.title: Digital Designer & Front-End Developer (HTML/CSS)
postings.descriptionText:
About the role
You will work with our marketing team to create and maintain web pages and produce visual content across our digital channels. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between HTML/CSS development and creative production, delivering work that is visually consistent, responsive and aligned with campaign objectives.

Key responsibilities
Website development and design

• Build, maintain and improve website pages and campaign landing pages using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

• Create responsive layouts that work across desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

• Improve page usability, visual presentation and performance to support enquiries and conversions.

• Maintain consistent branding across website pages and digital assets.

Digital design and advertising

• Design creatives for Meta and Google advertising campaigns.

• Produce banners, social media graphics and email campaign assets.

• Adapt designs for different platforms, placements and formats.

• Collaborate with the marketing team to turn campaign briefs into clear, engaging visuals.

Video editing and content production

• Edit videos for social media, YouTube and digital advertising.

• Create short-form content, including Reels and Shorts.

• Add captions, transitions, music and simple motion graphics.

• Repurpose existing footage into content suited to different channels.

Email development

• Build and update responsive HTML email templates.

• Check email layouts and formatting across devices and email clients.

• Support the production of promotional emails and marketing campaigns.

What we are looking for

• Practical experience with HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design and JavaScript.

• Strong graphic design skills, including typography, layout and visual composition.

• Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, or comparable design tools.

• Experience with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

• Experience creating digital advertising assets and content for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and Google Ads.

• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to discuss briefs, understand feedback and collaborate with an English-speaking team.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage several tasks and meet deadlines.

• A portfolio demonstrating both web development and creative design work.

How to apply
Please submit your CV in English

postings.title: Jefe/a Industrial
postings.descriptionText:
Desde Suessa , nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Jefe/a Industrial para incorporarse al equipo de trabajo de La Cardeuse , reconocida compañía argentina con más de 150 años de trayectoria en el mercado del descanso.
El puesto reportará al Gerente de Planta y tendrá a su cargo las áreas de Producción, Despacho y Mantenimiento de una planta industrial de aproximadamente 150 colaboradores ubicada en Lanús.
.| Principales responsabilidades:

• Administrar los recursos necesarios para cumplir satisfactoriamente con la fabricación y entrega de los productos según estándares de la Empresa.

• Evaluar los métodos de trabajo actuales y aportar mejoras tanto en tiempos de fabricación y entrega como en calidad y servicio.

• Diagramar la producción, planificando los sectores según las necesidades oscilantes de la demanda.

• Coordinar y planificar las tareas de Mantenimiento.

• Velar por la calidad de los productos fabricados y la calidad de servicio brindada al cliente.

• Controlar y verificar los stocks de Materia prima y Producto terminado. Coordinar y planificar stocks de repuestos.

• Generar informes de gestión que muestren la situación de cada uno de los sectores.

• Gestionar asuntos sindicales y el contacto diario con delegados gremiales, a fin de evitar potenciales conflictos.

• Dirigir, desarrollar, capacitar y evaluar al equipo de trabajo (supervisores, coordinadores, operarios), fomentando una cultura de seguridad, trabajo en equipo y mejora continua.

• Garantizar que las tareas se cumplan bajo las normas de Seguridad e Higiene determinadas por los organismos de control.

.| Requisitos:

• Preferentemente, graduado/a y/o estudiante avanzado/a de Ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica o afines.

• Experiencia mínima de 5 años en rol similar teniendo equipos a su cargo en plantas productivas de industrias textil, metalúrgica o química.

• Se valorará conocimiento en: interpretación de planos, electricidad, mecánica, electrónica y neumática, normas ISO 9001.

• Capacidad de liderazgo, comunicación efectiva, negociación, orientación a resultados, resolución de problemas, tolerancia al cambio, capacidad analítica y de toma de decisiones.

.| Condiciones de trabajo:

• Jornada full-time (lunes a viernes de 6 a 15hs). Presencial en planta.

• Lugar de trabajo: Lanús, Buenos Aires.

Si te interesa asumir un rol con responsabilidad operativa y estratégica, liderar equipos y contribuir a la mejora continua de la planta productiva de La Cardeuse, ¡esta oportunidad es para VOS! ¡Postulate! 🚀

postings.title: Analista de Payroll (Contrato por proyecto)
postings.descriptionText:
En Suessa nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Payroll Analyst para sumarse al equipo de reconocido laboratorio multinacional, líder en salud humana y salud animal.
Buscamos un perfil analítico, proactivo y con orientación a la calidad para formar parte del área responsable de la gestión integral de nómina, asegurando la precisión, puntualidad y cumplimiento normativo en cada etapa del proceso.
Misión del Rol
Garantizar la gestión integral y el procesamiento oportuno de la nómina y sus registros asociados, manteniendo actualizados los datos maestros, ejecutando controles de tiempo y asegurando el estricto cumplimiento de políticas y normativas vigentes. La posición participará activamente en el análisis y optimización continua de procesos, brindando soporte de primer nivel a colaboradores y socios estratégicos de negocio.
Principales Responsabilidades

• Gestión y procesamiento de nómina: Asegurar la liquidación precisa y a término de la nómina y los registros contables correspondientes.

• Liquidaciones y fondos: Calcular liquidaciones finales, pagos extraordinarios/especiales y gestionar los requerimientos de fondos junto al equipo de Tesorería de GBS.

• Control y auditoría: Conducir auditorías y revisiones periódicas para verificar la exactitud de los cálculos y garantizar la conformidad con la normativa laboral y fiscal aplicable.

• Gestión de tiempo y asistencia: Ejecutar los controles mensuales de control horario/tiempo, identificar desvíos, analizar reglas de negocio y parametrizar pagos/deducciones para la liquidación.

• Mantenimiento de datos maestros: Actualizar y custodiar los datos maestros de payroll (registros de jornada, novedades salariales, deducciones y conceptos adicionales).

• Atención y soporte: Administrar la casilla de correo de Payroll Services , canalizando y resolviendo consultas de colaboradores internos y líderes de área con agilidad y vocación de servicio.

Requisitos del Perfil

• Experiencia: Mínimo de 2 años en posiciones similares de administración de nómina, liquidación de sueldos o payroll regional/corporativo.

• Idiomas: Portugués avanzado (excluyente, para interacción fluida oral y escrita con equipos regionales).

• Herramientas informáticas: Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel (fórmulas complejas, tablas dinámicas, cruce de datos) y experiencia comprobable en software de nómina y sistemas de gestión de tiempo (HRIS / Time & Attendance).

• Conocimientos técnicos: Sólido dominio de prácticas de administración salarial, regulaciones laborales y procesos contables vinculados a nómina.

• Competencias clave:

• Fuerte capacidad analítica, criterio en la toma de decisiones y rigor en el detalle.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación interpersonal y capacidad de presentación.

• Enfoque centrado en el cliente interno, resiliencia y compromiso con la mejora continua.

Condiciones de la Posición

• Tipo de contratación: Plazo determinado hasta diciembre 2027.

• Esquema híbrido | Oficinas en Munro, Buenos Aires.

Si cumplís con los requisitos y te entusiasma formar parte de una compañía global de primer nivel, ¡envianos tu CV actualizado!

postings.title: Analista SR Comercial (Desarrollo de Canal)
postings.descriptionText:
Desde Suessa , nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Analista Sr Comercial (Desarrollo de Canal) para compañía local referente en la importación y comercialización de piezas de suspensión para el mercado de reposición automotor.
🎯 El Desafío
Tu objetivo principal será analizar, desarrollar y expandir la comercialización de la unidad de negocios de autopartes de suspensión importadas. Buscamos un perfil que logre un equilibrio perfecto entre la gestión directa de ventas a distribuidores/talleres y el análisis estratégico del mercado para optimizar la rentabilidad del canal.
🚀 Principales Responsabilidades
Desarrollo y Gestión del Canal Aftermarket

• Ejecutar la estrategia de captación y fidelización de distribuidores y talleres a nivel nacional y regional.

• Impulsar fuertemente la venta de la línea de suspensión: Bujes Silent-Block, Cazoletas de Suspensión, Topes de goma, Bieletas y Soportes de Motor.

• Identificar y calificar clientes potenciales a través de bases de datos, ferias, eventos de la industria y redes profesionales.

Análisis Comercial e Inteligencia de Mercado

• Monitorear el mercado analizando a la competencia, elasticidad de precios y tendencias del parque automotor.

• Aportar insights basados en datos a la Dirección Comercial para decidir la incorporación de nuevas referencias o familias de productos.

• Proyectar la demanda ( forecast ) para alinear estratégicamente las ventas con las áreas de compras e importación.

• Analizar la cobertura geográfica para detectar zonas desatendidas y expandir la red.

Negociación B2B y Gestión de Cuentas

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring an Accounting Automation Engineer to replace manual accounting work across a multi-entity, multi-country enterprise, using Claude Code and agentic AI. 

You will use Claude Code and agentic AI, plus Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, to automate accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end close and the wider day-to-day accounting operation. You need strong IFRS or US GAAP knowledge to get the numbers right, because an automation that posts wrong entries is worse than no automation.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The goal is to automate the repeatable core of enterprise accounting, with human review kept only where judgment is needed.

Accounts payable

 - Invoice capture and data extraction from PDFs and email, using AI where useful

 - Vendor matching, coding suggestions, and 2-way/3-way PO matching

 - Duplicate invoice detection and approval routing

 - Payment run preparation and vendor statement reconciliation

Accounts receivable

 - Invoice generation and delivery

 - Cash application and bank receipt matching

 - Aging reports, dunning and collections reminders

 - Credit note handling and bad debt/ECL provision support

Reconciliations

 - Bank and card reconciliations across all accounts and currencies

 - Balance sheet account reconciliations (prepayments, accruals, deferred revenue, fixed assets)

 - Intercompany and subledger-to-GL reconciliations

 - Exception reports that flag only the items a human needs to review

Month-end close

 - Close checklist tracking and scheduled reminders

 - Recurring, accrual, prepayment and amortization journals

 - Depreciation runs and FX revaluation

 - Trial balance checks, flux/variance analysis, and draft commentary

 - Management reporting packs

General accounting operations

 - Expense report and employee reimbursement checks

 - Chart of accounts and master data hygiene

 - Audit support: evidence collection, PBC lists, sample extraction

 - Data pipelines between ERP, banks, payment platforms and spreadsheets


QUALIFICATIONS

Two things matter most, and we weigh them above everything else:

 1. Strong knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP

 2. Real experience with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, backed by solid engineering basics

We accept two paths: an accountant who learned to code, or an engineer who learned accounting. Both are judged on the same practical test.

 - Hands-on experience building automations with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript (either is fine)

 - Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, with solid engineering basics, shipping working scripts and agents

 - Ability to run local scripts and schedule jobs (cron, task schedulers or CI pipelines)

 - Strong knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP, shown by ACCA, ACA, CPA or equivalent, or by several years of hands-on accounting experience

 - Experience with core processes: AP, AR, bank reconciliation, month-end close

 - Comfort working with APIs and MCP servers, CSV/Excel data and basic SQL

 - Care for accuracy, controls and audit trails


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in multi-entity or multi-currency environments, including intercompany and consolidation

 - Experience reconciling payment processor statements across multiple jurisdictions and currencies

 - Experience with shared cost services that invoice group companies, including complex expense splits and automated invoice generation

 - Experience with an ERP and its API (which ERP does not matter)

 - Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool use and MCP servers

 - Knowledge of VAT/GST and e-invoicing rules in several jurisdictions

 - Experience with Git, testing and basic cloud deployment

 - Prior experience in a finance transformation or accounting operations team

 - Additional languages, where our entities operate in non-English markets


LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. 

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. 

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. 

 - Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. 

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to take full ownership of paid social acquisition for one of our products. Meta, Snapchat and TikTok are key channels for our product, alongside other paid social networks. This is a senior, hands-on media buying role with end-to-end ownership. You will own the whole paid social acquisition process: strategy, account structure, bidding, budget allocation, creative testing, measurement, scaling and account health. You decide what to test, what to scale and what to cut, and you are accountable for the results. We need someone who has scaled paid social at volume, who knows how to grow in a policy-sensitive niche, and who can operate independently on large budgets.

You will manage performance against real revenue data (CPA, ROAS, payback, LTV and cohorts), not surface-level platform metrics. We also work AI-first, and we expect you to use Claude and automation to move faster.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the process end-to-end: take full ownership of paid social acquisition across TikTok, Meta, Snapchat and other paid social networks: planning, launch, optimization, scaling, reporting and documentation.

 - Lead on TikTok: own and scale TikTok as the primary acquisition channel, including account structure, campaign types (including Smart+ / automated formats and Spark Ads), bidding, optimization events and creative strategy.

 - Scale spend profitably while holding payback, ROAS and CPA targets based on real revenue and customer-value data.

 - Build and optimize account structure, conversion events, value-based bidding and budget allocation across paid social networks.

 - Decide budget allocation across TikTok, Meta, Snapchat and other paid social networks, and find new scaling levers: audiences, formats, placements, campaign types and additional networks.

 - Run a structured, high-velocity creative testing process with the creative team on all networks, with clear hypotheses and kill/scale rules.

 - Manage signal quality: conversion events, event value, purchase optimization and attribution.

 - Operate in a policy-sensitive niche: run acquisition within each platform's rules. Keep ads compliant, handle disapprovals, appeals and restrictions, and build prevention-first processes so issues are caught before launch.

 - Protect account health: manage ad account structure, backups and recovery plans.

 - Work with platform reps on betas, new campaign types and escalations.

 - Diagnose drops and spikes quickly and act on them.

 - Document tests, learnings and playbooks, and use Claude and automation to speed up builds, QA, reporting and optimization.


QUALIFICATIONS


MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of hands-on paid social / user acquisition experience.

 - Large-scale experience running paid social acquisition.

 - Proven experience working in policy-sensitive niches and keeping accounts healthy while scaling.

 - Strong hands-on TikTok, Meta and Snapchat Ads experience, scaling them profitably.

 - Working experience across other paid social channels is a plus.

 - Direct ownership of large budgets, ideally $1M+/month hands-on.

 - Strong understanding of subscription / app economics: LTV, ROAS, payback windows, cohorts, high-value-user dynamics and value-based optimization.

 - Deep policy and account health experience: disapprovals, appeals, restrictions, ad account bans and how to recover from and prevent them.

 - Strong creative testing discipline and measurement rigor.

 - Ownership mentality: you run channels end-to-end with minimal supervision and take responsibility for outcomes.

 - Run deployments through a sandbox with documented change control.

Make it self-serving (~15%)

 - Document every flow, rule and integration so nothing lives in one person's head.

 - Reduce request volume at the source: self-serve options, better defaults, smarter guardrails.

 - Use AI tools (e.g. Claude with Salesforce access) to automate hygiene checks and repetitive admin work.

 - Scope larger projects and manage external Salesforce developers when work goes beyond in-house capacity.

Talent Centre of Excellence
LDC’s Talent Centre of Excellence is undergoing a transformational process, embarking on an exciting journey towards building a Talent and Learning ecosystem that will further support and enable our people development and LDC’s business results. The Talent CoE is spearheading a series of strategic initiatives which will evolve the Learning and Talent landscape of our organization; aiming high towards the creation of a companywide Learning culture to reinforce and support existing and future key Business and HR priorities.
This is an expert role within LDC’s Talent CoE that focuses on Learning advisory, learning need analysis and Learning product development as well as stakeholder management, reporting and analysis, financial management, and operational support for strategic learning initiatives.
You will be reporting to the Head of Learning, and will collaborate with a wide group of Learning, Talent and HR Professionals and the Business.
Main Responsibilities

• Support the Head of Learning in driving the Learning strategy and organizational Learning agenda.

• Key account manager for the assigned business units for all Learning activities

• Collaborate with business stakeholders and HRBPs to commonly identify impactful Learning solutions and products for all LDC’s business units connected with business KPI’s, needs and aspirations.

• Be a reference point for learning topics, latest research, market trends, tools and methodologies.

• Senior learning advisor for the business on Learning needs assessment, skills & competencies analysis and active contributor in setting capability plans and Learning curriculum.

• Project, Program and Product Development manager to drive, supervise and deliver Learning products and Solutions – actively collaborate with the Learning Solutions Manager to develop inclusive and holistic products integrating Learning Experience.

• Learning program manager for high level transversal organizational competencies (Digitalization, Sustainability, Innovation, Customer Centricity)

• Drive the measurement of Learning (R.O.I, R.O.E., application of learning) through a set of defined metrics.

• Create and update the Learning calendar and curriculum for the assigned internal clients.

• Support change management activities, advocate, and promote LDC’s learning culture.

• Actively participate in internal Learning communities and communities of practice by sharing experience and latest research.

Experience

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role or more than 8 years in an expert L&D role with a track record of successfully advising business on Learning products and services.

• Demonstrated experience in Learning Functions: needs detection, content curation and learning architecture, competencies, learning operations, authoring tools, kickstarting and managing initiatives. Other talent focused experience is a plus.

• Depth of experience in Online Instructional Designing, Learning Architecture, Digital Learning Platforms and Technology Enhanced Learning is a must.

• A focused driver with a solution orientated approach and ability to deliver business centric outcomes

• Passionate about online solutions development to meet stakeholders needs, strong communicator, structured yet flexible, with ability to plan and prioritize.

• Excellent project and program management skills and orientation for developing high quality products in a timely manner.

• Excellent Communication Skills, Stakeholder Management and Internal Customer oriented: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively engage with stakeholders at various levels. Significant experience with cross functional and cross-country collaboration.

• Strong Analytical and Data Management Skills: Ability to analyze data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions to enhance learning programs.

• Active researcher and advisor for new Online training trends, methodologies, tools, providers….to support both our business stakeholders.

Other skills

• MS Office proficient, especially in SharePoint and Excel

• Technology Savvy

• HRIS, LMS, LXP Knowledge. Knowledge on Workday, SSFF, Percipio, Degreed, or similar is a plus.

• Content Design, instructional Design, Learning Architecture knowledge.

• Online tools management as: Author tools, Gamification, video editors, infographics

• High level of proficiency in networking & connecting internally and externally

• Facilitation, training and/or consultancy experience a strong plus

Languages:

• Proficient in English

• Other languages additional: Spanish and/or Brazilian Portuguese

Academics

• Bachelor's degree in business management or HR/Education or any related field

• International matrix organizations

postings.title: Responsable Regional Comercial de Acopios
postings.descriptionText:
El/la Origination Manager lidera y coordina la compra de G&O a productores y ventas de insumos, garantizando competitividad. Brinda liderazgo al equipo de originación de la región, promoviendo un servicio al cliente de excelencia y construyendo relaciones sólidas y sostenibles. Aporta su experiencia técnica como parte del equipo de liderazgo en una región, oficina o instalación determinada. Principal responsable de PnL y resultados integrales de la región asignada.
Responsabilidades claves:

• Formación e Implementación de Estrategia: Desarrolla planes tácticos para optimizar los recursos y activos dentro de su área o region.

• Liderazgo: Lidera el plan de acción de la región y lo vincula con la estrategia de originación y la misión organizacional. Motiva al equipo para alcanzar los objetivos de negocio.

• Gestión de Stakeholders: Diseña y planifica actividades de relacionamiento para asegurar la identificación y atención de necesidades clave.

• Cumplimiento Operativo: Monitorea el desempeño y las conductas del equipo para identificar y resolver incumplimientos de políticas y normativas.

• Gestión de Riesgos: Identifica riesgos, dependencias y restricciones en el negocio, proponiendo e implementando soluciones adecuadas. Aprueba línea de créditos con el limite definido.

• Desarrollo Comercial: Monitorear los principales indicadores de desempeño (KPIs) y aplicar herramientas de datos y soluciones digitales para soportar la toma de decisiones, la mejora continua y la adopción de procesos de CRM y gestión de territorios.

• Gestión de cartera de Clientes: Liderar y gestiona nivel de cobertura y penetración en el territorio de su región. Equilibrar las carteras de clientes entre los miembros de sus equipos garantizando la mejor llegada de la propuesta de valor de la compañía.

• Gestión del Desempeño: Establece objetivos de rendimiento, evalúa desempeño individual y de equipo, y aplica acciones correctivas cuando corresponde.

• Gestión del Talento: Contribuye al diseño e implementación de procesos de performance y desarrollo del talento.

• Gestión de imagen corporativa del activo: Asegura el mantenimiento y las condiciones adecuadas de las instalaciones, vehículos y elementos de trabajo del acopio, garantizando una imagen corporativa consistente en interacciones con clientes, eventos y visitas.

Comportamientos esperados:

• Análisis profundo de situaciones complejas desde múltiples perspectivas.

• Alto entendimiento del negocio, los drivers del mercado y alineación estratégica.

• Compromiso con los resultados propios y del equipo.

• Fomento de la colaboración y la escucha activa, tanto interna como externamente.

• Gestión eficiente de recursos múltiples en paralelo.

• Foco en resultados, incluso en contextos adversos.

• Mejora continua de procesos y resolución de fallas.

• Promotores del cambio

• Dominio de datos financieros y uso para la toma de decisiones.

• Valentía para enfrentar temas críticos y promover conversaciones difíciles.

• Planificación anticipada, alineación entre equipos y gestión de contingencias.

• Construcción activa de redes dentro y fuera de la organización.

Educación requerida: Título universitario o formación equivalente.

postings.title: Senior Solution / Product Specialist – SAP PP & QM
postings.descriptionText:
Estamos en búsqueda de un(a) especialista senior en SAP PP y QM para actuar como referente técnico y funcional de los procesos de Planificación y Calidad, con una fuerte interacción con el negocio y participación activa en iniciativas globales de SAP S/4HANA.
Como Senior Solution Specialist SAP PP/QM , serás el/la responsable de la solución , con una visión end-to-end de los procesos y su integración con todo el ecosistema SAP.

• Actuar como punto focal de los módulos SAP PP y QM, incluyendo la integración con MM, IM y otros flujos.

• Traducir las necesidades del negocio en soluciones SAP robustas y escalables.

• Diseñar procesos cross-funcionales, garantizando alineación con la estrategia de la compañía.

• Definir estándares, buenas prácticas, lineamientos e impactos sistémicos.

• Asegurar el mantenimiento, la evolución y la estabilidad de los procesos bajo tu responsabilidad.

2. Socio(a) estratégico(a) del negocio & mejora continua

• Gestionar la relación con las áreas para definir prioridades y generar valor.

• Trabajar con KPIs e indicadores medibles, asegurando visibilidad y desempeño.

• Elaborar y liderar planes de acción para mejoras continuas y resolución de incidentes recurrentes.

• Colaborar con otros dominios para garantizar el diseño end-to-end de las soluciones.

3. Proyecto global SAP S/4HANA

• Participar en el roadmap global de SAP S/4HANA.

• Formar parte de un proyecto global, desde la concepción hasta la entrega de la solución.

• Garantizar que las soluciones implementadas estén alineadas con las mejores prácticas SAP y las necesidades del negocio.

• Experiencia intermedia en SAP IM (Gestión de Inventarios).

• Inglés avanzado.

• Conocimientos mecánicos: transmisiones, izaje, oxicorte/soldadura, bombas, sellos, hidráulica, interpretación de planos y reductores.

Un entorno multicultural, dinámico y desafiante, que ampliará y desarrollará sus capacidades y canalizará sus habilidades y experiencia con excelentes oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, en una de las companías mas sólidas a nivel global.

-Salario y Beneficios Competitivos.

-Programa de Salud y Bienestar.
-Licencia por Maternidad y Paternidad Extendida.

Diversidad & Inclusión
LDC se rige por un conjunto de valores compartidos, elevadas normas éticas, y la diversidad y la inclusión forman parte de nuestro ADN. LDC es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a proporcionar un entorno de trabajo que adopte y valore la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión.

LDC fomenta la diversidad, apoya a las comunidades locales y las iniciativas medioambientales. Animamos a personas de todos los orígenes a presentar su candidatura.

postings.descriptionText:
Propósito: El/la Director/a de A&B es responsable de desarrollar e implementar una estrategia para cumplir el objetivo de incrementar las ventas, y también es responsable de la operación integral de Alimentos y Bebidas y de su equipo.
Descripción del puesto: El/la Director/a de A&B es responsable de brindar dirección a todos los departamentos operativos de alimentos y bebidas, que incluyen Banquetes, Restaurante, Servicio a la habitación. El/la Director/a de A&B es responsable de enfocarse continuamente en alcanzar la rentabilidad del hotel mediante la generación de ingresos y controles de costos efectivos.

Debe alcanzar los objetivos de satisfacción de huéspedes y las metas de satisfacción de los miembros del equipo. Además, es responsable de desarrollar y capacitar a los gerentes y supervisores operativos de A&B, analizar las tendencias actuales y realizar las recomendaciones correspondientes. El/la Director/a de A&B contribuye a la planificación y al desarrollo general del negocio del hotel.
Responsabilidades clave:
▪ Supervisa las actividades operativas del Restaurante, Bar, Servicio a la habitación, Banquetes.
▪ Desarrolla todos los presupuestos, pronósticos y cronogramas en línea con el plan de negocios del hotel.
▪ Implementa lineamientos, políticas y procedimientos para dichos departamentos operativos.
▪ Guía las operaciones y establece un ambiente de trabajo que permita alcanzar metas y objetivos.
▪ Gestiona los problemas de desempeño que surjan dentro de los respectivos departamentos operativos.
▪ Forma parte integral del equipo de negocios, asiste a todas las reuniones programadas y contribuye activamente con la preparación adecuada.
▪ Entrevista, selecciona, capacita, evalúa, acompaña, asesora y aplica medidas disciplinarias a los empleados/gerentes del departamento, de acuerdo con los estándares de la compañía.
▪ Se comunica de manera efectiva con los miembros del equipo.
▪ Realiza una reunión informativa diaria con los miembros del equipo sobre las actividades clave vigentes.
▪ Evalúa los cambios en las necesidades de los huéspedes, la composición de los huéspedes y el mercado competitivo, para recomendar los cambios adecuados en productos/servicios y operaciones, según sea necesario.
▪ Garantiza la satisfacción de huéspedes y empleados, manteniendo al mismo tiempo la competitividad en el mercado y un desempeño financiero excepcional.
▪ Anticipa y aborda las situaciones de los huéspedes y establece procesos proactivos para promover su satisfacción.
▪ Inspira a todo el personal del hotel a alcanzar niveles de desempeño propios del segmento de lujo.
▪ Interactúa de manera positiva con otros departamentos para asegurar una experiencia de lujo para el huésped.

▪ Debe ser ejemplo de los Valores Sofitel, de los estándares de la marca y promotor/a de las pautas de presencia e imagen personal.

postings.title: Copy of Enterprise Architect – Banking (Relocation to Spain)
postings.descriptionText:
About the role
We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to join a strategic architecture and transformation initiative within Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) .
In this role, you will work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to define target architectures, assess complex technology landscapes, and drive strategic decisions around applications, platforms, data, integration and modernization.
This is a hands-on architecture role . We are looking for someone who can analyse complex environments, challenge existing approaches, develop target-state options and turn architectural decisions into clear, actionable recommendations.
What will you do?

• Define decision-ready reference and target architectures for priority CIB capabilities, including capability decomposition, target building blocks, architecture principles, data and integration patterns, and transition considerations.

• Work closely with CIOs, Domain Technology Heads and senior business stakeholders , challenging existing architectures, inherited constraints, local variations and investment assumptions.

• Analyse current application and platform landscapes to identify duplication, fragmentation, obsolescence, dependencies, risks and opportunities for consolidation .

• Translate architecture decisions into clear application-level recommendations, such as adopt, consolidate, migrate, selectively invest, contain or retire , including dependencies and transition sequencing.

• Assess buy, build and reuse alternatives, evaluating market maturity, comparable CIB adoption, integration fit, vendor lock-in and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

• Prepare and lead architecture decision forums and domain working groups , presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations, required decisions and open dependencies.

• Assess EUCs (End User Computing) and AI-enabled local solutions within the target architecture, defining appropriate classification, controls, ownership and transition paths.

• Translate architecture decisions into fundable initiatives , contributing to preliminary business cases, expected benefits, complexity assessments, risks and investment planning.

• Collaborate with global and cross-domain teams to ensure alignment between strategic architecture and business transformation objectives.

What are we looking for?
Mandatory requirements:

• 8+ years of professional experience in technology architecture, enterprise architecture or technology transformation.

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in CIB / Wholesale Banking . Experience in this sector is mandatory.

• Proven experience defining reference architectures, target architectures and/or transition states in complex technology environments.

• Experience in at least one of the following areas:
• Application landscape rationalization

• Platform consolidation

• Technology modernization

• Strong understanding of current-to-target assessments and their implications across areas such as:
• Applications

• Data

• Integration

• Cloud

• Resilience

• Cybersecurity

• Ability to engage with senior technology and business stakeholders , constructively challenge existing approaches and clearly communicate architectural recommendations.

• English: minimum B2 level, ideally C1 , with professional fluency in both written and spoken English. You will be required to prepare and present recommendations, lead meetings and collaborate with global stakeholders.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field .

Nice to have

• Strong knowledge of a major CIB domain or transversal technology platform .

• Experience leading global or cross-domain transformation initiatives .

• Experience assessing buy / build / reuse alternatives, market solutions and TCO.

• Experience working with large-scale application portfolios and producing decision-ready architecture materials.

• MBA or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Technology Management or a related field .

What do we offer you?

• Full-time and permanent employment contract.

• Hybrid role based in Madrid.

• Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities

• Possibility to join a multicultural team & work in the international environment

• Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing: private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and transport card as part of the flexible remuneration pack, and online language classes

postings.title: Encargado de Abastecimiento
postings.descriptionText:
Gestión de Inventarios y Abastecimiento

• Responsable por los niveles de stock de materias primas, materiales de empaque y repuestos en planta y depósitos externos a su cargo.

• Asegurar el equilibrio entre disponibilidad de materiales y nivel de inventario.

• Analizar y gestionar el aging de stock (antigüedad).

• Identificar stock de baja rotación, fecha corta y excesos.

• Proponer acciones correctivas junto a Planificación y Compras.

• Alinear el abastecimiento con las necesidades de producción.

• Mantener las recepciones de órdenes de compra de materiales de packaging, repuestos y materias primas al día.

• Mantener el stock en transito al día (pedidos traslados UB-SAP).

• Informar el consumo del stock de graneles de forma semanal a Producción.

• Realizar inventarios de stock cíclicos de Materias primas y materiales de packaging.

• Liderar las tareas adicionales del área de forma metódica: Disoluciones, Fraccionamientos, Retiros de Scrap, carga de camiones de fertilizantes, generación de SOLPED del área, etc.

Gestión Operativa en SAP

• Uso de MB52, MB51, MB5T, MBLB.

• Seguimiento con ME2N y VL06I.

• Control de movimientos 101 / 261 / 201 / 311 / 701 / 702.

• Análisis de diferencias de inventario y causa raíz.

Gestión de Indicadores (KPIs)

• Nivel de servicio (Fecha de 311 vs fecha de reserva de producción)

• Días de cobertura de Stock según consumo histórico

• % vencimiento del stock

• Reporte de diferencias generadas mensual

• Demora de recepciones-VL06I

Formación:

• Secundario técnico completo; o en su defecto idoneidad acreditada y validada en la función por el Jefe de Logística y/o el Gerente de Operaciones.

Experiencia y Conocimientos:

• Tener 4/5 años de experiencia en mandos medios Abastecimiento en empresas de nivel medio, preferentemente del rubro alimenticio, habiendo estado involucrado en tareas de gestión de stock.

• Conocimiento de normas y procedimientos de Calidad, Seguridad e Higiene y Medio Ambiente;

• Conocimiento sobre Norma ISO 9001.

• Conocimiento sobre Norma ISO 14001.

• Acción en caso de derrames y manipulación de productos químicos.

• Requisito excluyente: Dominio de SAP, módulo IM/MM.

• Manejo del paquete Office acreditando al menos nivel intermedio.

• BPM y prerrequisitos específicos a su área (PPR).

• Aplicación práctica de HACCP: monitoreo, límites críticos, acciones correctivas.

• Procedimientos y registros de calidad e inocuidad (checklists, inspecciones, trazabilidad).

• Controles de autenticidad de insumos y vigilancia en puntos sensibles (fraude y defensa).

• Experiencia en gestión de inventarios ABC.

• Gestión de reportes y seguimiento de gestión basados en datos.

postings.title: Supervisor de Mantenimiento
postings.descriptionText:
Principales Responsabilidades:

• Supervisión y control de los mantenimientos que se encuentran bajo la responsabilidad directa e indirecta de los operadores de mantenimiento a su cargo.

• Responsable de la verificación del equipo, sus dispositivos de seguridad, asegúrese de que la persona interesada obtenga y firme el permiso de trabajo antes del inicio de la actividad.

• Control del nivel de calidad de los trabajos de mantenimientos realizados a las líneas de producción, elaboración, fermentación, enfriamiento, servicios y secado.

• Responsable de llevar el programa de mantenimiento de la producción y de todos los equipos que intervienen.

• Responsable de realizar Mantenimiento Preventivo para eliminar los riesgos de seguridad (protección de la máquina, LOTO, ruido...)

• Responsable de la calidad y autocontroles de los procesos bajo su responsabilidad directa (control, seguimiento del proceso y rúbricas de documentos de control).

• Advierte y denuncia desvíos reales, eventuales o posibles relacionados a Inocuidad y realiza las acciones necesarias para corregirla y prevenirla.

• Detecta y reporta cualquier tipo de anomalía en el taller y en el producto.

• Controla el llenado completo y correcto de los documentos de seguimiento de proceso de mantenimiento.

• Verificación de las correctas condiciones de provisión de repuestos, herramientas, servicios, lubricación y uso adecuado de los mismos.

• Asiste a producción, realiza las intervenciones y verifica su cumplimiento y resultado.

• Reporte diario de novedades sobre el personal de turno a sus superiores.

• Efectúa la capacitación del personal de turno de los talleres a su cargo y garantiza la formación en seguridad de los operarios de mantenimiento.

• Organiza reuniones formales de seguridad para los empleados de mantenimiento en su área de responsabilidad.

• Responsable de cumplir y hacer cumplir las normas de calidad, seguridad e higiene, inocuidad, procedimientos de accidentes y reglamento interno al personal a su cargo y a toda persona que ingrese a los talleres.

• Responsable por el cumplimiento de los procedimientos vigentes y por el llenado de los formularios correspondientes.

• Responsable de los cumplimientos de los programas de mantenimientos de cañerías, tanques y edilicios.

• Organiza, coordina y da seguimiento a las actividades de los contratistas.

• Forma parte de la implementación de la norma de seguridad (procedimientos críticos).

Formación:

• Especialización Electromecánico, Mecánico, Electrónico o Electricista o en su defecto idoneidad en la función acreditada ante la Jefatura de Mantenimiento e Ingeniería.

• Conocimiento básico de ISO 14001. Normas de manejo y almacenamiento de químicos. Normas de gestión de residuos industriales. Normas de gestión de derrames.

• Conocimiento en normas de Calidad e Inocuidad, FSSC 22000.

Experiencia y Conocimientos:

• Tres años de experiencia en empresas de alimentación (deseable).

• Buen nivel de comunicación y autonomía.

• Conocimiento de higiene en procesos alimenticios. Manejo de PC.

• Conocimiento de Norma de inocuidad

• Normas básicas de seguridad en Industria (EPP, orden y limpieza, etc.).

• Lectura y comprensión de una Hoja Tecnica / de seguridad.

postings.title: Coordinador Técnico Industrial - Rubro Panificación
postings.descriptionText:
Principales Responsabilidades:

• Su visión global de mercado deberá permitir un mapeo de los fabricantes industriales existente en el mercado Argentino.

• Proporcionar asistencia técnica, cursos y demostraciones a los diferentes Clientes Claves, Panificadoras Industriales y Molinos mediante sus conocimientos técnicos tanto en campo como en el Baking Center.

• Planear y efectúar ensayos de panificación del poder fermentativo de la levadura, pruebas de panificaciones necesarias, mediante un protocolo para el lanzamiento de nuevos productos y/o mejoramiento de los actuales, así como de la familia de aditivos, premezclas, masas madres y/o productos de derivados y/o molinería.

• Efectúar pruebas de control, Benchmarking de nuestros productos, como los de nuestra competencia para poder analizar el rendimiento en las principales aplicaciones industriales. Confecciona informes de resultados y presentaciones internas al departamento comercial y/o técnico.

• Preparar y emitir reportes sobre sus actividades y sobre las actividades y operaciones realizadas en campo y/o Baking Center, con la frecuencia y forma que le soliciten sus superiores.

• Prestar atención a las novedades del mercado (productos, promociones, técnicas, etc.)

• Buscar oportunidades de negocio en nuevos clientes y Cuentas Clave buscando Mejora Continua en sus procesos y productos con el fin de afianzar la posición del grupo en el mercado.

• Realizar la preparación de muestras, análisis de datos utilizando herramientas estadísticas y toda actividad relacionada con las degustaciones de los paneles sensoriales.

• Crear de una fuerte relación con los decisores técnicos del cliente, a través de visitas, recepciones en el BC local/regional o Corporativo, pero también a través de diversas herramientas de comunicación (participación en seminarios, redacción de artículos técnicos, etc.)

• Ser capaz de alimentar técnicamente a sus interlocutores, manteniéndose informado de la legislación vigente a nivel local y regional, mantenerse al día con los nuevos lanzamientos a nivel de grupo, manteniendo su nivel técnico de ingredientes y procesos a través de los vínculos creados con fabricantes de equipos locales, escuelas y universidades.

• Realizar visitas de seguimiento, para fidelización del cliente, e identificación de nuevas oportunidades.

Formación:

• Universitario (ingeniero o Lic. bioquímico o en alimentos, químico, o equivalente) o idoneidad acreditada o aprobada por el Gerente de Asistencia Técnica Regional

Experiencia:

• 5 años en la industria panadera, de aditivos y/o ingredientes o molinera EXCLUYENTE .

Conocimientos:

• Buen conocimiento de técnicas y equipamientos de la industria panadera.

• Conocimientos sobre aditivos y/o ingredientes en empresas del ramo y/o industrias alimenticias.

• Conocimiento de Buenas Prácticas de Manufacturas.

Habilidades Técnicas:

• Experiencia en área de I+D, relacionada a los aditivos de la industria y molinería EXCLUYENTE .

postings.title: Head of Global Events and Travel (100% REMOTE)
postings.descriptionText:
The Head of Global Events & Travel leads the strategy, governance, and execution of our global events and corporate travel function. This role oversees three interconnected areas:

• Flagship, VIP, High-Complexity & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events (client and client’s customers events, executive dinners, and high-touch VIP gatherings);

• Internal Meetings & Corporate Travel (global gatherings, executive offsites, collaborators travel program); and

• Dedicated Financial Control & Commercial Management .

The Head is accountable for the full events and corporate travel portfolio, consolidated budgets, strategic supplier agreements, service standards, and duty-of-care governance. Serving both internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, prospects, and partners), the Head sets priorities, builds team capability, and manages major commercial decisions and C-level/client escalations. Financial oversight is supported by the Event & Travel Finance Lead in alignment with central Corporate FP&A.

A key initial priority is leading the implementation and transition to our enhanced travel operating model. Once established, the Head provides oversight through periodic performance reviews and exception management, delegating routine operations to the team and Travel Management Companies (TMCs).

Responsibilities

• Function Leadership: Lead and develop the Team. Recruit open roles, establish team cadence, and build capabilities across the function. Strategic resource planning across agencies, production vendors, and internal talent to execute both internal and client-facing events seamlessly.

• Flagship, VIP & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events: Execute on objectives, budgets, and brand standards set by C-Level leadership for 5,000-attendee conference, VIP executive receptions, and regional customer summits. Manage delivery through the internal Team, supported by event specialists and external agencies. Lead venue selection, production, security, contract negotiations, and attendee experience for both internal and external audiences.

• Internal Meetings & Offsites: Oversee the internal gathering strategy and delivery. Standardize playbooks for routine company meetings and regional leadership offsites.

• Travel Operating Model Transition: Lead the implementation of our approved global travel operating model, including RFPs and contracts for multi-region TMCs, unified policy and expense frameworks, approvals, reconciliation, and dual quoting. Coordinate phased migration corridor-by-corridor, validate vendor acceptance, protect service continuity, and establish an operational handover once stable.

• Corporate Travel Oversight: Own global travel strategy, master agreements, and major operational escalations. Oversee daily fulfillment, group flights, hotel blocks, rebooking, and high-touch support for executives, clients, and guest speakers managed by TMCs and the Travel & Logistics Coordinator.

• Budget Accountability & Resource Stewardship: Own the consolidated events and travel budget, as well as revenue/cost-recovery models for sponsored or client-facing events. Act as a steward of company resources, prioritizing expenditure against strategic business objectives, maximizing ROI on client events, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and escalating forecast overruns early with mitigation plans.

• Financial Governance & Client Billing: Work through the Team to manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, vendor deposits, event ledgers, cross-charging/client billing, invoice reconciliation, and post-event financial reviews. Maintain strict approval thresholds, separation of duties, purchase orders, payment terms, and international VAT/GST recovery.

• Strategic Suppliers & Commercial Partnerships: Lead major RFPs and negotiations with TMCs, airlines, hotel chains, event venues, registration platforms, and production partners. Maintain competitive discipline, set service expectations, and delegate routine vendor management while remaining the key point of contact for material escalations.

• Policy, Duty of Care & Risk Management: Own the global events and travel policy. Establish traveler assistance, emergency response, data privacy, and incident escalation frameworks in coordination with People Ops, Legal, IT, and Security, ensuring comprehensive coverage for collaborators, clients, and external VIP guests.

• Cross-Functional & Client Partnership: Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on client event revenue targets, sponsorships, client experience, and commercial outcomes. Collaborate with C-Level executives on internal event agendas, keynotes, and executive participation. Partner with Finance, Legal, and People Ops to streamline global delivery.

• Events & Travel Leadership: 8+ years leading corporate events and managed travel programs, including 3+ years leading a global function in a fast-growing, international environment.

• Client & Internal Event Expertise: Proven track record running both internal company meetings/offsites and high-impact, client- or customer-facing events (e.g., user conferences, client advisory boards, sponsored summits, roadshows).

• Large-Scale Event Execution: Proven experience directing large conferences (5,000+ attendees) end-to-end, covering budgets, venue sourcing, registration tech, production, speaker/VIP management, and vendor teams.

• Travel Program Transformation: Hands-on experience implementing or re-platforming corporate travel frameworks (TMC selections, booking/expense integrations, phased migrations, and duty-of-care rollouts). Multi-TMC or hybrid experience preferred.

• Travel Industry & Commercial Fluency: Strong understanding of airline/hotel distribution economics (GDS, NDC, dynamic pricing, corporate direct programs) and commercial contracting for high-value event venues and suppliers.

postings.descriptionText:
About the Job:

We are seeking a highly driven Head of Financial Infrastructure Expansion to develop strategic solutions for banks, financial institutions, fintechs, payment companies, telcos, and large enterprises, institutions, governments globally .

The role will act as a key bridge between major external partners and Tether’s different business and product teams , leveraging capabilities across stablecoins, wallets, tokenization, payments, and other Tether’s solutions to design tailored financial infrastructure solutions.

This is a hands-on role combining deep financial knowledge, strong commercial capabilities, and the ability to connect multiple technologies and teams into compelling solutions . You will identify opportunities, structure complex projects, coordinate internal stakeholders, close strategic partnerships, and build the team required to scale the function globally.

Responsibilities:

Business Development & Solution Structuring

• Identify strategic opportunities with banks, fintechs, payment companies, telcos, financial institutions, retailers and large enterprises globally .

• Understand customers needs and design tailored solutions leveraging the broader Tether ecosystem .

• Combine capabilities across stablecoins, wallets, tokenization, payments, and other products into compelling commercial propositions.

• Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close high-value strategic partnerships and deployments.

• Nurture current and build new relationships with CEOs, CFOs, CTOs, banking executives, treasury leaders, payment teams, and other senior stakeholders.

Cross-Team Coordination & Execution

• Act as the bridge between customers, external implementation partners and Tether’s internal product and business teams .

• Bring together the right capabilities and stakeholders to design and execute complex, multi-product projects.

• Translate market and customer requirements into actionable opportunities for internal teams.

• Own strategic projects from initial engagement through structuring, execution, and scale

• Monitor the success of the project post implementation using select KPIs

Market Strategy & Team Leadership

• Define priority markets, industries, partners, and financial infrastructure use cases.

• Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic opportunities.

• Build and lead the Financial Infrastructure Expansion team globally .

• Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

• Work closely with Tether’s regional Expansion teams to identify and accelerate opportunities.

• Identify the best implementation partner to ensure successful execution of the projects

Strategic Representation

• Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations building the next generation of financial products and infrastructure .

• Represent Tether in strategic meetings with major enterprises, financial institutions, governments, regulators, and industry leaders.

• 7+ years of experience across banking, payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or technology business development .

• Strong understanding of payments, digital assets, wallets, tokenization, settlement, and financial infrastructure .

• Proven ability to understand complex customer needs and translate them into multi-product solutions .

• Tangible experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large strategic partnerships.

• Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across banks, financial institutions, fintechs, telcos, and large enterprises.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Strong ability to work across different product, technical, commercial, legal, and regulatory teams.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and experience building and managing high-performing teams.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

- Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android

- Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

About the job
Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com

Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
Learn more about Keet: keet.io

Responsibilities
In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

• Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.

• Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).

• Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.

• Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.

• Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.

• Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).

• Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.

• Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.

• Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).

• Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

• Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

• Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

• Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

• Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

• Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

• Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.
