You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

• Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

postings.title: Product Engineering Lead (QVAC) (100% remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.
We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.
The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

• Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

• Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

• Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Mandatory:

• Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

• Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

• Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

• You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

• Deep JavaScript and React .

• Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

• Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source .

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All…

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

• Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

• Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

• Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

• Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

• Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

• Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

• Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

• Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

• Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

• Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

• Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

• Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

• Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

• Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

• Deep JavaScript and React.

• Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

• Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

• Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

• Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

• Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

• Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

About the job
We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

• Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.

• Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.

• Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case

• Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.

• Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.

• Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.

• Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

• Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.

• Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.

• Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.

• Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.

• Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

• Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.

• Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.

• Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

• Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

• Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.

• Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

You Have

• 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.

• Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.

• Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.

• Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Experience building and managing high-performing teams.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-moving environments.

• Crypto, digital assets, or stablecoin experience is a plus, but not required .

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

• Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

• Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

• Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

• Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

• Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

• Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

• Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

• 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

postings.title: Credit Lead (Underwriter)-fintech & payments expertise
postings.descriptionText:
The role:
Tether Capital is launching a new credit vertical focused on providing short-term liquidity and credit facilities to fintech companies, payment providers, exchanges, and other financial institutions.

We are looking for a Credit Lead (underwriter) focused on institutional lending and liquidity to join this new initiative and help build the credit function from the ground up.
This is a hands-on role for someone with strong experience in credit underwriting and structuring, who is comfortable assessing businesses, making credit recommendations, and developing the policies and processes needed to support a growing lending platform.

Key Responsibilities:

• Underwrite and structure credit facilities, including revolving credit facilities, working capital loans, and liquidity facilities.

• Analyse companies' financial statements, cash flows, liquidity position and repayment capacity.

• Determine appropriate lending amounts, terms, covenants, security, and other risk protections.

• Develop credit policies, underwriting guidelines, templates, and concentration limits from scratch.

• Monitor credit risk and borrower performance and establish appropriate risk-monitoring processes.

• Support the development and scaling of the new credit business.

Requirements:

• 10+ years of relevant credit experience.

• Strong experience in credit underwriting and structuring , rather than purely credit analysis.

• Previous experience with fintech & payments is mandatory.

• Background in institutional lending, private credit, venture debt, specialty finance, or a similar environment.

• Experience establishing or developing credit policies, processes, or risk frameworks.

• Crypto, digital assets, or stablecoin experience is a plus, but not required .

About the job
As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.
We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

• Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

• Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

• Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

Design Collaboration & Project Management

• Brief designers with complete, unambiguous specs so work is right the first time.

Quality Assurance (Print & Digital)

• Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time.

Event Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure.

• Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events.

• Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones.

Risk & Logistics Ownership

• Keep stakeholders across requesting teams and design aligned with clear, proactive status updates rather than reactive fire drills.

About the job
We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

• Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.

• Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.

• Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case

• Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.

• Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.

• Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.

• Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

• Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.

• Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.

• Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.

• Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.

• Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

• Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.

• Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.

• Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

• Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Design Collaboration & Project Management

• Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time.

• Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure.

• Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events.

• Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones.

• Experience working with law enforcement agencies is highly desirable.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

About the job
We are seeking an Event Design Coordinator to manage the intake, production, and quality assurance of event-related creative requests coming from a wide range of teams across the business. This is a builder-and-gatekeeper role: you'll work hand-in-hand with designers to turn varied, often fast-turnaround requests into flawless deliverables, including booth graphics, signage, decks, digital assets, swag, and invites, while proactively spotting risks (timeline, brand, print spec, or logistical) before they become problems.

We are not looking for someone who simply routes tickets. We're looking for someone who understands both the creative process and the operational realities of live events well enough to catch a misaligned bleed line, a missing dieline, or a vendor deadline that's about to slip, and to fix it before anyone else notices.

• Request Intake & Triage

• Serve as the primary point of contact for event-related creative requests coming from varied teams across Tether.

• Scope each request clearly: deliverable type, format (print vs. digital), quantity, deadline, dimension, venue/vendor constraints, and brand requirements.

• Flag conflicting timelines, unrealistic turnarounds, or missing information immediately, and propose a workable plan rather than waiting to be asked.

Design Collaboration & Project Management

• Brief designers with complete, unambiguous specs so work is right the first time.

• Manage multiple concurrent event workstreams across different teams and deadlines without dropping details.

• Track status across all active requests and proactively surface bottlenecks before they affect the event date.

Quality Assurance (Print & Digital)

• Review every designer deliverable before it goes back to the requesting team, checking brand consistency, copy accuracy, resolution, color mode (CMYK vs. RGB), bleed/trim/safe zones, file formats, and platform specs (e.g., booth panel dimensions, social crop ratios, slide aspect ratios).

• Catch errors that would be costly or embarrassing to fix on-site or post-launch (typos, wrong sizing, low-res exports, broken links, outdated logos).

• Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time.

Event Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure.

• Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events.

• Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones.

Risk & Logistics Ownership

• Anticipate what can go wrong, such as vendor lead times, print production windows, last-minute scope changes, and shipping delays, and build buffer and contingency plans into every project timeline.

• Coordinate with vendors and print/production partners as needed to confirm specs and delivery windows.

About the job
Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.

The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.

This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management-only role.

Responsibilities

Architecture . Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high-level and low-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

Team leadership. Lead and line-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one-to-ones, growth and performance input.

Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer . Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled-job and node-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement. Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

Managed inference at scale. Serving architecture, multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential-compute-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

Observability and operations. Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post-incident review; an on-call model a small team can sustain.

Partners and vendors. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

Internal consumers. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

Hiring . Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

Must have

• Experience. Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Slurm at scale, hands on. Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster…

• Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

• Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

• Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

• Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

• Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.

Mandatory:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

• Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

• Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

• Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

• In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

• Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

About the job
As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in architecture development for cutting-edge models of various scales, including small, large, and multi-modal systems. Your work will enhance intelligence, improve efficiency, and introduce new capabilities to advance the field.
You will have a deep expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) and Multi-Modal architectures, a strong grasp of pre-training optimization, and a hands-on, research-driven approach. Your mission is to explore and implement novel techniques and algorithms that lead to groundbreaking advancements: multi-modal data curation and alignment, strengthening baselines, and identifying and resolving existing pre-training bottlenecks to push the limits of cross-modal AI performance.

Responsibilities

• Large-Scale Pre-Training: Conduct foundational pre-training for LLMs and Multi-Modal models (integrating text, vision, audio, or other modalities) on large, distributed servers equipped with multi-nodes & thousands of NVIDIA GPUs.

• Architecture & Alignment Innovation: Design, prototype, and scale innovative architectures, tokenizers, and cross-modal alignment layers to enhance model intelligence and multi-modal understanding.

• Data Strategy: Source, filter, and curate massive-scale textual and multi-modal datasets, establishing robust data pipelines for efficient pre-training.

• Experimental Research: Independently and collaboratively execute experiments, analyze results, and refine training methodologies for optimal performance and token efficiency.

• Optimization & Debugging: Investigate, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks in model efficiency, computational performance, and multi-modal alignment stability during long training runs.

• System Scalability: Contribute to the advancement of distributed training systems to ensure seamless scalability and hardware efficiency on target platforms.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Hands-on experience contributing to large-scale LLM or Multi-Modal pre-training runs on large, distributed servers equipped with thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, ensuring scalability and impactful advancements in model performance.

• Familiarity and practical experience with large-scale, distributed training frameworks, libraries and tools.

• Deep knowledge of state-of-the-art transformer and non-transformer modifications aimed at enhancing intelligence, efficiency and scalability.

• Strong expertise in PyTorch and Hugging Face libraries with practical experience in model development, continual pretraining, and deployment.

About the job
Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain.

Responsibilities

• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.

• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.

• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.

• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.

About the job
Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain.

Responsibilities

• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.

• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.

• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.

• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.

• Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.

• Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.

• Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.

• Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.

• Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.

• Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.

• Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

• Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).

• Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.

• Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

• Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

• Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

• Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).

• Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.

• Additional languages and willingness to travel to project sites.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.
We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities
Break down the key responsibilities in bullet points. It’s helpful to make them actionable and measurable. This could also be grouped into categories for more complex roles.

• Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

• Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

• Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

• Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

• Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

• Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

• Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

• Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.

List the qualifications, certifications, and experience needed for the role. You can split this into mandatory and preferred sections if needed.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

• Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

• Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

• Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

• Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and…

Your focus is on the runtime: making models load faster, run leaner, and perform well across different hardware. You'll ensure that the inference layer is stable, optimized, and ready for integration with the rest of the stack.
This role is for engineers who want to work close to the metal, enabling private and fast on-device AI without relying on cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• Work on deploying machine learning models to edge devices using the frameworks: llama.cpp, ggml

• Collaborate closely with researchers to assist in coding, training and transitioning models from research to production environments

• Integrate AI features into existing products, enriching them with the latest advancements in machine learning

• Strong programming skills in C++

• Strong experience with Llama.cpp and ggml inference engines, which facilitates the deployment of models to specific GPU architectures

• Experience with any GPU framework between Cuda, Vulkan, Metal, OpenCL

• Good understanding of deep learning concepts and model architectures

• Experience with transformers, LLMs, Diffusion models

• Demonstrated ability to rapidly assimilate new technologies and techniques

• A degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D

• You know how to train/fine-tune a LLM

• You have productionized models

• You have research experience in new model architectures

• You have experience with distributed systems

• Javascript experience

• Demonstrated success leading website and digital products launch, including close collaboration with design and development teams

Queremos que obtengas las herramientas que necesitas para seguir aprendiendo, creciendo, y marcando una diferencia en el mundo. Contamos con áreas de valor para tu crecimiento, tanto profesional como personal. Podrás acceder a exclusivos cursos y certificaciones.

Tendrás un rol clave en el diseño y desarrollo de soluciones end-to-end que van desde la automatización de procesos hasta la construcción de aplicaciones y pipelines de datos. Buscamos un perfil híbrido que combine la capacidad técnica de un desarrollador backend con la visión de un automation engineer, con foco en crear soluciones escalables que impulsen la eficiencia operativa dentro del ecosistema del cliente.

📌 Qué Desafíos Te Esperan:

• Desarrollo de Aplicaciones: Diseñar, construir y desplegar microservicios y aplicaciones dentro de la plataforma interna de desarrollo (IDP), utilizando el stack tecnológico del ecosistema (Go, Java/Spring Boot o Node.js), con manejo de contenedores Docker/Kubernetes y flujos de CI/CD integrados en GitHub.

• Automatización de Procesos: Identificar oportunidades de mejora en procesos operativos y desarrollar flujos automatizados en n8n, conectando APIs internas, servicios del cliente y modelos de lenguaje (LLMs) para resolver problemas de negocio sin necesidad de construir aplicaciones desde cero.

• Integración de APIs y Servicios: Consumir y conectar APIs REST/GraphQL de microservicios internos, manejar autenticación, webhooks y colas de eventos (Pulsar/RabbitMQ) para orquestar flujos de datos y automatizaciones de extremo a extremo.

• Datos y Visualización: Construir y mantener pipelines de datos (Dataflow/Apache Beam) y dashboards en Looker Studio o Tableau, apoyándose en BigQuery y SQL avanzado para transformar datos en insights accionables para el negocio.

• Prompt Engineering e IA: Diseñar prompts efectivos para nodos de LLMs dentro de los flujos automatizados, entendiendo limitaciones, costos y guardrails de seguridad en el uso de modelos como GPT-4o.

• Mejora Continua: Monitorear el impacto real de las soluciones implementadas, detectar errores en ejecuciones (debugging de flows y aplicaciones) y proponer mejoras iterativas con documentación sólida.

📌 Lo que te hará exitoso:

Hard Skills Técnicos:

• Backend: Conocimiento sólido en al menos uno de Go, Java/Spring Boot o Node.js (excluyente)

• Contenedores y orquestación: Familiaridad con Docker y Kubernetes (excluyente)

• APIs: Experiencia consumiendo y desarrollando APIs REST/GraphQL, manejo de autenticación (tokens, OAuth) (excluyente)

• SQL: Dominio intermedio/avanzado para consultas sobre BigQuery u otras bases (excluyente)

• Visualización: Manejo de Looker Studio o Tableau (excluyente)

• Git/GitHub: Flujo de trabajo con CI/CD integrado (excluyente)

• Automatización: Experiencia con herramientas tipo n8n, Make, Zapier o similares (nice to have)

• Python: Para scripts de automatización, limpieza de datos o lógica dentro de nodos (nice to have)

Soft Skills:

• Pensamiento de procesos: capacidad de descomponer un proceso de negocio complejo en pasos discretos, identificar cuellos de botella y proponer soluciones automatizables con criterio propio.

• Adaptabilidad y velocidad de rampa: comodidad para moverse en entornos de alta escala y cambio constante, incorporando nuevas herramientas y contextos sin perder el hilo de los proyectos en curso.

• Debugging metódico y tolerancia a la ambigüedad: capacidad de trazar errores tanto en código tradicional como en flows visuales, manteniendo la calma cuando el problema no tiene una causa obvia al principio.

• Comunicación técnica clara: habilidad para explicar decisiones de arquitectura o limitaciones técnicas a perfiles de negocio, sin asumir que el otro tiene el mismo contexto — y sin sobre-simplificar al punto de perder precisión.

• Colaboración proactiva: iniciativa para levantar la mano cuando algo no está claro, compartir aprendizajes con el equipo y anticipar dependencias antes de que se conviertan en bloqueos.

• Orientación al impacto: foco en que las soluciones lleguen a producción y generen valor real, no solo en que el código funcione localmente. Interés genuino en medir si lo que se construyó movió la aguja.

• Autonomía con criterio: capacidad de avanzar con información incompleta, tomando decisiones razonables y documentándolas, sin necesitar validación en cada paso, pero sabiendo cuándo escalar.

Cloud Native / Kubernetes & IaC Engineer

📋 Descripción del puesto
Buscamos profesionales con experiencia en administración de plataformas de contenedores, Kubernetes, Infraestructura como Código (IaC), GitOps y servicios Cloud Native. La posición tendrá responsabilidad sobre la operación, mantenimiento, automatización, observabilidad y soporte de entornos productivos, incluyendo despliegues, arquitectura IaC, servicios serverless e integraciones nativas de nube.

🎯 Responsabilidades

• Modificar, gestionar y proveer contenedores como servicio / Kubernetes: clases de almacenamiento, balanceo, autoescalado, mapeo de puertos, adición de workers, grupos de nodos, redes virtuales y reajuste de contenedores y volúmenes.

• Gestionar permisos, roles y accesos IAM en servicios de contenedores (EKS, AKS, ECS, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker).

• Operar el ciclo CI/CD mediante la modificación de scripts IaC y variables de entorno en ArgoCD, GIT y Terraform.

• Ejecutar despliegues automatizados vía GitOps.

• Ajustar y gestionar cambios del entorno CI/CD.

• Ejecutar pipelines IaC en entornos de producción y eliminar la deriva (drift) en IaC.

• Gestionar, modificar y desarrollar funciones serverless (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions) y su asociación con otros servicios, incluida la gestión de permisos IAM.

• Gestionar y modificar servicios de orquestación nativos en la nube y su integración con cómputo, red/seguridad, almacenamiento, notificaciones, mensajería y monitoreo.

• Gestionar y modificar servicios de mensajería, incluyendo colas, temas y suscripciones.

• Gestionar copias de seguridad y restaurar configuraciones de contenedores y servicios de orquestación.

• Monitorear los servicios bajo alcance, gestionar incidentes y solicitudes conforme a los procedimientos definidos y dar seguimiento a eventos y registros en ServiceNow Aurora.

• Actualizar el etiquetado de componentes (component tagging) y elaborar informes y análisis de desempeño.

• Planificar y reportar capacidades de GIT.

• Crear y mantener la documentación del entorno IaC/Serverless soportado.

• Coordinar incidentes en los que exista soporte por parte de los proveedores de nube.

• Crear arquitectura IaC utilizando Terraform y Ansible, incluyendo la gestión de pilas de recursos provisionados.

• Crear plantillas para gestionar configuraciones de cumplimiento a gran escala.

• Gestionar y modificar integraciones vía websockets o con recursos nativos en la nube, incluyendo API gateways, gestión de claves y claves de ruta.

• Aplicar hardening de contenedores de nube pública aprobado por AVC e implementar recomendaciones del fabricante, incluyendo parches y hotfixes.

• Ejecutar remediaciones de vulnerabilidades dirigidas por el equipo de ciberseguridad de AVC.

• Instalar agentes de seguridad y gestionar instalación o renovación de certificados digitales según direccionamiento y aprobación de AVC.

• Soluciones de mensajería en entornos cloud.

• Amazon CloudFront.

The Team Lead, Accounts Payable – International Upstream leads the invoice processing and payment activities supporting Chevron's International Upstream business units, including Venezuela, Brazil, Colombia and Mexico, among others, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and full compliance with internal controls, corporate policies and local requirements. Job Description – Team Lead, Accounts Payable – International Upstream Accounting (BASSC, Buenos Aires)
Position details

• Department: Upstream Accounting – GBS BA / BASSC

• Team: International Upstream Accounts Payable (Invoice Processing & Payments)

• Position: Team Lead, Finance Shared Services (Accounts Payable)

• Type of position: People leader – direct reports

• Job family / category: Core Accounting Services – FSS

• Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina (Madero office, hybrid)

1. Role Summary
The Team Lead, Accounts Payable – International Upstream leads the invoice processing and payment activities supporting Chevron's International Upstream business units, including Venezuela, Brazil, Colombia and Mexico, among others, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and full compliance with internal controls, corporate policies and local requirements.
2. Key Responsibilities
Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to the following:

• Lead, coach and develop a team of Accounts Payable analysts, managing workload distribution, performance, development plans and succession/backup coverage.

• Oversee the end-to-end invoice processing cycle (receipt, validation, classification, DOEA validation, posting, tax and withholding calculations) ensuring accuracy and adherence to the monthly schedule.

• Oversee the payment cycle (daily and/or weekly) for multiple countries: payment selection, confirmation of fund availability, execution and approval in banking platforms, monitoring of debits and rejections, and supplier payment communications.

• Ensure SOX controls under AP scope are designed, performed and evidenced on time; coordinate walkthroughs, internal and external audit requests and remediation actions.

• Coordinate month-end close and reporting deliverables of the AP team, including account reconciliations, accruals and variance explanations.

• Act as escalation point for complex issues, enabling their resolution, partnering with Treasury, Tax, Supply Chain and other relevant stakeholders.

• Partner with stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones through recurring performance reviews, KPI reporting and service quality discussions.

• Lead process improvement, digitalization and automation initiatives (RPA, dashboards, standardized desk guides) to increase efficiency and strengthen controls.

• Support migrations, transitions and system implementations (ERP and banking platforms), including knowledge transfer, testing, stabilization and change management.

• Ensure compliance with corporate policies, delegation of authority requirements and local regulations across all supported business units.

3. Required Qualifications
Education

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.

Experience

• 8+ years of experience in finance, accounting, or related fields.

• 2+ years leading or coordinating teams, including workload management and people development.

Skills

• Intermediate to advanced English proficiency.

• Solid understanding of accounting fundamentals and the end-to-end procure-to-pay cycle.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills under tight deadlines.

• Clear and concise communication skills, with the ability to present results and escalate issues to management.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, set standards and drive accountability within a team.

Tools / Systems

• Advanced Microsoft Excel; proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.

4. Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in Accounts Payable operations, preferably within a shared service or multinational environment.

• ERP experience (SAP and/or JD Edwards) in accounts payable or finance modules.

• Experience in energy, oil and gas or other asset-intensive industries.

• Experience with corporate banking platforms and payment execution in multiple currencies.

• Experience with reconciliation tools (e.g., BlackLine) and reporting or visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Power Automate).

• Exposure to automation and RPA initiatives, process standardization or migration projects.

• Knowledge of Latin American tax and withholding requirements applicable to supplier payments.

• Experience with internal controls (SOX or equivalent) and audit support.

5. Other Considerations

• Typical office environment in Buenos Aires, with a hybrid working arrangement subject to business needs.

• Supports multiple countries and time zones; occasional extended hours may be required during payment runs, month-end close and audit periods.

• Occasional international travel may be required to support migrations, transitions or stakeholder visits.

• Candidates must have legal authorization to work in Argentina.

6. Relocation and International Considerations
Relocation and expatriate assignments will not be considered for this role. Chevron does not sponsor employment visas or consider candidates requiring current or future visa sponsorship, including individuals on time-limited visa status, for this position.

• Conocimiento del mercado comercial de Santa Fé y su dinámica local.

• Capacidad analítica y experiencia en seguimiento de pipelines, forecasts, campañas e indicadores comerciales.

• Experiencia trabajando con objetivos comerciales y desarrollando acciones para mejorar resultados.

postings.title: Senior Accounting Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description
Responsibilities

• Perform General Ledger and monthly close activities, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with US GAAP, Argentine accounting standards, GM policies, and internal controls.

• Prepare journal entries, accruals, reclassifications, account reconciliations, variance analyses, and supporting working papers.

• Identify and analyze accounting risks, unusual balances, and complex transactions, applying sound technical judgment and escalating significant matters when required.

• Prepare the conversion of financial information from local currency to the USD functional currency and analyze foreign exchange impacts.

• Prepare statutory trial balances, US GAAP-to-Local GAAP adjustments, inflation accounting calculations, and complete statutory financial statements, including notes and supporting schedules.

• Prepare statutory and government reports and support filings with IGJ and other applicable authorities.

• Coordinate external audit requirements and ensure timely resolution of audit requests and accounting matters.

• Execute internal controls and SOX-related procedures, maintaining complete and review-ready documentation.

• Partner with Finance, shared service centers, and regional teams to obtain inputs and resolve accounting and reporting matters.

• Support process improvement and automation initiatives using data-analysis tools.

• Provides direction to a team of individuals with similar functional responsibility

• Research and interpret new accounting standards and brainstorm how each applies to GM as well as comply with external 10-Q/10-K reporting requirements

Required Experience

Mandatory

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) degree.

• Strong knowledge of Argentine Professional Accounting Standards.

• Proven experience with inflation accounting adjustments.

• Experience preparing complete financial statements, including notes and supporting schedules.

• Conversion of financial statements into USD functional currency.

• Preparation of financial information for external audits.

• Proficiency in excel,

Preferred

• Proven experience in general accounting, month-end closing, and financial reporting.

• Experience working within complex corporate groups.

• Hands-on experience managing month-end close processes under tight deadlines.

• Experience with statutory reporting and filings before the IGJ (General Inspection of Justice) or other public entities.

• Advanced SAP knowledge, preferably SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI).

• Advanced Excel skills and experience handling large volumes of data.

• Ability to prepare auditable journal entries and working papers.

• Knowledge of US GAAP and reconciliation with Argentine accounting standards.

• Intermediate or higher English proficiency to interact with regional teams.

• Experience in Big Four

• 3-4 years of exprience

• Experience with data automation and analytics tools such as Power Query, Power BI, or KNIME (preferred) Google workspace

Required Competencies

• Ability to independently execute complex activities with minimal supervision.

• Strong technical judgment to identify appropriate accounting treatments and assess risks.

• Excellent organizational skills and discipline to work within financial close calendars.

• Strong attention to detail and focus on internal controls.

• Analytical skills to investigate discrepancies and explain variances.

• Ability to document processes thoroughly and in an organized manner.

• Team player with strong communication skills, capable of effectively interacting with both accounting and non-accounting teams.

postings.title: Gerente de Producto de Especiales
postings.descriptionText:
En GSK estamos unidos por la ambición de adelantarnos a la enfermedad juntos. Nuestra estrategia Ahead Together busca transformar la prevención, el tratamiento y la evolución de las enfermedades, generando un impacto positivo en la vida de millones de personas.
Con un sólido portafolio de vacunas, medicamentos especializados y medicamentos generales, trabajamos para desarrollar soluciones innovadoras que mejoren la calidad de vida de los pacientes y fortalezcan los sistemas de salud en todo el mundo.

Hoy buscamos un(a) Gerente de Producto Especiales que quiera liderar una marca estratégica en Argentina y contribuir de forma directa al crecimiento sostenible del negocio y al acceso de más pacientes a terapias innovadoras.

El Rol
Como Gerente de Producto Especiales , liderarás la estrategia y ejecución de una marca clave del portafolio respiratorio de GSK. Serás responsable de transformar las necesidades de pacientes, profesionales de la salud y stakeholders en planes innovadores que impulsen el crecimiento de la marca, fortalezcan su posicionamiento y generen un impacto positivo en la vida de los pacientes.
Trabajarás en un entorno altamente colaborativo, impulsando proyectos con equipos multifuncionales y contribuyendo al liderazgo de GSK en una de las áreas terapéuticas más relevantes para la compañía.

Principales Responsabilidades

• Liderar la estrategia integral de la marca, desarrollando e implementando planes que impulsen el crecimiento sostenible del negocio y amplíen el impacto en pacientes.

• Diseñar y ejecutar campañas omnicanal centradas en el cliente, transformando insights del mercado y de los stakeholders en acciones de alto impacto.

• Gestionar una indicación estratégica del producto, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos comerciales, financieros y de posicionamiento.

• Liderar la colaboración transversal con equipos de Ventas, Médico, Acceso, Finanzas e Insights para garantizar una ejecución integrada y excelencia operativa.

• Monitorear el desempeño de la marca mediante KPIs, análisis de mercado y evaluación de resultados para optimizar continuamente la estrategia.

• Administrar presupuesto, forecasting y recursos, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de compliance, estándares éticos y regulaciones aplicables.

Formación Académica

• Título universitario en Marketing, Administración, Ciencias de la Salud o áreas afines.

• Más de 5 años de experiencia en la industria farmacéutica.

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia en Marketing, Gestión de Producto, Customer Engagement o áreas relacionadas.

• Experiencia liderando planes estratégicos de marca con responsabilidad sobre resultados de negocio.

• Experiencia en desarrollo e implementación de campañas omnicanal o digitales.

• Experiencia trabajando con equipos multifuncionales y stakeholders diversos.

• Conocimiento de planificación comercial, forecasting y gestión presupuestaria.

Calificaciones Deseables

• Experiencia en marketing farmacéutico dentro de productos de especialidad.

• Conocimiento del mercado respiratorio en Argentina.

• Experiencia en estrategias omnicanal y marketing digital.

• Manejo de herramientas CRM y plataformas de engagement.

• Experiencia desarrollando iniciativas centradas en el cliente.

• Conocimientos financieros aplicados a forecasting y gestión de negocio.

Competencias

• Visión estratégica y orientación a resultados.

• Fuertes capacidades analíticas y toma de decisiones basada en datos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e influencia.

• Capacidad para liderar en entornos dinámicos y complejos.

• Mentalidad centrada en clientes y pacientes.

• Colaboración, resiliencia y trabajo en equipo.

Idiomas

• Español fluido.

• Inglés avanzado.

En GSK tendrás la oportunidad de impulsar una marca con alto potencial de crecimiento, trabajar junto a equipos de alto desempeño y contribuir al desarrollo de soluciones innovadoras que impactan la vida de los pacientes.
Valoramos la diversidad de pensamiento, promovemos una cultura inclusiva y brindamos oportunidades para que cada persona crezca, se desarrolle y genere un impacto significativo.
Si te apasiona construir estrategias ganadoras, liderar proyectos de alto impacto y contribuir al futuro de la salud, queremos conocerte.
Postúlate y ayúdanos a adelantarnos a la enfermedad, juntos.

Resumen de la posición
Como Gerente de Distrito de Especiales, liderarás la ejecución comercial en el mercado argentino y el desarrollo de un equipo de visitadores médicos a nivel nacional. Convertirás la estrategia del portafolio en prioridades claras, seguimiento de resultados y acompañamiento efectivo en campo.
El rol combina la responsabilidad de continuar creciendo el portafolio actual con la preparación para productos nuevos y futuros lanzamientos. Tendrás la oportunidad de construir capacidades comerciales, fortalecer relaciones con actores clave y generar impacto para pacientes y clientes en un área estratégica para GSK.

Responsabilidades:

• Practicar el cumplimiento de las normas de prevención y control adoptadas por la Empresa, por su propia seguridad y salud en el trabajo y por la de aquellas personas a las que pueda afectar su actividad profesional, a causa de sus actos y omisiones en el trabajo, de conformidad con su formación e instrucciones establecidas.

• Informar oportunamente los accidentes e incidentes de trabajo o condiciones inseguras.

• Evitar reparaciones o procedimientos “hechizos” que comprometan la seguridad de las personas y de la operación.

• Verificar que los dampeners (amortiguador) de succión y descarga funcionen adecuadamente.

• Verificar correcta alineación y purga de las líneas de alta presión de las bombas.

• Verificar que todas las guardas y líneas de aguante de las mangueras de alta presión estén colocadas.

9. Verificar que las herramientas adecuadas estén disponibles y en buenas condiciones.

13. Realizar las requisiciones y hacer seguimiento de las partes y repuestos necesarios para mantener el inventario adecuado y garantizar su suministro con el personal de bodega y compras locales.
14. Utilizar el Sistema Electrónico de Mantenimiento Flex Works para generar nuevas órdenes de trabajo, reportar y registrar todos los trabajos realizados tanto de reparación como de mantenimiento en los equipos.
15. Cerrar oportunamente los órdenes de servicio generadas por el Sistema Electrónico de Mantenimiento para cada equipo en la base.
16. Recolectar información con instrumentos de medición, registros y otras fuentes, interpretar y utilizar dichos resultados en el seguimiento de los equipos a su cargo y tomar acción en caso de ser necesario.
17. Seleccionar de forma adecuada y segura de las prueba eléctricas y electrónicas de los componentes de los equipos.
18. Verificar que el equipo de prueba esté calibrado y funcionando adecuadamente.
19. Evaluar el desempeño de los equipos y monitorear la utilización del mismo.
20. Diagnosticar los equipos en búsqueda de fallas y proceder con el mantenimiento correspondiente.
21. Responsabilizarse y realizar el seguimiento de las reparaciones hasta que se haya logrado el resultado esperado.

postings.descriptionText:
At H&P, our people are our strength.

. Estar comprometido con The H&P Way (La Manera de H&P) y los Valores Corporativos Centrales de H&P: Activamente C.A.R.E., Actitud de Servicio, Espíritu Innovador y Trabajo en Equipo.
2. Conocer, difundir, cumplir y promover con las herramientas estratégicas de la Compañía: The H&P Way; la Visión de Seguridad de H&P; las Metas de HSEQ; y los procesos del Sistema C.A.R.E. (Salva Vidas de H&P, COACH, Tarjeta Brújula, ATSs, Programa de Reconocimiento y Premios, Discusión de Escenarios; Salva Vidas, haciéndonos responsables).
3. Controlar y remover exposiciones propias y de los demás. Activamente C.A.R.E.
4. Realizar inspecciones y reparaciones mayores de equipos y componentes de los taladros de perforación, el mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo así como detectar fallas eléctricas y electrónicas en los equipos durante su operación y durante las movilizaciones del equipo.
5. Efectuar reparaciones y mantenimiento programado de generadores de generación de equipos de los taladros de perforación.
6. Ejecutar el mantenimiento eléctrico en los cargadores frontales y equipo de levantamiento de personal de acuerdo a los requerimientos y a los planes o programas de mantenimiento para los mencionados equipos.
7. Realizar instalaciones eléctricas, conexiones de potencia, de comunicación y fibra óptica.
8. Tomar medida de lectura de puesta a tierra y la medición de puesta a tierra en cada locación.
9. Verificar que las herramientas adecuadas estén disponibles y en buenas condiciones.
10. Proporcionar a sus compañeros de mantenimiento y operaciones buena información, señalando próximas operaciones, y cualquier cambio en las condiciones del equipo y los riesgos conocidos.
11. Programar la inspección, el mantenimiento y/o reparaciones de los equipos con otros departamentos y grupos de trabajo.
12. Cumplir y velar por el cumplimiento de los procesos y procedimientos de mantenimiento según los estándares de: los fabricantes, internas de H&P, normas API, y/o otras normas y regulaciones que afectaren el uso y mantenimiento de los activos mecánicos y eléctricos.
13. Realizar las requisiciones y hacer seguimiento de las partes y repuestos necesarios para mantener el inventario adecuado y garantizar su suministro con el personal de bodega y compras locales.
14. Utilizar el Sistema Electrónico de Mantenimiento Flex Works para generar nuevas órdenes de trabajo, reportar y registrar todos los trabajos realizados tanto de reparación como de mantenimiento en los equipos.
15. Cerrar oportunamente los órdenes de servicio generadas por el Sistema Electrónico de Mantenimiento para cada equipo en la base.
16. Recolectar información con instrumentos de medición, registros y otras fuentes, interpretar y utilizar dichos resultados en el seguimiento de los equipos a su cargo y tomar acción en caso de ser necesario.
17. Seleccionar de forma adecuada y segura de las prueba eléctricas y electrónicas de los componentes de los equipos.
18. Verificar que el equipo de prueba esté calibrado y funcionando adecuadamente.
19. Evaluar el desempeño de los equipos y monitorear la utilización del mismo.
20. Diagnosticar los equipos en búsqueda de fallas y proceder con el mantenimiento correspondiente.
21. Responsabilizarse y realizar el seguimiento de las reparaciones hasta que se haya logrado el resultado esperado.

Thank you for your interest in joining our team!
