postings.descriptionText:
Environment Manager – Risk Management & GCO


Overview

Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure, and resilient technology services to support global business functions. Within this landscape, Risk Management & GCO requires robust environment strategy, governance, and operational excellence to support critical regulatory and control platforms.

The Environment Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of all environments supporting Risk Management and GCO applications, including planning, provisioning, governance, and coordination with release and change management processes. This role requires strong leadership, operational discipline, and the ability to align technical environments with business and regulatory requirements.







The Opportunity

The Environment Manager will lead environment strategy and execution across Risk Management and GCO platforms, ensuring environments are aligned with business priorities, release schedules, and control requirements. This role is accountable for environment availability, stability, and readiness to support development, testing, and production activities.

You will partner with product owners, development, production support, and business stakeholders to enable seamless delivery and operational continuity.







Key Responsibilities



• Coordinate, plan, and manage all environment-related activities including provisioning, refresh, and lifecycle management.


• Define environment strategy covering availability, utilization, and capacity planning.


• Align environment schedules with release and deployment timelines to ensure readiness.


• Partner with Service Delivery and Operations to ensure coordinated delivery and operational readiness.


• Establish and enforce governance standards including environment controls, access, and data integrity.


• Drive issue resolution related to environment conflicts or instability.


• Provide leadership, direction, and coaching to support teams.


• Ensure clear communication across business, development, QA, and operations teams.


• Identify and implement operational improvements to reduce cost and increase quality.


• Support Agile/SAFe planning and execution across multiple products.


• Track and communicate environment metrics and readiness status.


• Contribute to budget planning and resource strategy.






Analytical / Decision-Making Responsibilities



• Communicate effectively with Risk Management, GCO leadership, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.


• Influence prioritization and allocation of environments across competing initiatives.


• Balance delivery demands with operational stability and compliance requirements.


• Build strong stakeholder relationships to enable aligned decision-making.






Knowledge and Skills Requirements



• Strong understanding of enterprise environment management practices.


• Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into environment strategies.


• Experience in Agile/SAFe delivery models.


• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


• Experience with tools such as GitHub, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.


• Ability to develop long-term environment roadmaps aligned to product strategy.






To Qualify for the Role You Must Have



• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.


• 10+ years of experience managing large-scale enterprise environments or platforms.


• 5+ years of experience in environment planning and lifecycle management.


• 5+ years supporting release and change management processes.


• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.


• Experience supporting system implementations or migrations.


• Experience with multiple SDLC methodologies including Agile and Waterfall.


• Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage competing priorities.






Preferred Qualifications



• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance-driven environments.


• SAFe or Agile certifications.


• Experience with cloud-based enterprise environments.






What We Look For



• A self-starter with strong ownership and accountability.


• Ability to work across complex, multi-team environments.


• Strong focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.






What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you will be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. Our total rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, retirement plans, and a wide range of paid time off options, including flexible vacation based on individual needs and circumstances.

You will have access to continuous learning opportunities to develop the mindset and skills needed to adapt to evolving technology and business demands.

We provide a flexible work environment that empowers you to define your own path to success, supported by leadership coaching, tools, and resources to help you make a meaningful impact.

Our culture emphasizes inclusion and collaboration, ensuring that individuals are respected, empowered, and encouraged to contribute their perspectives while supporting others in doing the same.

We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated
exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering Team and you will work

communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join,
however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also

complex transformations.



Your Key Responsibilities

preferred





We are looking for talented and committed people to join our team who are passionate about
helping our clients to solve their toughest strategic problems and deliver insightful
recommendations that are rigorous in their grounding, creative in their selection, distinct to each

What we offer



• Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes
next.

meaningful impact, your way.

leader the world needs.
• Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use
your voice to help others find theirs.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better

postings.title: Modern Device Management Specialist - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
Modern Device Management Specialist

Expert in SCCM, Intune, SQL, PowerShell, Power BI and App Proxy Exposure


Open Position



• Supervising Associate


• Argentina




Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Modern Device Management Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in SCCM architecture and hierarchy, advanced troubleshooting abilities, and proven proficiency in SQL, PowerShell, and Power BI. In addition, the candidate should have intermediate (L2) knowledge of Microsoft Intune and basic (L1) understanding of Microsoft Entra Microsoft Entra Application Proxy concepts.


Key Responsibilities



• Design, implement, and optimize SCCM (System Center Configuration Manager) architecture and hierarchy for large-scale environments.


• Perform advanced troubleshooting of complex SCCM and Intune related issues, including client/server communication, software distribution, patch management, and compliance settings.


• Manage SCCM site servers, site roles, and maintain the overall health of the SCCM infrastructure.


• Develop and automate administrative tasks using PowerShell scripting to streamline processes and improve efficiency.


• Utilize SQL Server for custom queries, report generation, and database maintenance to support operational and management reporting needs.


• Leverage Power BI to develop dashboards and visualize key SCCM / Intune metrics for various stakeholders.


• Implement, monitor, and support SCCM Co-management for hybrid management of devices, ensuring seamless operation between SCCM and Intune environments.


• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cloud Management Gateway (CMG) in SCCM to enable secure management of internet-based clients.


• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with Intune for co-management scenarios, providing L2-level support for Intune-related issues.


• Assist in the deployment and configuration of devices using Intune, including enforcing compliance policies and security baselines.


• Troubleshoot Intune-related issues such as device enrolment, application deployment, and profile configuration.


• Support integration of Intune with SCCM for hybrid management scenarios and ensure smooth transition and coexistence of devices.


• Offer L1-level guidance and basic support for Microsoft Entra Application Proxy, ensuring secure access to on-premises applications as needed.


• Provide guidance on configuring and maintaining Microsoft Entra Application Proxy connectors for secure remote access to on-premises applications.


• Monitor and report on the health and performance of Microsoft Entra Application Proxy connections, escalating issues as needed.


• Document configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing and process compliance.


• Act as a technical mentor and escalation point for L1/L2 support teams.




Required Skills and Experience



• Extensive hands-on experience with SCCM and Intune, including designing and maintaining architecture and hierarchy in complex environments.


• In-depth understanding of SCCM components such as distribution points, management points, site systems, boundary groups, and client deployment.


• Expert-level troubleshooting of SCCM and Intune deployment, patching, Windows Update for Business, Application delivery, and Compliance management.


• Strong proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and reporting.


• Solid command of SQL Server for creating queries, custom reports, and maintaining SCCM database health.


• Experience developing visualizations and dashboards in Power BI.


• Intermediate (L2) experience with Microsoft Intune for device and application management in hybrid or cloud environments.


• Basic (L1) familiarity with Microsoft Entra Application Proxy concepts and ability to provide front-line support.


• Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.


• Ability to work independently, handle multiple priorities, and provide mentorship to junior team members.




Qualifications



• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


• Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals, or equivalent are preferred.


• Minimum 10 years of hands-on SCCM (Intune) administration and support in a large-scale enterprise environment.


• Demonstrated experience with PowerShell, SQL Server, and Power BI tools.


• Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra Application Proxy is a plus.


Apply now »

We are looking for a proactive, credible and insight-led finance professional who can translate complex data into clear leadership narratives and practical recommendations. You will bring discipline, judgement and curiosity to strengthen planning, forecasting and management information, identify performance trends and shape timely, evidence-based decisions.

· Partner with Finance, Reporting and Data Analytics, GDS and other teams to improve reporting, automate routine outputs, strengthen data quality and increase the usability of management information.


· Promote the effective use of AI, analytics and Global Finance tools to improve insight, efficiency, forecasting and decision support.


· Provide Finance expertise to strategic and cross-functional initiatives, while supporting the integrity of Service Line financial structures, hierarchies and service codes.


· Promote collaboration, knowledge-sharing and capability-building by coaching colleagues and modelling strong business-partnering behaviours.

• Commercial judgement and curiosity to understand market context, Service Line priorities and the actions needed to improve performance.

• Strong problem-solving, financial modelling and analytical capability, including the ability to evaluate options and develop practical recommendations.


• Proficiency in reporting, data visualization and analytical tools, with a practical approach to AI, automation, simplification and continuous improvement.


• A collaborative, ownership-led style, with the ability to build trusted relationships and manage ambiguity and competing priorities in a global matrix.


• A commitment to knowledge-sharing, coaching colleagues and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing Finance team.




To qualify for the role, you must have


· A degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or a related discipline, preferably supported by a relevant professional qualification.


· At least 10 years of relevant experience in FP&A, business analysis, commercial finance, management reporting, strategy, analytics or finance business partnering within a complex organisation.

· Ability to work independently across multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across cultures, locations and time zones.

postings.title: Global Integration Architect Lead - SAP Platforms - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
Global Integration Architect Lead – SAP Platforms


Role Summary

The Global Integration Architect Lead is the senior technical authority responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the enterprise integration architecture across the global SAP ecosystem. This role owns cross‑system integration strategy, API standards, and event‑driven patterns that connect SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, SAP SuccessFactors , and non‑SAP platforms at scale.

Operating as a design authority and architectural leader , the role ensures integrations are secure, scalable, resilient, and Clean‑Core compliant , while enabling rapid business transformation and global process standardization. The Global Integration Architect Lead partners closely with Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, Product Owners, and delivery partners to ensure integration decisions support long‑term enterprise outcomes—not just short‑term program delivery.



Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise Integration Architecture Leadership



• Define and own the global integration architecture strategy for SAP and non‑SAP platforms across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, and HCM domains.


• Establish standard integration patterns (API‑led, event‑driven, batch, synchronous/asynchronous) aligned with enterprise architecture principles.


• Act as the final design authority for complex, cross‑domain integrations involving SAP S/4HANA, Ariba, SuccessFactors, and third‑party systems.


• Ensure integration designs support global business processes (O2C, P2P, R2R, H2R) and enterprise data models.



2. SAP Integration Suite & API Management Ownership



• Lead architectural usage of SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh, Open Connectors where applicable).


• Define and enforce API standards , lifecycle management, versioning, security, throttling, and reuse strategies.


• Govern integration build quality to ensure consistency across internal teams, system integrators, and managed service providers.


• Drive adoption of event‑driven architectures using SAP standard events where available.



3. Clean Core & Extensibility Governance



• Enforce Clean Core principles , minimizing custom point‑to‑point integrations and fragile custom code.


• Define side‑by‑side extensibility patterns that protect SAP core stability while enabling innovation.


• Review and approve integration‑related exceptions, documenting rationale and technical debt implications.



4. Cross‑Program Design Authority & Risk Management



• Participate in architecture review boards and release governance forums as the integration authority .


• Identify integration risks, performance bottlenecks, security gaps, and data consistency issues early in the lifecycle.


• Partner with Security, GRC, and Identity teams to ensure integrations meet compliance and audit requirements.



5. Leadership, Mentorship & Vendor Oversight



• Lead and mentor regional and domain Integration Architects , setting technical direction and raising overall architecture maturity.


• Provide architectural oversight of SI partners and vendors , ensuring adherence to enterprise standards.


• Influence senior stakeholders by clearly articulating trade‑offs, risks, and long‑term impacts of integration decisions.





Required Skills & Experience

SAP & Integration Expertise



• 15 years of relevant experience


• Deep hands‑on experience integrating SAP S/4HANA , SAP Ariba , and SAP SuccessFactors in large global landscapes.


• Strong expertise in SAP Integration Suite , including CPI and API Management.


• Proven experience designing API‑led and event‑driven architectures at enterprise scale.


• Strong understanding of SAP standard APIs, data objects, and integration best practices.



Technical & Architectural Skills



• Advanced knowledge of RESTful APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth2, SAML, certificate‑based security, and integration performance tuning.


• Experience with hybrid integration scenarios (SAP cloud, hyperscalers, on‑prem systems).


• Ability to translate business requirements into clear, durable integration architectures rather than one‑off solutions.



Leadership & Enterprise Skills



• Demonstrated ability to act as a global design authority , influencing without direct control.


• Strong stakeholder management skills across IT, business, and external partners.


• Experience working in large, matrixed, global organizations with multiple delivery teams.



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience in global SAP transformation programs (S/4HANA, RISE, Ariba, SuccessFactors).


• TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.


• Exposure to AI‑assisted delivery, automation, or integration governance at scale.



Success Measures



• Reduction in point‑to‑point and non‑standard integrations.


• Increased reuse of APIs and integration patterns.


• Improved stability, performance, and auditability of integrations.


• Faster delivery enablement without erosion of architectural integrity.


Apply now »

postings.title: Rewards Senior Consultant - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
EY GDS – Rewards Senior Consultant



In today's rapidly changing and complex global workforce environment, managing human resources effectively is increasingly challenging. As a member of our Rewards practice, you will be part of a team that supports clients in aligning their HR functions with organizational strategies while prioritizing employee experience. Joining us means gaining cross-functional, multi-industry, and truly global work experience to advance your career.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in Total Rewards to join our Rewards team. This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organization and play a pivotal role in the growth of our Rewards practice.

Your Key Responsibilities:



• Leverage your experience in Rewards advisory services to enhance our practice at EY.


• Deliver high-quality work on global client projects as part of our global distribution team.


• Ensure the quality, timeliness, and accuracy of all work outputs.


• Establish yourself as a subject matter expert in areas such as Compensation pay band design, market intelligence, benefits design, incentive pay design, job evaluation & grading, gender pay gap, annual compensation and incentive reviews.


• Identify trends, derive market insights, and conduct research and analysis to uncover potential compliance issues and opportunities for performance improvement.


• Collaborate with broader teams to upskill resources, lead smaller projects, and conduct surveys within defined scopes.


• Adapt to a dynamic and ambiguous environment while managing multiple projects simultaneously.


• Drive effective client communication and build strong relationships with clients and project team members across global locations.


• Strive to receive excellent feedback from clients and global project counterparts.





Skills and Attributes for Success:



• High integrity and commitment to working in a challenging environment.


• Proactive thinking and a growth mindset that fosters efficient processes and solutions.


• Ability to manage ambiguity and think on your feet.


• Strong communication and presentation skills.


• Cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity.


• High energy levels, agility, teamwork, and adaptability.



To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:



• 4-8 years of experience in Total Rewards or consulting





• A Master’s degree in HR, a full-time MBA, or an equivalent postgraduate degree.


• Experience in Total Rewards transformation programs and working as part of a global distributed team.


• Strong background in compensation & rewards benchmarking, rewards strategy, and annual incentive/benefits design.


• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI dashboards, and other analytical tools.


• Strong communication and analytical skills with the ability to create insightful reports.


• Additionally, familiarity with the latest in-demand skills such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), prompt engineering, data analytics, and digital transformation will enhance your candidacy.



Ideally, You’ll Also Have:



• Comprehensive knowledge of end-to-end Total Rewards processes.


• Strong technical expertise in the complete Rewards process.


• Analytical skills and proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.


• Active involvement in end-to-end Rewards transformation programs, particularly those enabled by technology, and experience leading or participating in multi-workstream transformation initiatives.


• Experience in policy review, current state assessments, vendor selection, and designing global rewards processes and strategies.


• Rewards-related certifications are a plus.


• What We Look For:





• Independent, self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented professionals who can deliver high levels of customer satisfaction through world-class support services.


• Engage in strategic planning to grow the team.


• Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experience, and a strong enthusiasm for adapting and learning in a fast-paced environment.


• Professionals eager to work in an environment of continuous professional development, willing to take on new responsibilities and projects, and collaborate with clients across various geographies.



What Working at EY Offers:

At EY, we are committed to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do is as diverse as they are. You will engage in inspiring and meaningful projects, with a focus on education and coaching alongside practical experience to support your personal development. We value our employees and empower you to take control of your growth with an individual progression plan. You will quickly assume a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Additionally, we offer:



• Support, coaching, and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues.


• Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.


• The freedom and flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you best.





About EY:

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction, and advisory services, we leverage our finance products, expertise, and systems to build a better working world. This begins with a culture that prioritizes training, opportunities, and creative freedom. Regardless of when you join or how long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. With a commitment to hiring and developing passionate individuals, we aim to be the best employer.



If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us.



Join us in building a better working world.




Apply now »

postings.descriptionText:
Senior Domain Architect – EY Fabric AI, Post-Sales

Position Summary

You are a strategic Architect within the EY Fabric post-sales organization, accountable for defining repeatable AI and GenAI architecture patterns that enable EY Fabric adoption at scale. Your role is to ensure AI Factory, OpenAI-related capabilities, GenAI integrations, model orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and operational controls are delivered through reusable, governed, and easy-to-consume patterns rather than bespoke implementations.

This role is focused on post-sales adoption, architectural integrity, and repeatability. You will create the reference architectures, accelerators, guardrails, and implementation blueprints that help Forward Deployed Engineers and delivery teams implement AI solutions consistently while managing risk, cost, security, and operational readiness.

Essential Functions of the Job



• Define EY Fabric AI reference architectures covering AI Factory, OpenAI integrations, GenAI workloads, model orchestration, agentic patterns, retrieval-based approaches, deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management


• Create repeatable AI design patterns for common post-sales scenarios such as GenAI application onboarding, secure model access, prompt orchestration, RAG-style solution patterns, evaluation workflows, telemetry, and operational controls


• Develop AI accelerators including architecture blueprints, starter kits, integration templates, deployment patterns, evaluation frameworks, monitoring patterns, reusable prompts, configuration guidance, and handoff packs


• Ensure AI accelerators are easy to consume by Forward Deployed Engineers, delivery teams, and segment-aligned teams


• Define guardrails for responsible AI delivery, including access controls, data boundaries, auditability, monitoring, human oversight, and operational risk management


• Partner with AI Product, Engineering, Security, Risk, and Reliability teams to align post-sales patterns with platform roadmap and governance expectations


• Act as the senior escalation point for complex AI architecture questions that go beyond standard implementation playbooks


• Convert recurring AI implementation challenges into reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators


• Define clear handoff expectations between Presales, Domain Architecture, Forward Deployed Engineering, and ongoing support teams


• Govern exceptions to standard AI patterns and determine whether new supported patterns are required


• Maintain AI architecture assets in agreed EY Fabric knowledge repositories such as GitHub, SharePoint, Teams, and internal knowledge hubs


• Measure AI architecture effectiveness through pattern adoption, reduction in bespoke builds, implementation speed, operational quality, and reuse of accelerators


• Mentor mid-level AI Architects and help build post-sales AI architecture maturity across EY Fabric



Analytical and Decision-Making Responsibilities



• Evaluate AI solution designs for scalability, security, privacy, cost, reliability, observability, and operational readiness


• Decide when an AI use case should follow an existing standard pattern versus requiring a new architecture pattern


• Prioritize AI accelerator development based on recurring demand, risk profile, delivery complexity, and adoption impact


• Identify common sources of AI delivery friction and drive platform-level or pattern-level improvements


• Assess whether AI implementations are aligned to EY Fabric guardrails and responsible AI expectations



Knowledge and Skills Required



• Strong experience designing and governing production AI, ML, or GenAI systems


• Familiarity with AI Factory concepts, OpenAI-style integrations, model orchestration, RAG patterns, evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management


• Strong cloud architecture fundamentals including identity, networking, security, logging, and observability


• Understanding of responsible AI, data governance, security, risk, and operational controls


• Experience creating reusable AI architecture assets, templates, implementation guides, or accelerators


• Ability to communicate AI architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and risks to technical and executive stakeholders


• Strong ability to work across Product, Engineering, Security, Risk, Growth, and delivery teams



Supervision Responsibilities



• Provide technical leadership to AI Architects and senior engineers


• Review AI patterns, accelerators, and handoff artifacts for quality and consistency


• Coach teams on using approved EY Fabric AI patterns instead of bespoke implementations



Job Requirements



• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience


• 10+ years of engineering with recent GenAI architecture experience, including significant AI, ML, GenAI, or platform delivery experience


• Experience building reusable AI patterns, accelerators, technical standards, or implementation playbooks


• AI, cloud architecture, security, or data certifications preferred




Apply now »

postings.title: NextGen AI Technical Manager -Growth&Innovation - Assistant Director - Argentina - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
About the Next Frontier

Applied Innovation's Next Frontier focuses on emerging technologies, including Physical AI, Quantum Computing, and Next-Generation AI amongst others. This initiative translates advanced capabilities into measurable outcomes, helping clients and EY teams improve decision-making, strengthen resilience, and unlock new opportunities through technology-driven solutions.



About the Delivery Team

The Next-Generation AI team helps EY teams turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, secure, and governable solutions. The team builds small, high-fidelity experiments to test what AI can realistically do before decisions on scale or production are made. We work closely with EY teams to translate real business and engineering pain points into rapid, value-focused prototypes.



Position Summary

NextGen AI Manager – Technical Innovation, for the Next-Gen AI team provides technical expertise to assess emerging AI capabilities and explore their application to business and client challenges. Drawing on prior hands-on experience designing and building AI/ML solutions, the Manager evaluates relevant technologies, models and architectures and translates technical findings into practical experimentation opportunities. The role works with account teams to understand client problems, identify potential Frontier AI applications, and help shape focused prototypes and experiments. The Manager provides technical guidance to engineering teams, reviews technology choices, and surfaces feasibility considerations, risks and trade-offs during experimentation. The role supports Next-Gen AI leadership with technical insights and recommendations to inform decisions on which opportunities should be explored further.



Essential Responsibilities of the Job:

Emerging AI Technology Scouting & Assessment



• Maintain a strong understanding of developments across next-generation AI, including emerging models, agent architectures, frameworks, open-source technologies, infrastructure patterns, and adjacent technologies.


• Conduct hands-on technical assessments of emerging capabilities to understand their maturity, limitations, enterprise applicability, and potential areas of value.


• Distinguish meaningful technical advances from market hype and summarize implications for the Next-Gen AI team.


• Bring technically grounded insights and recommendations to leadership on areas that may warrant further exploration.



Technical Opportunity Identification



• Review business and client challenges surfaced by account teams and assess whether emerging AI capabilities could offer a relevant or differentiated approach.


• Identify connections between evolving technology capabilities and problems where traditional or currently available approaches may be insufficient.


• Develop initial technical hypotheses for how promising capabilities could be explored through focused experiments or prototypes.


• Provide leadership with technical perspectives on feasibility, maturity, dependencies, and potential value before decisions are made to pursue an opportunity.



Experiment & Prototype Technical Shaping



• Help translate selected opportunities into technically meaningful experiments with clear hypotheses and evaluation criteria.


• Recommend appropriate models, architectures, frameworks, data approaches, and technology components for experimentation.


• Work closely with engineering teams to provide technical direction, review proposed approaches, and challenge design decisions where appropriate.


• Identify technical risks, constraints, and trade-offs early and recommend practical alternatives.



Technical Evaluation & Learning



• Define approaches to evaluate experiments across dimensions such as capability, accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, security, and enterprise readiness.


• Analyze experiment outcomes and determine what the results indicate about the underlying technology and its applicability.


• Capture technical learnings, reusable patterns, and limitations to inform future experimentation across the portfolio.


• Provide evidence-based recommendations to leadership on whether a capability should be explored further, refined, monitored, or deprioritized.



Technical Ecosystem Engagement



• Engage with engineers, technology partners, startups, open-source communities, and EY technical specialists to remain close to emerging developments.


• Assess technology and alliance capabilities from a technical perspective and identify where external expertise or platforms could accelerate experimentation.


• Connect relevant technical expertise into experiments when specialist capabilities are required.



Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:



• Examine new AI methods and delivery patterns to determine where they are feasible, responsible, and worth piloting.


• Apply governance, security, and compliance requirements consistently across the experiment-to-delivery lifecycle, ensuring alignment with EY processes.


• Use evidence and outcome signals to make timely trade-offs, re-prioritize work, and steer teams toward the highest-impact results in a fast-moving environment.



Knowledge and Skills Requirements:



• Background in AI/ML, software engineering, data engineering, or solution architecture.


• Prior hands-on experience building AI/ML and GenAI solutions.


• Experience assessing emerging AI technologies and working with engineering teams.


• Tools & stack you may touch:


• Programming: Python, SQL


• AI Platforms: Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI API, etc.


• AI Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face


• Retrieval / Vector: Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector

You will be responsible for leading one of EY's strategic analytics products within the Global Analytics product portfolio. You will coach junior colleagues to enable them to carry out analysis for senior leaders. This may include managing of workload, quality assessment and evaluation, skill transfer and supervision, deliverable expectations and timeframes across multiple projects.

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Plus, we offer:
• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

postings.descriptionText:
¿Quiénes somos?



DRiV es una empresa líder en el mercado de reposición automotriz y soluciones de desempeño para vehículos. Con más de 30 marcas reconocidas, desarrolla, fabrica y comercializa una amplia gama de componentes automotrices de alta calidad, garantizando el rendimiento, la seguridad y la confiabilidad de los vehículos a lo largo de toda su vida útil. DRiV atiende al mercado de repuestos (aftermarket) , ofreciendo soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas que mejoran la experiencia de conducción y el desempeño de vehículos de distintas aplicaciones.



¿Estás listo(a) para unirte a DRiV y potenciar tu carrera?



Estamos buscando un Supervisor de Ventas para sumarse a nuestro equipo comercial en Argentina, con base en La Plata, Tortuguitas, o alrededores.

El objetivo principal de la posición es asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, rentabilidad y cobranza del canal Aftermarket en el territorio asignado, fortaleciendo las relaciones con distribuidores y clientes clave, e implementando las estrategias comerciales definidas para el crecimiento sostenible de nuestras marcas y líneas de producto.



Responsabilidades clave:



• Cumplir los objetivos de ventas mensuales, trimestrales y anuales establecidos para el territorio asignado.


• Desarrollar y ejecutar planes comerciales para distribuidores, mayoristas y cadenas de repuestos.


• Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento mediante la incorporación de nuevos clientes, ampliación de líneas de producto y expansión de cobertura de mercado.


• Negociar condiciones comerciales, promociones y acuerdos con clientes estratégicos.


• Gestionar y fortalecer relaciones comerciales de largo plazo con los principales clientes del territorio.





• Realizar seguimiento de la cobranza y los límites de crédito de los clientes en coordinación con el área de Créditos y Cobranzas.


• Analizar indicadores de cartera y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos financieros de la zona asignada.





• Analizar tendencias de mercado, precios y evolución del parque automotor para identificar oportunidades comerciales.


• Participar en la elaboración de forecast de ventas y proyecciones de demanda.


• Coordinar junto a Marketing la implementación de campañas comerciales, lanzamientos de productos, ferias y actividades promocionales.


• Detectar oportunidades de capacitación para clientes, distribuidores y talleres, coordinando acciones de entrenamiento técnico y comercial.





• Elaborar reportes periódicos de ventas, pipeline comercial, cobertura de clientes y evolución de negocios.


• Monitorear indicadores de rentabilidad, crecimiento y desempeño comercial.


• Gestionar reclamos y necesidades de clientes en conjunto con las áreas de Customer Service, Calidad, Supply Chain y Finanzas.


• Garantizar el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, Código de Conducta y normativas de Compliance.





¿Qué te hará exitoso(a) en esta posición?



• Título universitario o estudiante avanzado/a de Administración de Empresas, Comercialización, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.


• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en posiciones comerciales dentro de la industria autopartista, automotriz o sectores relacionados.


• Experiencia en gestión de distribuidores, casas de repuestos y clientes del mercado de reposición automotriz.


• Conocimientos de negociación, gestión de cuentas clave, análisis de rentabilidad y planificación comercial.


• Experiencia en herramientas CRM (Salesforce u otras), SAP y Power BI será valorada.


• Inglés intermedio. Se valorará conocimiento de portugués.

• Disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes dentro del territorio nacional.

Modalidad de trabajo





• Posición full time.


• Esquema de trabajo hibrido


• Disponibilidad para viajar aproximadamente dos semanas al mes dentro del territorio nacional asignado.

Queremos que te sientas bienvenido(a), desafiado(a) e inspirado(a). Por ello, brindamos un conjunto de beneficios destinados a potenciar tu salud y bienestar, para asegurar tu crecimiento personal, profesional y tu integración en un entorno laboral agradable en el día a día.

Nuestro equipo está listo para tomar acción de inmediato sobre aquellos(as) candidatos(as) que mejor se adapten al puesto. Nos enorgullecemos de avanzar rápidamente en los procesos, y puedes estar seguro(a) de la transparencia y la comunicación rápida en todo momento.

Visión general del puesto:

Contribuir al control de la extracción y calidad del mineral mediante el seguimiento en campo de los materiales provenientes de voladura, asegurando su correcta identificación, clasificación y destino. La función implica realizar controles, mediciones, muestreos y relevamientos geológicos y topográficos, utilizando herramientas de geo referenciamiento para proporcionar información confiable que contribuya al control de calidad del mineral y a minimizar su dilución.

Propósito del rol:

Controlar la extracción y calidad del mineral proveniente de voladura, verificando su correcta clasificación y destino. Realizar relevamientos, mediciones y muestreos en campo que permitan mantener información actualizada y confiable para la gestión geológica y el control de alimentación a planta.

Principales responsabilidades:

* Controlar la extracción del mineral de cada voladura, procurando minimizar la dilución y mantener la calidad requerida.
* Controlar y verificar el destino del material proveniente de las voladuras.
* Realizar el control diario de alimentación de mineral a planta.
* Manejar sistemas y equipos de geo referenciamiento GPS/GNSS para relevamientos en campo.
* Realizar mediciones de taladros, escaneos de cámaras y levantamientos de perfiles geológicos.
* Realizar muestreos, envío de muestras e inserción de muestras de control.
* Generar y actualizar mapas semanales y mensuales de stock.
* Coordinar con Topografía una vez finalizada la extracción del material.
* Identificar peligros y riesgos asociados a las tareas, actuando de acuerdo con los procedimientos y estándares de seguridad establecidos.
* Colaborar con las distintas áreas involucradas para contribuir al cumplimiento de los objetivos operativos y de seguridad.

Requisitos obligatorios:

* Secundario completo. Preferentemente Técnico/a en Minas o formación afín.
* Experiencia mínima de 2 años en posiciones similares vinculadas a control de ley, voladura, geología o topografía.
* Manejo de sistemas de geo referenciamiento y equipos GPS/GNSS.
* Conocimientos básicos de AutoCAD.
* Manejo de Microsoft Office.
* Conocimientos de identificación visual de minerales.
* Conocimientos básicos de mediciones y relevamientos topográficos.
* Experiencia o conocimientos en toma y gestión de muestras.

Cualificaciones deseables:

* Proactividad y orientación al trabajo en campo.
* Capacidad analítica y atención al detalle.
* Trabajo en equipo.
* Compromiso con la seguridad.
* Capacidad de organización y registro de información.

Condiciones de la posición:

* Modalidad de trabajo bajo diagrama 14x14.
* Jornada laboral de 12 horas.
* Contratación efectiva.
* Posición con importante presencia y actividad en campo.


Beneficios y Compromiso con el Colaborador y la Comunidad



Cerro Vanguardia prioriza la calidad de vida y el bienestar integral de sus colaboradores, ofreciendo iniciativas orientadas al desarrollo, salud, apoyo familiar y fortalecimiento del ambiente laboral. Entre las principales acciones se destacan programas de vínculo familiar, monitoreo ambiental participativo, asistencia integral al empleado, bienestar personal, asesoramiento técnico y gestión de liderazgo.



Además, la compañía brinda acceso a servicios especializados de salud, apoyo psicológico, nutricional y asesoramiento profesional para empleados y sus familias, reforzando su compromiso con un entorno seguro, colaborativo y sostenible. Los programas e iniciativas están sujetos a las políticas internas y criterios aplicables de Cerro Vanguardia.



Declaración de Igualdad de Oportunidades de Empleo



Estamos transformando la minería con una cultura de equidad, inclusión y respeto. Valoramos a cada persona y creemos que la diversidad de historias, ideas y perspectivas impulsa nuestro crecimiento.

This is a remote position.

We are seeking an experienced Atlassian Administrator to manage, optimize, and continuously improve our Atlassian Cloud ecosystem. This role will be responsible for the administration, configuration, customization, and support of Jira Software, Confluence, and Jira Service Management (JSM) , ensuring these platforms effectively support business processes and operational goals across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent problem-solving and communication skills, and has experience designing scalable solutions, automating workflows, integrating enterprise systems, and supporting end users in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Administer and maintain Atlassian Cloud products, including Jira Software, Confluence, and Jira Service Management.

• Configure and manage Jira projects, issue types, custom fields, screens, workflows, permission schemes, and notification schemes.

• Create and maintain Confluence spaces, templates, permissions, and knowledge-sharing structures.

• Design, configure, and optimize Jira Service Management portals, request types, queues, and ITSM workflows.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business processes into scalable Atlassian solutions.

• Develop and maintain advanced automations using Automation for Jira, ScriptRunner (Groovy), and Atlassian APIs.

• Manage integrations with enterprise platforms such as Okta, Azure AD, DevOps tools, and other third-party systems.

• Administer user access, groups, permissions, and Single Sign-On (SSO) configurations.

• Conduct periodic access reviews and support compliance and audit requirements.

• Monitor platform performance, troubleshoot issues, and resolve incidents related to Atlassian products and integrations.

• Manage Atlassian Marketplace apps, ensuring compatibility, security, and performance.

• Provide technical support and guidance to end users, resolving issues and answering platform-related questions.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and user guides.

• Deliver training sessions and promote best practices for Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management usage.

• Participate in governance initiatives, platform optimization, and continuous improvement efforts.

Requisitos

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience administering Atlassian platforms in enterprise environments.

• Proven experience managing Jira Software, Confluence, and Jira Service Management Cloud .

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in:

• Jira workflow design and administration.

• Custom fields, screens, permission schemes, and notification schemes.

• Confluence administration and space management.

• Jira Service Management (JSM) and ITSM process implementation.

• Experience developing automations using:

• Automation for Jira.

• ScriptRunner (Groovy).

• Atlassian REST APIs.

• Experience integrating Atlassian products with external systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware solutions.

• Knowledge of identity and access management solutions, including Okta , SSO, and SAML.

• Experience managing users, groups, permissions, and security controls within cloud environments.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to Atlassian configurations, integrations, and platform performance.

• Experience with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript is highly desirable.

Soft Skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong customer-service mindset and user support experience.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Collaborative team player with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.

Preferred Qualifications

• Atlassian certifications (ACP or equivalent).

• ITIL Foundation certification.

• Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, or other compliance-driven environments.

• Experience leading Atlassian implementations, migrations, or governance initiatives.

• Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies.

• Experience with SQL, reporting tools, or Business Intelligence solutions.

• Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, SOX, GDPR, or similar regulations.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrated Workflows
postings.descriptionText:
The Integrated Workflows team exists to expand Mural 's value by embedding it seamlessly into the essential business workflows our customers already live in. We connect Mural to the tools that teams rely on every day, from the systems of record where work gets tracked to the places conversations happen and the surfaces content moves through.

That is what integrations unlock, and it is the most interesting thing about this team. When Mural can reach the work happening everywhere else, a canvas stops being a snapshot of one meeting and becomes a live surface for how a team operates: real context pulled in, real decisions pushed back out, nobody retyping a status update or hunting for the current version. A workshop stops ending at the wall of sticky notes and starts ending in tracked, owned, moving work. That is when collaboration gets genuinely effective, and building toward it is the point of everything we do.

Underneath all of that, we build the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns that let any team at Mural ship a connected experience without starting from scratch. Our mission: to make Mural a natural part of daily work. We measure success by how indispensable Mural becomes inside real customer workflows, not by the number of integrations we ship.



YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Integrated Workflows team, you'll own significant parts of how Mural connects to the outside world. You'll design and build integrations that are reliable, secure, and genuinely used, and you'll turn one-off connector work into integration platform capabilities the rest of the company can build on.

This role sits at the intersection of product and platform. You'll work directly against third-party APIs and SDKs with all the ambiguity that entails: shifting contracts, rate limits, auth models, partner review processes. At the same time you'll keep our own abstractions clean and our public API stable for the developers who depend on it.

Senior Engineers at Mural lead, design, and implement complex technical projects, contribute to team and company-wide processes and culture, and provide mentorship and support for early-career colleagues.

• 
Use AI tools as part of your fundamental workflows

Design, plan, and implement automated testing and documentation strategies, including for the failure modes that only show up when someone else's API misbehaves

The Opportunity



The Global Operations Specialist plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.

The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.

Operational Excellence

• Assist with additional reporting and analysis requests, help manage stakeholder expectations, and reinforce self-service options.






Stakeholder Engagement

• Facilitate communication and coordination across domains, functions, and pods for smooth execution of initiatives.

postings.title: HE3 - Software Developer, E-Commerce Systems
postings.descriptionText:
We run three home furnishings storefronts on a catalog of 100,000+ SKUs from a long list of manufacturers. Almost all of it runs on software we built ourselves: a Django backend, a React storefront on Cloudflare Workers, and a set of pipelines that turn messy vendor spreadsheets, emails, SFTP drops and websites into clean product, pricing and inventory data.

We're looking for a developer to work alongside our lead developer on that stack. Most of the job is solving concrete business problems: a vendor feed that breaks every month, a pricing rule nobody can explain, a task the team still does by hand in a spreadsheet. You'll figure out what's actually going on, then build the fix, and look for places where AI can make the process itself work better.

What you'll work on

● Product data. Vendor imports and feeds, our in-house PIM, categorization, images and data quality across a large, inconsistent catalog.

● Inventory and pricing. Feed ingestion (AWS Lambda, S3, SFTP), scrapers for vendors without feeds, and the pricing, deals and cart logic that depend on them.

● The storefront API. We're replacing Shopify with our own Django backend and a React Router storefront. You'll build and test the API endpoints the new site depends on.

● Search. Elasticsearch-backed search, facets and recommendations.

● Internal tools and automation. Find the manual, repetitive work across the business (merchandising, customer service, operations) and replace it with something reliable. Sometimes that's a script or an admin screen. Sometimes it's an LLM-based workflow, if that's the right tool for the problem.

● Infrastructure. We're moving hand-built AWS and Cloudflare resources to OpenTofu. Some exposure here is useful but not required.

How we work

● Tests come first. We write a failing test, then the code. Tests build their own data and assert on exact values. A test that only checks for a 200 response doesn't count.

● Typed, reviewed, small. Python is type-annotated and checked, TypeScript runs in strict mode, and changes go in as small, focused pull requests with one fix per commit.

● Production is careful work. Migrations, data fixes and infrastructure changes get agreed on before they run, and we don't commit secrets.

● We use AI coding assistants every day, and we review everything they produce. We keep written project conventions that the agents follow. We want someone who gets real speed out of these tools and still owns every line that ships, and who can spot when the assistant got it wrong.

What we're looking for

● Strong Python. Django (ORM, migrations, admin) experience is a big plus.

● Solid SQL and PostgreSQL. Comfortable reading query plans and pushing work into the database when it makes sense.

● Experience building and consuming APIs. Django Ninja, Pydantic or OpenAPI is a plus.

● Experience working with messy real-world data: CSV/Excel imports, vendor feeds, scraping, ETL.

● Enough TypeScript/React to work on the storefront when a feature spans both repos.

● Good judgment about when automation (including LLMs) helps and when a plain script or a better process is the right answer.

● Clear written communication. You'll write PR descriptions, docs and tickets that someone else can act on.

Nice to have

● E-commerce experience, especially catalog, PIM, order management or checkout (Stripe).

● Elasticsearch or another major search platform.

● AWS (Lambda, S3, ECS), Cloudflare Workers, OpenTofu/Terraform.

● Experience in furniture, home furnishings or another product-heavy retail business.

Our approach moves customers beyond one-off imagery toward continuous awareness and alert-driven decision-making, with flexible pathways that can evolve from managed monitoring to full satellite ownership and sovereign control.

It takes requirements from different subsystems and converts them into high-quality, reliable software.

• Version Control: Strong knowledge of Git , version control platforms like GitLab , software packaging , and distribution .

Interpersonal skills

• Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• A strong capacity for continuous learning and a passion for innovation.

Valued skills

postings.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
postings.descriptionText:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

• Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

• Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

• Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

• Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

• Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

• Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

• Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

• 2+ years of professional software engineering

• Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

• Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

• Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

• Regular use of an AI coding tool

• Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

• You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

• At least 10 hours a week, starting now

• A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

• Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

• Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

• US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

• Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

• The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

• Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

What you’ll do



• Own the end-to-end relationship for 5–10 enterprise customers, driving retention, expansion, and executive trust.

• Develop ROI-driven business cases that demonstrate the value of Superside’s model.


• Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve customer outcomes.


• Coach and develop PMs and Producers to raise the bar on delivery and customer management.


• Partner with Creative, Product, and Operations to align on resourcing and execution.




What you'll need to succeed



• 5–10+ years of experience in account management or client services in creative, marketing, or digital environments.


• Proven track record of managing and growing enterprise or high-value global accounts.


• 3–5+ years in an account leadership role (e.g., Senior Account Manager, Group Account Manager, or equivalent).


• Strong commercial acumen with ownership of revenue, retention, and growth targets.


• Experience working with enterprise, SaaS, D2C, or B2B clients.


• Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders and navigate complex organizations.


• Experience leading and developing cross-functional teams.

• Excellent communication skills with a structured, solution-oriented approach.




Compensation


Additional Information

We’re seeking a Customer Solutions Architect (CSA) to help drive the adoption of Supabase across a diverse range of customers: from agile startups building towards their first launch to established brands with highly scaled workloads.

At Supabase, CSA’s are responsible for the entire customer journey, working closely with our most valuable users to:



• 
Uncover and understand business and technical requirements.




• 
Design and architect technical solutions built on the Supabase platform.




• 
Work with customers to lead proof-of-value implementations.




•

Successful CSAs always put customers first, working closely with them to become trusted advisors who understand their needs, work as an extension of their team toward common success, and advocate on behalf of the customer within Supabase.

You'll be joining our team to support Supabase Team & Enterprise customers, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility:



Discovery



• 
Lead technical discovery to uncover business and technical objectives, set appropriate expectations of the Supabase platform, and define the criteria for success, ensuring customers can receive the guidance they need to achieve it.

Design, build, and present Supabase platform demonstrations to high-value customers. Leverage quality storytelling to present the value of the Supabase platform and of the entire Supabase Success team.

Set proof-of-value timelines, business outcomes, and success criteria that ensure a customer is comfortable proceeding with the platform once a proof-of-value has been completed.




• 
Actively guide new customers through an onboarding journey, utilizing emails, docs, guides, and webinars to promote their rapid deployment and growth on the platform.






Customer Success



• 
Understand immediate custom goals (i.e onboard and adoption) as well as long-term customer opportunities (i.e. optimization & identifying new workloads) to build meaningful account plans for high-value customers.




• 
Deliver on synchronous and asynchronous engagements with Supabase customers, including application architecture assessments, database design and performance optimization, and proactive support to enable customers to scale with confidence.




•

Preferred Experience



• 
6+ years of relevant work experience in Solutions Architecture, Database Engineering, or similar.




• 
Strong background with relational database management systems such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.




• 
Background in web application development, with familiarity with Python, C# and popular JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte) as well as Node.js.




• 
Very strong communication skills, particularly of technical concepts. CSA’s at Supabase spend a significant amount of time translating business needs to technical outcomes, and technical concepts to organizational impact.




• 
Well-organized and effective storyteller with meaningful interpersonal skills. CSA’s often have to navigate multiple stakeholders with conflicting opinions, and the ability to effectively mediate this type of conflict is crucial.




• 
Experience with project management, business analysis and revenue operations tools. We use HubSpot, BigQuery etc., and familiarity with these platforms will help enable your success.




• 
Previous experience leading customer-facing engagements to deliver meaningful technical and business value.






What We Offer

Fully Remote

Tech Allowance

Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

Annual Off-Sites

Flexible Work

postings.title: Senior QA Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role:

The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of the company's software products. This role involves close collaboration with product and engineering teams to define clear acceptance criteria, develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, and build robust automated testing frameworks for a modern web application and its backend services. The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle.

What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer:

-

•
Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria.

•
Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases.

•
Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests.

•
Performs manual testing for complex or new features prior to the establishment of full automation coverage.

•
Monitors, analyzes, and improves test coverage, reliability, and performance over time.

•
Contributes to the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) process by integrating automated tests into the deployment pipeline.

•
Enhances overall product quality by creating detailed bug reports, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear testing documentation.

•
Designs and deploys AI-assisted testing workflows to automate recurring tasks such as test case generation, test data synthesis, and log analysis.

•
Evaluates and integrates LLM-based testing and coding tools into the QA team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for automated testing and edge-case discovery use cases.

Experience and skills required:

-

•
Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer (5+ Years of experience) or similar role, specifically testing modern web applications and backend services.

•
Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools.

•
Deep understanding of backend services, APIs (REST and GraphQL), and their common failure scenarios.

•
Ability to read and comprehend frontend and backend code to assist in debugging and test creation.

•
Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools and processes.

•
Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) and demonstrated ability to build, deploy, or thoroughly validate agent-assisted testing systems in a near-production context.

•
Proactive and highly detail-oriented mindset.

•
Advanced proficiency in the English language.

Applicants must be based in South, North or Central America

(applications from other locations will not be considered).

This is a fully remote role , reporting to our Tech Lead.

Compensation

Additional Information

postings.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers’ objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:



• Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical


• Focus - Large companies with established ARR


• Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers



All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.

Location: This role will be based remotely.


What your day will look like



• Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.


• Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.


• Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.


• Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.


• Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams


• Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.


• Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.


• Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.



What we are looking for in you

The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:



• Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.


• Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.


• Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.


• A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.


• Knowledge of agile methodologies.


• We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!



Additional skills that you might also bring



• Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!




What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.



• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person


• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year


• Annual compensation review


• Recognition rewards


• Annual holiday leave


• Maternity and paternity leave


• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform


• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues


• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events






About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. postings.title: Law Clerk/Counsel
postings.descriptionText:
About Teramind

Teramind is a global leader in workforce analytics, insider threat detection, data loss prevention (DLP), and business process optimization. We help organizations of all sizes protect sensitive data, ensure compliance, and optimize workforce performance. Our platform is trusted by enterprise clients across financial services, healthcare, government, and technology sectors worldwide.

About the Role

Teramind is growing rapidly, and so is the legal work required to support that growth. Our General Counsel manages a high volume of enterprise contracts, vendor agreements, compliance requirements, and commercial negotiations across North America, EMEA, and APAC. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Law Clerk or Paralegal to serve as her right hand, taking ownership of operational legal tasks, enabling faster contract throughput, and ensuring no ball gets dropped.

This is a high visibility role in a lean, fast-moving legal function. You will work closely with the GC on everything from first pass contract review to research, documentation, and cross-functional coordination with Sales, Finance, and HR.

Key Responsibilities

• Review, draft, and redline commercial agreements including MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, vendor contracts, and SaaS subscription agreements

• Support the General Counsel in managing the contract pipeline: tracking status, deadlines, open items, and follow-ups

• Conduct initial review of incoming customer and vendor contracts; flag non-standard terms and escalate as appropriate

• Maintain and organize the contract repository; ensure executed agreements are filed, version-controlled, and accessible

• Coordinate with outside counsel: prepare documents, manage communications, and track billing

• Support responses to fraud inquiries, subpoenas, regulatory requests, and government correspondence

• Assist with employment-related documentation including offer letters, severance agreements, and policy updates in coordination with HR

• Conduct legal research on topics including data privacy, cross-border regulatory requirements, and SaaS commercial norms

• Support the GC in educating internal stakeholders (particularly Sales) on contract standards, liability positions, and acceptable terms

• Assist in maintaining and updating legal playbooks, contract templates, and standard operating procedures

• Manage and organize legal holds and related documentation

Qualifications

Required:

• Paralegal certificate, law degree, or J.D. (non-practicing or pre-bar)

• 2–5 years of experience in a legal, law firm, or in-house corporate legal environment

• Strong working knowledge of commercial contract structures and common SaaS agreement terms

• Experience reviewing, redlining, and negotiating NDAs, MSAs, and vendor agreements

• Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to translate complex legal concepts for non-legal audiences

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

• Proficiency with contract management tools, document management systems, and Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

Preferred:

• Experience supporting a General Counsel or senior attorney in a tech or SaaS company

• Exposure to data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 context, HIPAA)

• Familiarity with cross-border commercial agreements (EMEA, APAC)

• Experience with e-signature platforms (DocuSign, Adobe Sign) and CLM tools

• Background in or exposure to cybersecurity, DLP, or workforce analytics industries

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

• Contract turnaround time reduced from 3–5 days to same-day or next-day for standard agreements

• GC's time freed from first pass review and administrative coordination, redirected to strategic legal matters

• Outside counsel spend meaningfully reduced

• Contract repository fully organized and maintained

• Sales team supported with faster legal responses, reducing deal friction and limiting exposure to unfavorable commercial terms
