postings.title: Graduate Customer Success Manager
postings.descriptionText:
The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer’s objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.

This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.

Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.

What your day will look like

• A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.

• Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.

• Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.

• Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers

• Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.

• Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.

• Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification

• Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team

What we are looking for in you

• Customer-facing experience

• An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others

• Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must

• Excellent presentation skills

• Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation

• A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally

Additional skills that you might also bring

• We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others

• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's essential bills, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the role

As a Senior SDET at Flex, you will own the test automation and quality efforts for entire product areas or major features. You will architect and optimize automation frameworks, lead test strategy for complex systems, and regularly collaborate across teams to deliver reliable and high-quality releases. This role offers the opportunity to mentor others, drive cross-functional quality improvements, and play a critical part in shaping the future of our engineering excellence.

What you’ll do

• Architect, implement, and optimize automated test frameworks for complex product areas, ensuring high reliability and maintainability

• Design, develop, and maintain robust automated test suites for API, UI, and integration testing

• Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and quality leaders on cross-functional quality initiatives and release planning

• Maintain accurate and actionable test documentation, reports, and quality metrics for assigned product areas

• Investigate and resolve complex defects and production issues through advanced debugging and root cause analysis

• Advocate for quality and champion adoption of best practices within and across engineering teams

• Proven ability to lead test strategy and risk analysis while making high-impact technical decisions amid ambiguity and prioritizing what matters most.

Key qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in software development and test automation

• Advanced proficiency in multiple programming languages and test automation frameworks

• Deep experience designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, RestAssured)

• Advanced debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis

• Solid understanding of database systems and advanced SQL

• Experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog, NewRelic)

• Excellent cross-functional communication and mentorship skills

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to collaborate across functions

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, and compensation may vary depending on your primary work location. Work locations are categorized into one of three tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be commensurate with their experience, qualifications, and Flex’s internal leveling guidelines and benchmarks.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle)

$136,000—$170,000 USD

Tier 2 (Austin, Washington D.C. Philadelphia, San Diego, Chicago, Atlanta)

$122,400—$153,000 USD

Tier 3 (Salt Lake City, all other USA cities)

$115,600—$144,500 USD

Life at Flex

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

View our benefits and more at getflex.com/careers .

• Foremost a software engineer . You exemplify high code quality and guide others, and have at least 5 years of industry experience as a data engineer or similar role.

• You are experienced in creating automated testing, applying design patterns, and other engineering best practices.

• You are an expert in Python and possess fluency in SQL and have developed maintainable data pipelines with each.

• Hands-on with architecting solutions. You have designed several data pipelines from start to finish. Choosing appropriate technologies, building, testing and rollout.

• Experience with aychronous systems. You are comfortable identifying and applying APIs, streaming, multithreading, and other asynchronous approaches to the right problems. You understand how to monitor and maintain these systems.

• Product mindset. You think about the business impact of your work, and can use high-level goals to prioritize work.

• Communication Extraordinaire. You excel at communicating to both technical and non-technical people, with an ability to explain complex concepts simply.

• ML/AI–aware. You have working knowledge of how ML/AI applications are deployed and monitored, and you’re motivated to use this awareness to advance data-driven initiatives.

Here's How You Will Make an Impact

• Collaborate with product managers, data analysts, and machine learning engineers to develop pipelines and ETL tasks in order to facilitate the extraction of insights.

• Understand product requirements and translate them into actionable project plans that you or your peers execute upon.

• Establish data architecture processes and practices that can be scheduled, automated, replicated and serve as standards for other teams to leverage.

• Collaborate with your team's Data Leadership to identify and push forward meaningful projects across the commercial org.

About Us

• Explore our stack

• We have over 500 private repositories in Github containing our pipelines, our own internal multi-functional tools, and open-source projects

• We have worked as a distributed team for a long time; we're currently about 65% distributed

• Find out more information on the Doximity engineering blog

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $165,000 - $221,000, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

• Base salary

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Flexible paid time off and company holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Professional development and learning opportunities

• Wellness and mental health resources

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

• Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

• Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

Alliances & Channels Leader

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We have new senior leadership opportunities in our Global Alliances and Channels organisations, to lead business development and partnership with some of the most important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, Canonical works across a broad partner ecosystem that includes global system integrators, value-added resellers, regional distributors, independent software vendors, independent hardware vendors, silicon companies, public clouds and other strategic technology brands.

These partners shape the platforms, solutions, marketplaces, hardware and delivery motions through which enterprises adopt open source at scale. We are looking for exceptional partner leaders who can build durable, mutually valuable relationships, develop joint solutions, drive global go-to-market programmes, and convert partner potential into measurable customer impact, revenue growth and market expansion for Canonical.

Opportunities are available for both people leaders and senior individual contributors. In these roles, you will lead, build or scale one or more strategic partner motions for Canonical, either by managing a team or by directly driving high-impact partner initiatives. You will work closely with partners throughout their sales, product, delivery and executive planning cycles to make Canonical their trusted partner for enterprise open source solutions. Depending on your experience and Canonical’s business priorities, your focus may include Channels, GSI, ISV, IHV/OEM, Silicon, Cloud or cross-ecosystem partnerships.

Our Alliances and Channels teams build trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelise the partnership, and lead business interactions from engineers to CxO level. This role will own strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions across assigned partners or sectors, as well as promotion of partner-related activities, from campaigns, enablement and executive engagement, to strategic opportunities and partner events.

Location: These are globally remote positions.

The role entails



• Own and drive partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical across one or more indirect routes to market

• Build strategic relationships with global and regional partners at executive levels


• Design and execute joint go-to-market plans with partners, sales, product management, product marketing and engineering teams


• Develop partner capability through sales engagement, technical enablement, joint marketing and disciplined business planning


• Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organisation


• Establish operating cadence, pipeline governance and data-driven accountability across complex partner relationships



What we are looking for in you:



• 10+ years of experience in alliance, channel, partner, ecosystem or indirect sales management roles


• Experience in one or more of GSIs, VARs, distributors, ISVs, IHVs/OEMs, silicon, public cloud, marketplaces or strategic technology alliances


• Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue, margins, pipeline, forecasting and partner economics


• Proven leadership and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently from engineer to CxO level


• Ability to build trusted executive relationships while aligning product, sales, marketing, engineering and operations teams


• Insight into open source, Ubuntu, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, AI, security and Canonical’s competition and opportunities


• Track record of data-driven decision-making and disciplined execution across complex, global relationships


• An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality


• An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.


• Business level written and spoken English.


• Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.


• International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.



In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:



• Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.


• Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.


• Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.


• Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.



What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Si pasas horas descubriendo creadores en TikTok e Instagram, este rol puede ser para ti. En este puesto nos importa tanto la capacidad de encontrar perfiles relevantes como el criterio para evaluar si realmente tienen potencial.

• Experiencia: experiencia buscando o investigando influencers en volumen .

• Dominio de plataformas: TikTok e Instagram (hashtags, explorar, sugeridos, etc.).

• Criterio: buen ojo para detectar perfiles de calidad.

• Interés: interés por redes sociales y la economía de creadores.

• Colaboración: comunicar hallazgos de forma clara y mantener consistencia para que el equipo comercial aproveche los leads.

Responsabilidades:
En Fanova buscamos un/a Especialista en Scouting de Influencers para encontrar creadoras de contenido con gran potencial.

• Identificar y evaluar creadoras de contenido.

• Entregar 10 leads calificados al día.

• Documentar la información de cada perfil de forma organizada.

• Colaborar con el equipo comercial (sin necesidad de enviar mensajes ni hacer ventas).

Nos enfocamos en la calidad del scouting, la consistencia diaria y el orden en la documentación para que el equipo pueda avanzar rápidamente con las mejores oportunidades.

Deseable:
• Experiencia en startups.

• Conocimiento del mercado de influencers en México y Latinoamérica.

Sumará si ya tienes métodos propios para detectar crecimiento, engagement y señales de calidad en TikTok e Instagram, y si puedes traducir eso a una evaluación coherente y documentada.

Beneficios:
• Trabajo remoto 100%: lunes a viernes de 10:00am a 6:00pm (horario CDMX).

• Salario competitivo en USD a partir de $1,500 al mes.

• Membresía de gimnasio.

• Oportunidades reales de crecimiento profesional.

• Ambiente de equipo colaborativo y de apoyo.

Vacante disponible únicamente para personas que residan en México.

postings.title: Arquitecto de Datos (Data & AI)
postings.descriptionText:
Descripción
Buscamos un/a Arquitecto/a de Datos Junior para sumarse a nuestro equipo de arquitectura, que da soporte transversal a todas las áreas de datos de la organización. Vas a trabajar junto a arquitectos senior en el diseño y la evolución de la plataforma de datos en Azure y Databricks, aprendiendo a tomar decisiones basadas en datos, definir estándares y acompañar a los equipos desde el diseño hasta producción y en la resolución de incidentes. Es un rol ideal para alguien con base en ingeniería de datos que quiera dar el paso hacia la arquitectura, con una visión más amplia del ecosistema.

Requisitos

• De 2 a 3 años de experiencia en Ingeniería de Datos, BI, Analytics Engineering o un rol similar.

• Experiencia práctica en Azure, especialmente Azure Data Factory (ADF) y Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS).

• Experiencia práctica con Databricks: Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows y conocimientos de Unity Catalog.

• Buen manejo de Python, PySpark y SQL.

• Experiencia con Terraform y CI/CD, idealmente Terraform Cloud y GitHub Actions, para desplegar jobs, clusters y permisos.

• Conocimientos de modelado de datos relacional y dimensional, y nociones de bases NoSQL documentales (modelado de documentos e índices).

• Comprensión de conceptos de arquitectura de datos: Lakehouse, arquitectura medallion (bronze/silver/gold), batch vs. streaming.

• Capacidad para documentar y comunicar ideas técnicas de forma clara, tanto escrita como con diagramas.

Perfil que buscamos
Visión sistémica y curiosidad por entender cómo encajan las piezas de una plataforma completa, desde SAP hasta las apps y los reportes. Hábito de medir antes de opinar. Buena comunicación para trabajar con equipos diversos, incluidos soporte y negocio, y explicar conceptos técnicos a perfiles no técnicos. Pensamiento analítico, orden para documentar y disposición para aprender de los arquitectos senior y recibir feedback.

Responsabilidades:
• Apoyar al equipo de arquitectura en el diseño de soluciones sobre la plataforma Lakehouse en Azure y Databricks, siguiendo las arquitecturas de referencia y los estándares del equipo.

• Diseñar y revisar los patrones de integración entre el Lakehouse y los stores operativos (MongoDB y Couchbase): patrón publish, estrategias de purga, índices y rendimiento de escritura desde los ETLs.

• Apoyar en el modelado de datos de la plataforma: maestros en silver, vistas public y RLS en gold con seguridad por país, y modelos documentales para las aplicaciones, considerando escenarios multi-país y multi-tenant.

• Medir antes de decidir: usar system tables y linaje de Unity Catalog para analizar costos, uso, rendimiento e impacto antes de proponer cambios de arquitectura.

• Participar en los pases a producción: revisar PRs, definir criterios para QA y validar después del pase.

• Diagnosticar incidentes de punta a punta junto a soporte y negocio, desde la fuente hasta el consumo, y documentar la causa raíz.

• Apoyar la implementación de políticas de gobierno en Unity Catalog (catálogos, permisos, linaje, convenciones de nombres).

• Documentar arquitecturas, decisiones técnicas (ADRs), estándares y guías de buenas prácticas, y hacer diagramas de arquitectura y flujos de datos.

• Participar en revisiones de diseño con los distintos equipos para verificar que cumplan los estándares de arquitectura y gobierno.

• Servir de enlace entre el equipo de arquitectura y los equipos de desarrollo para resolver dudas técnicas y difundir estándares.

• Ocasionalmente, desarrollar pruebas de concepto y evaluar nuevas funcionalidades de la plataforma.

Deseable:
• Experiencia con SAP como fuente de datos, especialmente con sus extractores.

• Experiencia con MongoDB o Couchbase.

• Conocimiento de Lakeflow.

• Experiencia con Power BI como consumidor de modelos gold.

• Experiencia preparando datos para agentes de IA: Vector Search, MCP o Azure AI Foundry.

• Nociones de gobierno de datos: calidad, linaje, catálogo y seguridad de accesos.

• Certificación Databricks Data Engineer Associate o Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203 o su equivalente vigente).

Beneficios:
• Oportunidad de trabajar de forma remota.

• Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y dinámico.

• Desarrollo profesional continuo y oportunidades de crecimiento.

postings.title: GTM/ Sales - Sales Lead - Buenos Aires (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Sales Lead to accelerate the growth of Clara Global and strengthen Clara's presence in Argentina. This is a strategic, hands-on Individual Contributor role that combines enterprise sales, business development, and market expansion. You'll be responsible for generating new business, closing high-value opportunities, and helping position Clara as a leading financial technology solution for companies operating across borders.

You'll work closely with our teams in Mexico to identify growth opportunities, develop the market, and build a scalable commercial pipeline.

In this role, you will:

• Own the end-to-end sales cycle for Clara Global, from prospecting and qualification to product demos, negotiation, and closing.

• Drive new business acquisition , identifying and engaging companies that can benefit from Clara's global reimbursement and financial solutions.

• Build and execute a strong outbound strategy , generating a high-quality pipeline through targeted prospecting, referrals, and multi-channel outreach.

• Develop relationships with CFOs, Finance Directors, HR leaders, and other key decision-makers , positioning Clara as a strategic partner.

• Help drive Clara's positioning and expansion in Argentina , identifying market opportunities, building strategic relationships, and increasing brand awareness within the business ecosystem.

• Identify opportunities within our existing customer base to drive product adoption, expansion, and Total Payment Volume (TPV) .

• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and other teams to support go-to-market initiatives and accelerate growth.

• Bring valuable market insights, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to help refine Clara's commercial strategy and product positioning.

• Leverage AI and automation to improve prospecting, account research, outreach personalization, and sales productivity.

• Manage your pipeline and forecasts through HubSpot , using data to prioritize opportunities, track performance, and improve conversion.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

• 5+ years of experience in B2B Sales, Enterprise Sales, Account Executive, or Business Development roles, ideally within fintech, SaaS, payments, or financial services.

• Proven track record of generating pipeline, managing complex sales cycles, and consistently achieving commercial targets .

• Experience selling to C-level executives and senior decision-makers , particularly within Finance, HR, or Operations.

• Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Experience developing new markets, territories, or customer segments , with the ability to build opportunities from scratch.

• Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting .

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot or similar CRMs , and prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, or Apollo.

• Experience using AI tools and automation to improve prospecting, productivity, or commercial workflows.

• Strong analytical mindset, high ownership, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English .

Nice to haves

• Experience selling cross-border payments, corporate financial solutions, expense management, or reimbursement products .

• Strong network within the Argentinian business, fintech, or technology ecosystem .

• Experience supporting go-to-market strategies, market expansion, or brand positioning .

• Experience working with multinational companies or customers with cross-border operations.

• Familiarity with AI and automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar platforms.

• Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or BI tools .

• Portuguese proficiency.

How we work in this territory

Argentina is an emerging territory for Clara — there's no office to go into, so this role works remotely from Argentina day to day. You'll ramp up in person with the team, and come together in person for team moments, events and customer visits through the year.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Senior Marketing Analyst, Data & Analytics
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We are looking for a strategic Senior Marketing Analyst to join our growing data and analytics (DNA) team at Thomasnet.com and serve as the analytical engine behind our paid and owned marketing strategy. This is a role that sits at the intersection of marketing performance, data engineering, and executive storytelling. You will own paid marketing analytics end-to-end: building the data infrastructure that powers our reporting, running attribution analysis across channels, and — critically — translating complex data into the clear narratives that drive budget, strategy, and product decisions. We don't just need someone who can build a dashboard. We need someone who knows what it means, and can make a room of senior leaders feel it. This role bridges Marketing, Sales, Yield, and Product. Your work will directly influence how we allocate marketing spend, price our inventory, and grow revenue.

About Thomas

For over 125 years, Thomas has been the definitive resource for industrial buyers and suppliers across North America. Today, thomasnet.com is the leading digital platform for industrial product discovery and supplier selection connecting more than 1.4 million active buyers including engineers, procurement managers, and MRO professionals with over 500,000 North American manufacturers and distributors across 70,000 product categories. No other platform in the industrial space operates at this depth or scale. Thomas Data and Analytics team is the data and intelligence function at the heart of that network — owning the analytical infrastructure that connects buyer demand to supplier performance and drives Thomas's growth strategy and data-informed decision makings.

How You’ll Contribute:

Paid Marketing Analytics

• Own end-to-end analytics for paid channels: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and any emerging paid media — from impression to revenue attribution

• Build and maintain attribution models and funnel reporting across paid and organic channels to measure true ROAS, CAC, and long-term LTV outcomes

• Monitor campaign pacing, budget utilization, and performance against targets; surface anomalies and recommend actions in real time

Insights & Storytelling

• Transform raw marketing data into clear, executive-ready narratives — not just "what happened," but "why it happened" and "what we should do"

• Develop weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance recaps for leadership that drive decisions, not just inform them

• Proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities across marketing channels and synthesize them into a point of view — with a recommendation

• Partner with the marketing and sales teams to answer the "so what" behind every metric

Analytics Engineering

• Build and maintain robust data models in Snowflake (SQL, dbt, or similar) integrating data from Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Segment, Salesforce, Iterable, and ad servers

• Manage and improve reverse-ETL pipelines that feed performance data back into operational tools (Google Ads API, campaign management platforms)

• Create and own Looker dashboards aligned to marketing KPIs, campaign health, and revenue forecasting

Testing & Experimentation

• Design and analyze A/B tests for paid campaigns, landing pages, and yield strategies; translate statistical results into plain-language recommendations

• Support channel-level experiments: bid strategies, audience segmentation, creative performance

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

Experience

• 5+ years in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or a closely related field — ideally in a marketplace, B2B SaaS, AdTech, or lead-gen environment

• Demonstrated experience owning paid marketing analytics (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta); you understand how the platforms work, not just how to report on them

• Track record of producing analysis that changed a decision — and you can tell that story in an interview

Technical Skills

• Expert-level SQL; strong Python for data manipulation and analysis

• Hands-on with Snowflake and dbt (or equivalent modern data stack)

• Proficient in Looker (or Tableau/similar) — you build dashboards that people actually use

• Familiarity with Google Ads API, Microsoft Ads API, Segment event tracking, and CRM data (Salesforce, HubSpot)

• Bonus: experience with ad servers or yield platforms (Kevel, Placements.io)

Communication & Storytelling

• Exceptional written and verbal communication — you write crisp, jargon-free analyses that a CMO would forward to a CEO

• Ability to structure ambiguous problems, frame a hypothesis, and present findings with confidence and a point of view

• Comfort presenting to senior stakeholders; you don't hide behind the data, you use it to make an argument

Domain Knowledge

• Deep understanding of paid marketing KPIs: ROAS, CPC, CPL, impression share, quality score, attribution windows

• Familiarity with marketing attribution methodologies (last-click, data-driven, multi-touch)

• Understanding of lead funnels from impression through conversion and renewal

postings.descriptionText:
Join Our Team
 
Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.
 
As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.
 
We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Kafka/AWS Integration Engineer to join a project focused on building and productionizing an event-driven middleware platform using Apache Kafka and AWS.
This is a highly hands-on engineering role where you will build the AWS side of the integration platform, with Salesforce serving as the initial event source. You will work alongside the Lead Integration Architect and within the Agile sprint process, implementing solutions based on an established architecture and prioritized backlog.
You will work across Apache Kafka, Amazon MSK, Java, Kafka Connect, Change Data Capture (CDC), AWS serverless technologies, and Infrastructure as Code, while helping establish reliable, testable, and maintainable event-driven integrations.

Responsibilities:
• Provision and configure Amazon MSK clusters, Kafka topics, and schema registry .

• Configure and maintain Kafka Connect and CDC source connectors .

• Build REST-based event ingress using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to receive Salesforce events and publish them to Kafka.

• Develop Java stream-processing applications to transform data between Kafka topics.

• Build Java-based integration pipelines to deliver events from outbound topics to downstream systems.

• Implement dead letter queues and error-handling patterns for reliable event processing.

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and code coverage .

• Build and maintain infrastructure using AWS CloudFormation , enabling the client's operations team to redeploy and manage the environment.

• Work within the client's Agile/sprint process and collaborate closely with the Lead Integration Architect.

• Create clear technical documentation and provide ongoing knowledge transfer to the client's engineering and operations teams.

Requirements:
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• Strong hands-on experience developing backend and integration solutions with Java .

• Professional experience building event-driven and Kafka-based systems .

• Hands-on experience working with AWS services and cloud-based integrations .

• Experience building and supporting production-grade integration pipelines.

• Strong understanding of automated testing, CI/CD, and production-quality software development practices.

• Comfortable working within an Agile/sprint environment under the direction of a client architect.

• Strong communication and technical documentation skills.

• Ability to transfer technical knowledge effectively to client engineering and operations teams.

• Advanced written and verbal English communication skills.

Must Have:
• Strong Java development experience, including stream processing and API components.

• Strong hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK , including:

• Kafka clusters and topics

• Kafka Connect

• Change Data Capture (CDC)

• Experience with Schema Registry , including schema versioning and evolution.

• Strong experience with AWS serverless technologies , including:

• API Gateway

• AWS Lambda

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with AWS CloudFormation .

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines .

• Experience with automated testing and code coverage .

• Experience building or supporting event-driven integration systems .

• Comfortable working in an Agile/sprint environment under a client architect's direction .

• Strong communication and documentation skills for technical knowledge transfer .

• Advanced written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have:
• Experience with Salesforce CDC or Salesforce event integrations .

• Experience implementing dead letter queues (DLQs) and error-handling patterns in event-driven systems. Kafka-AWS-Integration-Engineer.

Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company;

Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational);
Games and Competitions;

postings.title: Ejecutivo/a Senior de Cobranzas y Recuperación de Cartera – LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
En Anyone AI tenemos una misión: impulsar el talento de Latinoamérica para que sea protagonista de la revolución de la Inteligencia Artificial.

Estamos construyendo el hub de talento en AI más grande de la región. A través de nuestro AI Fellowship Program, ayudamos a software developers a transformar su experiencia en nuevas capacidades para crear tecnología con AI, acelerar sus carreras y acceder a oportunidades globales. Combinamos formación práctica, expertos de la industria y una comunidad que aprende y crece en conjunto.

Sumarte a Anyone AI es contribuir a que más profesionales transformen su futuro y a que el talento latinoamericano tenga un papel cada vez más relevante en la industria tecnológica global.



El propósito de tu rol

Serás responsable de gestionar y recuperar los pagos de fellows que cursaron nuestro entrenamiento y cuya obligación de pago se ha activado conforme a las condiciones de su contrato.

Administrarás una cartera regional: aproximadamente el 70% de los fellows se encuentra en Argentina y el resto en México, Colombia, Chile y otros países de LATAM.

Buscamos a una persona con experiencia en cobranzas complejas, capacidad de negociación y seguridad para explicar condiciones contractuales. Deberás combinar persistencia, firmeza y empatía para convertir conversaciones difíciles en acuerdos de pago y cobros efectivos.



Tus principales responsabilidades

 - Administrar una cartera de fellows con obligaciones de pago activadas, pagos pendientes y acuerdos incumplidos.

 - Revisar contratos, antecedentes, información laboral y registros de contacto para preparar cada gestión.

 - Contactar a los fellows mediante llamadas, correo electrónico, WhatsApp y otros canales habilitados por la compañía, siguiendo sus políticas de contacto y confidencialidad.

 - Diseñar y ejecutar secuencias de seguimiento para localizar a personas con baja respuesta o que han interrumpido la comunicación.

 - Conducir conversaciones con fellows que presentan objeciones, desconocen su obligación de pago o manifiestan su negativa a cumplirla.

 - Explicar con claridad las cláusulas aplicables, las condiciones que activan el pago, los montos y las fechas correspondientes, utilizando criterios y materiales validados por el área legal.

 - Distinguir entre dificultades económicas, dudas contractuales, controversias sobre la activación del pago y negativas de cumplimiento.

 - Negociar compromisos y planes de pago dentro de los márgenes autorizados, escalando descuentos, excepciones o modificaciones para su aprobación.

 - Dar seguimiento a los acuerdos hasta confirmar el ingreso y la correcta aplicación de los pagos.

 - Registrar en el CRM las gestiones, respuestas, objeciones, compromisos, comprobantes y próximos pasos.

 - Coordinar con Finanzas, Operaciones, el equipo de acompañamiento a fellows y asesoría legal para resolver casos.

 - Preparar expedientes completos para los casos que requieran revisión o escalamiento legal.

 - Proponer mejoras en mensajes, procesos, segmentación y estrategias de recuperación.



Lo que buscamos

 - Al menos 3 años de experiencia en cobranza, recuperación de cartera o negociación de pagos, con participación directa en casos de alta resistencia.

 - Experiencia gestionando cartera de personas físicas en Argentina y el resto de LATAM, y conocimiento de los hábitos de comunicación y negociación del mercado local.

 - Resultados comprobables en recuperación de pagos, cumplimiento de metas y seguimiento de acuerdos.

 - Experiencia leyendo contratos y explicando obligaciones, condiciones de pago y cláusulas relevantes de forma clara.

 - Capacidad para manejar objeciones, desescalar conflictos y sostener conversaciones difíciles con profesionalismo.

 - Excelente comunicación oral y escrita en español.

 - Manejo de CRM, Excel o Google Sheets y herramientas de comunicación digital.

 - Organización y autonomía para gestionar una cartera de manera remota.

 - Criterio para reconocer cuándo un caso requiere revisión legal y evitar comprometer condiciones fuera de su autorización.

 - Disponibilidad para coordinar contactos en los usos horarios de Argentina y otros países de LATAM.



Valoraremos especialmente:

 - Experiencia en fintech, créditos personales, financiamiento educativo, edtech, bootcamps, suscripciones o servicios con pagos diferidos.

 - Experiencia con esquemas de pago vinculados a contratación laboral o mejora de ingresos.

 - Es un plus contar experiencia trabajando con despachos o equipos legales.

 - Formación en Derecho, Administración, Contabilidad, Finanzas o carreras afines.



Cómo mediremos tu éxito:

 - Monto efectivamente recuperado frente a la meta asignada.

 - Tasa de recuperación sobre la cartera gestionable.

 - Porcentaje de contacto efectivo con los fellows.

 - Tiempo de recuperación y evolución de saldos vencidos.



Qué esperamos durante tus primeros 90 días:

 - Dominar los contratos, los criterios de activación del pago y los procedimientos de cobranza.

 - Contar con una estrategia de seguimiento para cada tipo de caso.

 - Mantener trazabilidad completa de las gestiones y acuerdos.

 - Mostrar resultados de recuperación frente a las metas definidas.

 - Identificar las principales objeciones y proponer mejoras concretas al proceso.
   
   

Qué ofrecemos:

 - Trabajo 100% remoto desde LATAM, preferentemente Argentina.

 - Participación en una compañía de educación en inteligencia artificial con alcance regional.

 - Oportunidad de contribuir a la mejora del proceso de cobranza y recuperación.

En Bidcom impulsamos la evolución del comercio electrónico liderando el mercado con nuestras marcas propias, como Gadnic, y una consolidada presencia en canales digitales y marketplaces. Somos un entorno dinámico, de alto impacto y en constante aceleración, diseñado para profesionales orientados a resultados que buscan transformar datos en decisiones estratégicas. Si te apasionan los grandes desafíos e impactar directamente en la rentabilidad y escalabilidad de un negocio digital líder, este rol es para vos.

Tareas y Responsabilidades
Como Head of Growth Marketing , asumirás un rol clave y transversal para acelerar el crecimiento rentable de Bidcom y Gadnic sobre todo el funnel (Adquisición, Activación, Retención y Revenue) tanto en nuestros canales propios como en MercadoLibre y otros marketplaces.

• Liderar la estrategia integral de Growth Marketing alineada a los OKRs de la compañía y de la Plataforma de Marketing, con foco en el crecimiento de GMV y net profit .

• Desarrollar y coordinar un equipo de 5 profesionales distribuido en tres squads (Customer Acquisition, Customer Activation & Retention, y Revenue & Optimization), además de dirigir las agencias y partners externos (medios, SEO/GEO y martech ) como extensión del área.

• Supervisar y optimizar la inversión publicitaria en medios de performance y brandformance (Google, Meta, TikTok y Mercado Ads), garantizando eficiencia en ACOS/TACoS y ROAS, y migrando el modelo hacia POAS e impacto incremental.

• Construir el business plan anual y el forecast mensual de inversión, integrando la visión bottom-up del área con los objetivos estratégicos top-down de Dirección.

• Liderar la estrategia comercial en Mercado Ads y la relación con Mercado Libre, gestionando el Joint Business Plan y las reglas de automatización de la pauta.

• Impulsar la estrategia de tráfico orgánico (SEO técnico, contenidos y GEO) para reducir progresivamente la dependencia del tráfico pago.

• Dirigir la estrategia de CRM y lifecycle en Salesforce Marketing Cloud y Data Cloud: automatizaciones, crecimiento de la base contactable, frecuencia de compra y personalización onsite midiendo el impacto incremental con grupos de control.

• Asegurar la excelencia en la infraestructura de analítica y medición junto a Data y TI (GA4, GTM, feeds , modelos de atribución y Marketing Mix Modeling) para establecer la agenda de experimentación y escalabilidad.

• Planificar y ejecutar la estrategia de Growth para eventos masivos de la compañía (CyberMonday, Hot Sale, Black Friday, Navidad) y presentar los análisis post-evento.

• Gestionar la contratación, negociación de fees , alcance y seguimiento de resultados de agencias y proveedores.

• Reportar periódicamente a Dirección mediante tableros de KPIs, reportes mensuales de performance y propuestas estratégicas de inversión.

• Coordinar con las áreas de Comercial, Web & Marketplaces, Brand & Social, TI y Data para alinear el calendario comercial, la conversión del sitio y el roadmap tecnológico.

Requisitos
Excluyentes:

• Más de 8 años de experiencia en marketing digital o growth en e-commerce, retail o marketplaces, con al menos 3 años liderando equipos.

• Experiencia comprobable gestionando presupuestos de paid media de gran escala en Google Ads, Meta y TikTok, con foco en performance y rentabilidad (ROAS, ACOS, CAC, POAS).

• Experiencia en retail media y marketplaces, con foco en Mercado Libre y Mercado Ads.

• Solidez en CRM, automatización de marketing (deseable Salesforce Marketing Cloud) y estrategias de lifecycle y retención.

• Manejo analítico avanzado: GA4, análisis de funnel y cohortes, definición de KPIs y toma de decisiones basada en tableros de control.

• Experiencia en armado de business plan y forecast de inversión publicitaria.

• Experiencia gestionando agencias y proveedores externos, incluyendo negociación de contratos y fees .

• Trayectoria liderando la estrategia de Growth en eventos de alto volumen (CyberMonday, Hot Sale, Black Friday).

• Título universitario en Marketing, Administración, Economía, Ingeniería o carreras afines.

Deseables:

• Experiencia previa en marketplaces, fintechs , retailers regionales o agencias de performance.

• Experiencia en roles con alcance regional (operación en múltiples países).

• Posgrado o Maestría en Negocios Digitales, Marketing o afines.

• Conocimiento de SEO técnico, estrategia de contenidos y GEO (posicionamiento en respuestas de IA).

• Manejo de BigQuery/SQL, Looker Studio o herramientas de BI.

• Conocimiento técnico de martech : GTM, server-side tagging , gestión de feeds , modelos de atribución e incrementalidad (MMM / Meridian).

• Experiencia con Salesforce Data Cloud, personalización onsite y WhatsApp como canal de CRM.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio-avanzado.

Beneficios Corporativos

• Posibilidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo en una empresa líder.

postings.title: Senior User Acquisition Manager, Paid Social Ads
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a senior, hands-on media buying role with end-to-end ownership. You will own the whole acquisition process on Paid Social acquisition channels: strategy, account structure, bidding, budget allocation, creative testing, measurement, scaling and account health. You decide what to test, what to scale and what to cut, and you are accountable for the results. We need someone who has already run Paid Social Ads at scale, who knows how to grow profitably in a policy-sensitive niche, and who can operate independently on large budgets.

You will manage performance against real revenue data (CPA, FTD, ROAS, payback, player LTV and cohorts), not surface-level platform metrics. We also work AI-first, and we expect you to use Claude and automation to move faster.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the process end-to-end: take full ownership of acquisition across all paid social ad networks (TikTok, Meta, AppLovin, Snapchat, and more): planning, launch, optimization, scaling, reporting and documentation.

 - Scale spend profitably in the US market while holding payback, ROAS and CPA targets based on real revenue and player-value data.

 - Build and optimize account structure, conversion events, value-based bidding and budget allocation across paid social networks.

 - Decide budget allocation across acquisition channels and find new scaling levers: audiences, formats, placements, campaign types and additional channels.

 - Run a structured, high-velocity creative testing process with the creative team on all channels, with clear hypotheses and kill/scale rules.

 - Manage signal quality: conversion events, event value, deposit / purchase optimization, attribution.

 - Operate in a policy-sensitive niche: run in the US within each platform's rules. Keep ads and handle disapprovals, appeals and restrictions, and build prevention-first processes so issues are caught before launch.

 - Protect account health: manage ad account structure, backups and recovery plans.

 - Work with reps on betas, new campaign types and escalations.

 - Diagnose drops and spikes quickly and act on them.

 - Document tests, learnings and playbooks, and use Claude and automation to speed up builds, QA, reporting and optimization.


QUALIFICATIONS




 - 5+ years of hands-on paid social / user acquisition experience.

 - Large-scale experience running acquisitions in the US market.

 - Proven experience working in policy-sensitive niches and keeping accounts healthy while scaling.

 - Strong hands-on Meta Ads experience scaling accounts profitably.

 - Hands-on AppLovin (AppLovin Ads / AXON) experience, scaling it as an acquisition channel.

 - Direct ownership of large budgets, ideally $1M+/month hands-on.

 - Strong understanding of unit economics: LTV, ROAS, payback windows, cohorts, high-value-user dynamics and value-based optimization.

 - Deep policy and account health experience: disapprovals, appeals, restrictions, ad account bans and how to recover and prevent them.

 - Strong creative testing discipline and measurement rigor.

 - Ownership mentality: you run channels end-to-end with minimal supervision and take responsibility for outcomes.


LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

 - Company-provided MacBook: Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Read more about it here: Independent Contractor Agreement https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dHF4ctKlez75whdn-ybUwP5d5Wr0BdwVrorrm_fM40Q/preview

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!




LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we're a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that a diversity of thought and backgrounds builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status. Join us and be part of a company that is crafting the future of technology across multiple industries.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:
Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team. The successful candidate is someone with a deep understanding of legal and regulatory requirements pertaining to the crypto-asset industry in Thailand, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.

To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, crypto-assets and the regulatory requirements.
You will have a focus around translating regulatory requirements in Thailand into clear and actionable strategic recommendations, managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business.

You will report to the regional Lead, Asia Pacific, within the Regulatory and Licensing department, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on licensing initiatives in different parts of the globe.

• Policy Analysis and Guidance: Provide analysis on local regulatory proposals, and advise the business on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance.

• Regulatory approval process: contribute to the process of obtaining necessary license approvals in identified markets, where appropriate.

• Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., legal, compliance, finance) to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and to proactively address emerging regulatory challenges.

• Minimum of 5 years regulatory experience within the financial services or crypto-asset industry.

• Ability to apply knowledge of key regulatory frameworks in Thailand both strategically and operationally and provide direction to resolve complex regulatory issues.

• Expertise in preparing regulatory analysis including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities, such as regulatory consultation response submissions.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must have hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently, with excellent verbal and written communication skills

• English speaking

• University degree

postings.descriptionText:
Total Number of Openings
1

The Exploration BPF Analyst provides financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and decision support for Chevron's Global Exploration organization. The role partners with Exploration Leadership, Finance, Planning, Operations, Commercial and Business Unit stakeholders, to deliver timely financial insights, support strategic decision-making, and ensure accurate financial stewardship of exploration activities across a diverse portfolio of global assets and countries.
The analyst serves as a trusted business partner, supporting business planning cycles, outlook development, management reporting, capital stewardship, cost management, and performance analysis while helping drive continuous improvement and standardization across Exploration Finance processes. Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

• Prepare and coordinate monthly outlooks, annual business plans, and long-range planning activities for assigned Exploration assets and countries.

• Develop forecasts for exploration capital, exploratory expense, G&A, earnings impacts, and working capital components.

• Analyze actual versus forecast performance and identify key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.

• Support delivery of forecast accuracy and financial performance objectives established by Exploration leadership.

Accounting, Financial Reporting and US GAAP Compliance

• Apply accounting principles and U.S. GAAP to evaluate business transactions, forecasts, accruals, and financial impacts related to exploration activities.

• Partner with Accounting and Finance teams to ensure compliance with Chevron policies, accounting guidance, and reporting requirements.

• Identify and escalate accounting issues, risks, or unusual transactions requiring technical review.

Business Performance & Financial Analysis

• Perform detailed analysis of financial results, spending trends, commitments, and cost drivers.

• Monitor exploration project expenditures, drilling activities, farm-in/farm-out transactions, and country-specific exploration portfolios.

• Identify emerging financial risks and provide recommendations to support business decisions.

• Develop management reporting packages, scorecards, and executive presentations.

Business Partnership & Decision Support

• Partner with Exploration Managers, Country Managers, Finance Managers, Planning teams, and technical stakeholders to support strategic and operational decisions.

• Provide financial guidance related to exploration investments, project economics, funding requirements, and portfolio activities.

• Support evaluation of business opportunities, exploration programs, exits, acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic initiatives.

• Participate in stakeholder discussions and leadership reviews, translating financial information into actionable business insights.

Governance, Controls & Stewardship

• Ensure compliance with Chevron financial policies, controls, accounting guidelines, and planning processes.

• Support capital governance activities including AFE-related reviews, spending authorization monitoring, and documentation requirements.

• Coordinate audit requests and support internal and external compliance activities.

• Maintain strong financial stewardship and data integrity across planning and reporting processes.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Generate recurring and ad hoc reports to support leadership decision-making.

• Leverage digital tools and data analytics solutions to improve reporting efficiency and insight generation.

• Drive standardization, automation, and process improvements across Exploration BPF activities.

• Contribute to documentation, knowledge management, and transition activities supporting the broader Exploration Finance organization.

Key Relationships

Internal

• Vice President and Exploration Leadership Team

• Exploration Country Managers and Asset Leaders

• Exploration Finance and Planning organizations

• Technical Exploration teams (Geology, Geophysics, Drilling, New Ventures)

• Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Supply Chain, and Compliance partners

• Global Business Services Finance organizations

Required Skills & Competencies

Analytical Thinking

Ability to evaluate complex financial and operational information, identify trends, and develop actionable insights that support business decisions.

Financial and Business Acumen

Strong understanding of planning, forecasting, management reporting, capital management, financial analysis, and performance management principles.

Stakeholder Partnership and Teamwork

Ability to establish effective relationships across functional, geographic, and organizational boundaries while influencing outcomes through collaboration.

Effective Communication

Ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly and concisely to both finance and non-finance stakeholders through written materials, presentations, and discussions.

Continuous Improvement Mindset

Focus on simplification, standardization, automation, and leveraging digital solutions to improve effectiveness and efficiency.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or related discipline.

• Experience in financial planning, business performance, decision support, accounting, or related analytical roles.

• Strong Excel, Power BI, SAP, and financial modeling skills.

• Experience working in cross-functional and global business environments preferred.

Chevron participates in E-Verify in certain locations as required by law.

postings.descriptionText:
Application Instructions: Please submit your resume in English when applying.
Work Location Assignment: Buenos Aires, Argentina (Complejo LUMINA – Office Park). This role follows a hybrid model. Colleagues are expected to work from the assigned Pfizer office 2–3 days per week , or as required by business needs.

Use Your Power for Purpose
Our mission is straightforward: support healthcare decisions that ensure the safe and effective use of medications. Whether you are developing the framework to ensure our evidence is scientifically robust, providing unbiased and medically essential expertise, or exploring ways to bridge data gaps, your role is vital. By ensuring our evidence is sound and offering necessary medical insights, we strive to improve patient care and treatment efficacy.

The Senior Associate, Central Monitor is responsible for ensuring the completeness, quality and integrity of the subject data in the clinical trial database under Risk Based Monitoring (RBM) mode. The areas of activity include but are not limited to: developing Risk-Based Monitoring system for applicable studies, ensuring key risk indicators (KRIs) properly defined and set up in the system to support the study, processing and reviewing study data in the system for the signal and action management, follow up for the issue resolution. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor ensures risk based monitoring activities comply with regulations, applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Processes at all times and is familiar with supported systems (RBM system, etc.) and able to troubleshoot and provide rapid response for all database issues. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor ensures quality oversight/control steps implemented in the central monitor activities activities and may be required to perform tasks as CM Program Oversight Lead. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor works with the global study team to meet the study objectives.

What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will:

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
General:
· Implement global strategies, initiatives, processes, and standards to ensure consistent, efficient, and quality processes to meet quality, timelines and deliverables.
· Provide technical expertise to set up and test study level Risk-based Monitoring system
· Review study level system outputs to process for the signal and action management
· Plan and execute communication plans & methods to ensure customer satisfaction and enable improvements to be implemented during the course of a study.
· Able to resolve conflicts, influence and communicate with key stakeholders and customers.
· Implement quality oversight/control steps implemented in the central monitor activities.

System setup Functions:
· Review protocols to ensure the set-up, review and reporting requirements can be met and are standardized.
· Provide technical oversight, guidance and coordination for all the central monitor activities.
· Set up and test RBM system at study level to ensure system quality.
· Define key risk indicators (KRIs) in study system, and ensure consistency between the standard level and the study level.
· Set up dictionary for data quality assessment DQA in study system
· Ensure RBM system align with the protocol and adhere to ICH GCP, SOPs, corporate standards and regulatory requirements.

Data review Functions:
· Work with Study Team to define the issue resolution for the reviewing findings as signal and action.
· Develop, implement and maintain Quality Control related documentations for RBM related activities to ensure data completeness and accuracy.
· Perform central monitoring activities including review system outputs, propose suggestion for signal and action management, and follow up with study team for the action resolution.
· Work with Clinical Data Scientist to ensure all signal and actions are properly mitigated and RBM systems properly released.
· Ensure lessons learnt during the course of the study are documented and shared with other central monitors/ study teams to facilitate cross-study learning.

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

• Bachelor’s degree or above of equivalent experience in a scientific or business related discipline required.

• 3 - 5 years working experience in the clinical development fields.

• Working knowledge of clinical development process, understanding concepts of Phase I-IV and principles of study design

• Previous experience within a data management role, understanding key processes and principles associated with role including CRF design, database set-up, edit check specification, DMPs and data cleaning activities

• Knowledge of clinical trial database and its applications

• Knowledge of Windows Environment and its applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, etc.)

• Experience in Oracle, PL/SQL, SAS, Java, relational database design and database programming skills.

• Technical Skill Requirements:Technical expertise and business experience in supporting clinical trials database development, data management, site monitoring, etc.Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.Project management skills and technical capabilities as well as effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside the organization.Works independently, receives instruction primarily on unusual situationsAbility to organize tasks, time and priorities; ability to multi-taskAbility to communicate effectively and appropriately with internal & external stakeholders, locally and globallyStrong understanding of the state-of-the-art technologies to evaluate and leverage them into improved business processes for worldwide deployment and adoption.

postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptal’s value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.

• Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.

• Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.

• Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.

• Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.

• Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.

• Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal.

• Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.

• Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.

• Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.

• Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

• Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.

• Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the client’s need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.

• Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.

• Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment…

postings.title: Senior Software Enginner (Full-stack Node + React)
postings.descriptionText:
About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve the full stack systems that power Airtm’s financial products. You’ll work within one of our autonomous product pods, taking ownership of projects end-to-end, from technical design through production, and mentoring the engineers around you.

Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices deployed on Kubernetes, paired with React front ends. You’ll work across the entire stack, backend and frontend, as needed to deliver on your pod’s goals, collaborating with engineers in other pods when initiatives cross boundaries. AI-assisted development is core to how we build software: you’ll be expected to use AI coding tools fluently to move faster without sacrificing quality.

Key Responsibilities
