• Full Stack Development : Build and maintain TypeScript/Node.js microservices, event handlers, and cronjobs, as well as the React UIs that consume them, powering our core financial flows

• AI-Assisted Development : Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your daily workflow, from scaffolding and refactoring to test generation and code review, while maintaining a high bar for correctness and judgment about when and how much to rely on them

• Project Ownership : Break down complex problems into actionable work across multiple services and UIs; drive delivery from design through deployment

• Code Quality : Write well-tested, maintainable code; conduct thorough code reviews (including AI-generated code) and hold a high bar for the team

• Mentorship : Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, including on effective and responsible use of AI tooling; share knowledge and elevate the team’s technical practices

• Cross-Pod Collaboration : Coordinate with engineers in other pods when work crosses service boundaries; contribute code to shared services following established ownership guidelines

• On-Call : Participate in on-call rotation for services the pod owns; lead incident response and post-incident reviews

• Technical Debt : Proactively identify and address technical debt; balance short-term delivery with long-term health of the systems

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated full stack range (backend services and frontend UIs)

• Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for building production services

• Proficiency in React for building production-facing UIs (state management, component design, performance)

• Experience designing and building REST or GraphQL APIs

• Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), modeling, query optimization, and migrations

• Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging patterns (Kafka, SQS, or similar)

• Experience working in a microservices environment

• Hands-on, day-to-day experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Zed’s Agentic editing, or similar) for coding, debugging, and code review; comfort with prompt/context engineering and sound judgment about validating AI-generated output

• Strong grasp of software design principles : separation of concerns, error handling, testing strategies

• Experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

• Comfort operating in a cloud environment (AWS preferred), understanding of deployments, logs, and basic infrastructure concepts

• Strong communication skills; proactive about sharing progress, blockers, and technical risks

Nice to Have

• Background in fintech, payments, or financial systems

• Experience working with GraphQL (schema design, federation, or tooling)

• Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)

• Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions

What We Look For

Beyond the technical skills, we’re looking for engineers who:

• Take ownership , they drive their work to completion and communicate early when something is at risk

• Write code for the next engineer , clean, tested, and documented, whether they or an AI tool wrote the first draft

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

postings.title: AI Senior Engineer (Vision)
postings.descriptionText:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

What you’ll be doing

We are seeking someone who enjoys working at the cutting edge where Computer Vision meets Logic . You will be responsible for the "eyes" and the "brain" of our system—extracting complex data from visual documents and then orchestrating how that data is used by Large Language Models.

In short, someone who likes:

• Unlocking Visual Data: Building pipelines that can "read" complex documents, understanding layout, charts, and visual context using Vision-Language Models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5) and Layout Analysis .

• Orchestrating Intelligence: Owning the application logic layer. You will use LangChain or LangGraph to build the agents and chains that query our data, reason about it, and generate responses.

• Native PDF Handling: Handling the messy reality of PDF processing (PyMuPDF, layout parsing) to preserve structure before the AI even sees it.

• Prompt Engineering & Logic: Crafting complex prompts and control flows to ensure models interpret financial charts and layouts accurately without hallucinating.

• Cost & Scale: Applying a cost-optimization mindset (batch processing, model selection) to ensure our vision and orchestration layers are economically viable.

What we’re looking for

We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps.

Ideally, they would also have:

• LLM Orchestration (Must Have ): Deep experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. You know how to manage context windows, tool calling, and agentic workflows.

• Multimodal AI Experience: Hands-on experience integrating state-of-the-art vision models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) and embedding models (CLIP).

• Document Intelligence Specialist: Familiarity with specialized models (e.g., Donut, Pix2Struct) and tools like Unstructured.io or Docling.

• PDF Processing Mastery: Mastery over tools like PyMuPDF or pdfplumber for native element extraction.

• Python ML Stack: Strong proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Nice-to-Have:

• Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning vision or language models, specifically to improve accuracy on domain-specific artifacts like financial charts or tables.

• Domain Knowledge: Prior experience handling documents in the Real Estate or Finance sectors.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

• To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.

• Payments made in USD.

• 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.

• Wellness + Remote Stipend

• AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

postings.descriptionText:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

RevenueCat helps app developers manage subscriptions and make more money from them. Maybe you're an indie developer who doesn’t know what "conversion" even means, you just want your app to make money so you can keep building it. Or maybe you're a growth specialist at a company doing millions a month, and pricing experiments are already your whole job. Either way, you probably didn't get into this to spend your days staring at a dashboard. So we built two AI agents to do that work for you, or make you even sharper at it if you're already a pro.

Enter Rico. Rico watches over your subscription business and can help you make sense of it, and act on what it finds. Say your revenue dropped last week. You don't need to go digging through charts to find out why. Just ask Rico. It pulls the data, explains what happened in plain language, and shows you how you compare to similar apps. Then it can fix things itself, like setting up a new plan or restoring a customer's access, with you approving the change before it goes live. Run a pricing experiment and Rico will read the results for you and tell you which version is winning. There are so many things we want Rico to be able to do!

Then there's our AI Paywall Editor, a specialized agent to build and edit paywalls, the screen that asks someone to subscribe. Most developers are not designers, and a paywall that actually gets people to tap "subscribe" is harder to build than it looks, so the AI Paywall Editor helps you with that. Use it in our online editor, from the command line, or hook your own AI tools into it over MCP.

You can see both agents in action in our most recent product launch recap .

This is a role for engineers who've built advanced agents that do actual work , not just a thin wrapper around an LLM. You'll ship agentic features to thousands of developers, and you’ll shape the foundation everything else runs on: orchestration, tool execution, context management, evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls.

About You

•
You have 8+ years of experience shipping production systems.

•
You've built agents that other people actually use and the systems around them: tool use, structured output, context management, evaluation, orchestration.

•
You have strong backend fundamentals. You've built systems that need to be reliable, observable, and secure.

•
You hold a high bar for quality and instinctively know which details matter, but also are discerning enough to cut scope when needed while still delivering value.

•
You’re customer-obsessed: you imagine yourself as the developer, product manager, or marketer using the feature or experiencing the issue.

•
You’re a builder, not an implementer: scoping, prioritizing, and driving rollout in partnership with our Product team. This isn’t a role where you check off items from a detailed specification.

•
You can quickly familiarize yourself with code you didn't write yourself and improve it.

•
You’re scrappy and biased toward shipping. You’d rather ship a good version today and iterate than wait to ship a perfect one next quarter.

•
You communicate clearly, both in real-time and asynchronously. We’re a fully remote team, and how you write is as important as how you code.

•
You’ve shipped meaningful user-facing features to production, monitored their usage and adoption, and improved them over time.

•
You write high-quality, well-tested code, debug issues methodically, and help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful feedback and mentorship.

•
You act like an founder:: you notice problems, propose improvements, and follow through fast.

•
You're comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early stage product inside a growth stage company, and the architecture is still being figured out.

•
You're self directed. You figure out what needs to be built, build it, and ship it.

•
You are curious and stay current on AI tools and practices.

•
You have a habit of sharing what you learn with others.

Ideally, you have:

•
Familiarity with subscription business models, app stores, or developer tools

•
Experience with OpenAI/Anthropic APIs specifically

•
Experience with observability frameworks (Langfuse, Langchain, etc.)

•
Built Slack integrations

•
Contributed to open source AI/ML tooling

•
Maintained systems at scale

In the first month, you’ll:

•
Meet frequently with your team and manager to get up to speed

•
Learn our tools, processes, and the subscription business concepts that shape our product

•
Get familiar with our debugging tools, infrastructure, and overall architecture

•
Ship your first project: a small feature that gets you into the codebase and shows you how the agents talk to RevenueCat's APIs

•
Jump in early: fix bugs, ship small improvements, and weigh in on PRs

Within the first 3 months, you’ll:

•
Ship a medium sized project, ideally a new agentic feature that reaches tens of thousands of developers

•
Understand the main product areas your team owns and how they work end to end

postings.title: Head of Sales
postings.descriptionText:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role

We are looking for a Head of Sales to build and lead the commercial system that converts RevenueCat's market position, product signals, and customer demand into dependable revenue, regardless of that revenue coming in the form of an immediate contract, a self-serve credit-swipe, or long-term expansion.

In the ‘app monetization platform’ category, RevenueCat currently has about a 90% marketshare, ranging from the biggest apps in the world (ChatGPT, Ladder, VSCO) to a long tail of 100,000+ indies and startups vying to make it big. We only power roughly 25% of in-app revenue, though: The majority of apps still tries to build this themselves. Your job will be to show them the error of their ways. Not (just) to close a deal, but because we truly, deeply believe we will help them make more money.

As the Head of Sales, you’ll lead the AE and Sales Engineering teams, bringing both teams together in a single, well-oiled machine. You’ll set the functional strategy, develop talent, own forecasting and results, and you’ll personally help move important opportunities forward without becoming the required manager or closer on every deal.

Why we are hiring for this role now

We have more opportunities than the current team can consistently identify, prioritize and pursue.

Our reputation and market position produce consistent touch points with the majority of potential prospects, without those touch points turning into economic opportunities. At the same time, we’re rapidly expanding into new markets and product areas that need more proactive sales support than we can deliver.

We need a leader who can make several motions work together without forcing them into one generic process:

•
Complex evaluations involving technical, business, security, legal, and procurement stakeholders.

•
Faster mid-market opportunities that require strong qualification and commercial momentum.

•
Self-exploration where customer behavior reveals an opportunity before a formal handraise.

•
Carefully researched outbound engagement with app businesses where RevenueCat has a specific reason to be useful.

•
Partner-sourced and selected regional motions whose economics must be demonstrated before they are scaled.

The foundations exist: Account Executives, Sales Engineers, product and usage data, a respected brand, Growth Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Product, Finance, and Customer Growth. This role will turn those ingredients into a successful Sales function.

What you will be responsible for

•
Own the function. Set goals, metrics, operating cadences, headcount plans, budget, organization design, executive communication, and the performance bar across Sales.

•
Build a multi-motion Sales system. Define how strategic, mid-market, product-led, outbound, partner, and regional opportunities are identified, qualified, staffed, and advanced, across a growing product portfolio.

•
Create qualified pipeline beyond inbound. Develop focused account and outbound programs grounded in customer evidence, specific use cases, market events, and product signals rather than undifferentiated prospecting.

•
Close the coverage gap. Ensure high-potential product usage, sign-ups, inbound requests, support interactions, and target-account signals quickly result in a named owner and an intentional next action.

•
Build the team. We have good building blocks in place but the team needs to be significantly expanded to take on our current scale. Hire and developer exception talent, and define what makes a great sales team member at RevenueCat.

•
Remain close to customers. Participate in customer conversations every week and personally lead or support opportunities with unusual economic, technical, or organizational complexity.

•
Make the forecast useful. Establish definitions and inspection habits that distinguish real, qualified opportunity value from incomplete records, existing usage conversions, renewals, total contract value, or loosely influenced demand.

•
Help shape pricing and packaging. Bring a clear Sales point of view to cross-functional pricing and packaging decisions, using customer evidence to advocate for structures that support value, adoption, and durable growth.

•
Get cross-functional collaboration right. Define how Sales works with Customer Growth, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, Revenue Operations, Product, Engineering, TAM, and Support without creating duplicate account ownership or executive rescue as the default operating model.

•
Create learning from every deal. Turn repeated discovery patterns, objections, migrations, wins, and losses into better playbooks, reusable assets, Product evidence, and team training.

What success looks like

We help even more apps make even more money, without turning Sales into the standard SaaS “spray and pray” factory

postings.title: Head of Customer Growth
postings.descriptionText:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role

We are looking for a Head of Customer Growth to build and lead the operating system that helps RevenueCat customers become better app businesses.

This is broader than a traditional Customer Success role. It combines strategic account coverage, app-growth judgment, specialist advisory, customer education, product adoption, and scalable enablement. The goal is not to give every customer the same high-touch service. It is to identify where RevenueCat can create disproportionate value, deploy the right kind of help, and turn every successful customer intervention into knowledge that benefits the rest of the customer base.

You will lead a multi-lane Customer Growth function spanning the CSM team, Growth Advisory, Growth Advocacy, and the emerging Customer Enablement function. The CSM Team Lead will own daily CSM execution. You will set the strategy, operating model, talent bar, investment plan, and measures of success for the function as a whole.

For our highest-value customers, this means deep account context, growth diagnosis, stakeholder mapping, product-adoption strategy, technical-account coordination, and clear next-step ownership. For high-potential customers, it means identifying them early and providing the right help before revenue has fully materialized. For customers with specific growth bottlenecks, it means bringing in the right specialist. For the broader customer base, it means scalable education through Growth Advocates, lifecycle guidance, office hours, playbooks, templates, product nudges, and eventually dynamic next-best-action systems.

Your job is to make Customer Growth one operating system rather than a collection of disconnected activities.

Why we are hiring for this role now

RevenueCat serves tiny indie apps, fast-growing startups, games, media companies, health and fitness apps, AI products, marketplaces, and some of the most sophisticated consumer app businesses in the world.

The app market is top-heavy, so the human touch must be allocated deliberately. At the same time, a customer that is small today may become strategically important very quickly. Contract status and current revenue are necessary signals, but they are not sufficient.

We already have many of the ingredients: CSMs, a CSM Team Lead role, Growth Advocates, Customer Growth Advisory specialists, Product, Support, Marketing, Sales, TAM, Data, and one of the richest datasets in app monetization. We need a leader who can turn those ingredients into a coherent function.

What you will be responsible for

•
Own Customer Growth strategy across the full customer base. Define how RevenueCat helps customers grow after they begin using the product, including named accounts, high-potential customers, specialist-assisted customers, scaled customers, and the long tail.

•
Build segmentation and coverage. Use current value, future potential, adoption, intent, growth moments, risk, and strategic importance to decide who receives named CSM coverage, time-bound help, specialist advisory, scaled education, product-led guidance, or monitoring.

•
Lead through the CSM Team Lead. Set the bar for customer context, account strategy, stakeholder management, growth diagnosis, adoption planning, commercial awareness, and follow-through. Develop the Team Lead and create a strong leadership bench rather than becoming the permanent CSM manager.

•
Identify high-potential customers early. Work with Data, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Support to find customers with meaningful future potential before revenue alone makes them obvious.

•
Govern Growth Advisory. Define intake, qualification, expected impact, output quality, follow-through, and reuse. Specialists should be deployed against specific high-value problems rather than become general-purpose consulting capacity.

•
Make Growth Advocacy a customer-education channel. Ensure Growth Advocates turn real customer learning into authoritative one-to-many education for existing customers and the broader app ecosystem.

•
Build Customer Enablement and Scaled Growth. Create the roadmap for lifecycle programs, templates, office hours, documentation, automation, product nudges, and next-best-action guidance.

•
Drive meaningful product adoption. Partner with Product and Product Marketing so customers adopt RevenueCat capabilities in ways that help them win, rather than merely increasing feature activity.

•
Create clear cross-functional decision rights. Define how Customer Growth works with Sales, TAM, Support, Product, Marketing, and Data without turning CSMs into AEs, TAMs into a catch-all, or collaboration into meeting theater.

•
Build the customer-insight loop. Repeated customer questions should become product improvements, enablement, playbooks, benchmarks, documentation, lifecycle programs, and market education.

•
Own the function. Set metrics, operating cadences, headcount plans, budget, organization design, executive communication, and the talent bar across Customer Growth.

What success looks like

postings.title: Mid Market Onboarding Coach
postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Mid Market Onboarding Coach, you will empower our mid-market customers to transform their properties through our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission. You will manage and guide the onboarding experience for mid-market properties, serving as a trusted advisor and strategic partner throughout implementation, training, adoption, and launch. Leveraging your firsthand hospitality operations experience, you won't just teach the system—you will help hoteliers design processes that eliminate friction, allowing them to focus on their guests. You will guide customers through the successful setup, learning, adoption, and optimization of the Cloudbeds platform, balancing hospitality expertise with technical proficiency to ensure customers realize value quickly and confidently.

This is a role for a Caring Rebel who models Hospitality Before Efficiency—someone who understands hospitality and personalizes every interaction, caring for our customers just as you would for a guest in a hotel.

Our Customer Onboarding Team:

Our Onboarding team is where Hospitality Hearts meet Smart Solutions. We're a fully remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can spend more time on our "human magic": building relationships and ensuring customers feel confident and supported from day one. As a Mid Market Onboarding Coach, you'll collaborate closely with Onboarding Project Management and cross-functional partners to deliver a seamless experience for some of our most strategic and operationally complex customers.

What You Bring to the Team:

•
Serve as the trusted advisor for assigned mid-market customers, providing strategic guidance on operational workflows, change management, system configuration, and platform adoption throughout the onboarding journey.

•
Own the customer relationship end-to-end—guiding system setup, resolving escalated issues across channels, and facilitating the journey from onboarding through hypercare and transition to ongoing support.

•
Build trusted relationships with property leadership, owners, and key stakeholders, partnering with Onboarding Project Management to execute plans and hit critical implementation milestones.

•
Act as a strategic consultant throughout onboarding, identifying opportunities to expand platform/feature adoption and driving long-term customer success.

•
Collaborate with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Support to convert onboarding feedback into systemic improvements and ensure Cloudbeds' value is realized early.

•
Deliver consultative training and coaching that empowers customers to confidently learn, adopt, and maximize platform value, while proactively identifying and removing risks in complex engagements.

•
Champion "standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful"—adopting AI and tooling to handle administrative work, freeing you to focus on relationship-building and strategic guidance.

What Sets You Up for Success:

•
4+ years of hospitality operations experience, preferably in leadership or senior operational roles within hotels, resorts, hotel groups, or hospitality management companies.

•
Demonstrated expertise in hotel operations, including front office, reservations, revenue management, guest services, distribution, and property management systems.

•
2+ years of SaaS onboarding, implementation, customer success, account management, or customer-facing software experience preferred.

•
Proven ability in emotional intelligence and trust-building, comfortable engaging directly with customers at all levels—from operational users to executive decision-makers—to ensure they feel genuinely cared for.

•
Strong consultative, problem-solving, and project coordination skills, managing multiple high-value, complex customer engagements simultaneously.

•
Exceptional technical aptitude and learning agility, with the ability to leverage AI and quickly adopt new tools in a constantly evolving environment.

•
Experience working with hospitality technology solutions (PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, Revenue Management Systems, or related hotel software) strongly preferred.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

•
Experience supporting multi-property operators, hotel groups, or more complex hospitality organizations.

•
Experience leading operational transformation, technology rollouts, or process improvement initiatives within hospitality organizations.

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

postings.title: Staff Software Engineer - Platform
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will own the technical direction of Alpaca's streaming platform - our Redpanda-based event backbone and the user-facing streaming infrastructure. Platform also owns Authentication, Developer Experience and QA, and AI-Native Engineering. Streaming is roughly two-thirds of the job and where we expect you to become the deepest engineer in the company; across the other three you review the designs, hold an informed opinion, and lead the work where they meet streaming.

This is a Staff role, so we are hiring for direction as much as delivery - the engineer who decides what the streaming platform looks like in two years, writes the RFC that gets three teams to agree, and then builds the hard part. We own client-facing and internal services, maintain shared libraries nearly every team depends on, and manage our own deployments. Most of our time goes into Go, but we also write Helm charts, dig through logs and metrics, and get pulled into a wide variety of problems.

Things You Get To Do

• Own the architecture of our event streaming platform end to end - Redpanda, the UTS ecosystem, client libraries and user-facing streaming - and set its two-to-three-year direction

• Lead the shift from batch to event-driven across Alpaca's systems, working with the teams who own them rather than around them

• Design user-facing streaming at scale: connection fan-out, slow consumers, backpressure, ordering and delivery guarantees, and the failure modes that only show up on a volatile market day

• Set the standards for event-driven design - schema evolution, topic ownership, replay, idempotency - and own the shared libraries other teams build against, including the cost of versioning and deprecation

• Shape AuthN/AuthZ direction across Alpaca and lead the work where identity meets streaming: authorizing real-time subscriptions, token lifecycle on long-lived connections, multi-tenant isolation

• Help shape how Alpaca builds with AI - the schemas, contracts and event streams you own are the substrate our agentic development platform runs on

• Partner with SRE on chaos testing and game days for the event backbone, and with our QA stream on test tooling and pre-production gates, so resilience is verified rather than assumed

• Lead through influence rather than authority, and multiply the engineers around you through mentoring, design review, and handing off the work that grows people

• Join the Platform on-call rotation and act as technical lead during incidents affecting shared infrastructure

Who You Are (must-haves)

• 8+ years of professional engineering experience, including several years running systems at real scale. You write Go, or have deep experience in another strongly-typed language and will pick it up quickly.

• You have architected event streaming systems, not just used them - real production depth in Kafka or Redpanda across partitioning, consumer groups, rebalancing, retention and delivery guarantees, and how each breaks under load.

• You have delivered realtime data to clients at scale (WebSockets, SSE or gRPC streaming) and handled fan-out, slow consumers and backpressure in production.

• You have driven technical direction across team boundaries without formal authority. You can point to the decisions you owned, the RFCs you wrote, and what happened next.

• You have built or maintained libraries many teams depend on, and know what backward compatibility and deprecation actually cost.

• You have mentored senior engineers and left the teams around you better than you found them.

• You have real depth in at least one adjacent area - identity and access, developer tooling and CI, or testing and resilience - and genuine curiosity about the others.

• You know Kubernetes beyond the basics: you can write a Helm chart with relative ease, you understand security best practices, and you have job experience or certifications to prove it.

• You have worked with relational databases - we use PostgreSQL, but we are not picky as long as the fundamentals are solid.

• You have worked at a startup before - you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre-existing processes or documentation.…

• Develop predictive models using Machine Learning, statistical methods, and econometric techniques to analyze demand, pricing, and consumer behavior.

• Conduct feature engineering using pricing, sales volume, seasonality, product, channel, and market data.

• Design and execute experiments, backtesting, sensitivity analyses, and statistical validations to ensure model reliability.

• Proficiency in feature engineering using pricing, volume, seasonality, and commercial variables.

• Experience designing experiments, performing backtesting, and conducting statistical validation.

• Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and MLflow.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, Data Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers.

postings.descriptionText:
Desde Rehire nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Técnico/a de Mantenimiento Electromecánico para incorporarse a una empresa industrial especializada en procesos de mecanizado, corte y transformación de metales.

Buscamos un perfil con sólida experiencia en mantenimiento de maquinaria industrial metalmecánica, especialmente tornos, fresadoras, equipos de corte y sistemas hidráulicos.



La posición está orientada a profesionales con experiencia práctica en planta, capacidad para diagnosticar y resolver fallas mecánicas y electromecánicas, y conocimientos sobre el funcionamiento de diferentes equipos industriales. Valoramos especialmente perfiles resolutivos, autónomos y con buena predisposición para trabajar directamente sobre las máquinas.



Responsabilidades:

 - Realizar mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo y predictivo de maquinaria industrial metalmecánica.

 - Diagnosticar y reparar fallas mecánicas, eléctricas, hidráulicas y neumáticas en equipos de producción.

 - Ejecutar tareas de mantenimiento sobre tornos convencionales y CNC, fresadoras, centros de mecanizado y equipos de corte industrial.

 - Intervenir en máquinas de corte por sierra, cizallas, guillotinas, prensas hidráulicas y mecánicas, rectificadoras, taladros de banco y radiales, entre otros equipos.

 - Realizar mantenimiento de sistemas hidráulicos, incluyendo bombas, cilindros, válvulas, mangueras y circuitos.

 - Inspeccionar y reparar componentes mecánicos como rodamientos, ejes, engranajes, transmisiones y sistemas de lubricación.

 - Identificar causas de fallas recurrentes e implementar soluciones para reducir paradas de producción.

 - Realizar ajustes, calibraciones y reemplazo de componentes mecánicos y electromecánicos.

 - Interpretar planos mecánicos, eléctricos e hidráulicos para realizar diagnósticos y reparaciones.

 - Colaborar con los equipos de producción para asegurar la disponibilidad y el correcto funcionamiento de la maquinaria.

 - Registrar intervenciones de mantenimiento y colaborar en la mejora continua de los equipos y procesos.

 - Cumplir con las normas de seguridad industrial y los procedimientos de mantenimiento establecidos.
   
   

Requisitos:

 - Experiencia comprobable en mantenimiento industrial dentro del sector metalmecánico, preferentemente en industrias de mecanizado, corte, fabricación o transformación de metales.

 - Conocimientos sólidos de mecánica industrial y mantenimiento electromecánico.

 - Experiencia en mantenimiento de tornos paralelos, tornos CNC, fresadoras convencionales, fresadoras CNC y centros de mecanizado.

 - Experiencia o conocimientos prácticos en maquinaria de corte y mecanizado, incluyendo sierras sinfín, sierras circulares industriales, cizallas, guillotinas, rectificadoras planas y cilíndricas, taladros radiales, perforadoras y roscadoras.

 - Conocimientos de mantenimiento de prensas hidráulicas, prensas mecánicas, plegadoras, punzonadoras y equipos de conformado de metales.

 - Familiaridad con equipos de corte por plasma, oxicorte, láser industrial o corte por chorro de agua, según la maquinaria utilizada en planta.

 - Conocimientos sólidos de hidráulica industrial, incluyendo circuitos, bombas, válvulas, actuadores y diagnóstico de fallas.

 - Conocimientos de neumática industrial y sistemas de accionamiento.

 - Capacidad para diagnosticar fallas en motores eléctricos, reductores, transmisiones y componentes mecánicos.

 - Experiencia utilizando herramientas manuales, eléctricas e instrumentos de medición industrial.

 - Capacidad para interpretar planos y documentación técnica.

 - Perfil práctico, autónomo, proactivo y orientado a la resolución de problemas.

 - Disponibilidad para trabajar 100% presencial en Villa Martelli.



Se valorará:

 - Título de Técnico Electromecánico, Técnico Mecánico, Técnico Electricista Industrial o formación afín.

 - Experiencia previa en industrias metalúrgicas, metalmecánicas, talleres de mecanizado o plantas de industria pesada.

 - Conocimientos de automatización industrial, PLC, sensores y variadores de frecuencia.

 - Experiencia con sistemas CNC y diagnóstico de fallas en maquinaria automatizada.

 - Conocimientos de soldadura, montaje y reparación de componentes mecánicos.

 - Experiencia en mantenimiento de sistemas de refrigeración y lubricación de maquinaria de mecanizado.

 - Capacidad para realizar reparaciones mecánicas y adaptarse a diferentes tipos de equipos industriales.

 - Residencia en Villa Martelli, Vicente López, San Martín, Munro, Florida o zonas cercanas.

If you like being in the room when a customer’s agent takes its first real call, and you can trace a dropped call through telephony, webhooks, and the LLM, this role is for you.

You’ll work with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success, and with customer developers, IT teams, and telephony providers.

Get enterprise customers live and scaling

Build with customers

Debug and resolve production issues

Shape the product

 - Clear communication: you can explain a technical issue to a developer and to a business stakeholder, in writing and live.

 - Comfort working directly with customers, including during live launches and incidents.

 - Availability for meaningful overlap with Pacific Time working hours.

Nice to have

 - Python or TypeScript experience.

 - Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or voice AI and conversational AI platforms.

 - Telephony knowledge: SIP, VoIP, PSTN, and providers like Twilio or Telnyx.

 - Familiarity with latency optimization, speech-to-text and text-to-speech, or real-time (WebSocket) systems.

 - Startup experience and enterprise customer experience, including security reviews and compliance questions (SOC 2, HIPAA).

 - Willingness to travel occasionally for launches or onsite work.

You might thrive here if

 - You’d rather build with customers than hand them a ticket response

¿Qué desafíos vas a encontrar en esta posición?

• Liderar equipo técnico : ser referente del equipo en decisiones de arquitectura, calidad de código, code reviews y buenas prácticas; mentorear a otros desarrolladores, alinear la visión técnica con los objetivos de negocio y gestionar la deuda técnica de forma estratégica.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Al menos 6 años de experiencia laboral en desarrollo backend.

• Experiencia comprobable desempeñándote como Tech Lead o en roles de liderazgo técnico de equipos.

Hard Skills:

• Backend core: fuerte dominio de Java 21 y Spring Boot y/o Node.js (typeScript).

• Cloud & Arquitectura: Experiencia en AWS (EKS, Serverless) y diseño de microservicios resilientes.

• Arquitecturas Orientadas a Eventos: Experiencia comprobable en procesamiento asincrónico y mensajería con Apache Kafka , gRPC o WebSockets/SSE para la actualización de estados de mercado/operaciones en tiempo real.

• Inteligencia Artificial aplicada: Uso activo e integración de herramientas de IA en el desarrollo (agentes de codificación, asistentes conversacionales, MCP).

• Conocimientos profundos de Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture y Ports & Adapters.

• Calidad y DevOps: Prácticas avanzadas de Clean Code, DDD, TDD, integración/despliegue continuo (CI/CD con GitLab/GitHub), observabilidad y monitoreo (Datadog/CloudWatch).

• Seguridad: Aplicación de estándares OWASP en la construcción de APIs financieras seguras

Soft Skills:

• Visión de negocio, autonomía y accountability.

• Habilidades de comunicación e influencia para generar consensos cross-functional.

• Capacidad para mentorear y potenciar el talento técnico.

Se valorará la experiencia previa en empresas Fintech, Insurtech o en plataformas de alto volumen transaccional y conocimientos en desarrollo de aplicaciones mobile nativas o híbridas.

Sumarte a la Experiencia NX es:
📍 Modo Flex: Creemos en la presencia más que en la presencialidad. Trabajá de manera híbrida y flexible: desde casa, oficina o mixto.
🌍 #WorkFromAnywhere: desde cualquier parte del país o el mundo.

🥰Y una propuesta de valor mucho más amplia pensada para acompañarte en cada momento y desarrollar todo tu potencial.

En Naranja X promovemos un espacio de trabajo seguro e inclusivo, donde podés desplegar tu talento, tus ideas y tu magia.
Nuestras búsquedas son abiertas y equitativas para todas las personas: teniendo en cuenta diversidad de género, etaria, de religiones, ideas y opiniones, nacionalidad, personas con discapacidad, LGBTIQ+. ¡Mientras más diversos sean nuestros equipos, mayor será nuestra capacidad de agregar valor a las finanzas de las personas!

Job Summary
The Salesforce Developer will support the development, enhancement, and ongoing optimization of our Salesforce Sales Cloud environment, delivering scalable, high-quality CRM solutions for global sales operations. This role involves working independently with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and enterprise IT teams to translate requirements into effective Salesforce capabilities. In addition to hands-on Sales Cloud development and configuration, the ideal candidate will have strong experience in system integrations, API-based connectivity, and middleware solutions to ensure seamless data exchange and efficient business processes across enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities
Salesforce Development & Sales Cloud Configuration

• Develop, enhance, and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce Flow.

• Configure and extend Sales Cloud capabilities, including lead management, account and contact management, opportunity management, sales processes, and forecasting.

• Design and optimize sales workflows, including lead conversion, opportunity tracking, approval processes, and pipeline management.

• Develop and maintain custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, and workflow automation.

• Translate business requirements into technical designs and deliver scalable solutions aligned with Salesforce architecture and development best practices.

• Troubleshoot technical issues, develop unit tests, and support deployments and continuous platform improvements.

Enterprise Integrations & Technical Delivery

• Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations between Salesforce and internal enterprise systems or third-party applications.

• Work with REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), External Objects, and other Salesforce integration patterns.

• Collaborate with enterprise IT teams on middleware-based integrations and data synchronization across business applications.

• Ensure integration reliability, data consistency, security, performance, and appropriate error handling.

• Participate in technical design reviews, system testing, release management, and deployment activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Sales, Commercial Excellence, Operations, Product Owners, and IT stakeholders to improve sales processes and CRM capabilities.

• Provide technical guidance on Salesforce functionalities, integration options, and platform limitations.

• Collaborate with external implementation partners and globally distributed teams to support consistent Salesforce development practices.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including practical experience delivering or supporting Salesforce Sales Cloud solutions in an enterprise environment.

• Strong development skills in Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, and Salesforce APIs.

• Solid understanding of Sales Cloud capabilities, particularly lead management, opportunity management, forecasting, and sales process automation.

• Experience developing, maintaining, or troubleshooting integrations between Salesforce and external systems.

• Good understanding of Salesforce data models, security architecture, sharing rules, profiles, and permission sets.

• Ability to independently analyze business requirements, propose technical solutions, and deliver implementations.

• Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Salesforce Administrator.

• Experience with enterprise-scale Salesforce implementations across multiple countries or business units.

• Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, middleware platforms such as MuleSoft or Boomi, and event-driven integration patterns (Platform Events / CDC).

• Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, version control, and automated deployment tools.

• Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP, finance, marketing, or analytics platforms.

• Knowledge of asynchronous processing, Salesforce integration security, and API-based connectivity.

• Experience collaborating with external system integrators and globally distributed development teams.

Un lugar donde la persona está primero : no festejamos solo los goles y los tries, sino también el esfuerzo, el trato humano y el saludo respetuoso al final de cada entrenamiento.
Cada jugador tiene nombre y apellido. Los entrenadores enseñan cada deporte y educan en valores, los compañeros se convierten en amigos y las familias acompañan todo el proceso. Buscamos vivir especialmente los valores de respeto, servicio y alegría, porque cada entrenamiento y cada partido es una oportunidad de crecer como persona.
Las familias son nuestras grandes protagonistas : el club no es solo para los chicos, es también para que los padres crezcan con ellos. Acá todos formamos parte del camino.
El deporte es una escuela extraordinaria. En la cancha se aprende disciplina, resiliencia, trabajo en equipo, liderazgo y humildad: lecciones que quedan para toda la vida. Creemos que la persona siempre vale más que el resultado y que la verdadera victoria es el crecimiento de cada jugador.
El Club cuenta con tres sedes : Pilar, Munro y Beccar.

postings.title: Pasante de Analítica de Datos y Transformación Digital
postings.descriptionText:
Buscamos un/a Pasante para sumarse a brindar apoyo al Competence Center , un centro de expertise que brinda soporte desde distintas especialidades a las operaciones a nivel global, impulsando la transformación digital a través del análisis de datos, la automatización, la inteligencia artificial y las tecnologías de Industria 4.0.
🌟 Lo que vas a aprender

• Utilizar herramientas y sistemas de Industria 4.0 aplicados a entornos industriales.

• Monitorear tableros de control con indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) de diferentes plantas y regiones.

• Analizar sistemas de eficiencia energética y mantenimiento predictivo.

• Identificar correlaciones entre variables operativas y desarrollar modelos simples de seguimiento y análisis.

• Gestionar casos de desvíos operativos y realizar el seguimiento junto a referentes locales y regionales.

• Aplicar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para el análisis de datos y soporte a la toma de decisiones.

• Elaborar reportes e indicadores para presentaciones mensuales.

• Interactuar con equipos multidisciplinarios para entender procesos y detectar oportunidades de optimización.

🎯 Lo que buscamos en vos

• Estudiantes avanzados/as de Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ciencia de Datos, Analítica, Automatización, Electrónica o carreras afines.

• Interés por la transformación digital, la analítica de datos y la Industria 4.0.

• Conocimientos intermedios de Excel y herramientas de análisis de datos.

• Inglés intermedio/avanzado.

🤝 Lo que valoramos

• Curiosidad y ganas de aprender sobre tecnología aplicada a procesos industriales.

• Proactividad para identificar oportunidades y proponer mejoras.

• Capacidad para trabajar con múltiples stakeholders en un entorno regional.

• Orientación a resultados y atención al detalle.

• Interés por herramientas digitales, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial.

🚀 Sumate a un equipo que transforma datos en decisiones y tecnología en impacto para nuestras operaciones.

Que ofrecemos
Un entorno multicultural, dinámico y desafiante, que ampliará y desarrollará sus capacidades y canalizará sus habilidades y experiencia con excelentes oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, en una de las companías mas sólidas a nivel global.
Estos son algunos de nuestros beneficios:
-Salario y Beneficios Competitivos.
-Ambiente Laboral Flexible.
-Accesos a Capacitaciones y Desarrollo.
-Programa de Salud y Bienestar.
-Licencia por Maternidad y Paternidad Extendida.

Diversidad & Inclusión
LDC se rige por un conjunto de valores compartidos, elevadas normas éticas, y la diversidad y la inclusión forman parte de nuestro ADN. LDC es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a proporcionar un entorno de trabajo que adopte y valore la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión.

LDC fomenta la diversidad, apoya a las comunidades locales y las iniciativas medioambientales. Animamos a personas de todos los orígenes a presentar su candidatura.

Sustentabilidad
El valor sustentable está en el centro de nuestro propósito como empresa.
Nos apasiona crear un valor justo y sustentable, tanto para nuestra empresa como para las demás partes interesadas de la cadena de valor: nuestra gente, nuestros socios comerciales, las comunidades con las que nos relacionamos y el medioambiente que nos rodea.

• Que tengas 5 o más años de experiencia desarrollando aplicaciones mobile.

• Que tengas experiencia implementando Unit Testing (Jest, Mocha, etc).

• Familiaridad con procesos de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, EAS, etc.).

• Experiencia en autenticación avanzada (OAuth, biometría, WebAuthn).

💥 ¿Cómo es trabajar en Cocos?

• Somos una Fintech que no cree en los limites, nos ponemos objetivos desafiantes y buscamos superarnos constantemente.

• Aprendemos en movimiento, somos curiosos, agiles, nos encanta probar y mejorar.

• Valoramos todas las voces, las ideas y creemos que siempre hay algo nuevo para aprender.

• Tenemos un equipo con mucho talento, buena onda y ganas de construir cosas que transforman.

• Tenemos una cultura donde la educación financiera, la innovación y la colaboración están en el centro de todo lo que hacemos.

• Y no solo buscamos crecer como empresa, sino también hacer crecer a las personas que forman parte del equipo.

postings.title: Product Engineering Lead, Keet (100% Remote, Worldwide)
postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

• Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

• Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

• Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

• Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

• Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

• Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

• Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

• Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

• Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

• Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

• Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

• Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

• Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

• Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

• Deep JavaScript and React.

• Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

• Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

IFF es líder global en sabores, fragancias, ingredientes alimentarios y salud y biociencias. Desarrollamos innovaciones sostenibles que mejoran los productos de uso cotidiano.

• Liderar la gestión de desvíos mediante análisis de causa raíz y la implementación de acciones correctivas y preventivas.

• Título universitario en Ingeniería en Alimentos, Ingeniería Química o carreras afines.

• Experiencia en roles de Calidad, Inocuidad Alimentaria o Sistemas de Gestión dentro de plantas industriales.

• Experiencia comprobable en implementación, mantenimiento o auditoría de sistemas certificados bajo FSSC 22000.

• Conocimientos sólidos de ISO 22000, ISO/TS 22002-1, HACCP, BPM y Programas de Prerrequisitos.

• Experiencia liderando auditorías internas, externas, de certificación y auditorías de clientes.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio a avanzado.

• Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel.

• Experiencia en auditorías SMETA y auditorías de proveedores.

• Conocimiento de SAP.

• Perfil proactivo, colaborativo y orientado a la mejora continua.

• Contribuirás al fortalecimiento de una sólida cultura de calidad y seguridad alimentaria en toda la organización.

postings.title: Global Study Assoc. Director - Single Sponsor Dedicated
postings.descriptionText:
The Global Study Associate Director (GSAD) is a business-critical role within Study Management, BioPharmaceuticals Clinical Operations, whose main accountability is the delivery of clinical studies. The GSAD is responsible for leading a cross-functional study team and for providing the team with direction and guidance to enable successful study delivery. The GSAD is the main liaison between the study team and the Clinical Program Team (CPT) starting with study handover through to close-out and archiving. The GSAD is accountable to the CPT for the delivery of a study according to agreed upon timelines, budget, and quality standards by ensuring an effective partnership and teamwork within study team and/or external partners.

The GSAD leads the study team and/or study oversight team in accordance with the study team operating model, current clinical trial regulations (e.g. ICH GCP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies and best practices (e.g. guidelines) and in line with values and behaviours.

Essential Functions
• Lead, provide guidance and delegate appropriately to a cross-functional study team or oversee outsourced delivery activities to ensure the clinical study progresses as planned, driving achievement of milestones according to timelines, budget and quality standards. May hold accountability and/or oversight of several studies.
• Lead and facilitate communication across all functions, including external partners and service providers. Lead and conduct investigator meetings and other study related meetings.
• Provide input into and hold accountability for the development of essential study level documents (i.e., Clinical Study Protocol (CSP) through to Clinical Study Report (CSR)) in accordance with relevant SOPs.
• Ensure all external service providers (i.e., Contract Research Organizations (CROs), central laboratories, IXRS, ePRO, etc.) engaged at the study level are performing to contracted goals and timelines/budget and that adequate oversight is documented and any issues are escalated appropriately. May participate in vendor selection activities.
• Develop and maintain relevant study plans including required input into study level quality and risk management planning (e.g., risk-based quality management, proactive risk and contingency plans, etc.) ensuring that the risk response strategies and issue escalation pathways are clear to the entire study team
• Accountable for ensuring that information in all systems utilized at a study-level (e.g. ACCORD/ABACUS, PharmaCM, etc.) are current and accurate.
• Oversee study level performance against agreed upon plans, milestones and key performance indicators (KPIs, quality and operational) by using company tracking systems and project timelines and communicate any risks to timelines and/or quality to CPT and sDSM/DSM along with proposed mitigations
• Identify and report quality issues that have occurred within the study in accordance with relevant SOP and collaborate with all functions as necessary to overcome barriers and achieve milestones; proactively communicate findings and corrective action plans (CAPAs) to relevant stakeholders (e.g. CPT, quality assurance staff, functional line management, etc.)
• Oversee Trial Master File (TMF) completion in accordance with relevant SOPs, including ensuring the TMF plan and Expected Document List (EDL) are in place and that QC activities are performed on an ongoing basis to ensure TMF completeness at all times
• Ensure timely compliance with company-wide governance controls (e.g., Delegation of Authority, Sunshine Act, financial system attestations, Clinical Trial Transparency)
• The GSAD is responsible for study budget re-forecasting following initial budget estimate provided by the CPT and accountable for study budget management through the study lifecycle and for providing budget progress reports to the CPT including any financial risks and mitigation plans (as part of the ongoing study change control process)
• Ensure studies are inspection-ready at all times, according to ICH-GCP and SOP and relevant policies/guidelines; GSAD is the primary Study Management point-of-contact in the event of an audit or inspection
• Provide regular feedback on individual performance to the study team members and their line managers to support their professional development; may mentor less experienced colleagues
• Work on non-drug project work such as being a Study Management representative in process improvements and/or leading improvement projects as discussed and agreed upon with their manage
• May act as Subject Matter Expert for a particular process or system within Study Management.

• Extensive knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research regulatory requirements and demonstrated abilities in clinical study management processes and clinical/drug development
• Demonstrated solid project management skills and knowledge of relevant tools
• Strong, demonstrated abilities/skills in team leadership
• Strong abilities in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with internal and external co-workers and stakeholders, along with strong conflict management skills
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

postings.title: Principal AI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

About the Role

As our Principal AI Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of production AI systems that solve real business problems for our partners and shape how Able builds. You were a Technical Founder, Co-founder, or founding engineer at an AI company. You have the scar tissue of taking something to market and learning why product-market fit is hard. You will set the technical bar for AI at Able, working at the spec and acceptance layer of an AI-native engineering model, and play a key role in establishing Able as a leader in the AI space.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: you will lead technical conversations, be hands-on in building applications or proofs of concepts, and establish AI/ML guidelines and standards for our partners, prospects, and across the organization.

• Entrepreneurship: you will spot market opportunities to match technology with business outcomes, bringing a builder's instinct for what will and won't land commercially.

• AI Thought Leadership and Innovation: you will drive Able's AI strategy forward by constantly exploring and implementing cutting-edge AI technologies, frameworks, and tools.

• Consulting/Business Development: you will work with partners and prospects to understand their business and conceive of opportunities to introduce technology (AI specifically) to improve performance.

• AI Enablement: you will provide coaching and mentorship, continuously enhancing our team's and partner teams AI capabilities through knowledge sharing and training on the latest technology and best practices.

Required Skills & Experience

• 12+ years building AI/ML systems, with production experience shipping and operating them

• Fluency with the modern LLM stack: frontier models, RAG, vector databases, agentic frameworks, and the evals and guardrails that make them trustworthy in production

• You operate in the spec-and-harness model, leveraging agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.,) at the spec and acceptance layer

• Demonstrated experience leading large and complex projects

• Proven experience integrating ML and generative models with existing web and mobile applications

• Innate ability to effectively interact and inspire our partners and executive stakeholders on new AI ideas

• Demonstrated skill in connecting business challenges to the potential benefits of AI, and effectively communicating those opportunities to non-technical audiences

• Excellent English verbal and written communication

Nice to Have

• Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with a strong focus on AI and Machine Learning

• Experience with MCP, graph-based retrieval, or multimodal pipelines

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

• To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.

• Payments made in USD.

• 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.

• Wellness + Remote Stipend

• AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

postings.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
postings.descriptionText:
Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries.

This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

What you’ll do

• Design across branding, campaigns, and digital platforms: logos, visual identity systems, social and display content, presentations, web and landing pages, and more.

• Use generative AI tools & models (e.g. Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, Seedance, etc.) throughout your process: concepting, ideation, image generation, layout exploration, and production to move faster without sacrificing craft.

• Translate creative briefs into polished, on-brand visual concepts, iterating based on feedback from creative leads and clients.

• Maintain and evolve visual identity systems, ensuring consistency across deliverables and touchpoints.

• Apply strong fundamentals such as typography, layout, color, and composition to produce work that is both conceptually sharp and production-ready.

• Know where AI-assisted output needs a human hand to protect brand integrity, craft quality, and emotional resonance, and refine accordingly.

• Collaborate closely with Creative Leads, Project Managers, and fellow designers across multiple concurrent projects and accounts.

• Give and receive constructive creative feedback in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• Stay current on new AI tools and workflows as they emerge, and share techniques and learnings with the wider design team.

• Manage your time and priorities across multiple projects, meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality.

What you’ll bring

• 4+ years of experience as a designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong conceptual thinking and visual craft across brand, campaign, and digital work.

• Hands-on, current experience with generative AI creative tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, Seedance, etc as a required, everyday part of your workflow, not a nice-to-have.

• Deep proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

• Solid grounding in design fundamentals: typography, layout, color theory, and visual hierarchy.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to interpret briefs and explain design decisions clearly.

• A collaborative mindset, comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

• Self-motivation and comfort working independently in a remote-first environment.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.
