postings.title: Head of Security Operations
postings.descriptionText:
This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.

While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

This role reports to the CISO.

What you will do in this role:

• Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals

• Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks

• Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC

• Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture

• Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices

• Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks

• Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice

• Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives

• Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical

• Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials

• Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations

• Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs

• Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice

• Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

• Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats

• Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up

• In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc

• Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it

• Expert in Linux security

• Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks

• Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools

• Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds

• Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF

• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path

• Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations

• Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security

• Leadership and management ability

• Excellent business English writing and presentation skills

• Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness

Optional things we value

• Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability

• Experience with open source security tools

• Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001

• Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

We have created a new career path at Canonical for Performance Engineers who bring exceptional clarity to software performance, correctness and efficiency. We are adding these roles to every engineering team at the company.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We are profitable and growing our global enterprise sales organisation. We are hiring a regional sales renewal team manager in North America to lead the renewals team in the region.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and over $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

• Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems

• High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence

• Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes

• Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. Canonical is a global software company that publishes Ubuntu and open-source enterprise solutions for cloud, developer, IoT and AI. Ubuntu is the fastest growing Linux distribution and ranks as the number #1 OS in the cloud.

In partnership with Google, Amazon, IBM and Microsoft, Canonical helps companies become more agile, productive and adopt new technologies faster. Examples of customer success include AI, Blockchain, IoT, Advanced Robotics and self-driving cars, where Ubuntu is the preferred development platform.

The role of a Sales Development Representative at Canonical

Canonical is profitable and growing. We consider our sales development organization to be the best technology sales academy in the market, and as such, we select exceptional and ambitious candidates to join our team. You will enjoy this role if you are organized, persistent, charismatic, and hard-working. You will need to be interested in tech and its business implications. In this role, you will collaborate with a regional sales and marketing team, and your primary objective is to find customer projects that fit our product lines and spread the good name of Canonical across multiple different industries and geographies.

Click HERE to watch our SDR team discuss their role in Canonical

What your day will look like

• Handle inbound customer inquiries across email, phone and chat

• Execute outbound sales & marketing campaigns

• Travel to events and conferences worldwide, presenting on booths and driving face-to-face marketing and sales opportunities

• Collaborate across multiple teams and senior stakeholders to drive results

• Work directly with marketing on campaigns

• Research information about prospective customers

• Generate a multi-million pound pipeline

• Identify prospects and market trends

• Help define the processes and policies for the team

• Liaise with new and existing customers, setting up and attending meetings whilst actively mapping accounts to identify new opportunities

• Accurately create, update, maintain and nurture leads on global opportunities

What we are looking for in you

• Excellent academic results at school and university

• Passion for business and technology

• Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific

• Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration

• Verbal and written communication skills

• Result driven with an over-achiever spirit

• Persistence & perseverance

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

• Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Parental Leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

De rol van een Sales Development Representative (SDR) bij Canonical

Canonical is winstgevend en groeit. We beschouwen onze sales organisatie als de beste sales academie op de markt en we zijn op zoek naar uitzonderlijke en ambitieuze kandidaten om ons team te versterken.

Voor deze rol zoeken we personen die georganiseerd, volhardend, charismatisch en hardwerkend zijn. Ook is interesse in technologische ontwikkelingen en de zakelijke implicaties ervan belangrijk. Je primaire doel is het vinden van klantprojecten die passen bij onze productlijnen en het verspreiden van de goede naam van Canonical over verschillende industrieën en regio's. Ook werk je in deze rol samen met een regionaal sales- en marketingteam.

Klik HIER om te zien wat onze SDRs te vertellen hebben over hun rol en het werken bij Canonical.

Hoe de taken binnen de rol eruit zien:

• Het behandelen van inbound klantvragen via e-mail, telefoon en chat

• Het opzetten en uitvoeren van outbound sales- en marketingcampagnes

• Reizen naar evenementen en conferenties over de hele wereld: presenteer op stands en werk aan face-to-face marketing- en salesmogelijkheden

• Het samenwerken met meerdere teams en senior stakeholders

• Het onderzoek doen naar potentiële klanten

• Rechtstreeks samenwerken aan campagnes met het marketing team

• Het genereren van een sales pipeline van meerdere miljoenen ponden

• Identificeren van prospects en markttrends

• Het helpen bij het definiëren van processen en beleid voor het team

• Contact onderhouden met nieuwe en bestaande klanten, vergaderingen opzetten en bijwonen, en actief accounts in kaart brengen om nieuwe kansen te identificeren

• Nauwkeurig leads voor wereldwijde kansen creëren, bijwerken en onderhouden

Wat wij in jou zoeken

• Uitstekende academische resultaten op school en universiteit

• Passie voor business en techniek

• Leergierigheid en wil om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen - nieuwsgierig, flexibel, wetenschappelijk

• Creatief problemen oplossen en samenwerken met diverse teams

• Mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden

• Resultaatgerichtheid

• Volharding en doorzettingsvermogen

Wat wij bieden

Het basissalaris is afhankelijk van verschillende factoren, waaronder geografische locatie, ervaringsniveau, kennis en vaardigheden. Daarnaast komen bepaalde functies ook in aanmerking voor extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en beloningen, waaronder jaarlijkse bonussen op basis van omzet. Onze beloningsfilosofie is het waarborgen van gelijkheid binnen ons wereldwijde personeelsbestand.

Naast een competitief basissalaris bieden we alle teamleden extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, die onze waarden en idealen weerspiegelen. Houd er rekening mee dat er afhankelijk van de werklocatie aanvullende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden van toepassing kunnen zijn. Onze Talent Partners kunnen je hierover meer vertellen tijdens de sollicitatie rondes.

• Persoonlijk leer- en ontwikkelingsbudget van 2.000USD per jaar

• Jaarlijkse salarisbeoordeling

• Recognition rewards

• Jaarlijks vakantieverlof

• Ouderschapsverlof

• Employee Assistance programma voor medewerkers

• Mogelijkheid om naar nieuwe locaties te reizen om collega’s te ontmoeten tijdens ‘sprints’

• Priority Pass voor reizen en reisupgrades voor bedrijfsevenementen op lange afstand

Canonical is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt

We zijn er trots op dat we een werkplek kunnen bieden die vrij is van discriminatie. Diversiteit aan ervaringen, perspectieven en achtergronden zorgen voor een betere werkomgeving en betere producten. Wat je identiteit ook is, wij zullen je sollicitatie eerlijk in overweging nemen.

Canonical is a global software company that publishes Ubuntu and open-source enterprise solutions for cloud, developer, IoT and AI. Ubuntu is the fastest growing Linux distribution and ranks as the number #1 OS in the cloud.

In partnership with Google, Amazon, IBM and Microsoft, Canonical helps companies become more agile, productive and adopt new technologies faster. Examples of customer success include AI, Blockchain, IoT, Advanced Robotics and self-driving cars, where Ubuntu is the preferred development platform.

The role of a Sales Development Representative at Canonical

Canonical is profitable and growing. We consider our sales development organization to be the best technology sales academy in the market, and as such, we select exceptional and ambitious candidates to join our team. You will enjoy this role if you are organized, persistent, charismatic, and hard-working. You will need to be interested in tech and its business implications. In this role, you will collaborate with a regional sales and marketing team, and your primary objective is to find customer projects that fit our product lines and spread the good name of Canonical across multiple different industries and geographies.

Click HERE to watch our SDR team discuss their role in Canonical

What your day will look like

• Handle inbound customer inquiries across email, phone and chat

• Execute outbound sales & marketing campaigns

• Travel to events and conferences worldwide, presenting on booths and driving face-to-face marketing and sales opportunities

• Collaborate across multiple teams and senior stakeholders to drive results

• Work directly with marketing on campaigns

• Research information about prospective customers

• Generate a multi-million pound pipeline

• Identify prospects and market trends

• Help define the processes and policies for the team

• Liaise with new and existing customers, setting up and attending meetings whilst actively mapping accounts to identify new opportunities

What we are looking for in you

• Excellent academic results at school and university

• Passion for business and technology

• Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific

• Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration

• Verbal and written communication skills

• Result driven with an over-achiever spirit

• Persistence & perseverance

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

postings.descriptionText:
In security risk management we’re looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do.

To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will not only work within the team but also cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation. The team contributes ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. Additionally, the team collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical.

The security risk management team’s mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role:

• Define Canonical's security risk management standards and playbooks

• Analyse and improve Canonical's security risk practices

• Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices

• Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice

• Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials

• Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

• Participate in developing key risk indicators, provide inputs to the development of key control indicators, and key performance indicators for various programs

• Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)

• Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions

• Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes

• Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action

• Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions

• Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes

• Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company

• Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure efficiency of security functions and capabilities.

What we are looking for

• An exceptional academic track record

• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path

• Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations

• Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security

• Leadership and management ability

• Excellent business English writing and presentation skills

• Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management

• Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks

• Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk

• Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. Raising individual leaders

• Landing the hard conversations, because you coach leaders to make them happen.

• Turning 360 feedback into real, followed-through commitments, not a report that gets filed.

Lifting organisations and the company

• Leaving an organisation you take on visibly better led, off a sharp first-weeks diagnosis and a plan you own and drive.

• Contributing to defining and implementing new ways of working across our globally distributed company.

Building the function and its standards

• Setting the bar for how coaching and organisational development is done at Canonical: owning what exceptional looks like, proving the methods in the field, and holding the practice to them.

• Sharpening the management-excellence standard itself across Canonical, by feeding back what you learn in the field.

You will design and maintain test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security. You will build and evolve automated test frameworks – including stress testing, fuzzing, code coverage analysis, and regression detection – that not only must remain effective across many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance, but must be able to scale with the high demand for Ubuntu kernels (currently more than 160 under active support).

The successful candidate will bring strong Python skills, familiarity with Linux kernel internals, and experience building test infrastructure that scales. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

• Strong attention to detail and a relentless commitment to quality.

• A collaborative, professional, and customer-centric mindset.

• Experience working fashion and beauty campaigns

Overview
At Monks, we are looking for AI Artists to accelerate master asset production and provide high-quality, production-ready visual masters for templating, agentic pipelines, and downstream adaptation teams. The AI Artists will partner closely with Art Directors, Creative Technologists, AI Leads and Production teams to originate high-impact master assets—creating the foundational creative content that enables scale and raises overall creative quality for static and video assets.

About the role

As the AI Artist focused on master asset production, you will be the specialist who creates the high-quality visual masters that power large-scale creative programs. Reporting into a governance-led creative team, you will translate art direction into reproducible AI-driven workflows and deliver production-ready master assets—layered files, isolated plates, passes, and metadata—that downstream teams use for templating, localization and distribution. Your work will directly improve the consistency, speed and scalability of the entire production pipeline: higher-quality masters mean less manual retouching, fewer rounds of rework and better agentic pipeline performance.

Responsibilities

• Create and deliver production-ready master assets and production-ready elements (layered files, isolated plates, passes and metadata) that serve as the canonical sources for templating and downstream adaptation.

• Produces the high-quality masters that enable large-scale adaptation and agentic workflows handled by other teams.

• Reduces manual retouching and rework downstream by delivering masters designed for automation and consistency.Improves agentic pipeline performance by providing reliable, brand-aligned source assets.

• Create high-fidelity visual concepts, look-dev, and production-ready master image assets using generative AI and hybrid (AI + manual) workflows.Translate Art Director briefs into reproducible multi-stage generation workflows: prompt recipes, model choices, and post-process steps.

• Collaborate with Art Directors and Creative Technologist to align masters with style guides, toolkits, and platform specifications.

• Run or contribute to workshops and documentation to upskill creators on AI generation best practices.Assess when AI generation is appropriate versus traditional production and document quality trade-offs; escalate cases that require traditional production.

Requirements

• 3–5+ years combined experience in visual production, digital art, motion/stills, or related fields with demonstrable use of generative AI tools in production contexts.Strong craft: composition, color, lighting, perspective, retouching, and basic motion principles.

• Proficiency with Figma and at least one pixel-editing/compositing toolset (Photoshop, After Effects, Nuke, Blender, etc.).

• AI Tools Skills: hands-on proficiency with Adobe Firefly, MidJourney, Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, Runway, ChatGPT, and Google Gemini.

• Proficiency in English communication.

• Hands-on experience with generative models/tools, prompt engineering, image-to-image workflows and batching strategies.

• Experience preparing masters for hand-off: layered files, cutouts, passes and metadata for downstream teams.

• Good communication and collaboration skills; able to take direction from Art Directors and translate it into technical generation steps.

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. We are seeking a Cloud DevOps & Technical Operations Engineer to join our growing engineering team. This unique role is designed to be the "throughput engine" of our delivery team. You will spend 70% of your time designing, building, maintaining, and scaling robust CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure, integrating our solutions with our shared enterprise systems, and driving the maintenance of enterprise-grade systems . The remaining 30% of your time will be focused on Technical Operations , acting as our dedicated operational safeguard by managing cloud access control, security assessments, and compliance workflows to unblock senior engineers and lead developers.

The ideal candidate is a certified Google Cloud specialist who thrives on automating environments, enjoys maintaining high-security standards, and is highly organized in managing operational compliance.

What You’ll Do

Cloud DevOps & Platform Engineering (70%)

• CI/CD & Automation: Design, build, and maintain robust, secure CI/CD pipelines to automate application deployments on Google Cloud Platform.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to manage multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments.

• Enterprise Integration: Integrate localized applications and workflows with our shared enterprise systems to accelerate delivery speed and eliminate custom backend setups.

• System Maintenance: Lead the continuous maintenance of enterprise-grade systems to ensure high availability, reliable scaling, and robust performance across all operational applications.

• Core GCP Stack Management: Manage, configure, and monitor core Google Cloud services, specifically including App Engine (standard environments), Agent Engine (AI agent setups), Cloud Run, Cloud Storage/Firestore, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Build.

• Runtime Optimization: Optimize runtime configurations (e.g., Python, Go, TypeScript) and manage secure application frameworks.

Technical Operations & Compliance (30%)

• Security & Compliance Liaison: Serve as the primary operational coordinator for client-specific security reviews, vendor security assessments (VSA), and launch compliance gates.

• Operational Housekeeping: Manage technical operations backlog: provision and manage API keys, monitor AI policy compliance, and maintain approved AI tool registries.

• Access Control: Manage team access controls, repository/project group permissions, and Google Cloud project IAM roles (such as Editor/Viewer allocations).

• Performance & Accessibility Audits: Execute and document static performance, compliance, and accessibility audits across staging environments before production releases to ensure "Google-Grade" standards.

• Workflow Coordination: Coordinate with client-side technical liaisons and internal project managers to streamline code style reviews and secure deployment approvals.

About You

Required Qualifications

• Certification: Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer (Active).

• Experience: 3-5+ years of professional experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability, or Systems Engineering role in a cloud-native environment.

• Enterprise Grade Systems: Demonstrated track record in the proactive maintenance of enterprise-grade systems with high availability and security requirements.

• Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience building and deploying services on App Engine standard/flexible environments.

• AI & Agent Environments: Understanding of or direct exposure to deploying and maintaining Agent Engine architectures or AI agent setups.

• Automation Tooling: Strong proficiency in Terraform and setting up automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI).

• Scripting & Web Dev: Solid scripting skills in Python or Bash , and familiarity with web technologies (TypeScript, Angular, or Lit).

• Security Guardrails: Experience configuring cloud security controls, including Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP), Web Security Scanners, and HTTPS enforcement.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional organizational skills with a passion for documentation, process hygiene, and administrative coordination.

Preferred Qualifications

• Google Ecosystem Experience: Previous experience working directly with Google as a client, or within Google’s marketing agency ecosystem.

• Familiarity with Google-native developer tools, version control repositories, and internal launch compliance processes (e.g., Kato, SPUR, Buganizer).

• Additional Certifications: Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Cloud Security Engineer.

• Experience running web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and web performance audits.

postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website ( monks.com/careers ).

About the Role

Monks is seeking a Creative Technologist in Buenos Aires to serve as the vital connective tissue between high-concept creative design , emerging technical execution, and top-tier global client delivery. We are looking for someone who bridges an undeniable design eye with deep technical acumen , optimizing for a candidate with a high-quality track record of applying novel and emerging technologies to scale top-tier creative output across multimodal mediums rather than sheer length of tenure.

In this role, you will embody the philosophy of selecting the right technical approach for the right job—pragmatically evaluating, benchmarking, and pairing the ideal tools, generative AI models, node-based computational workflows, and tech stacks tailored specifically to the brief at hand.

Operating in a highly dynamic environment, you will collaborate across diverse multidisciplinary partners—including Account Management, Program & Project Management, Creative Directors, and Technical Leads—as well as interfacing directly with client teams.

Above all, this position requires a proactive, project-enhancing mindset. We need a self-starter who actively seeks out ways to elevate creative delivery, anticipates roadblocks, and shapes project outcomes rather than waiting for the next ticket to show up in a queue.

Responsibilities

• Technical Evaluation & Benchmarking ("Right AI Approach for the Creative System"): Systematically evaluate and benchmark the output quality of various tools, frameworks, and generative AI models against one another to select the most suitable approach for high-fidelity creative delivery.

• Proactive Delivery Enhancement: Drive projects forward with an ownership mindset—actively identifying opportunities to elevate quality, optimize pipelines, and streamline execution without waiting for top-down task assignments.

• Multimodal GenAI & Node Workflows: Harness, benchmark, and orchestrate generative AI models across modalities (image, music, voiceover, video manipulation) and construct node-based computational workflows to scale creative execution.

• Brand Nuance & Contextual Adaptation: Understand and execute the subtle nuances of various brand marks and identity systems across physical, digital, and game-style worlds.

• Upfront Feasibility Evaluation: Interrogate briefs early alongside Creative Directors and strategy leads to assess technical viability, flag platform limitations, define optimal tech stacks, and protect creative ambition before production begins.

• Cross-Functional & Client Engagement: Partner dynamically across internal disciplines (Account Managers, Program/Project Managers, Creative Directors, and Technical Leads) and engage directly with client teams to present prototypes and manage delivery milestones.

• Proactive Global Communication: Maintain continuous alignment across global teams and client partners with exceptional English communication—setting expectations early, raising flags proactively, and translating complex technical trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

About You

The Essentials:

• Design Eye Meets Technical Acumen: High visual design sensitivity (typography, UI/UX polish, spatial aesthetics) combined with clean coding abilities.

• AI-Native Development Fluency: Comfort working within modern AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Anti-Gravity, Cursor, Claude Code) to rapidly build, iterate, and ship solutions. Working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern web standards (CSS, Tailwind) is expected, along with the ability to read, diagnose, and debug code but deep traditional full-stack depth is not a hard requirement. We're optimizing for speed and craft in AI-assisted iteration over classical engineering tenure.

• System & Model Benchmarking Track Record: Proven experience evaluating, testing, and benchmarking emerging technical systems and generative AI models to determine output quality and suitability for tier-1 brand execution.

• Proactive, Anti-Ticket Mindset: A self-directed operator who thrives in dynamic environments, takes initiative to solve unstated problems, and focuses on enhancing overall project delivery rather than passively checking off tickets.

• Multimodal Generative AI Stack: Familiarity with generative AI models across image, music, voiceover/audio synthesis, and video manipulation/editing.

• Modern Design & Creative Tools: Proficiency with modern design platforms (Framer, Figma) and the Adobe Creative Cloud suite, along with familiarity with node-based creative logic systems (e.g., ComfyUI, Weavy).

• Brand System Literacy: Proven ability to navigate, interpret, and maintain brand identity integrity across diverse visual environments (digital, physical, and gaming/3D contexts).

• Global English Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with the confidence to lead technical conversations with client teams and collaborate across global time zones.

Nice-to-Haves / Pluses:

• Nodal / VFX Background: Experience with Nuke, Fusion, Houdini, or ComfyUI is a huge plus. This background signals a proven ability to architect the technical processes needed to reach beautifully crafted, production-grade output.

• Google Platform & Web Ecosystem: Familiarity with Google web standards, Google Cloud tools, or Google creative and media platforms.

postings.title: Data Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website ( monks.com/careers ).

Description

As a Data Engineer at Monks, you'll have the opportunity to grow and contribute to exciting projects by helping to design, build, and maintain data pipelines and cloud infrastructure. The data engineer should have a strong foundational understanding of cloud environment, data pipelines, data cleansing, and basic data warehousing. Ideally, you possess a foundational understanding of machine learning concepts, allowing you to bridge the gap between engineering and advanced marketing analytics applications. This role is an excellent opportunity for those looking to build a career in data engineering and data science.

This Netherlands-based role requires supporting the Data Strategy team with a major Netherlands client so requires a Dutch native speaker. We offer a dynamic and challenging work environment at the forefront of AI-driven innovation in marketing. If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, we encourage you to apply!

Responsibilities

• Develop data pipelines and solutions across cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP.

• Support the authentication and integration of platform APIs and help automate an end to end ETL processes for data integration and transformation.

• Participate and collaborate in the design and implementation of data models and data warehouses.

• Develop data transformation recipes that efficiently transform raw data into structured formats suitable for data warehousing.

• Support and maintain with the documentation for data models, including architecture diagrams, schema, definitions, and metadata.

• Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines’ issues to ensure timely data availability.

• Collaborate with the data science team to integrate and build ML models and Gen-AI applications.

• Possess good data literacy and understand how technical data applications create business value.

• Communicate progress and findings to both technical and non-technical team members.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and in a team environment

Requirements

• Bachelor or Masters in a quantitative subject such as Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

• 5+ years of working experience in data science or data engineering or a related field.

• Associate Cloud Certification such as GCP Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer or any equivalent.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL.

• Expertise in authenticating and authorising API requests using methods such as OAuth and API keys and troubleshooting common API-related challenges.

• Solid understanding of data structures and databases.

• Good understanding of data modeling concepts and tools such as dbt or Dataform.

• Solid understanding of data warehousing and ETL concepts and experience with tools like Amazon Redshift or Google BigQuery.

• Familiarity with data privacy principles and best practices.

• Fluent English communication and written skills.

Preferred Requirements:

• Bachelor or Masters Degree in Data Science.

• Professional Cloud Certification.

• Experience with CI/CD and version control tools.

• Familiarity with marketing analytics tools and data (e.g. Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics).

• Familiarity with social data (e.g. Instragram, Facebook, Tiktok).

• Experience with machine learning and Gen-AI models.

• Dutch native speaker is required for this role.

At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We build production web applications for clients, and we like engineers who are comfortable owning a feature from the database to the interface. As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you work across React / Next.js and Node / TypeScript to design, build, and ship features that stay reliable in production.

You'll work inside a Monks delivery team, alongside clients, product, and design, taking real ownership of the parts of the product you build.

We're all-in on agentic engineering. Tools like Claude Code and Codex are part of our everyday workflow, and we're looking for people who are genuinely fluent working alongside AI coding agents and excited to push those practices further.

Who You Are

• Comfortable across the whole stack: you move between frontend and backend without friction.

• Ownership-minded: you take a feature from idea to shipped, and you sweat the details.

• A pragmatic problem-solver: you pick the simplest thing that works and holds up.

• A clear communicator: you keep clients and teammates in the loop without noise.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and maintain features across the frontend (React / Next.js) and backend (Node / TypeScript).

• Build and consume APIs, and model the data behind them.

• Review code, including AI-generated code, for quality and consistency.

• Collaborate with product, design, and other engineers to ship end to end.

• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues.

• Contribute to the team's standards, tooling, and practices.

What You Bring

• 5+ years building and shipping full-stack web applications.

• Strong TypeScript: React and Next.js on the front end, Node on the back end.

• Solid API design and data modeling.

• Experience building on AWS.

• Good testing habits and an eye for maintainable code.

• Strong English communication skills.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, agile consulting environment.

Extra Credit

• You've worked on AI-heavy products or integrated LLMs.

• Deep PostgreSQL experience.

• You've built or maintained a design system.

• Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices.

• Open-source work you're proud to link.

About the Role

Monks is looking for an exceptional Lead Retoucher to join our team in Buenos Aires. In this leadership role, you will champion the craft of high-end automotive retouching, guiding a dedicated global team in producing top-quality content for one of the world's most recognizable brands . You will act as the bridge between creative vision and technical execution, mastering complex compositing, CGI integration, and Generative AI workflows.

Responsibilities

Craft & Technical Execution

•
Automotive Visuals: Deliver complex, photo-realistic images of both vehicle interiors and exteriors, mastering precision vehicle paint color changes and complex material adjustments.

•
Material & Lighting Mastery: Apply a keen eye to the effects of lighting, shadow, and color across varied surfaces—including vehicle paint, chrome, glass, and plastic parts—ensuring absolute photorealism.

•
CGI & Gen AI Integration: Seamlessly integrate CGI vehicles and Generative AI elements into practical photography. Retouch CGI vehicles into practical backgrounds by adjusting paint colors, bright-work reflections, drop shadows, and window transparencies for lighting and color harmony.

•
Environment Building: Create large complex environmental extensions to fit banner format proportions, which may include buildings, roads, mountains, bridges, and skies.

•
Advanced Workflows: Utilize Generative AI tiling in Photoshop to maintain hi-resolution images, and apply an understanding of perspective and how to correct or match it to create a realistic look.

Leadership & Collaboration

•
Team Guidance: You'll help other designers excel at retouching, harmonizing speed, style, and scale to retouch high-end photography at a steady pace .

•
Quality Safeguarding: Pixel perfectness is important . You safeguard quality at all times and work together with QA testers .

•
Client Partnership: You will work together directly with art directors on the client side, representing Monks from a design POV .

•
Process Efficiency: You are always on the lookout for process efficiencies .

About You

Essentials & Requirements

•
Experience: For this role, we're looking for a designer with around 5+ years of experience retouching and creating beautiful images. A utomotive retouching experience is a big nice to have.

•
Photoshop Mastery: You are an expert in Photoshop and know every trick in the book . You must be an expert at Photoshop pathing, masking, adjustment layers, and smart objects, as well as knowledgeable of camera raw files. You know how to keep your files, layers, and folders super-organized .

•
Gen AI Proficiency: Comfortable using Generative AI tools and integrating them into practical photography.

•
Artistic Vision: You have an eye for art and composition and can relate to what's typically desirable in a photographic image . Creating balanced and beautiful layouts is your second nature . A good balance of creative vision and technical execution is required.

•
Soft & Hard Skills: A good communicator and problem solver, with a balance of Soft and Hard skills. You can take charge of small tasks independently, and take on bigger jobs with little supervision . You are a clear communicator and are happy to work with designers from all over the world .

•
Language: You are well-versed in English and production tricks .

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Semi-Senior Motion Animator who finds as much beauty in a perfectly organized project file as they do in a smooth animation.

In this role, your primary mission is to act as the architect of our visual output. You won’t just be creating videos; you will be building the engines that allow our global campaigns to live across dozens of languages and formats with surgical precision.

You are the bridge between high-end design and massive-scale execution. While you will develop original creative assets, your core focus is on the technical craft of localization, template architecture, and AI-driven automation using the Google ecosystem.

Core Responsibilities

• Master Template Architecture: Design and "bulletproof" complex After Effects templates. You will ensure that layouts, typography, and timings adapt intelligently to varying text lengths and localized content via Expressions and Essential Graphics.

• Precision Localization: Own the end-to-end technical rollout of global campaigns. You will ensure every regional variation is frame-perfect, managing the nuances of different languages and cultural formats with an obsessive eye for detail.

• Workflow Automation: Champion the use of AI-assisted tools to eliminate manual tasks. You will connect data feeds (Sheets/CSV) to creative templates to trigger high-volume renders with minimal manual intervention.

• Asset Scaling & QA: Maintain rigorous organizational standards across massive asset libraries. You are the final line of defense, ensuring that every export—regardless of the quantity—meets our exact technical and brand specifications.

• Strategic Creative Development: Design the foundational "Hero" motion assets that serve as the blueprint for our automated systems, ensuring they are built from the ground up for scalability.

Your Technical Mindset

• The Architect: You believe a project is only as good as its structure. You prioritize clean hierarchies, strict naming conventions, and scalable workflows.

• The Logic Specialist: You have a deep command of After Effects Expressions and scripting, using them to solve layout challenges before they occur.

• The Google Power-User: You are comfortable navigating Google Workspace, and leveraging Gemini/AI tools to optimize creative production.

• Detail Obsessed: You are someone who naturally spots a 1-pixel misalignment or a slight tracking inconsistency across 100+ localized banners.

Experience & Qualifications

• 3–5 years of experience in an agency or fast-paced in-house creative team.

• A portfolio demonstrating high-end motion work alongside examples of dynamic/programmatic creative projects.

• Proven track record of managing "Creative at Scale" (localizing content for multiple regions or AB testing).

• A "hacker" mindset—always looking for a way to automate a repetitive task.

Monks is looking for a seasoned and experienced 3D Technical Director/Pipeline Engineer who can solve technical issues, and develop pipelines and workflows for the 3D Animation team in Buenos Aires and beyond. In this role, you will work on demanding CGI projects for premium customers with the highest demands on quality and aesthetics.

Our ideal candidate can communicate with the art and production team on the needed technical components and pipeline improvements. You will be involved in all aspects of the pipeline: from scoping alongside with the producers, through setting up a team until the delivery.

• Attend to team calls and brainstorming solutions together with the team

• Working closely with other offices in different countries and time zones.

• At least 8 years of production experience with the end-to-end 3D animation process in a senior or leading role.

• A deep knowledge of different CGI production pipelines and industry standards.

• Excellent ability to troubleshoot and solve technical problems.

• You have an excellent knowledge of all 3D softwares and render engines with a main focus on Maya/Arnold and Cinema4/Redshift.

• You have a deep understanding of 2D compositing.

• Excellent communication in English and collaboration skills to work effectively within a team.

• Able to meet, talk, and present to clients.

• Pro-active attitude. You are a team player and have a positive, hands-on approach.

postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Semi-Senior Motion Animator who finds as much beauty in a perfectly organized project file as they do in a smooth animation.

In this role, your primary mission is to act as the architect of our visual output. You won’t just be creating videos; you will be building the engines that allow our global campaigns to live across dozens of languages and formats with surgical precision.

You are the bridge between high-end design and massive-scale execution. While you will develop original creative assets, your core focus is on the technical craft of localization, template architecture, and AI-driven automation using the Google ecosystem.

Core Responsibilities

• Master Template Architecture: Design and "bulletproof" complex After Effects templates. You will ensure that layouts, typography, and timings adapt intelligently to varying text lengths and localized content via Expressions and Essential Graphics.

• Precision Localization: Own the end-to-end technical rollout of global campaigns. You will ensure every regional variation is frame-perfect, managing the nuances of different languages and cultural formats with an obsessive eye for detail.

• Workflow Automation: Champion the use of AI-assisted tools to eliminate manual tasks. You will connect data feeds (Sheets/CSV) to creative templates to trigger high-volume renders with minimal manual intervention.

• Asset Scaling & QA: Maintain rigorous organizational standards across massive asset libraries. You are the final line of defense, ensuring that every export—regardless of the quantity—meets our exact technical and brand specifications.

• Strategic Creative Development: Design the foundational "Hero" motion assets that serve as the blueprint for our automated systems, ensuring they are built from the ground up for scalability.

Your Technical Mindset

• The Architect: You believe a project is only as good as its structure. You prioritize clean hierarchies, strict naming conventions, and scalable workflows.

• The Logic Specialist: You have a deep command of After Effects Expressions and scripting, using them to solve layout challenges before they occur.

• The Google Power-User: You are comfortable navigating Google Workspace, and leveraging Gemini/AI tools to optimize creative production.

• Detail Obsessed: You are someone who naturally spots a 1-pixel misalignment or a slight tracking inconsistency across 100+ localized banners.

Experience & Qualifications

• 3–5 years of experience in an agency or fast-paced in-house creative team.

• A portfolio demonstrating high-end motion work alongside examples of dynamic/programmatic creative projects.

• Proven track record of managing "Creative at Scale" (localizing content for multiple regions or AB testing).

• A "hacker" mindset—always looking for a way to automate a repetitive task.

Sr. Animator/2D Motion Designer

About the Role

You'll be a senior creative force on high-profile brand marketing campaigns spanning social content, hero video, motion graphics, and typographic animation. Operating within a dedicated client team, you'll own the animation process end-to-end — from concept and pre-production through final delivery — collaborating with creative directors, producers, illustrators, and animators across a global team.

At this level, nobody oversees your craft — you set the bar. You're expected to drive quality and efficiency, mentor junior and semi-senior animators, push new techniques and tools, and serve as an internal ambassador for generative AI in the animation workflow.

What You'll Do

• Own the full animation lifecycle — pre-production assessment, creative scoping, execution, and final delivery — across social assets, complex hero videos, and multi-platform campaign toolkits.

• Lead early-stage creative ideation alongside art directors and creative leads, translating briefs and copy into high-quality motion work across formats, languages, and dimensions.

• Build and optimize production templates that improve speed and consistency for the broader global animation team.

• Maintain brand integrity across all deliverables — consistent across ad formats, platforms, and languages — while proactively flagging risks and unfeasible timelines before they become problems.

• Champion and integrate generative AI tools into your workflow, staying ahead of market trends and helping the team adopt new techniques and software.

• Present work and contribute to creative conversations with support from the craft director; collaborate with producers and cross-functional teams across multiple offices worldwide.

• Support and mentor junior and semi-senior animators, actively sharing progress, problems, and creative solutions across the team.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of professional experience in motion design and 2D animation, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership across brand campaigns, social content, and hero video production.

• Advanced proficiency in After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma — you know how to do the basics right, and when to break the rules for creative effect.

• Hands-on experience with generative AI tools — Runway, MidJourney, Adobe Firefly, Whisk, or similar — with a genuine drive to stay current as the toolset evolves.

• Strong visual design sensibility across typography, colour, layout, and composition in both static and motion contexts.

• Proven ability to manage your own time, flag risks early, and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines — independently, without hand-holding.

• Intermediate to advanced English proficiency (written and verbal) — enough to work fluidly with international teams, communicate blockers clearly, and present creative work.

• Collaborative mindset — equally comfortable leading a creative direction, mentoring a junior, or taking notes from a craft director.

Nice to Have

• 2D character animation

• 3D animation (C4D / Blender)

• Storyboarding

• Lottie / Rive

• Agency / production background

• Social platform specs (Meta, TikTok, YT)

postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. Role Purpose

The Senior Caster serves as the strategic talent orchestrator and craft curator for senior creative and content capabilities across global business units. Moving beyond administrative scheduling or generic resource allocation, this role pairs a nuanced appreciation of creative craft—aesthetic tone, visual identity, conceptual storytelling, and generative AI prompting maturity—with rigorous commercial capacity management.

Operating at the intersection of business demand and creative ambition, the Senior Caster ensures the right creative minds are deployed on the right briefs at the right moment, maximizing billable utilization, minimizing bench time, and safeguarding team well-being across a ~77-person roster.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Creative Casting & Craft Matching

Curate Talent by Craft: Partner with Executive Creative Directors (ECDs), Group Creative Directors (GCDs), and Creative Leads to interpret project briefs, matching talent based on portfolio aesthetic, brand affinity, storytelling style, and technical craft specializations.

AI & Hybrid Workflow Placement: Evaluate creative team members on their familiarity with AI-assisted creative workflows (e.g., prompt crafting, Midjourney, Firefly, ChatGPT/Claude copy augmentation) to match talent effectively with next-generation production pipelines.

Brief Triage & Scoping Alignment: Act as a critical filter during brief intake, validating that scope, deliverables, and timelines align realistically with available creative bandwidth before committing holds.

2. Capacity Planning, Bench Optimization & Well-being

Bench Minimization: Proactively identify upcoming roll-offs and unallocated talent 2–3 weeks in advance; partner with business development, account teams, and client leads to secure billable placements before talent lands on the bench.

Workload Balancing & Burnout Prevention: Monitor continuous run-rates and overtime trends across high-pressure retainer accounts. Strategically rotate creative talent between demanding pitch cycles and steady-state work to prevent creative fatigue and attrition.

Discipline Capacity Forecasting: Run bi-weekly forward-looking capacity models across all four sub-disciplines (Art, Copy, Creative Direction, Proofreading) to spot structural shortages or surpluses before they impact delivery.

3. Contingent Talent & Center of Excellence (CoE) Integration

Early Shortage Signal: Trigger contingent talent requests well before internal bandwidth caps are breached, defining precise craft specifications rather than generic roles.

Freelance & Vendor Partnering: Collaborate closely with Talent Sourcing, Talent Acquisition, and Procurement to brief, vet, and onboard specialized freelance talent and CoE resources.

Commercial Contingent Management: Balance freelance spend against full-time employee (FTE) capacity to protect project margins and prevent unnecessary third-party spend when internal capacity is available.

4. Operational SLAs & System Data Health

24-Hour Allocation SLA: Maintain single-source-of-truth accuracy in Sanskrit (ERP/Resource Management tool) by ensuring all holds, confirmed bookings, extensions, and reallocations are fully updated within 24 hours of brief agreement.

Roster Hygiene: Audit allocation statuses weekly to close ghost bookings, resolve unconfirmed soft holds, and synchronize project start/end dates with client Statements of Work (SOWs).

5. Commercial Analytics & Leadership Reporting

Weekly Utilization Reviews: Produce and lead weekly utilization health syncs with Creative Discipline Leads, highlighting actual vs. target billability, bench percentages, and risk areas.

Executive Visibility: Partner with Operations Leadership to surface trends in skill deficits, recurring freelance dependency, and hiring trigger recommendations backed by historical allocation data.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications:

• Experience & Background: 5–8+ years of progressive experience in Creative Resource Management, Creative Operations, Traffic Management, or Creative Production within a high-growth creative agency, digital production studio, or enterprise in-house agency.

• Proven track record managing creative rosters of 60–100+ specialists across multi-disciplinary creative fields (Art Direction, Copywriting, Design, Creative Direction, Post Production, Animation, Produccion, Strategy, Account).

• Strong working knowledge of contemporary digital advertising workflows, social/content production, brand campaigns, and localization pipelines.

• Craft Literacy & Modern Tools: Creative Fluency: Ability to evaluate portfolios, understand creative decks, and speak the language of creative directors, distinguishing between conceptual, design, and production capabilities.

• Familiarity with AI Creative Workflows: Working understanding of how generative AI tools fit into creative concepting, storyboarding, and copywriting to assess creative team member readiness.

• Systems Proficiency: Hands-on mastery of enterprise resource planning (ERP) and project management systems.

Soft Skills & Leadership:

• Diplomatic Negotiation: Exceptional communication skills with the confidence to push back on unrealistic deadlines, negotiate allocations with senior creative leadership, and defuse resource conflicts.

• High EQ & Empathy: Innate talent for building trust with creatives while maintaining accountability to commercial goals.

• Language Proficiency: Full professional bilingual proficiency…

About the Role

As a Senior Finance Analyst , you’ll play a key role in supporting the financial management and performance of our client portfolio. You’ll partner closely with Account Management, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to provide financial insights, maintain accurate forecasting and reporting, support revenue recognition, and help ensure strong financial controls across client engagements.

We are looking for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver who can work independently, communicate effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders, and translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.

Responsibilities:

• Support the financial management of assigned clients, including revenue, costs, profitability, forecasting, and financial reporting.

• Prepare and maintain monthly revenue forecasts, identifying risks and opportunities and communicating key changes to Finance leadership.

• Support monthly and quarterly close activities, including revenue recognition, accruals, deferred revenue, and related balance sheet reconciliations.

• Review project financials to ensure revenue and costs are recognized accurately and in accordance with company policies and accounting standards.

• Partner with Account and Operations teams to monitor project budgets, scopes, staffing, utilization, and overall client profitability.

• Analyze actual financial performance against budget and forecast and provide clear explanations for material variances.

• Monitor client billing, accounts receivable, work-in-progress, and other financial balances to identify and resolve aged or outstanding items.

• Support the preparation and maintenance of client rate cards, staffing plans, and financial models.

• Assist with client and project setup to ensure appropriate financial structures and controls are established.

• Prepare financial reporting and analysis for Finance and business leadership, highlighting trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Support internal and external audit requests by preparing accurate and complete financial documentation.

• Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial processes, reporting, and controls.

• Collaborate across Finance, Account Management, Operations, Billing, Accounting, and other teams to resolve financial issues and support business decisions.

About You

The essentials:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

• 3–5+ years of experience in Finance, FP&A, Client Finance, Commercial Finance, Accounting, or a related role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, revenue recognition, forecasting, budgeting, and financial analysis.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills with the ability to work with and analyze large data sets.

• Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to identify financial risks and translate data into actionable business insights.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

• Proactive and solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently while collaborating across teams.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Not a Must but a Plus:

• Experience within advertising, media, digital marketing, professional services, or another project-based business.

• Experience supporting large or complex client accounts.

• Knowledge of IFRS 15 revenue recognition principles.

• Experience with NetSuite or similar ERP systems.

• Experience with project-based financial management, including time and materials, fixed-fee, and retainer engagements.

• Experience with process improvement, financial systems implementations, or automation initiatives.

About the Role

As a Senior Digital Project Manager, you’ll lead a flagship, high-visibility digital transformation program for a major public sector client in Kuwait, directing the multi-platform migration of legacy e-Services into a unified, mobile-first ecosystem spanning enterprise web portals, mobile apps, and an enterprise-grade AI solution. We are looking for someone who is passionate about seeking new opportunities to create impactful work, pairing agency-grade creative, UX, and technology delivery with the rigor and governance that large-scale government digital transformation demands.

Responsibilities:

•
Lead discovery phases to draft, validate, and secure sign-off on Business, System, and Customer Requirements documents.

•
Translate high-level client mandates into precise technical user stories, API integration blueprints, and functional specifications across web, mobile, and AI microservices.

•
Partner with enterprise architects on cloud infrastructure (primarily Microsoft Azure / Azure Government Cloud), ensuring adherence to data sovereignty, zero-trust security, and containerised deployment standards.

•
Oversee UI/UX workflows in Figma, ensuring wireframes, design systems, and prototypes meet WCAG accessibility standards and client branding guidelines.

•
Own project lifecycles end-to-end across portal rebuilds, mobile app rollouts (iOS/Android), and AI model integration (LLM agents, conversational AI, NLP search).

•
Run hybrid governance models (Agile for dynamic product development, Waterfall for milestone sign-offs, procurement, and budget compliance) while managing risks, SLAs, and program performance metrics.

•
Liaise between senior government stakeholders, steering committees, and internal technical delivery teams to translate complex architecture into clear executive narratives.

•
Oversee Performance, Security, VAPT, UAT, and operational readiness phases to ensure seamless handover and client IT team enablement.

About You

The essentials:

•
8+ years of progressive experience in IT/digital transformation, with at least 5 years leading complex, large-scale portal, mobile app, and system integration projects.

•
Proven track record delivering digital initiatives for Public Sector clients in Kuwait or the broader GCC region.

•
Deep technical delivery experience spanning enterprise CMS platforms, microservices architecture, RESTful API gateways, and native/hybrid mobile frameworks (React Native, Flutter, iOS/Android).

•
Practical experience integrating AI technologies (e.g., LLM agents, conversational AI, NLP-driven search, RPA) into public-facing digital channels.

•
Solid knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud topology (including Azure AD/Entra ID) alongside working knowledge of GCC data privacy laws, cybersecurity frameworks, and national e-KYC standards.

•
Working proficiency in Figma for reviewing user flows, prototypes, and design systems.

•
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field.

Not a must, but a plus:

•
Master’s degree or MBA in IT Management or a related field.

•
Formal Project Management certification (e.g., PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum certifications).

• Accountable for relationship management with central and local clients, developing and maintaining a positive, trust- and collaboration-based relationship

• Proactively supporting and participating in our L&C roadmap for future-looking solutions

ESSENTIAL

DESIRED

postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. About the Role

As a Senior UI Designer , you’ll act as a dual threat a sharp conceptual thinker and an exceptional, hands-on UI designer who bridges the gap between big ideas and flawless digital execution. In this role, you will be a driving force within our Transformation Center of Excellence (CoE), focusing on Platforms & Brand Experience. You will comfortably flex between crafting immersive, idea-led campaign sites where emotion rules, and building large-scale brand platforms, .coms, and ecosystems where user flows and conversion take center stage. You are someone who loves the thrill of the pitch, can jump straight into Figma to bring an idea to life, and is eager to work on digital experiences for some of the world's most recognisable global brands. We are looking for someone who is passionate about seeking new opportunities to create impactful work.

Responsibilities:

•
Concept original ideas that start with a strong, own-able thought and pressure-test them seamlessly across every screen, scroll, and user interaction.

•
Design beautiful, considered, and systemic UI components and screens within Figma, setting a high visual and craft bar for the broader design team.

•
Translate brand strategies into highly functional user journeys, meticulously thinking through flows, states, motion, and edge cases.

•
Integrate AI tools fluently into your daily creative process—from ideation and copywriting to image generation and rapid prototyping—to push the boundaries of craft.

•
Prototype ideas rapidly using Figma, light code, or AI workflows to get tangible concepts in front of clients and pitch teams quickly.

•
Build highly polished presentation decks that pair a compelling visual narrative with sharp design rationale and killer copy.

•
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across art direction, copy, UX, motion, and engineering to ensure the central creative idea stays intact from kickoff to launch.

•
Provide day-to-day guidance and constructive feedback to mid-level and junior designers, helping elevate their craft and execution.

•
Present concepts and design work to internal leadership and clients with confidence, articulating not just what the idea is, but why it works.

About You

The essentials:

•
Experience: Around 5+ years of experience in digital design, UI/UX, or creative roles within a fast-paced agency, studio, or in-house team, with a portfolio showing a strong mix of campaign work and digital platforms.

•
UI Mastery: Exceptional digital design fundamentals (typography, grid, layout, color theory, and responsive design) with expert-level fluency in Figma and modern component design thinking.

•
Conceptual Range: The unique ability to think both emotionally for brand campaigns and logically for complex digital systems, marketing sites, and content ecosystems.

•
AI Fluency: Practical, hands-on experience using AI tools across image, video, copy, or prototyping, paired with strong judgment on when it elevates the work and when it doesn't.

•
Communication & Pitching: Sharp written and verbal communication skills; comfortable building narratives, writing design rationales, and standing up to present ideas.

•
Collaboration & Autonomy: A self-starter who can take a brief and run with it, while remaining an ego-free collaborator who lifts up the team around them.

•
Adaptability: The confidence to handle curveballs, iterate quickly based on client feedback, and the maturity to "kill your darlings" when a project demands it.

Not a must, but a plus:

•
Code literacy (HTML/CSS, or strong experience handling designs over to engineering teams).

•
Motion design skills (After Effects, Principle) or exposure to 3D/WebGL.

•
Experience creating work where AI is integrated as a user-facing product feature.
