We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.

postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please note: This is a temporary, 3-month contract position running from October through the end of December.

In this Senior Video Editor position, you’ll cut together amazing advertising content. This is a role where you’ll partner with a global team in producing top quality content for one of the world’s most recognizable technology brands. If your eye for detail and whether a shot should be extended by just one frame is beyond compare, we’d love to see your portfolio. Additionally, our ideal candidate is a fast and flexible go-getter who jumps on new opportunities.

About the Role
As part of our renowned post-production team, you’ll work alongside our in-house colorists, VFX artists and sound designers to edit all kinds of work for top-notch brands.
Together with our clients and producers you translate raw footage into spot-on edits, actualizing the creative vision for the project only making it look even better than they could have ever imagined.
You’ll cut your way through terabytes of footage in search of the perfect edit for TVCs, interactive films, VR and 360 projects, and more.
We’ll also look for your help in producing case videos of our projects, which includes making captures that truly capture the essence of our (interactive) projects.

About You
You’re a passionate storyteller and team player, willing to go the extra mile to create award winning content. You’ve worked on many short format projects and have a portfolio that we can immediately sell to our clients.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of professional experience working as an editor of creative work.

• You can create spot-on edits for TVCs, social-first content, and other types of linear work.

• You have experience editing nonlinear work for interactive films.

• You have premier Adobe Premiere skills and can also work with After Effects and Photoshop.

• You are proficient in integrating AI video tools into your workflow to optimize processes, generate assets, or enhance footage (e.g., Runway, Luma Dream Machine, Sora, Pika, Topaz Video AI).

• You know how to leverage native AI features within the Adobe Creative Cloud (e.g., Premiere’s Text-Based Editing, Generative Fill, AI audio enhancement, and auto-reframing).

• Familiarity with prompt engineering for asset generation or storyboarding (Gemini, Nano Banana, Veo) is a big plus.

• You can take care of simple animations, designs and (transition) effects.

• You can do the heavy lifting of the offline edit, as well as the nitty-gritty of getting the online perfect.

• If you also know your way around editing 360/spatial videos, you’re awesome all-around.

• You carry a solid understanding of the entire production process, evidenced by edits that seamlessly fit into the post-production pipeline.

• In addition to editing, you also know about color grading to enhance edits or prep them for client reviews.

• The same goes for experience with rendering edits for the web and/or compositing software.

• Finally, you’re a well-organized team player who’s great with clients and colleagues alike but can also work independently with little guidance.

This position may require participation in an on-call support rotation in the future.

Responsibilities

• Build, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure supporting AI SaaS and PaaS solutions.

• Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines across multiple ecosystems to support efficient, reliable software delivery.

Qualifications & Skills

• 7+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or site reliability engineering.

• A collaborative, resilient, and proactive approach to working with cross-functional teams.

• Strong organizational and communication skills, including the ability to structure focused, clear discussions.

• A meticulous approach to creating clear, comprehensive documentation.

• Preferred: AWS or GCP certifications.

• Preferred: Experience with MLOps practices and their integration into CI/CD pipelines, Nvidia NIM, or relevant Nvidia certifications.

• Nice to have: Experience with Temporal workflows.

Understanding of, or experience with, web technologies, technical concepts, software development (coding), and APIs .

postings.title: Full Stack Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to design, build, and ship features end-to-end across one of our core product teams — from the interface a user touches, through the API, down to the data. You own meaningful parts of the product front to back: shaping the approach with your team, building both the UI and the services behind it, testing them, and running them in production. This is a hands-on role: most of your day is spent writing, reviewing, and debugging real code across the stack, with the autonomy to make sound technical decisions and the judgment to know which ones to raise.

You care about more than making it work. You think about edge cases, failure modes, performance — both on the server and as the user perceives it — accessibility, and the engineers who'll read your code next. You collaborate closely with product managers, QA, and fellow engineers to turn ambiguous goals into reliable software, and you push back early when requirements don't add up. You bring an AI-first working style — using AI tooling daily to move faster across design, coding, and review — with the judgment to catch where its output falls short. You’re also comfortable working hands-on with LLM/agent APIs — prompt and context design, retrieval, and orchestrating agent workflows — and understand their behavior and failure modes in production.

This is not a role for someone who lives on only one side of the stack. We need an engineer who's genuinely comfortable building and owning a feature from the component to the database, takes it from ambiguous intent to shipped, reliable software, and raises the bar for the team around them.

Key Responsibilities - What this person will own and do day-to-day

Feature ownership (front to back)

• Build and own features end-to-end — UI, API, and data — from design discussion through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Translate product requirements and architectural direction into working, maintainable code across the stack.

• Break larger pieces of work into shippable increments and sequence them sensibly.

Frontend craft

• Build accessible, responsive UIs with a modern framework (React, Vue, or similar) in TypeScript.

• Make sound component-architecture and state-management decisions, and keep the front end maintainable as it grows.

• Care about perceived performance and the actual user experience — not just that it renders.

Backend, data, and APIs

• Design and build services and APIs (REST/GraphQL or event-driven) with sensible data models across relational and non-relational stores.

• Write clean, well-tested production code; handle failure deliberately with sound error handling and observability.

• Build and maintain integrations with third-party platforms and reason about their failure modes.

Code quality and working within the architecture

• Review PRs thoroughly — catching correctness, clarity, and maintainability issues, not just style.

• Implement against the boundaries, contracts, and patterns the architecture defines, flag when a contract or requirement doesn't hold up, and escalate the decisions that aren't yours to make.

• Refactor and pay down technical debt deliberately, where it buys real leverage.

Cross-functional collaboration

• Work directly with Product and Design on scope, feasibility, and trade-offs inside the current iteration.

postings.title: Digital Measurement Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

So you're interested in joining Brainlabs as a Digital Measurement Consultant? Let's see what it looks like!

What You'll Do:

• Design and maintain Solution Design References (SDRs), data layer recommendations, and technical specification documents that serve as the source of truth for tracking implementations across web and app properties.

• Implement and validate analytics tags and marketing pixels using Google Tag Manager, covering both client-side and server-side setups, with strong QA discipline at every stage.

• Write JavaScript, ES6, and jQuery functions to capture required data from web pages, and troubleshoot discrepancies between what the implementation says and what GA4 reports show.

• Manage and mentor a small team of analysts and implementation engineers, reviewing their work, unblocking technical problems, and helping them grow their skills in both implementation and analysis.

• Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to gather analytics requirements, translate them into scoped technical projects, and produce Point of Views (POVs) on measurement trends or platform changes as needed.

• Stay current on privacy-driven shifts in measurement, including consent mode, server-side tagging, and cookieless tracking, and bring practical responses to those changes into the team's standard approach.

Who You Are:

What We Really Want:

• Someone who still enjoys the implementation craft but is ready to be responsible for more than their own output. You can write a data layer spec, spot a broken tag, and explain what the data means to a non-technical stakeholder, all in the same week. You've managed a small team or mentored others and you're ready to do it more formally.

What Particular Set of Skills Would Suit This Role:

• Exposure to additional TMS platforms such as Tealium or Adobe Launch , as is experience with CDPs like Tealium AudienceStream or BlueConic.

• Deep working knowledge of GA4, including event modeling, custom dimensions, exploration reports, and the differences from Universal Analytics.

• Solid JavaScript, ES6, and jQuery skills sufficient to write and debug tag implementations without leaning on front-end developers.

• Experience with server-side tagging via GTM Server and working knowledge of consent management platforms (CMPs).

• Familiarity with mobile app analytics implementation using Firebase or AppsFlyer.

• A track record of producing clean technical documentation, including SDRs and tag collection guides, that others can actually work from.

• Some experience managing or mentoring others, formally or informally.

How You Succeed:

You're succeeding when the tracking is solid, the documentation is trusted, and the analysis is changing how people make decisions. Your team ships clean implementations, QA is thorough before anything goes live, and stakeholders come to you first when something looks wrong in the data or a new measurement requirement lands on the table.

Some benefits for you: ✨

• This is a full time job ( en relación de dependencia ).

• Hybrid salary scheme (50% paid in USD).

• 20 working days vacation plus all Argentina public holidays.

• Private healthcare (OSDE 360).

• Adaptive/hybrid working, with 3 days in our amazing Palermo Office (right opposite the Hippodrome!)

• Free breakfast and lunch in the office.

• Quarterly training sessions on wider business skills (pitching, strategy, client servicing)

• Mobility programmes - work from another country for up to 30 days!

The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

A note on our offices: We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. postings.title: Accounting Specialist - LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Customer Support & Onboarding Specialist - Accounting (Latin America), you will help our Latin American hotel customers unlock the full potential of Cloudbeds' financial and accounting capabilities. You will work directly with clients and their accounting teams across the region to guide them through end-to-end accounting configuration — from chart of accounts mapping and tax setup to ERP integrations and country-specific e-invoicing compliance — ensuring every property is set up correctly and running smoothly from day one. This is a customer-facing role requiring equal parts hospitality accounting expertise, technical curiosity, and a genuine passion for helping people succeed. If you thrive behind a spreadsheet but prefer not to engage with customers directly, this role is not the right fit.

Our Onboarding & Accounting Integration Team:

We sit at the intersection of hospitality expertise and technical execution — solving real financial challenges that hotel operators face every day. We move fast, collaborate closely with Engineering, Support, and Sales, and take genuine pride in helping customers connect their financial backbone to Cloudbeds. If you love solving problems that actually matter to the people you are helping, you will feel right at home here.

What You Bring to the Team:

•
Guide Latin American hotel clients through full accounting onboarding, including chart of accounts mapping, tax configuration, revenue recognition setup, reconciliation workflows, and country-specific e-invoicing compliance (Mexico SAT/CFDI, Colombia DIAN, Chile SII, and others).

•
Translate each customer's unique business processes — night audits, folio management, accounts receivable, month-end close — into a properly configured Cloudbeds environment.

•
Support integrations between Cloudbeds and third-party accounting platforms and ERPs including QuickBooks, Xero, M3, NetSuite, and regional Latin American accounting systems.

•
Troubleshoot accounting discrepancies, integration sync issues, and configuration questions with a hands-on, solutions-oriented approach.

•
Serve as the internal subject matter expert on Latin American hospitality accounting practices and regional fiscal compliance.

•
Contribute to onboarding documentation and best-practice resources for hospitality accounting workflows across Latin American markets.

•
Collaborate with Product and Engineering to relay customer feedback and help shape the roadmap.

What Sets You Up for Success:

•
5+ years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience specifically within the hotel or hospitality industry — required.

•
Proven experience configuring or supporting integrations between a hotel PMS and accounting or ERP software (QuickBooks, NetSuite, M3, or comparable) — not theoretical; you have done this.

•
Deep knowledge of at least one Latin American country's fiscal and e-invoicing requirements with working familiarity across the broader region.

•
Strong customer-facing communication skills — you are comfortable and confident engaging directly with hotel clients and their accounting teams via phone and video daily.

•
Fluent in both Spanish and English — this is a firm requirement for this role; Portuguese is a strong additional plus.

•
Comfort navigating SaaS platforms and adopting new tools quickly with minimal hand-holding.

•
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to trace data flows, identify mapping issues, and troubleshoot integration problems methodically.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

•
Prior hands-on experience in hotel operations — front office, night audit, or revenue management.

•
Knowledge of fiscal compliance requirements across multiple Latin American countries beyond your home market.

•
Active personal use of AI tools or workflow automation — we are building a team that embraces technology and learns continuously.

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. How You'll Make an Impact:

As Manager, Customer Recovery, you own the retention engine and critical recovery motions that turn high-risk accounts into long-term brand advocates. You lead a specialized team of Customer Recovery Coaches who sit at the vital intersection of customer retention, risk mitigation, and product success. You will scale our Intelligent Recovery Motion and oversee the Fire-Team concept, a cross-functional, executive-level intervention designed to deliver decisive issue resolution during critical retention moments. As a leader, you understand that technology should handle administrative drag so your team can focus on customer connection and meaningful interactions. Your job is to turn reactive support into proactive rescue operations, using data and systemic feedback loops to ensure Cloudbeds remains central to our customers' business success. This is a player-coach role, leading a high-performing team of Customer Recovery Coaches while overseeing critical recovery operations across mid-market and SMB accounts.

Our Customer Recovery Team:

Our Customer Recovery Team is dedicated to rescuing at-risk accounts and transforming customer frustration into long-term loyalty. Serving as trusted internal consultants and single points of contact for customers at critical moments in the Customer Journey, Recovery Coaches mobilize cross-functional response teams to swiftly eliminate customer friction. This is a team of problem-solvers - regardless of what led the customer to the Recovery team, they always focus on a few key goals: prevent churn, take unhappy customers and get them back on track, and identify key customer experience friction points to drive continuous improvement across the organization.

What You Bring to the Team:

•
Lead, coach, and develop a specialized team of Customer Recovery Coaches, running regular 1:1s, risk portfolio reviews, and clear performance expectations, while hiring, onboarding, and continuously upskilling new Recovery Coaches.

Set the operating rhythm for the Customer Recovery motion: risk queue triage, Fire-Team mobilizations, post-sales friction resolution, executive escalation tracking, and weekly retention forecasts.

•
Oversee and optimize the Fire-Team motion as an executive escalation owner, helping coaches mobilize cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to restore trust.

•
Ensure the team effectively triages high-impact queues of at-risk customers, driving proactive rescue and structured save motions, and guide the team in executing Rapid Wins that prioritize immediate operational stabilization.

•
Own and execute the "Recovery Becomes Prevention" feedback loop, treating cancellation requests and severe risk as systemic failures and transforming root-cause insights into actionable product and process improvements.

•
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Onboarding, and Customer Support leadership to eliminate recurring operational blockers and friction points that deplete customers and internal teams.

•
Champion "Standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful" by working with CS Ops to implement AI-driven tooling, automated risk detection, and clean CRM reporting in Salesforce.

What Sets You Up for Success:

•
5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Retention, CS Ops, or Post-Sales Operations in B2B SaaS.

•
At least 2 years of direct people management or proven lead experience managing high-stakes customer retention workflows.

•
Significant direct management experience in hotel or resort operations (front office, revenue, or property management), with a deep understanding of the real business impact when hotel technology fails.

•
Exceptional emotional intelligence and proven capability in executive-level de-escalation, trust-building, and high-impact problem-solving.

•
Technical aptitude to leverage AI tooling and automation to unlock team capacity, with high attention to detail and strict standards for CRM hygiene, activity logging, and process documentation.

•
Proven ability to drive alignment and mobilize internal teams across Product, Support, and Sales without relying solely on direct authority.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

•
Deep experience managing customer recovery or retention motions across SMB, mid-market, enterprise, or multi-property hospitality clients (management companies, branded clusters, or franchise models).

•
Fluency in Spanish and English.

•
Familiarity with Salesforce, Zendesk, or advanced CS risk-analytics tooling.

Our Data Analytics & BI Team:

We are a small, senior, fully remote team running analytics for the entire company on Snowflake, dbt, Matillion, and Sigma. We move fast and ship things people use daily. That's this role, and it comes with unusual latitude to decide how the platform should work.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As our Tech Lead Data Engineer & Data Architect, you will shape the technical direction, architectural standards, and data governance of our core Data Analytics platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will act as our Data Architect—owning logical and physical data modeling, warehouse design, and layered curation (staging → intermediate → mart)—while serving as our Data Engineering Tech Lead.

You will help continuously modernize our tech stack, elevating our software engineering discipline across our data pipelines (DataOps/CI-CD), optimizing compute performance and costs, driving MLOps workflows, and reinforcing data quality and security standards. Crucially, you will drive our AI-readiness initiatives—architecting the semantic layers, data structures, and access patterns needed to make our data seamless and reliable for AI agents and automated workflows. You will serve as the technical anchor for a talented team of Analytical Engineers, collaborating closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Data Science / ML, and business stakeholders to ensure our data ecosystem is reliable, scalable, and business-ready.

•
Data Architecture & Modeling Ownership: Set and evolve our cloud data architecture on Snowflake. Own data model design across data products and marts, implementing flexible dimensional models (Star Schemas, SCDs, conformed dimensions) and documenting decisions through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

•
Data Engineering Competency: Lead the end-to-end design and execution of data pipelines—owning ingestion, API integrations, custom connectors, ELT/ETL processes, and pipeline orchestration.

•
DataOps & CI/CD Integration: Build upon our existing Git, CI/CD, and Jira workflows by embedding specialized data discipline—such as automated dbt testing on pull requests, environment isolation, automated credential management, and data deployment standards.

•
Governance & Observability Strategy: Build upon and refine the initial foundations of our governance model. Evaluate, select, and implement scalable Data Catalog and Data Observability solutions to track data lineage, ensure freshness, monitor completeness, and automate failure alerting.

•
Platform Efficiency & Cost Control: Continuously tune Snowflake query performance, clustering, and warehouse sizing to optimize execution times and compute spend.

•
Technical Mentorship & Agile Leadership: Raise the technical effectiveness of Analytical Engineers within our Agile planning framework through architectural guidance, design reviews, and constructive challenge.

•
Stack Modernization & Architecture Evolution: Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and architecture patterns to modernize, optimize, and add flexibility to our data stack.

What Sets You Up for Success:

•
Senior Hands-On Experience: Proven track record as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Tech Lead in cloud data environments.

•
AI & Agent Readiness: Exposure to preparing data structures, semantic models, feature stores, and API/access layers for AI agents, machine learning pipelines, and automated LLM workflows.

•
Snowflake & dbt Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise administering, tuning, and modeling in Snowflake, alongside advanced mastery of dbt (macros, incremental models, custom tests, packages, and dbt-native CI/CD testing).

•
Advanced SQL & Python Skills: Expert analytical SQL skills (query execution plan tuning, window functions, CTEs) and strong Python proficiency for data pipelines, scripting, and MLOps workflows.

•
Orchestration & Tool Evaluation: Practical experience with ingestion and orchestration engines (e.g., Matillion, Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Fivetran), with a strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, performance, and costs when selecting or migrating platforms.

•
DataOps & Software Engineering Discipline: Experience operating with active Git and CI/CD pipelines, with a track record of extending these systems to include automated data testing, deployment validation, and secure credential rotation.

•
Critical Thinking & Problem Decomposition: Tendency to question assumptions, gather full business context, form hypotheses, and rigorously evaluate outputs (especially for AI/ML outputs) before jumping to technical solutions.

•
Pragmatic Experimentation: Passion for building lightweight MVPs and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, test architectural hypotheses, and modernize the data stack.

postings.title: ITAD Billing Operations Associate
postings.descriptionText:
About AppDirect

Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

About Firstbase, an AppDirect Subsidiary

Firstbase helps companies equip their teams with everything they need to do great work—from computers and furniture to company swag and perks. We give businesses the ability to instantly support employees with the right physical goods, and give employees the flexibility to choose what works for their unique needs. Firstbase is part of AppDirect, a subscription commerce platform that powers millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations selling any product, through any channel, on any device—as a service.

About You

The ITAD Billing Operations Associate will own the financial side of our IT Asset Disposition program, a small, fast-moving team responsible for what happens to hardware at the end of its life, and for the money that comes back when it's resold or recycled. You'll own the final word on whether a settlement is right. Half of that is investigative: a deposit that doesn't match any invoice, a partner file that's quietly missing a hundred devices, revenue a vendor earned months ago that never reached our books. You find it, you prove it, you close it. Increasingly, you won't do that hunting alone. We're building AI agents that work these queues inside ITAD OS, our internal operations platform, pulling partner files apart, matching deposits against revenue, flagging the rows that look wrong, and we're putting the best AI tooling available into this team's hands as fast as it ships. That moves the job up, not away: the agent proposes, you decide. Your value becomes knowing what the right answer should look like, catching the case the agent got confidently wrong, and turning a workflow you've been running by hand into one that runs itself with you supervising it. If you'd rather be the person who automates their own job than the one it gets automated around, this is that seat.

This posting is for the finance-focused seat on the team. Alongside your primary ownership, you'll be trained across the rest of our ITAD operations —data destruction documentation, vendor management, shipping and logistics — so the team can cover for one another. Everyone here rotates.

The position offers a flexible hybrid schedule: you will work one day per week onsite and four days remote. Compensation includes 15 paid working days (PTO) plus local holidays, comprehensive medical coverage (OSDE Plan 310) for you and your dependents, reimbursement for eligible wellness activities, English lessons, global and local events participation, and much more!

What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact

• Ingest settlement and revenue reports from our resale and recycling partners. Every partner sends a different format, and a real part of the craft is turning messy vendor data into clean, trustworthy records without introducing errors.

• Reconcile device-level and order-level ITAD revenue against actual bank deposits, and allocate deposits to settlements.

• Investigate unmatched records, ambiguous serials and variances.

• Own the end-to-end credit issuance workflow in partnership with Finance.

• Raise and resolve discrepancies directly with our vendor partners.

• Own financial reporting for the ITAD program, including revenue and margin, and produce executive-ready summaries that go straight to leadership.

• Review and ingest Certificates of Destruction and data destruction reports from partners, matching them to the devices they cover.

• Monitor ITAD action queues, ensuring steps are followed per SOPs and that we're hitting our service level objectives.

• Support shipment and recycling order workflows with our warehouses and partner facilities: pick lists, ship and receipt dates, and resolving receipt exceptions.

• Maintain and enrich our internal database of fair market value estimates per device, drawing on secondary market platforms, trade-in partners and historical resale data.

• Act as a primary point of contact between Operations, Finance, Customer Success and Warehouse teams for ITAD financial workflows.

What we’re looking for

• 2–5 years in reconciliation, cash applications, billing, audit, accounts payable/receivable, or financial operations. This is a hands-on execution role.

• Demonstrated experience finding and resolving discrepancies, not just processing transactions. We'll ask you about a number that didn't tie and what you did about it.

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets: lookups, pivots, text-to-columns, deduplication, and genuine comfort cleaning up badly formatted exports.

• Strong spoken and written English. You'll speak and write directly to partners in the US and UK, and to colleagues over Slack. Expect this to be assessed.

• The judgment to know when something is wrong, and the confidence to escalate rather than force a match.

• High attention to detail, and the ability to run several parallel workflows without losing track of any of them.

• Comfortable with structured SOPs, but restless about improving them.

(*) Interested candidates should submit their resume in English. Please note that Spanish versions will not be reviewed.

postings.descriptionText:
About AppDirect

Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

About you

The core mission of the product management team at AppDirect is to improve how cloud software and solutions are discovered, purchased and managed globally. We have a strong passion for creating best-in-class user experiences at every stage of the customer journey. We thrive on turning complex technical challenges into elegant customer-focused solutions that are scalable and easy to use. Catering to a diverse ecosystem of cloud commerce vendors, channels and users requires us to creatively think our way through challenges, with a dual focus on product quality and time-to-market. We learn, holding each other accountable, while also being committed to our shared success.

You are an experienced product manager to lead the evolution of our reseller and CPQ services, with a particular focus on creating one of the industry’s best advisor selling experiences. You will own strategy and execution for features that enable advisors to prospect, solution, price, upsell, and manage quotes quickly and intuitively.

The position offers a flexible hybrid schedule: you will work one day per week onsite and four days remote. Compensation includes 15 paid working days (PTO) plus local holidays, comprehensive medical coverage (OSDE Plan 310) for you and your dependents, reimbursement for eligible wellness activities, English lessons, global and local events participation, and much more.

What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact

• Own and evolve the advisor selling journey: design and deliver a world-class self-serve quoting experience that enables advisors to create accurate quotes quickly, customize offers, and close deals with minimal friction.

• Nail and scale adoption: define, document and roll out playbooks, product patterns and operational processes so advisor selling workflows scale across geographies, partners, and channels.

• Leverage AI and automation: design and ship AI-enabled capabilities (recommendations, pre-fill, bundle suggestions, predictive pricing, automated validations, and intelligent workflows) to make quote creation and ongoing quote management more intuitive and operationally efficient.

• Partner broadly to drive adoption: work closely with business partners, channel sales, sales operations and advisor communities to deeply understand needs, pilot new capabilities, and drive adoption through enablement and change management.

• Build data-driven feedback loops: establish both quantitative (usage metrics, funnel conversion, business KPIs, A/B tests) and qualitative (advisor interviews, support tickets) feedback channels to prioritize improvements and iterate quickly on the quoting experience.

• Create a universal quoting experience: collaborate with AppDirect’s first party services and other internal stakeholders to deliver a compelling, cross-sell enabling quoting platform that surfaces relevant products across lines of business and unlocks new revenue opportunities.

• Define success and measure impact: own KPIs for advisor adoption, quote velocity, conversion, average deal size, time-to-quote, and operational cost reductions; convert insights into prioritized roadmaps and experiments.

• Communicate and evangelize: produce sales enablement materials, product documentation, and training content; represent the product internally and externally, and serve as the voice of the customer across the company.

• Execute with engineering and design: write clear business requirements, partner with UX and engineering to build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions, and ensure high-quality delivery.

What we’re looking for

• 3+ years of product management experience in reseller/partner management, CPQ, quoting platforms, or related SaaS commerce products.

• Demonstrated experience owning or shipping advisor/reseller selling experiences or CPQ workflows at scale and measurable success driving adoption.

• Strong track record of partnering with sales, sales ops, channel teams, and external advisors to pilot features and drive adoption.

• Experience designing and operating quantitative and qualitative feedback loops (instrumentation, analytics, experiments, advisor interviews, voice-of-customer programs).

• Deep understanding of multi-tenant SaaS at scale, with a focus on usability, performance, reliability and security.

• Excellent communication skills with comfort presenting to executives and cross-functional stakeholders; ability to translate customer needs into pragmatic product roadmaps.

• Strong analytical skills, comfortable defining KPIs, interpreting product metrics and using data to prioritize and validate hypotheses.

• Experience working with Agile teams and modern product development practices, including working with AI in your workflows.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

• Bonus: experience with integrations across CRM/ERP/first-party services, or prior exposure to sales enablement platforms and quoting integrations.

postings.descriptionText:
About AppDirect

Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture - one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

About You

You will support the revenue team’s close and process improvements while supporting acquisitions, partnering closely with teams across Accounting & Finance, Legal Sales, and Operations to deliver accurate, timely, and insightful results. This role is a foundational member of our global revenue accounting team. You will roll up your sleeves to develop and improve revenue accounting process in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building scalable processes, and want your work to directly influence how the business grows globally, this is an exciting opportunity to make an outsized impact. Join the Revenue accounting team and help shape how we recognize and report revenue across our rapidly growing marketplace business.

The position offers a hybrid schedule: you will work once a week onsite and four days on remote. Compensation package includes 15 paid working days (PTO) plus local holidays, comprehensive medical coverage (OSDE 310) for you and your dependents, reimbursement for elegible wellness activities, English lessons, global and local events participation, within other benefits.

What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact

• Review deals/sales orders in NetSuite to ensure deals are recorded and documented properly, and that documents are audit-ready.

• Review and approve revenue arrangements in NetSuite ARM for defined deal size.

• Partner with system teams to enhance revenue system utilization to improve process efficiency and revenue accuracy.

• Revenue month-end close and reconciliations.

• Identify bottlenecks, manual work, and automation opportunities in the revenue recognition and close processes.

• Assist with the external audit process and participate in and/or lead ad hoc projects with cross-functional impacts.

What we’re looking for

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA preferred.

• 2+ years of revenue experience.

• Proficiency in NetSuite ARM system or similar.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Produce concise, actionable product artifacts, including requirements, prioritization rationale, and launch plans.

• Experience working with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback, validate assumptions, and ensure solutions solve real problems.

• Demonstrated ability to partner closely with engineering and design to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements and shipped solutions.

• Strong product judgment, with the ability to make prioritization trade-offs using customer insights, business context, and data.

• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain product decisions, trade-offs, and progress to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving execution in a fast-moving environment.

Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. You will work hands-on in tools like 6Sense and Demandbase to maintain target account lists, segment and score accounts, and surface intent signals that inform what Paid Media, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams do next. This role is equal parts platform execution and strategic thinking — you're expected to not just pull the data, but understand what it means and flag it before someone else has to ask.

You'll partner closely with the Director of ABM on playbook development and client-facing materials, and coordinate directly with channel teams to make sure account tiering and intent data are actually driving campaign decisions, not just sitting in a dashboard.

• Build, maintain, and continuously refine target account lists, tiering, and scoring models in 6Sense and Demandbase

• Translate account tiers and intent signals into campaign briefs and targeting inputs for Paid Media, Paid Social, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams

• Coordinate with channel teams to confirm account-based campaigns are executing against the intended tiering and messaging strategy

• Own ABM reporting and dashboards; track pipeline influenced/sourced, account engagement, and movement through funnel stages

• Support cross-agency collaboration across SEO, Paid Media, Creative, PR, Influencer, and CRO to keep ABM campaigns unified

• Assist Revenue and Appraisal teams with account and market research for new and expanded business opportunities

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize ABM processes and reporting

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to ABM strategy and reporting

• Join client calls and discovery discussions to represent ABM performance and platform data; build toward leading these independently

Role Requirements:

• Mandatory: hands-on working proficiency with 6Sense, Demandbase, or an equivalent ABM/intent data platform

• 2–4 years in B2B marketing, marketing operations, or ABM, in-house or in-agency

• Comfortable working in core B2B Martech such as Salesforce, Marketo, or HubSpot

• Working knowledge of intent data, predictive scoring, and account tiering, with a desire to go deeper on the strategy behind them

• Strong analytical skills; comfortable pulling and interpreting data without hand-holding

• Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate platform data into a takeaway a channel lead or client can act on

• Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage account data and reporting across multiple clients concurrently

• Team-oriented and collaborative, with the confidence to flag issues or opportunities to more senior stakeholders

• Agency experience valued but not required

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Net MRR across B2B ABM / Strategy portfolio

• Client NPS (8+ avg)

• Delivery of all work within agreed-upon deadlines

• Accuracy and freshness of account tiering, scoring and intent data across assigned clients

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Keep account data, intent signals, and reporting accurate and current — the Director and channel teams are making decisions off your work

• Clear, direct, and radically candid communication with internal and external stakeholders

• Client value — has your work provided new insight, confirmed a course of action, or outlined a clear path forward

A day in the life:

As the Creative Director, you are the leader of your pod, a hybrid of senior individual contributor, people manager, and product leader for Creative within the division. Reporting to the Managing Director, you own two things above all else: the people on your pod, and the quality of the creative work that pod produces.

This is a player-coach role. You are the best generalist on your pod, earning the team's trust through judgment and craft, not title, and you lead from the front: explaining creative strategy directly to clients, and stepping into concepting, design, or production coverage at an exemplary standard on select high-priority accounts, and for escalations and pitches when needed.

You protect your pod from unreasonable client pressure while holding a high, non-negotiable creative bar, and you own the full creative vision for your book of business, from strategy through post-production. Beyond delivery, you push the creative product itself forward, partnering with the R&D team to pilot new tools, formats, and approaches, then translating those innovations into practical gains for your division. This role is on the roadmap to Managing Director, building the people leadership and product judgment that role demands while staying closer to the craft.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Development: Maximize the Team’s Output & Trust

• Lead and manage a pod of creative professionals (Strategists, Designers, Editors, ACDs), owning hiring, onboarding, and day-to-day leadership.

• Build development plans, coaching cadences, and mentorship for each team member.

• Own team retention through trust, positive sentiment, psychological safety, and clear growth paths.

• Drive performance management using the ARC framework; deliver direct feedback and raise/promotion recommendations.

• Oversee capacity planning and staffing alignment as client books shift.

• Facilitate ongoing training and knowledge-sharing on industry trends and tools.

Client & Delivery Oversight: Senior Contributor - Lead From The Front

• Able to meet directly with clients and explain strategy, performance, and channel nuance.

• Able to get hands-on with coverage, meaning stepping into day-to-day execution on the channel, and do it at an exemplary standard.

• Provide executive-level oversight for pod accounts, with hands-on support on the most complex or highest-priority clients.

Platforms restate attributed conversions days after the fact, each in a different way. Entity hierarchies don't match (campaign/ad set/ad on Meta, campaign/ad group/ad on Google). • Model across sources so the numbers reconcile: spend, impressions, conversions, and revenue across Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, LinkedIn, and Microsoft, plus customer-level joins across Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4, and client CRMs.

• Contribute to client-bespoke modeling on top of the core layer: custom logic, overrides, and client-specific marts built in response to individual client requests, with patterns that extend the shared foundation rather than fork it. This is steady, recurring work, not an occasional exception.

• Deep expertise in dbt, not just writing models. Incremental strategies and full-refresh tradeoffs, Jinja and macros, packages, generic and singular tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and how to keep a large project's DAG and materializations under control.

• Strong command of Snowflake and the surrounding cloud data stack to operate autonomously as a foundational data owner.

• Experience modeling in a multi-tenant environment, with the judgment to know when a client request belongs in a client layer and when it belongs in the core.

You are a B2B and Lead Gen data specialist. You understand the full pipeline data landscape, CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), marketing automation tools (Marketo, Pardot), demand generation platforms (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase), call tracking and form capture tools (CallRail, Unbounce), and the messy reality of lead data that arrives in every format imaginable: CSV dumps, screenshot imports, manual spreadsheets, and custom-built ingress pipelines. This role reports to the Director of Data Operations & Enablement and works closely with the Appraisal team, the Measurement team, Analytics Engineering, and client account leads.

B2B & Lead Gen Vertical Client Delivery:
- Own the end-to-end data onboarding experience for B2B and Lead Gen clients post-signature — from scoping through integration validation and measurement readiness

- Coordinate standup of B2B and Lead Gen data pipelines — CRM connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot), MAP integrations (Marketo, Pardot), demand gen platforms (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase), and call/form tracking tools (CallRail, Unbounce)
- Own the ingestion and normalization of unstructured lead data sources — CSV imports, manual spreadsheets, screenshot-based reporting, and custom ingress tooling — leveraging AI-assisted schema mapping and data extraction where applicable
- Validate integrations are live and pipeline data is landing correctly before handing off to analytics engineering for modeling

- Join sales calls and pitch meetings for large B2B and Lead Gen prospects — speak credibly to Power Digital's data capabilities, CRM integration experience, and onboarding process
- Conduct pre-signature data audits: assess the prospect's CRM setup, lead data quality, attribution methodology, and integration complexity — flag custom data requirements and surface red flags before contract
- Partner with the Appraisal team to scope data complexity into deal pricing — translate CRM fragmentation, unstructured data ingress, and pipeline attribution requirements into effort estimates

Key Responsibilities:

• Process access, license and entitlement requests in the ticketing system within SLA, with the correct approval captured on every request

• Comfortable in spreadsheets: reconciling license counts, utilization and cost data

• Experience working in a ticketing system and following approval workflows

• Vendor management experience is a plus

• Detail-oriented with clear written communication; comfortable saying "not yet" politely when an approval is missing

• Advanced spoken and written English (B2 or higher) and availability overlapping US business hours

• Access Reviews & Offboarding – 100% of quarterly access reviews completed on schedule; 100% of leaver access removed within 24 hours of notification

• User Satisfaction – 4.5/5 or higher CSAT on post-ticket surveys

• Right access, right person, right time, with the approval on record

• Okta entitlements are structured by role and group, not improvised one-off

postings.title: Paid Advertising Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

A day in the life:

The Paid Advertising Strategist is responsible for owning the execution, performance, and growth of campaigns within their book of business. They are oriented towards the clients’ business success, tying their efforts to the greater business goals. They are self-starters and autonomously own their responsibilities. The Strategist works hand-in-hand with account leadership to ideate and evolve the strategy of their service within the broader media mix. They are responsible for owning reporting, optimizations, client communication, and execution of keyword research, ad copy development, bid optimizations, and routine campaign management, sometimes with the support of a Specialist. The Strategist is excellent at providing insights and forward-thinking strategy to clients on an ongoing basis and has a strong understanding of their service’s strategy and the levers to pull to drive performance.

Key Responsibilities:

• Full ownership and execution of performance marketing via paid social & paid media native platforms

• Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Youtube Ads, Bing Ads

• Effectively executing builds and production A-Z with redundancy across channels and 100% on time delivery

• Lead execution of optimizations with regard to performance improvements relative to goals

• Manage all client budgets and/or advise on budget changes based on your expertise with accurate budget pacing

• Sufficient QA that results in no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients

• Lead proactive strategy recommendations across assigned channels, surfacing opportunities and risks ahead of client requests.

• Maintain client testing roadmaps and project manage next steps, ensuring a consistent, ongoing cadence of experimentation.

• Escalate performance risks early, distinguishing normal fluctuation from genuine account risk requiring intervention.

• Effectively own strategic communication internally for client teams

• Proactive internal communication with team on performance, strategy, recommendations, deliverables, and action items; facilitating tactical needs with Specialists where applicable

• Weekly client progress recaps, outlining performance insights and future recommendations

• Consistent upkeep of client testing roadmaps and project management of next steps

• Excellent marketing and business strategy acumen

• Complete understanding of the marketing funnel and how to execute via paid social and paid media

• Full knowledge of the Power Circuit, adapting to the latest product processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your role

• Ability to navigate roadblocks and adapt strategy to changes in landscape to achieve desired results

• Ownership of performance reporting and strategy communication

• Ability to leverage data to tell a story and articulate results to clients and key stakeholders with clear next steps

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

Role Requirements:

• 2-3 years of digital marketing experience; 1-2 years in an agency setting

• Minimum 2-3 years of hands-on experience with at least 2+ of the following paid advertising channels

• Google/Bing, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat and other applicable paid advertising networks

• Specifically having experience with campaign development and optimization processes such as bid optimization, keyword research, ad copy development, campaign strategy, and optimizations

• Proficiency in Google/Microsoft Office Suite(s)

• Proficiency in Google Analytics

• Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing

• Other skills required:

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Strong organizational and project management skills

• Self-motivated individual with a strong desire to succeed

• Excellent interpersonal skills

• Confident with client-facing presentations and communication

• Strong work ethic and ability to learn quickly and independently

• Interested in a long-lasting relationship with a growing company

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Managing a full workload indicated by $28K revenue/employee

• 90% Client Retention, evaluated biannually

• Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 95%

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Excellence in channel production…

Definir y comunicar la dirección técnica del equipo, tomando decisiones sobre arquitectura de aplicaciones, diseño de servicios, integración entre sistemas y evolución de soluciones desarrolladas con .NET.




RESPONSABILIDADES:

 - Diseñar, desarrollar y escalar servicios y aplicaciones utilizando .NET Framework 4.7+ y .NET Core 6+, priorizando la confiabilidad, el rendimiento, la seguridad y la mantenibilidad.

 - Participar en decisiones de arquitectura técnica que involucren distintos equipos y servicios, definiendo estándares de integración, contratos entre APIs, manejo de dependencias y estrategias para la evolución de sistemas existentes.

 - Diseñar y revisar soluciones basadas en microservicios y sistemas distribuidos, considerando aspectos como escalabilidad, resiliencia, observabilidad y disponibilidad.

 - Elaborar y revisar documentación técnica, RFCs y propuestas de diseño, comunicando de forma clara los trade-offs técnicos y las decisiones de arquitectura a audiencias técnicas y no técnicas.

 - Resolver los problemas técnicos de mayor complejidad y alcance del equipo, incluyendo debugging de aplicaciones y sistemas distribuidos en ambientes productivos.

 - Liderar code reviews y design reviews, promoviendo altos estándares de calidad de código, buenas prácticas de desarrollo y soluciones simples, escalables y mantenibles.

 - Mentorear a Ingenieros(as) de distintos niveles, ayudándolos a desarrollar sus habilidades técnicas, resolver obstáculos y ganar autonomía, contribuyendo al desarrollo de futuros referentes técnicos dentro del equipo.

 - Trabajar en conjunto con Producto y Engineering Managers para transformar objetivos de negocio en soluciones y planes técnicos ejecutables, evaluando prioridades, riesgos y trade-offs.

 - Garantizar estándares de calidad y confiabilidad en el desarrollo, incluyendo testing, CI/CD, seguridad, manejo de errores, observabilidad y buenas prácticas de desarrollo asistido por IA.

 - Impulsar la evolución y modernización de aplicaciones existentes, identificando oportunidades para mejorar la arquitectura, reducir deuda técnica y facilitar el crecimiento de los productos y servicios.

 - Participar en el diseño, implementación y evolución de soluciones que utilicen tecnologías como SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, IIS, Nginx/Kestrel y contenedores, de acuerdo con las necesidades de cada servicio.





REQUISITOS:

 - Experiencia con .NET Framework (4.7+) y .NET Core (6 o superior).

 - Experiencia con arquitectura orientada a microservicios y sistemas distribuidos.

 - Configuración y optimización de servidores Windows (IIS, pipelines CI/CD).

 - Configuración y despliegue de aplicaciones .NET Core en Linux (Nginx, Kestrel, contenedores).

 - Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales (SQL Server) y NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).

 - Experiencia con APIs RESTful, versionamiento y seguridad (OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect).

 - Experiencia con sistemas de mensajería: Kafka, RabbitMQ o equivalentes.

 - Conocimientos de observabilidad: monitoreo, logs centralizados y métricas (Elastic Stack, Prometheus, Grafana).

 - Experiencia con Cloud Computing en al menos uno de los siguientes proveedores: Microsoft Azure, AWS o GCP.

 - Experiencia con CI/CD (Azure DevOps, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions).

 - Inglés y/o Español avanzado o fluido para la comunicación con socios internacionales.

 - Será un diferencial:
   
   - Deseable: Portugués avanzado.
   
   - Experiencia con lenguajes funcionales: Erlang, Elixir o Rust.
   
   - Conocimiento de contenedores (Docker) y orquestadores (Kubernetes).
   
   - Experiencia con Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
   
   - Certificaciones en Microsoft Azure o AWS.
   
   - Experiencia con Event Sourcing y streaming de datos.

 


OFRECEMOS:

 - Misión a nivel regional: lograr que los negocios de LATAM se despreocupen de su logística.

 - Ubicación: Argentina, Colombia.

 - Salario: Competitivo y negociable según experiencia, habilidades y resultados del proceso de contratación.

 - Esquema: 100% remoto.

 - Horario: Lunes a Viernes 8:00 a 17:00 CST (México).
   
   - Con flexibilidad de horario cuando haya nuevos releases.

 - Crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.

postings.title: Freelance Developer
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

The Role

We are looking for a Freelance Developer to join our team and help deliver high-quality, scalable digital advertising experiences. In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize dynamic creative campaigns across multiple ad serving and DCO platforms. You will work closely with Account, Project Management, Creative, and Media teams to transform campaign strategies into technical solutions, ensuring flawless execution, quality assurance, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Campaign Execution

• Develop and maintain responsive HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript banners, animations (e.g., CSS and GSAP), and modular templates for Dynamic Creative Optimization (DCO).

• Implement dynamic variables, business rules, and data feeds (CSV, JSON, XML, Google Sheets) to enable personalized campaigns at scale.

• Prepare publication packages, including naming conventions, packaging, tags, clickTags, and polite loading implementation.

• Upload and traffic creative assets and dynamic campaigns across DCO and ad serving platforms according to client technology stacks.

Collaboration & Operations

• Partner with Account, Project Management, and Client teams, as well as media agencies, to translate addressable marketing strategies into clear technical requirements.

• Support the definition of technical ways of working for new client accounts, including staging environments, repositories, and approval workflows.

• Estimate development effort and timelines while proactively identifying technical risks and limitations.

Quality Assurance & Launch

• Perform functional and visual QA across multiple creative variations, browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

• Validate tracking integrations (click, impression, and interaction tracking), brand safety requirements, and platform compliance.

• Provide QA documentation, including variation checklists, screenshots, and screen recordings when required.

Documentation & Technical Support

• Create and maintain technical documentation, template functionality guides, and internal implementation documentation.

• Provide technical support to Project Management and Creative teams during automation RFPs, including feasibility assessments, technical inputs, and scope definition.

• Assist with the onboarding of new platforms and tools by supporting initial setup and proof-of-concept implementations.

Continuous Improvement

• Promote and implement best practices for performance optimization, accessibility, naming conventions, and version control.

• Contribute to the evaluation of new third-party advertising solutions across display, social, and video channels through proof-of-concept projects.

Qualifications

Required

• 3–5 years of experience developing HTML5 banners and dynamic creative solutions for paid media campaigns.

• Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript, with experience using CSS and GSAP for animations, as well as sprite and video assets.

• Hands-on experience with DCO and ad serving platforms such as Google Marketing Platform (Studio, Campaign Manager 360, Display & Video 360), Flashtalking, Sizmek, Celtra, or similar technologies.

• Experience working with dynamic data feeds (CSV, JSON, XML), including field mapping, business rules, and data validation.

• Experience performing cross-browser and cross-device QA, optimizing creative performance (including lazy/polite loading), and troubleshooting tags and tracking implementations.

• Experience using version control systems (Git), project management tools (Jira, Asana, Trello), and design collaboration platforms (Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud).

• Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with the ability to read technical documentation and collaborate with global teams.

Preferred

• Experience with social DCO platforms (e.g., Meta Creative Hub, Smartly or similar).

• Familiarity with Connected TV (CTV), Online Video (OLV) specifications, and VAST/VPAID standards.

• Experience with template systems, build tools (NPM), templating engines, and code quality tools such as linters.

• Understanding of data layers, UTM tracking, measurement frameworks, and privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) as they relate to digital advertising creatives.

The Role

You will help create sophisticated consumer experiences by building and maintaining a mature, large-scale design system and a proprietary ecosystem of shared libraries and global elements (headers, footers, media galleries, analytics wrappers) used by multiple independent development teams using advanced HTML, CSS, and Javascript.

Embedded in a hybrid US and Argentina team, you will manage interdependent code repositories, resolve cross-repository dependencies, and collaborate with designers and engineers to define interaction behaviors.

Above all, your technical voice is just as important as your code. We thrive on open debate and live collaboration—As a Senior Developer we expect you to actively share your technical perspectives, challenge assumptions, and help drive design and engineering decisions.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

• Expert knowledge of HTML, CSS-SASS, JavaScript, and associated web development/production tools.

• Strong experience maintaining and extending libraries using Vanilla JavaScript

• Proven experience using, actively building, and maintaining a mature, large-scale design system.

• Experience developing website global elements and custom shared libraries - video , analytics, gallery

• Experience building web experiences fully compliant with WCAG 2.2 AA

• Experience with templates and task automation including handlebars, NPM, Gulp and Vite

• Advanced knowledge of responsive web design

• Experience with translating comps and wireframes into flexible and usable code

• Experience implementing pixel perfect designs across a broad range of browsers and devices

• Experience using version control software (git) in multi-developer team

• Experience with developing large customer-facing websites

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

Role Overview

We are looking for an Desktop Support to provide reliable and professional technical support to end users in a fast-paced corporate environment.

The role will primarily focus on Level 1 desktop and end-user support, covering hardware, operating systems, applications, connectivity, user access, and workplace technology. The position will support a mixed technology environment, including macOS and Windows devices, while working closely with Level 2 and specialist IT teams when required.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with a customer-focused approach, ensuring that users receive an efficient and professional IT support experience.

•
Escalate more complex issues to Level 2 or specialist teams with appropriate diagnostic information.

•

•

•

•

•
Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN troubleshooting.

•
Familiarity with user account, authentication, MFA, and access management.

•
Experience working with an ITSM / ticketing system and understanding of incident and service request management.

•
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

•
Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.

•
Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and requests in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable Skills

•
Experience with Apple device management or MDM platforms, such as Jamf Pro, Intune, Kandji, or Mosyle.

•
Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory and endpoint management.

•
Experience supporting Adobe Creative Cloud or other professional/creative applications.

•
Familiarity with Apple Business Manager and automated device enrollment.

•
Experience supporting iPhone and iPad devices.

•
ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL practices.

Personal Attributes

•
Customer-focused, approachable, and service-oriented.

•
Strong ownership and accountability when managing technical issues.

•
Structured and methodical approach to troubleshooting.

•
Comfortable working with both technical and non-technical users.

•
Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with wider IT teams.

•
Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

•
Strong attention to detail and commitment to IT and security procedures.

Education & Certifications

Degree, diploma, or equivalent experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

•

postings.title: Senior Motion Designer
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled Motion Designer with a strong technical profile—someone who can not only craft high-quality animated content, but also develop scripts and automation solutions to optimize workflows within After Effects and other post-production environments. This role is critical to scaling team productivity and maintaining an agile, organized, and efficient pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and animate content for digital platforms, social media, campaigns, and branded content.

• Develop reusable templates, toolkits, and assets.

• Collaborate closely with editors, designers, creative teams, and producers.

• Create scripts, expressions, and tools to automate repetitive tasks in After Effects.

• Integrate workflows across platforms (e.g., Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere, custom panels, external systems).

• Optimize rendering processes, versioning, and project organization.

• Troubleshoot complex technical issues and improve team efficiency.

• Contribute ideas and collaborate with creative teams to enhance output.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in motion graphics.

• Advanced proficiency in After Effects (mandatory).

• Strong working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere.

• Experience with scripting and expressions in After Effects (ExtendScript, JavaScript, AE Expressions).

• Proven experience in workflow automation (custom scripts, plugins, or APIs).

• Background in template creation and task automation.

• Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of additional tools and technologies.

• Experience with 3D tools and workflows.

Soft Skills

• Strong technical problem-solving abilities.

• Curious, self-driven, and innovation-oriented mindset.

• High attention to detail and strong aesthetic judgment.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

• Proactive approach to improving processes and building internal tools.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-NC1
Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy st atement . This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.
