We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

The role
  We are looking for a Freelance Web Graphic Designer with expertise in Photoshop for website production. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of the interactive space and its production requirements including resolution and outputs. In addition, candidates must be detail-oriented, comfortable working with multiple servers, organized, undaunted by working under tight deadlines, and have a keen eye for image quality.

Key responsibilities:

• Update product imagery and UI elements in Photoshop comps, and output web graphics

• Structure Photoshop comps to optimize efficient production and localization workflows using slices, smart objects, and layer comps

• Review final deliverables with an exacting eye, ensuring that layout, images, text, and links are flawless

• Track and check-in web graphics and visual assets using a version control system

• Ensure project deadlines are met and with accurate file handoffs for localization

• Support training of newer team members

Requirements:

• 3-5 years experience in a hands-on, high-volume web or HTML email design and publishing environment (or equivalent)

• Photoshop expertise, particularly setting up files for web production and adhering to graphic design standards

• Excellent design and typography sensibilities applicable to web pages and HTML email

• Familiarity with Sketch and GiT

• Solid standards-based HTML, CSS, and general web publishing knowledge

• Highly detail oriented, with a drive for perfection down to the last pixel

• Thrives in a challenging, fast-paced web publishing workplace

• Self-motivated with strong written and verbal communication skills

• Establishes rapport and collaborates easily with designers and web developers

• Able to adhere to a consistent graphic production and checkin process, while also identifying opportunities for improvement

• Resourceful, adaptable, creative, and results-oriented with high energy and a positive attitude

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-BS1
Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy st atement . This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.

postings.title: AI & Machine Learning Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.

AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.

What you’ll do

Are you passionate about a future that exceeds your expectations? Here, at AlixPartners your passion becomes your career. We work in smaller and more senior teams that bring deep industry and functional knowledge to our clients. You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with owners, boards, and CEOs to address the issues that sit at the top of their agendas - and often become front-page news.

If you join our practice, you will work with financially secure, under-performing and distressed companies across a variety of urgent, high impact situations. Our elite professionals are recognized experts in their respective fields, bringing to bear their skills and experience to craft measurable, improved outcomes for our clients.

The AI & Machine Learning Consultant is a full time employee role located in Buenos Aires, and the main responsabilities are:

• Model Development: Develop and refine models for pricing, forecasting future trends, and scoring to assess various metrics.

• Data Collection and Exploration: Gather and explore data to uncover insights that can help companies make better decisions.

• Work with Generative AI: Utilize generative AI technologies to automate processes traditionally performed by analysts.

• Dashboard Creation: Build dashboards for decision-making, providing a visual interpretation of data.

• Reporting: Generate reports with findings that can enhance business revenue and inform strategic decisions.

We are open to hire different seniority levels, apply to learn more!

This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.

What you’ll need

• Bachelor’s degree with concentration in Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative field

• More than 1 year of related experience.

• Proficient in Python for machine learning tasks.

• Machine Learning: Proficient in machine learning libraries such as Scikit-learn and XGBoost, with hands-on experience in building classification, regression, clustering, and forecasting models.

• Data Manipulation and Analysis: Proficient in using Pandas and NumPy.

• Statistical Analysis: Skilled in using SciPy and Statsmodels for advanced statistical analysis.

• Data Visualization: Competent in creating insightful visualizations with Matplotlib, Seaborn, and tools like Tableau or Power BI.

• Natural Language Processing: Familiar with text analysis using NLTK.

• SQL: Solid understanding of SQL for data querying and management.

• Databricks: Basic experience with Databricks for managing large-scale data processing.

• Apache Spark: Fundamental knowledge of PySpark for big data processing.

• Generative AI: Awareness of the capabilities and applications of generative AI technologies.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Ability to synthesize the requests received from team members at client sites.

• Capability to be a creative, innovative problem solver —but using simple ideas

• Motivated to discover and learn new analytical techniques and software tools to improve the quality of our work

• Authorized to work in applicable country and travel freely internationally without restrictions or visa sponsorship

• Desire to actively engage in geographically dispersed teams.

• Ability and willingness to work long hours and travel if necessary, to meet client demands

• Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday.

This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities. AlixPartners  is a results-driven global consulting firm that specializes in helping businesses successfully address their most complex and critical challenges. You can learn more about our  Culture   and Career Development opportunities ,

The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.

The benefit type and level differ per location.

AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, or disability.

Build and lead a top-talented engineering hub in Buenos Aires that delivers scalable, secure, and reliable software for our products portfolio.

Create scalable, reliable, and high-performing software solutions that multiply our clients’ results and drive business growth.

Build and ship LLM-driven product features (RAG, document Q&A, intelligent workflows) that drive user growth and revenue.

Take a hands-on role, both at the architecture and code level in advancing our technical goals, while being a steward of the local engineering team.

Key Responsibilities :

•
Drive the BA engineering hub for new and existing platforms and applications.

•
Accountable for delivering thought leadership, strategic direction, and technology guidance to achieve business outcomes.

•
Maintain clear, recurring communication with the Global Head of Engineering and provide actionable guidance to local Technical Leads.

•
Select, onboard, and manage local vendors and contractors aligned to global strategy; monitor delivery, quality, cost, and compliance.

•
Define and refine KRs with stakeholders and drive delivery according to business outcomes.

•
Foster close communication with stakeholders and product owners to improve transparency and SLAs.

•
Accelerate delivery of AI product features, tying engineering work to measurable user and business outcomes.

•
Drive adoption of modern software engineering principles, tools, and technologies to maximize efficiency and productivity.

•
Advance the maturity of the engineering guild through technical leadership and best practices.

•
Provide mentorship and promote continuous learning for Platforms engineers.

•
Lead technical decisions on AI-powered, user-facing products and connect engineering outcomes to business impact

What you’ll need

•
15+ combined experience working as a Software Engineer, Software Architect, Technical Lead, Technical Manager, or similar technical field.

•
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience.

•
Demonstrated expertise in software frameworks, technologies, and development.

•
A proven track record of collaborating on technical projects with cross-functional teams.

•
Deep experience in hands-on development work to stand up an architecture and drive the adoption within an organization.

•
Experience working in accordance with DevSecOps principles, and familiarity with industry deployment best practices using CI/CD tools and IaC (Infrastructure as Code).

•
Proven engineering leadership skills, including leading engineering teams and inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams towards a common goal.

•
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to craft innovative solutions.

•
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders and influence decision-making; adept at translating complex technical details to diverse audiences.

•
Management skills, including experience with OKRs and Agile methodologies.

• Business fluency in English and Spanish.

Additional qualifications

•
Developed software supporting business consulting fields or enterprise SaaS solutions.

• Hands-on experience building LLM-driven features in production (e.g. RAG, document intelligence, conversational AI)

•
Contributions to open-source projects or active involvement in tech communities.

•
Demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to mentor and uplift junior team members or peers.

postings.title: Senior Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.

AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.

What you’ll do

Are you passionate about a future that exceeds your expectations? Here, at AlixPartners your passion becomes your career. We work in smaller and more senior teams that bring deep industry and functional knowledge to our clients. You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with C-Level executives to address the issues that sit at the top of their agendas - and often become front-page news.

If you join our practice, you will work with financially secure, under-performing, and distressed companies across a variety of urgent, high impact situations. Our elite professionals are recognized experts in their respective fields, bringing to bear their skills and experience to craft measurable, improved outcomes for our clients.

In this role, you will ….

• Analyze corporate performance, drive cost reductions, and profitability improvement in your industry or functional area(s) of expertise in ‘high stakes’ situations.

• Create and execute organization transformation programs across multiple industries in complex situations

• Leverage publicly available data to create hypothesis and estimate value creation levers

• Interview industry experts and clients (internal and external) to gain insights on a given industry and company.

• Collaborate with clients and stakeholders, with the ability to build relationships, influence, and provide advice to key decision-makers.

• Prepare client-ready documents and compelling presentation materials.

• Leverage on internal tools to develop fast and accurate outcomes

• Use creativity and innovation to generate insights on companies (web scrape, analytics, benchmarking, reports)

We are open to hire different seniority levels, apply to know more!

What you’ll need

• Completed bachelor's degree with focus in Finance or Business Management. Advanced degrees or certifications a plus but not required (MBA, CFA, etc).

• Bilingual - Spanish & English. Proficiency in other languages is a plus.

• More than 2 years of related consulting experience in a professional services firm environment with client facing.

• High degree of proficiency with Excel and an ability to create in-depth financial analyses via modeling. Experience with Data visualization tools such as Tableau or PowerBI, preferred.

• Proficient with all Microsoft Office applications including Word and PowerPoint.

• Experience in leveraging publicly available data to create hypothesis and estimate value creation.

• Experience leading/coordinating teams and evaluating their performance, preferred.

• Synthesizes complex analysis, and identifies implications with attention to detail.

• Ability to rapidly analyze qualitative and quantitative information and accurately articulate conclusions and recommendations.

• Capability to be a creative, innovative problem solver —but using simple ideas.

• More than 1 year of relevant experience as an analyst in an investment, finance, private equity, investment banking, or related role (Desired)

• Highly developed verbal and written-communication skills.

• Strong judgement and decision-making skills.

• Demonstrate organizational skills and proven ability to multi-task in fast-paced environment.

• Detail-oriented, and self-motivated with track record of meeting tight deadlines in time sensitive situations while maintaining a professional demeanor.

• Outstanding interpersonal skills; team-oriented.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality.

• Authorized to work in Argentina and travel freely internationally without restrictions or visa sponsorship.

• Desire to actively engage in geographically dispersed teams.

• Ability to work in an office and within a remote environment.

• Physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday.

• Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization.

This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities. AlixPartners  is a results-driven global consulting firm that specializes in helping businesses successfully address their most complex and critical challenges. You can learn more about our  Culture   and Career Development opportunities ,

The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.

The benefit type and level differ per location.

AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, or disabi…

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.




THE ROLE

You will think like a founder: curious about the why, ruthless about priorities, and at your best when things move fast. You’re fine with not having all the answers, you learn quickly, and you do whatever it takes to win.

You’ll own some of ARQ’s most important business challenges, from figuring out where to grow next to making our operations work better at scale. You’ll combine sharp analytical thinking with hands-on execution, working directly with founders and teams across the business to turn ambiguous problems into clear priorities and measurable results.



What you'll be doing

 - Own strategic and operational initiatives end to end, from defining the problem and building the business case to execution and measuring results.

 - Identify opportunities to accelerate growth, improve unit economics, and make our operations more efficient.

 - Turn complex data, customer insights, and market research into clear recommendations - and put them into action.

 - Build and scale processes, tools, and workflows that help ARQ move faster, using AI and automation wherever they make a meaningful difference.

 - Define and track success metrics, spot issues early, and drive improvements across the business.

 - Work across product, engineering, operations, finance, and compliance to unblock decisions and deliver on shared priorities.

 - Lead partnerships with external providers - banks, processors, and other strategic partners - when relevant to your projects.



What you'll need

 - Previous experience thriving somewhere demanding, like MBB, a high-growth startup, or a business operating at significant scale.

 - Strong analytical skills. You can structure ambiguous problems, work confidently with data, and connect your analysis to business decisions.

 - A track record of getting things done. You take ownership of outcomes and follow through from recommendation to implementation.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication. You translate complexity into clarity for frontline teams and executives.

 - A bias to action and comfort with ambiguity. You might not always have all the answers, but you know how to find them and iterate quickly.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities without losing momentum.



Nice-to-haves

 - Experience in fintech, payments, or a highly regulated consumer business.

 - Experience at a high-growth startup from early to scale stage.

 - Experience launching or scaling businesses in Latin America.

 - Proficiency in SQL and experience using AI or automation to improve business processes.

 - Spanish or Portuguese language skills.




BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and benefits

 - Stock options, so you own part of what you build

 - Discretionary performance bonus

 - The latest tools and technology

 - A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

 - Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

postings.title: Account Executive (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

The Role

We are launching LATAM as a region, and are looking for founding enterprise sellers with high drive to join us. We are an untraditional SaaS revenue organization, built to support a rapidly scaling technology start-up driven by product-led-growth and sales (PLG / PLS). We need to expand our footprint in the region, working closely with partners to expand relationships and drive growth.

Specific responsibilities for Account Executives include nurturing larger named accounts and enterprise customers across Latin America – who are looking for a better way to connect with their customers, adopt AI, and find product-market fit.

You will work closely with customers end-to-end throughout their lifecycle – from concept to technical requirements, implementation, adoption, expansion, and paid. This is truly an expansive sales responsibility that spans selling, success, and support.

Activities related to this role will, for example, include:

• Expand outreach to your existing network and new opportunities across LATAM, working closely with BDRs to build and qualify pipeline.

• Develop and sell through channel and ecosystem partners (resellers, SIs, and technology partners) to extend reach and accelerate deals across the region.

• Relentlessly manage customer follow-up and your own pipeline, against quotas.

• Work with our Growth team to increase product awareness across the region.

• Nurture and follow up with customers to share relevant use cases, find key decision makers, and gather requirements.

• Guide customers through implementation plans to further adoption and drive paid conversion.

• Work with our Product and Engineering to share feedback and feature requests.

• Create content and refine scripts to support the customer journey and engagement points.

• Maintain pipeline data and account information in DevRev's in-house CRM.

• Travel up to 50% throughout the region.

Ideal Candidate Qualifications

• BA/BS, or equivalent educational or professional experience.

• 3–5 years in a quota-carrying, closing role selling enterprise software and/or AI solutions (SaaS, IT, or B2B technology).

• Experience working alongside BDRs to build and qualify pipeline, and driving joint outbound motions.

• Experience selling with and through channel/ecosystem partners (resellers, system integrators, technology partners) in the region.

• Professional fluency in Spanish and English; Portuguese is a strong plus for Brazil coverage.

• Familiarity with LATAM enterprise buying cycles, procurement dynamics, and business culture across multiple countries.

• Ability to connect with people deeply.

• Outstanding communication (written and spoken), collaboration, and follow-up skills, with professionalism and friendliness.

• Named account, customer success, account management, or other related experience.

• Understanding of customer journeys and product-development feedback loops.

• Some technical knowledge in cloud-based SaaS implementations and integrations.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, global environment.

How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

postings.descriptionText:
About DevRev

About the role

The Customer Engineer sits inside our Customer Experience (CX) team and is a customer-facing engineer who resolves the platform customer bugs that need an actual code change and builds important customer-facing features. Our CX model pairs two roles — Customer Outcomes (relationship and account ownership) and Customer Engineer (code and incidents) — both powered by Computer, our AI engine that handles L1–L4 diagnosis instantly, 24/7.

You are not a back-room ticket-closer. You are the subject-matter expert for a specific product area, lead the technical response when things break, and ship real fixes and features. Every fix you ship feeds back into Computer, so the next identical issue resolves automatically.

Responsibilities

Product-area specialist

• Own deep expertise in one area of the product (e.g. integrations, workflows, search/AI, platform).

• Be the go-to escalation point for issues in that area, across accounts.

• Keep Computer's knowledge sharp for your area — feed in fixes, edge cases, and known issues.

• Spot recurring problems and drive them to a permanent fix or product change, partnering with the core Engineering team that owns the area.

• Translate customer technical needs into clear product feedback for Product and Engineering.

Resolution and feature development

• Own and resolve complex, code-level platform customer bugs routed from Customer Outcomes for your product area.

• Build important customer-facing features and enhancements that directly address customer pain points and business needs.

• Use Computer's full L1–L4 diagnosis as a head start — you don't start from zero.

• Investigate root cause at the code level: logs, queries, API behavior, service interactions.

• Write, test, and deploy fixes and features — real resolutions, not just workarounds — and confirm them directly with the customer where relevant.

• Document every fix (what broke, why, how to prevent recurrence) and feed it back to Computer.

Incident management

• Participate in the on-call rotation within the Customer Engineering team to front customer-impacting incidents in your product area and mitigate them.

• Act as first responder: detect and confirm incidents, triage severity and impact, and communicate status to affected customers (plain language) and Customer Outcomes owners.

• Drive or support technical investigation and mitigation alongside core Engineering.

• Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, then turn every learning into Computer knowledge and a known-issue entry.

• Build playbooks from mitigated incidents so recurring problems can be handled faster — or resolved automatically by Computer next time.

What this role does not do

• Own the overall customer relationship or account book — that stays with Customer Outcomes; you own the technical relationship.

• Sit in a separate, deprioritized engineering backlog — you work inside CX, prioritized by customer impact.

Qualifications

• 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience.

• Strong proficiency in a backend language (Golang strongly preferred), with hands-on, production-grade coding experience.

• Prior experience in Customer Engineering, Sustenance/L4 engineering, or an equivalent support-focused, customer-facing engineering team.

• Strong debugging, logging, and observability mindset for distributed systems and microservices.

• Comfortable investigating root cause at the code level — logs, queries, API behavior, and service interactions — and writing, testing, and deploying both fixes and features end-to-end.

• Experience writing postmortems, root-cause documentation, and reliability/incident reports.

• Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Grafana, Datadog, Kibana, or similar).

• Comfortable with on-call responsibilities and leading incident mitigation.

• Excellent communication skills — able to explain root cause and fixes directly to customer engineering and admin stakeholders.

• Good to have: deep expertise in a product area such as integrations, workflows, search/AI, or platform; exposure to multi-tenant SaaS systems; working knowledge of frontend concepts (SPA frameworks, preferably ReactJS); and adoption of modern AI-assisted dev tooling (e.g. Cursor, Claude).

Code-fix and feature delivery time, % of issues resolved without core engineering, root-cause documentation rate, fix-recurrence rate, incident response / time-to-mitigate for your area, and the technical health of the accounts your product area serves.

About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About the Role
As part of the Global Partner Sales organization at DevRev, we are growing our team and hiring talented, ambitious, and AI-native Inside Partner Managers in the United States.

As an Inside Partner Manager at DevRev, you will operate at the intersection of partnerships, AI, and go-to-market execution. Your mission will be to expand and activate DevRev's partner ecosystem, generate qualified partner-sourced pipeline, and help shape our channel go-to-market strategy. Rather than relying solely on traditional partner-development methods, you will leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to identify partner opportunities, personalize engagement, and build meaningful relationships with prospective and existing partners at scale.

In this role, you'll work closely with Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to refine messaging, uncover ecosystem insights, and continuously improve how we recruit, onboard, and engage with partners.

What You'll Do

• Expand our partner pipeline by identifying and engaging high-quality prospective partners across target ecosystems and market segments (SIs, resellers, ISVs, and technology alliances).

• Research partners, principals, and co-sell signals using AI-powered tools and modern partner-development techniques.

• Build personalized outreach campaigns across email, phone, text, social, and emerging channels.

• Set up introductory meetings with target partner leaders and key decision-makers.

• Qualify partners by understanding their business model, practice areas, priorities, and go-to-market goals.

• Partner with Account Executives and Partner Solutions Engineers to develop co-sell strategies and create high-quality partner-sourced pipeline.

• Onboard newly signed partners and drive them into the deal-registration and co-sell motion quickly.

• Leverage AI-assisted workflows to increase productivity while maintaining thoughtful, high-quality engagement.

• Develop, test, and optimize messaging, prompts, and partner-recruitment playbooks to improve conversion rates.

• Analyze partner interactions, engagement data, and ecosystem trends to continuously improve targeting and outreach effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate pipeline data, partner records, and deal registrations within DevRev's CRM.

• Act as the voice of the ecosystem by sharing partner insights, objections, and feedback with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Revenue teams.

• Stay current on emerging AI technologies, partner/channel methodologies, and industry trends to continuously evolve your partner-development approach.

What We're Looking For

• BA/BS degree or equivalent educational or professional experience.

• Prior experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), Partner/Channel Development Representative, Account Executive (AE), or similar customer- or partner-facing role.

• Experience selling or partnering around SaaS, technology, or IT-related products.

• Experience with sales engagement platforms such as Outplay, Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, or similar tools.

• Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar technologies to support research, personalization, and workflow optimization.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to combine AI-generated insights with human judgment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with fluency in English.

• A growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to experiment and learn quickly.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and highly collaborative environment.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Genuine ability to build trust and connect deeply with people.

• Bonus: exposure to channel/partner ecosystems, deal registration, or co-sell motions.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

• You embrace AI as a force multiplier and continuously look for ways to work smarter and create more value.

• You are highly coachable and eager to learn.

• You enjoy experimenting, measuring results, and iterating quickly.

• You are resilient, resourceful, and energized by building something from the ground up.

• You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding how partners build their business.

How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The Role

AI is no longer a roadmap item — it's the operating system for how modern growth teams win. We're hiring a AI Native Engineer, Growth Marketing to be the hands-on builder who embeds AI into every corner of how our Growth team works: performance marketing, creative production, CRM, landing pages, growth ops, and beyond.

This is a rare hybrid role. You're equal parts engineer and growth practitioner — someone who can write a Python script in the morning, ship a Braze-connected AI workflow by afternoon, and explain the business impact to a non-technical stakeholder by EOD. You don't need to have done this at scale before — you need to be obsessed with building at the frontier of what's possible and have the technical chops to make it real.

You'll report directly to the Head of Growth and work across every subteam in the Growth org as their embedded AI engineer.

Responsibilities:

• Performance Marketing: Build AI-powered tools to automate bid strategy analysis, budget pacing alerts, creative performance scoring, and anomaly detection across paid channels (SEM, Meta, Affiliate, YouTube, etc.)

• Creative Studio: Develop AI workflows for ad copy generation, creative brief automation, image asset variation at scale, and creative performance feedback loops between analytics and the studio team

• CRM & Lifecycle: Implement AI-driven personalization and send-time optimization across email, SMS, push, and in-app channels; build agentic workflows that pull Snowflake data, generate segment logic, and trigger Braze campaigns with minimal manual intervention

• Landing Pages & Conversion: Automate LP variant generation, headline testing ideation, and personalization logic by audience segment or traffic source

• Growth Ops: Build internal AI tools — dashboards, Slack bots, report generators — that reduce repetitive analytical work and accelerate decision-making across the team

• Growth Product: Partner with Product and Engineering to identify where AI-powered features (recommendations, dynamic content, smart nudges) can accelerate funnel conversion and retention

• Tooling & Infrastructure: Evaluate, implement, and maintain the AI/ML toolstack that powers Growth — from LLM APIs to workflow orchestration tools to data pipelines

What Success Looks Like

• A measurable reduction in manual hours across mundane Growth through AI-driven automation

• At least 5-10 production-grade AI tools or workflows live and actively used by the team within the first 4 months

• CRM campaigns that are more personalized, faster to launch, and higher-performing because of AI assist

• Proficiency in Python or Typescript and comfort working with APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM providers)

• Build repeatable skills or plugins for popular LLM clients to empower your team

• Educate and mentor team members to become more AI-Native

• A builder's mentality: you'd rather ship a working prototype than write a spec about one

• Ability to work cross-functionally and translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred requirements:

• Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Agent SDK, n8n, Make, Zapier, or custom Typescript/Python pipelines)

• Prior work at a DTC subscription company or growth-stage startup

• Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or fine-tuning

• Experience building internal tools used by non-technical teams

• Familiarity with marketing platforms and data infrastructure — ideally some combination of Braze, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Snowflake, or equivalent

• Strong enough understanding of growth marketing to ask the right questions and build tools that practitioners actually want to use

Technologies You'll Use

• LLM APIs: OpenAI, Anthropic, and/or open-source models

• CRM & Marketing: Braze, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager

• Data: Snowflake, SQL, Tableau, dbt, Hex

• Orchestration: Typescript, Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, Python, n8n, Make, or similar

The Business Analytics team is the analytical engine behind CookUnity's growth. We sit at the center of the business to turn behavioral and marketplace data into the decisions that shape acquisition, retention, pricing, and membership. From forecasting and goal-setting to experiment readouts and board-level analysis, this team owns the numbers that leadership relies on to steer the company.

It's a small, high-trust team of analysts who work close to the business, own their stakeholder relationships directly, and hold each other to a high analytical bar through peer review.

The Role

We're looking for a Business Analytics Manager to lead our Business Analytics team and own the analytical strategy that drives CookUnity's core growth and retention agenda. Reporting to the Head of Data, you'll manage a team of analysts, set priorities against the company's most important questions, and be the analytical partner senior stakeholders come to when they need clarity.

This is a player-coach role. You'll spend part of your time leading — coaching analysts, managing stakeholder demand, and raising the quality of the team's work — and part of your time hands-on in the data on the highest-stakes questions.

You'll be stepping into a well-established function with strong momentum and a talented team, with the mandate to shape its next chapter as CookUnity scales.

postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

We are looking for a Real Time Analyst to work with the WFM Analyst. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining service level agreements (SLAs), improving workforce allocation, and providing actionable insights to stakeholders in real time.

The role:

As a Real-Time Operations Analyst at CookUnity, you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations across our CX teams. You’ll manage real-time data, support frontline teams, and help ensure we hit key performance targets. You don’t need to come in knowing everything about WFM—we’re ready to train the right person—but you do need to be analytical, action-oriented, and curious.

If you love digging into data, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are excited to support both people and processes, we’d love to meet you.

Note: You will be assigned a schedule that may include evenings, weekends, or holidays. These schedules will be adjusted periodically to meet the needs of our business.

Responsibilities:

• Monitor real‑time metrics (e.g. service level, average speed of answer, schedule adherence, occupancy, handle time) and identify deviations from targets.

• Monitor queue conditions, agent states, workload distribution, and available capacity throughout the assigned shift.

• Adjust resource allocation on the fly: reassign agents, manage breaks, redistribute workload, even skill our team dynamically to maintain performance.

• Collaborate with WFM Analyst and CX Leadership teams to ensure shift coverage and service targets.

• Maintain detailed logs of interventions, staffing changes, and performance shifts to support post-event analysis and process optimization.

• Provide KPI reporting and crisis management during outages or spikes, and maintain detailed logs for performance review.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives—help build dashboards, refine real‑time monitoring tools, and share best practices across teams

What You Bring

• Understanding of customer support or contact center operational metrics, including service level, average speed of answer, occupancy, adherence, average handle time, abandonment, and backlog.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including filtering, pivot tables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, and data formatting.

• Ability to interpret live operational metrics and make logical, timely decisions.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to escalate issues appropriately and communicate with stakeholders at different levels.

• Ability to remain calm and organized in a fast-paced environment.

• Proactive problem-solving skills and willingness to act within established guidelines.

• 3+ months of experience in workforce management roles .

• 6+ months of experience in a call center or customer support environment .

Nice-to-Haves

• Familiarity with Zendesk, Slack, Google Sheets, or similar operational tools.

• Experience with Workforce Management platforms such as NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar systems.

• Experience using Real-Time dashboards, alerts, or operational reporting.

• Prior exposure to incident communication or escalation processes.

• Experience supporting multichannel Customer Experience operations.

• Certifications in Workforce Management, analytics, Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or related disciplines.

Preferred Requirements:

• Logical thinking: You back decisions with data, not just instincts.

• Time management: You can juggle tasks and adapt quickly.

• Communication: You provide crisp, timely updates—especially when things change.

• Problem solving: You don’t wait for direction—you act when something’s off.

• Attention to detail: You catch small issues before they grow.

• Team collaboration: You work seamlessly with WFM, Ops, and CX teams.

• Willingness to learn: You’re curious and open to training in workforce management.

Interview process:

• Application review - Please submit your English version resume

• Preliminary Assessment

• Take home Test

🐣 Paid Family leave

postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

We are a small, hardworking, dynamic, and purpose-driven team focused on improving the way CookUnity creates and produces food. Our work centers on reducing environmental impact through real, operational initiatives: lowering food waste across all markets, strengthening responsible sourcing, elevating ingredient quality and nutrient value in our meals, and advancing lower-impact packaging solutions.

We partner closely with Culinary Ops, Chef Success, Supply chain to turn these commitments into daily practice, building cleaner standards, improving processes, and scaling innovations that make our meals better for people and for the planet.

The role:

We are looking for a recent Food Engineering graduate (or equivalent degree in Food Science or Technology) to join our team. The ideal candidate is organized, respectful, collaborative, analytical, and critical-thinking , with the potential to take leadership in research-oriented projects . They should be eager to learn, capable of structured analysis, and able to translate research findings into practical applications within our operations.

This role does not require prior field experience but demands a methodical and team-oriented mindset , curiosity for continuous improvement, and the ability to contribute ideas while following structured workflows.

Responsibilities:

• Actively work on the Food Science Lab Project (Ingredients Integrity + Nutrients Optimization) by researching, studying and analyzing every step of CookUnity’s food production process, from ingredients till meals are consumed by customers.

• Understand and evaluate how meals are produced, identifying opportunities to improve nutritional value and overall ingredient performance.

• Participate in the Ingredients Integrity program by evaluating ingredient quality, formulations, storage practices, and kitchen usage, while collecting and organizing data to strengthen standards, improve sourcing decisions, and support nutrient-forward upgrades.

• Gain in-depth knowledge of food additives, their functions in the industry, and their regulatory restrictions in different applications.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Chefs, Sourcing, Cullinary Ops and Nutrition) to ensure ingredient quality, safety, and consistency.

• Maintain clear, organized documentation and reports to support research and innovation projects.

• Contribute to the development of clean, high-standard recipes aligned with CookUnity’s mission to deliver better, healthier meals.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Food Engineering , Food Science , or a related field.

• Fluent English (written and spoken).

• Strong organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills. Strong data collection, communication, and problem-solving skills required

• Have the ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment - skilled at planning, organizing, prioritizing, and executing multiple projects and activities simultaneously.

• Experience and a high level of expertise in data entry, a food production enterprise resource or recipe management software, food labeling and compliance programs, GSuite, and Slack.

• Team player with a proactive, respectful, and detail-oriented attitude.

• Interest in food innovation, ingredient quality, and applied research .

• Optimistic, resourceful, and ready to take on any challenges

postings.title: Ingredients Sourcing Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the team

The Supply Chain team owns all raw materials, packaging & all kinds of items (office/cleaning & kitchen) supply and its distribution to the chefs/fulfillment. It’s a high-impact role with the ability to communicate constantly between all different areas of CookUnity. Our customers use our digital experience weekly to find their favorite meals from our 300+ menu items, and the Supply Chain team is responsible for making that easy and smooth for the operation.

The role:

We are looking for an Ingredient Sourcing Analyst to connect CookUnity’s culinary needs with operationally sound sourcing decisions. You will evaluate ingredient and supplier options, lead sourcing projects, coordinate testing and rollout, and help ensure ingredients are high-quality, cost-effective, and available when needed.

You will partner with category leads on assigned sourcing projects and selected subcategories, with priorities determined by category needs. The role combines supplier evaluation, product-quality improvement, ingredient testing, and disciplined sourcing execution.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain secondary-sourcing coverage for assigned ingredients, validating true like-for-like substitutes, supplier availability, on-hand quantities, and lead times.

• Contribute to category and supplier strategy through priority sourcing projects, subcategory analyses, Request For Proposal (RFP) processes, supplier identification, pricing, contracting, and rollout.

• Lead assigned RFPs end-to-end and support cross-category projects from industry analysis and sample coordination through Culinary testing, recommendation, and implementation.

• Develop supplier strategies for ingredients with quality concerns, inconsistent specifications, or limited supplier coverage; evaluate options to improve product quality and supply continuity.

• Coordinate bench samples and market-level pilots with Culinary and other stakeholders; document results and recommendations before network rollout.

• Coordinate approved ingredient and vendor setup across Wholesaleware, Parsley, Supplier Service, and NetSuite, ensuring accurate information and clear operational handoffs.

• Establish a dependable forecast cadence with suppliers and distribution partners; monitor on-hand quantities, lead times, and potential supply risks.

• Respond to new-ingredient and meal-related requests, communicate status, and route work through the appropriate intake and stage-gate process.

• Manage credit-memo resolution and reduce preventable or repeat issues; support workflow automation and the planned handoff of transactional ownership to ISC or the appropriate operational team.

• Improve sourcing processes, handoffs, and operating discipline by documenting learnings and standardizing repeatable workflows

Qualifications

• Degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field.

• Experience or strong interest in ingredient sourcing, procurement, quality, or food industry operations.

• Solid understanding of food ingredients specifications and food standards compliance (or willingness to develop this expertise).

• Advanced English level (written and spoken).

• Excellent communication, collaboration and negotiation skills with cross-functional teams and external suppliers.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to evaluate ingredient specs and supplier information.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally and managing multiple sourcing requests.

• Highly organized, proactive and able to follow structured processes. High autonomy and ownership on goals to achieve.

Preferred requirements (but not mandatory)

• Background or exposure to culinary-driven environments (meal kits, foodservice, hospitality, CPG).

• Knowledge of regional sourcing, clean-label ingredients, or sustainability-oriented procurement practices.

• Understanding of ingredient regulatory constraints , spec sheets, and documentation.

• Experience using ChatGPT and/or Claude to automate processes and optimize workflows.

• Experience with Monday.com or equivalent project management tools.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD.

🗺 Hybrid Work Model: Design a work-life balance that fits you! Work remotely and from our Lima office on the days of your choice.

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5-year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Family leave of 12 weeks for primary caregiver and 6 weeks for secondary caregiver, fully paid

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page .

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

postings.title: Product Manager, Your Private Chef
postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the role

Your Private Chef is CookUnity's premium, personalized chef meal service, currently moving from pilot to scale. We're looking for a Product Manager to own YPC end-to-end and to also support the B2B product team as a generalist on other initiatives when needed.

Responsibilities

• Own the YPC roadmap: subscriber personalization, wellness menu verticals (GLP-1, Everyday Wellness, Fitness Fuel, Healthy Heart, Blood Sugar Balance, Kids), and menu recommendation logic.

• Own the chef and recipe pipeline: chef onboarding, recipe intake, tagging, and QA.

• Work with kitchen and vendor partners on ingredient sourcing, costs, and kitchen tooling.

• Manage pricing tiers (standard, premium, extra premium) and unit economics.

• Support the B2B product team more broadly — Smart Fridges, partnerships, integrations — as a generalist when capacity is needed.

• Bring structure to a fast-moving, early-stage product as it expands into new markets.

What success looks like

• YPC has a clear backlog, fewer manual workarounds, and measurable improvements in retention and CSAT.

• The chef/recipe pipeline scales without sacrificing quality or personalization.

• Pricing and vendor economics are transparent and defensible as the product scales.

• Teams have clarity on what we're building, why, and what success means.

• Leadership trusts you with increasingly complex, cross-functional problem spaces.

What we're looking for

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager.

• Comfortable owning a product end to end, from strategy to execution.

• Strong communicator, works well across stakeholders, engineering, design, ops, and CX.

• Business-minded: cares about retention, margin, and outcomes.

Strong plus

• Passion for wellness, nutrition, or the food-is-medicine space.

• Experience with subscription, personalization, or recommendation-driven products.

• Experience with marketplace/vendor management or culinary/hospitality products.

• Experience taking a product from pilot to multi-market scale.

• Startup or high-growth environment experience.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach
If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page .

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

The CookUnity Product Support Team plays a crucial role as the initial responders to customer-related issues, coordinating efforts among various teams and ensuring stakeholders stay updated. They take charge of the Incident Management process, emphasizing the importance of learning from any system outages or disruptions.

The Role:

We are looking for a Product Support Engineer with solid analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of communicating effectively with tech and business areas, along with having a strong level of technical background in technical troubleshooting and run database SQL queries.

For new categories and ordering formats, define the measures that show whether customers find value and whether the model can scale.

• Reduce the work and stress of ordering: Combine behavioral data with research and customer feedback to understand where subscriptions, delivery information, account management, or support journeys create friction. Measure whether self-service and product improvements solve the underlying problem, not just move contacts to another channel.

• Build a trusted measurement foundation: Define and document product metrics, cohorts, event tracking, and dashboards. Work with Engineering and Data partners to validate instrumentation and maintain reliable behavioral data. Create compelling dashboards that let product teams explore results, spot meaningful patterns, and monitor outcomes after launch.

Share methods and review work with other analysts to raise the quality of product analytics across the team.

• Stakeholders trust and regularly use self-service reporting, and core behavioral data is sufficiently complete to diagnose product performance.

Data Analysts are the people who form a marriage of minds with product, marketing and commercial managers and provide them the insights they need to drive improvements in their products. They explore data, create impactful visualizations and visualization and design and analyze experiments to fuel team learning and innovation. Over time, as both the learning needs and the analysts' understanding of how to address them mature, they build their understanding into self-service insights dashboards that enable learnings to be generated without the direct support of data professionals. This creates the opportunity to go deeper on other areas. It’s a role where mastery in metric setting, visualization, data storytelling, experimentation and partnering come together to facilitate team measurement and learningwithin their daily rhythms.

Uncover patterns and trends in menu discovery, evaluation and ordering actions, informing the improvement of the marketplace experience. Success will be measured by the number of insights that have led to improvements in user experience and engagement metrics, resulting in increased customer satisfaction and retention.

• Enable self-service insights where you can: Develop intuitive, interactive data visualizations in Tableau that empower stakeholders to easily explore and understand key metrics and trends. Create storytelling narratives within the dashboard that guide users through the data, enabling them to derive actionable insights independently. Success will be measured by the adoption of the dashboard among stakeholders and the frequency of use in decision-making processes, indicating improved data literacy.

Produce learnings and work closely with user experience researchers to help the product teams understand the why of their successes and failures. Success will be measured by the number of major product features where roll out and full development is evidenced through early testing and light touch experimentation.

Proactively identify new unknown learning needs that can inform product direction and improve the user experience. Success will be measured by the number of product iterations and innovations that successfully move the product team's success metrics, as a result of your insights.

Define target schemas and work with engineers to implement common schemas design principles and conventions as needed to maintain data quality and integrity at source. Success will be achieved by ensuring complete and accurate data collection, enabling a clear understanding of Marketplace performance through well-defined and reliable data sources.

The Role

CookUnity is looking for a Staff Product Manager to own our ChefTech team and lead the direction of ChefOS Platform, the product chefs use to run their business with us.

ChefTech is the chef relationship and content layer of our operation. It covers how chefs join the platform, how their recipes become sellable products on our menus, and the tools they use every day: the Chef Portal, the chef mobile app, and the business surfaces where chefs manage their ratings, sales, payouts, and performance.

The broader mandate is ChefOS Platform. A chef's experience with us currently lives across several separate tools. This role owns the vision for bringing them into one product: a single place where a chef handles onboarding, recipes and menu, kitchen operations, and the performance and pay that come out of all of it. It's a wider vantage point than any single squad, drawing on work that runs across the operation and pulling it into one experience for the chef.

There's a larger ambition behind this. We believe the platform we build for our own chefs can become a modular, white-label product for other restaurants and food businesses. That work is greenfield. It calls for someone who can set product direction in open territory, where the problem itself still has to be defined.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll partner closely with Design and Engineering, and there's room to grow a team beneath you over time as the platform scales.

What You'll Do

Own the ChefTech product surface

• Set the roadmap and OKRs for chef onboarding, recipe and product activation, the Chef Portal, and the chef mobile app, and deliver against them each cycle.

• Own these products end to end, from the problem through launch, adoption, and the iterations that follow.

• Partner with Engineering and Design to build and improve the tools chefs use to run their business with us.

Know the chef deeply

• Build a direct line to chefs through interviews, surveys, and ongoing conversation, and use it to understand their needs and where the tools fall short.

• Anticipate what chefs need before it surfaces as a problem, and turn that understanding into product direction.

• Spend real time with chefs using the tools, so each iteration is grounded in how they actually work.

Lead the ChefOS Platform vision

• Define what a unified chef platform looks like and build the multi-quarter plan to get there.

• Pull the separate chef tools into a single, connected product.

• Make the case for platform investments and secure the resourcing to deliver them.

Shape the greenfield opportunity

• Develop the direction for turning the platform into a modular, white-label offering for restaurants and food businesses.

• Set strategy in areas where no precedent exists and the problem is still open.

• Frame large, ambiguous problems in a way the rest of the organization can build against.

Prototype and keep improving how you work

• Build prototypes to test ideas early and cheaply, before committing to a full build.

• Use AI across your workflow (prototyping, drafting, research, analysis) and keep experimenting with it to work faster and improve the quality of your output.

Drive measurable impact

• Own the outcomes that matter to chefs: how quickly they onboard, how smoothly their recipes reach the menu, how much of the toolset they adopt, and how well the platform supports their business.

• Define how success will be measured before the build starts, so impact is provable.

• Surface progress, risk, and results to senior leadership.

You Are

• Experienced owning product at the platform or multi-product level, able to hold a wide, connected surface without losing the thread.

• Comfortable setting direction when the problem is undefined and there's no precedent to lean on.

• Effective at moving work across teams you don't manage, through influence and clear alignment.

• Low-ego at the seams between your work and adjacent teams, without letting accountability blur.

• Trusted for your judgment by senior stakeholders, and sought out when a hard problem needs framing.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a platform or several connected product lines rather than a single feature area.

• A track record of 0-to-1 work: taking on large, undefined problems and setting direction where there was none.

• Experience leading complex, multi-team programs that required aligning and influencing teams you didn't own.

• Product judgment that senior stakeholders trust as an input to strategy.

• Ability to break down big, ambiguous problems and give others a way to reason about them.

• Excellent communication across engineering, operations, and executive audiences, including turning cross-team conflict into decisions that hold.

• Comfortable using AI tools in your product work, with a habit of experimenting to work faster and better.

• This role requires regular in-person travel to the US.

• Bonus: experience with operational, supply chain, marketplace, or B2B platform products, or packaging an internal platform into a product for external customers.
